abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide metal fittings capable of sufficiently maintaining strength of a joint section when a sleeper for a large cross section is constructed, solving such a problem as the occurrence of the condensation or the fragility in the case of a disaster, reducing processing expenses of a member and, in addition, being used for joining a foundation enabling also cracks occurring in the sleeper to control with the sleeper and a connector making use of the metal fittings.  <P>SOLUTION: Since a part of load acting on the sleeper 41 is transferred to the sill 31 from the uneven step line 17 of the metal fittings 11 by connecting the sleeper 41 having a large cross section to the sill 32 by using the connector constituted of the metal fittings 11 forming an step line 17 capable of being mounted on the upper surface of a sill 31, a fastening member consisting of a bolt 14 for fixing the metal fittings 11 to the sill 32 and a nut 15 and a drift pin 16, the concentration of the load to everyone of the sill 32, the sleeper 41 and the metal fittings 11 can be prevented to make it possible to surely maintain reliability of a building.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Method for predicting dynamic risk and vulnerability under fine dimension
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predicting dynamic risk and vulnerability at fine scale and belongs to the scientific field of global information. The method is mainly characterized in that an optimized Bayesian network is searched from multi-source heterogeneous spatiotemporal data on the basis of a grid format with certain resolution at fine scale; domain knowledge is combined to improve the network; therefore, the uncertain estimation of disaster risk and the vulnerability, namely probability estimation, is carried out. In the method, a nuclear density method is put forward to train a sample according to a sample derivative grid; an optimized discretization method is put forward to discretize continuous variables so as to provide discrete state space input for the network; a simulated annealing optimization algorithm is adopted to search an optimized network structure; and a method of accurate reasoning combined with approximate reasoning to predict the probabilities of risk and the vulnerability is adopted. The method provided by the invention can position the positions of the disaster risk and the vulnerability in real time at the fine spatial scale, estimate the spatial distribution of the risk probability and has important theoretical significance and practical value for improving the effects on the reduction and relief of disaster and building an intelligent public emergency pre-warning system by the state.

title_en: Electric generator reconstruction hydraulic cylinder device
title_ko: 유압 실린더 장치를 재 구성한 발전시스템
abstract_en: An electric power system remaking a hydraulic cylinder device is provided to produce non-polluted electricity by using a hydraulic cylinder equipped with a cylinder shaft, a joint shaft, and a clutch gear set and obtaining big power from small electrical energy. An electric power system remaking a hydraulic cylinder device comprises hydraulic cylinder devices(1,2). The hydraulic cylinder obtains the big power from small electrical energy. The hydraulic cylinder comprises cylinder shafts(3,4), joint shafts(5,6), and clutch gear sets(7,8). The cylinder shaft pushes the joint shaft as a two-stroke piston. The joint shaft is converted from linear motion to rotational motion and rotates the clutch gear set. The connection shaft is connected to the cylinder shaft and the clutch gear set and increases torque. Excessive electric energy over 90% is obtained by power generation consumption electricity below 10%. Three back up batteries are equipped and self-driving is performed in power outage.

title_en: Railway disaster prevention wind early warning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a railway disaster prevention wind early warning method which is based on wind historical data of a wind data acquisition subsystem in a railway disaster prevention system, identifies a wind early warning probability mathematical model of the point through analysis of sample points formed by the wind historical data, and calculates the condition of wind speed distribution of the next stage through the model and the current wind speed. The method is used for predicting the probability of the strong wind in the next stage under the condition of the current wind and giving early warning to the wind speed in the next time interval in a confidence interval mode.

title_en: Disaster-preventing ecological roof tile and structure thereof
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve the problems of conventional predominate roof tiles such that a pottery roof tile highest in heat-insulating property among them is heavy in weight and apt to cause the penetration of rainwater due to its fragility, and its heavy body weight is the main factor of collapse of a wooden structure; reflection of solar light to the air or release of radiation heat runs counter to prevention of warming; and the temperature difference between the outside and the inside is bad for health and causes molding or the like through dew condensation.  <P>SOLUTION: The disaster-preventing ecological roof tile is a structure composed of a foam body in low density. Therefore, this roof tile can be extremely reduced in weight to reduce a member strength, and thus allows replacement without needing reinforcement in reform or the like to promote earthquake countermeasures. The disaster-preventing ecological roof tile structure is excellent in heat insulation to secure an exterior thermal insulation effect for a structure. Therefore, the temperature difference between room temperature and outside air can be eliminated to prevent dew condensation. Further, a living environment which is cool in summer and warm in winder can be attained with increased ecological effect such as reduction in usage of an air conditioner or the like. The penetration of rainwater observed in the pottery roof tile can be also prevented by eliminating a gap by an EPS heat-insulating base.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Beach area predicating method based on Bayesian dynamic model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a predicating method of beach area. The method comprises the following steps of: obtaining Shanghai beach area in the recent 10 years through combination of RS (Remote Sensing), GPS (Global Positioning System) and GIS (Geographic Information System); selecting an initial training set of a Bayesian dynamic model according to the data; calling the model for predication; and comparing a predicating result with an actual value until the predicating result falls within a confidence interval of the actual value. By using the predicating method disclosed by the invention, fine predicating structure is obtained, the predicating accuracy is also improved while data expense is saved, a tool is provided for coastal fishermen to avoid marine disaster in the operation, and contributions are also made to national disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Evaluation method of debris flow disaster risk based on Bayesian network model
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an evaluation method of the debris flow disaster risk based on a Bayesian network model. The evaluation method is characterized by comprising the following steps of: determining an evaluation unit; obtaining an evaluation index of the debris flow disaster risk of the evaluation unit by processing an evaluation parameter of the debris flow disaster risk of the evaluation unit; creating a training sample set according to historical data of the debris flow disaster risk in the evaluation unit and the evaluation index; creating the Bayesian network model according to the training sample set; and evaluating the debris flow disaster risk in an area to be evaluated by adopting the Bayesian network model. According to the evaluation method provided by the invention, the Bayesian network model is created by combining the historical data of the debris flow disaster risk in the evaluation unit and the evaluation index, the debris flow disaster risk in the area to be evaluated is evaluated by adopting the Bayesian network model, the accuracy of a debris flow disaster risk evaluation result is greatly increased, and the debris flow disaster risk in the area to be evaluated can be accurately evaluated by adopting the evaluation method.
assignees: INST GEOG SCI & NR RES CAS

title_en: Method for prewarning Doppler radar remote sensing strong storm
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic prewarning method for strong storms. Doppler weather radar data is used. According to identification on storms, false combination of storms can be successfully identified by adopting a method based on mathematical morphology, namely expansion operation and corrosion operation are comprehensively used during multi-threshold identification, and relatively near storms can be separated from a storm cluster; then, according to tracking of the storms, the tracking process is greatly simplified by adopting a sequential monte carlo method, and situations of splitting, combination and leakage detection of the storms can be handled; and finally, the storms are prewarned, namely linear fitting extrapolation prewarning is realized by being combined with a motion vector field obtained by an optical flow method. According to the method, complicated situations that radar echo is densely distributed and frequently split and combined can be handled. The method has the advantages that a prewarning software system is arranged in provincial and municipal weather stations; high-convection weather prewarning service is provided; and the urgent demands for preventing and reducing disasters in China are met.

title_en: A kind of wind farm risk evaluation method based on monte carlo method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of wind energy turbine set disaster risk estimation method based on monte carlo method.The present invention includes following steps, step (1) is set up based on the wind series forecast model of time series method; First, raw data standardization: secondly, Model Identification: then, parameter is determined: step (2) allusion quotation is based on the bulk power system reliability assessment taking into account wind energy turbine set of sequential Monte Carlo method; First, random sampling: secondly, reliability assessment: the present invention is based on a large amount of wind-powered electricity generation database, take into full account the randomness of wind speed; And adopting Monte Carlo fast algorithm, speed is fast.

title_en: Lattice type single-row reinforcing bar L-shaped section concrete column
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lattice type single-row reinforcing bar L-shaped section concrete column, and belongs to the technical field of shock absorption and disaster prevention. A steel bar framework of the L-shaped column is L-shaped. Two pieces of lattice single-row reinforcing fabric (3) are welded to form two limbs which are in an L shape. Pieces of ladder-lattice-shaped reinforcing fabric (2) are welded on the end portions of the two limbs of the L-shaped lattice single-row reinforcing fabric (3). Tie bars (4) are vertically welded on the centers of transverse horizontal steel bars of the ladder-lattice-shaped reinforcing fabric (2), and are distributed at even intervals along the direction of the height of the column. The lattice type single-row reinforcing bar L-shaped section concrete column utilizes single-row reinforcing bars, so that construction is simple and steel bar consumption is low. Lattice reinforcing steel pieces are welded to form the reinforcing bars, and therefore the lattice type single-row reinforcing bar L-shaped section concrete column is suitable for industrial production. The lattice reinforcing bars are utilized, inclined web bars are good in shearing resistance, and therefore fragility shearing destruction of deformed-section short columns is prevented and anti-earthquake ductility of the lattice type single-row reinforcing bar L-shaped section concrete column is improved. In the end portions of a section of the lattice type single-row reinforcing bar L-shaped section concrete column, short steel bars are utilized to be combined with ecological wall boards or ecological wall bricks closely, so that the purposes that the integrity of a house is enhanced and overall anti-earthquake and energy-dissipated capacity is improved are achieved. Accordingly, the lattice type single-row reinforcing bar L-shaped section concrete column is applied to rural houses.

title_en: Wind power farm risk assessing system based on Monte Carlo method
abstract_en: Embodiments of the utility model disclose a wind power farm risk assessing system based on the Monte Carlo method. The risk assessing system comprises a data processing module, a wind speed predicting module, a random sampling module and a risk assessing module. The output end of the data processing module makes wind speed standardization data input into the wind speed predicting module. The output end of the wind speed predicting module outputs wind speed predicting signals to the random sampling module. The output end of the random sampling module outputs element state signals of an electric power system to the risk assessing module. The system which is applied for setting up a large power grid system reliability rapid analysis model applied for wind power farm calculation and based on Monte Carlo simulation takes the randomness of the wind speed and the forced outage rate of a wind generation set into full consideration and performs reliability assessment on a large power grid system of calculated wind power farms. The wind power farm risk assessing system has a wide application prospect and potential economic values.

title_en: Based on game theoretic large-scale crowd evacuation optimum escape route generating method
abstract_en: The present invention is in order to when there is disaster, during simulation large-scale crowd evacuation, calculate the Evacuation Strategies of optimum, and during this basis is to whole evacuation occur crowding phenomenon, each evacuates the crowd density situation in path, critical path artificial abortion's situation is analyzed statistics, it is achieved the generation to the optimal strategy of crowd evacuation.The present invention provides a kind of optimization method based on game theoretic large-scale crowd evacuation path, according to disaster radiation areas scope, at a distance of Safe Escape Distance, the safety measure number that best-effort path includes, degree of crowding factor carries out quantitative risk analysis, and quantitative risk analysis uses Monte Carlo model, using the Risk Results of assessment as the input parameter of the revenue function of path game, determine to evacuate the choice in path by game theory, form optimum dispersal plan.

title_en: Circuit on power system state transition probability prediction analysis method under vile weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses the circuit on power system state transition probability prediction analysis method under a kind of vile weather, comprises the following steps：A：Build with line fault probability as dependent variable index and with meteorological factor as the regression model of independent variable index；B：Calculate the flow transferring relativity factor of other each branch roads after certain branch road breaks；C：Obtain each branch road cascading trip probabilistic model；D：Obtain line status transition probability model under bad weather condition.The present invention can realize each membership transition probability assessment under bad weather condition, so as to obtain high-risk fault branch information, it is ensured that electrical network is run in inclement weather with security and stability.

title_en: The method that assessment mountain fire causes transmission line malfunction probability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of method assessing mountain fire initiation transmission line malfunction probability, belong to Power System and its Automation technical field。Present invention achieves mountain fire and cause the qualitative assessment of transmission line malfunction probability, the mechanism of transmission line malfunction is caused according to mountain fire, establish line fault probabilistic model accurately, correctly reflect the inside and outside portion factor relevant to transmission line malfunction, make mountain fire cause line fault probability assessment and be not necessarily dependent on the accumulation of historical data, and it is contemplated that key factor, there is very strong adaptability。The present invention has greatly promoted transmission line of electricity risk management, improves the ability of power system defence external disaster。

title_en: Substation operation risk evaluation method based on graph theory
abstract_en: A substation operation risk evaluation method based on a graph theory comprises the following concrete steps: carrying out data input and constructing an input data module for substation operation risk evaluation; using an element outage model module to calculate the outage probability of substation elements; using a Monte Carlo module to simulate the randomness for the substation elements to exit operation so as to form a substation system state; identifying connectivity of the system state of the substation by a graph theory method and judging whether a load point is communicated with a power supply point; and evaluating a substation operation risk and calculating a corresponding substation operation risk index. According to the substation operation risk evaluation method of the invention, consideration is given to the randomness of substation events, the system state of the substation is extracted by a Monte Carlo method, the method of identifying the connectivity through the use of the graph theory is proposed, substation main wiring risk evaluation is converted into a problem of identification of connectivity between the load point and the power supply point inside the substation, the complexity of problem analysis is simplified, and the purpose of substation operation risk evaluation is achieved.

title_en: Power grid operating state assessment method based on risk theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid operating state assessment method based on the risk theory. The method comprises the following steps: data is collated, and a data processing module is established; the outage probability of power grid elements is calculated; the element outage probability data is stored; the power grid operating state is extracted through the Monte Carlo method; the system state is analyzed; system state analysis is performed through a submodule 5 to judge whether problems, such as the circuit overload problem, the voltage out-of-limit problem, the bus isolation problem, the problem that a system is separated into isolated islands, etc., occur; the power grid operating risk indicators are calculated; and the power grid operating state risk indicator result is analyzed to give out the weak link of the power grid. According to the invention, risk assessment is performed on the power grid operating state; the actual operating state of the power grid is simulated by using the Monte Carlo method, the event random nature of the power grid is taken into account reasonably; different risk indicators are used, multi-angle and multi-level assessment is performed on the power grid operating state risk; and the power grid operating state risk assessment result is analyzed to give out the weak link of the power grid.

title_en: Differentiation based power transmission network anti-disaster ability planning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a differentiation based power transmission network anti-disaster ability planning method which is used for improving an anti-disaster ability of a power transmission network when a meteorological disaster occurs. The differentiation based power transmission network anti-disaster ability planning method comprises the steps of: firstly, developing an IEEE standard based tri-state meteorological condition to obtain a relationship between a fault rate of a power transmission line at different anti-disaster protection levels and the meteorological disaster; obtaining a fragility index and a goal by utilizing Monte Carlo simulation and an optimized load shedding algorithm. The fragility index and a planned construction cost serve as an objective function of multi-goal power transmission network planning; an NSGA-II algorithm is used for obtaining optimal Pareto disaggregation of a power distribution network planning scheme and is used for decision-making in the later period. The verification shows that the provided power distribution network planning method can determine the anti-disaster protection level of each power distribution line exactly, accordingly improves the anti-disaster ability of the power distribution network efficiently when the meteorological disaster occurs, meanwhile reduces line construction cost to the maximum extent and achieves important reference value for the planning of the power distribution network in the environment where meteorological disasters occur frequently.

title_en: One adopts fragmented rock body water sand migration pilot system and monitoring method

title_en: Hydroenergy storage station participates in the dispatching method containing wind-powered electricity generation electric power system
abstract_en: The invention provides the dispatching method that a kind of hydroenergy storage station participates in containing wind-powered electricity generation electric power system, first the installed capacity of hydroenergy storage station is divided and carry out option screening and obtain feasible program, then set up according to different feasible programs the scheduling model a few days ago that hydroenergy storage station participates in containing wind-powered electricity generation electric power system; Then solving model obtain the operating point of hydroenergy storage station regulating units, the Unit Combination of fired power generating unit and operating point under different feasible program, system operating cost and abandon air quantity; What relatively contain wind-powered electricity generation electric power system under each feasible program abandons air quantity, if it is inconsistent to abandon air quantity, then choosing and abandoning the minimum scheme of air quantity is optimal case; Otherwise, total positive and negative spinning reserve that each period system can provide is calculated according to the above results, use the expected loss of energy of Monte Carlo simulation approach computing system and then obtain outage cod, finally compare the total cost under each feasible program, and to choose the minimum feasible program of total cost be optimal dividing scheme.

title_en: Method for quickly evaluating economic losses generated by landslides caused by earthquakes
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for quickly evaluating economic losses generated by landslides caused by earthquakes. The method includes the steps that firstly, a study area is divided into different geological areas according to geological classes, and then gradient data of the study area are acquired; safety coefficients of the geological areas are calculated, limit acceleration and ground motion peak acceleration data of the geological regions are calculated, risk parameters of the landslides probably causing the economic losses of the geological areas are calculated, and the average value of the risk parameters of the landslides in each county is acquired with the county as the unit; economic fragility parameters of each county are calculated, reduction coefficients are calculated for the areas where the earthquake intensity limit degree is larger than or equal to VI or ground motion peak acceleration is larger than or equal to 0.05 g in the areas administrated by each county, and finally the number of the economic losses probably generated by the secondary landslides caused by the earthquakes in the study area is calculated. The method for quickly evaluating the economic losses generated by the landslides caused by the earthquakes can quickly evaluate the economic losses probably generated by the secondary landslide disasters.

title_en: The idle work optimization method containing distributed power distribution network of optimization is bored based on MIXED INTEGER
abstract_en: The present invention is directed to the idle work optimization method of distributed power distribution network containing wind-powered electricity generation that optimization is bored based on MIXED INTEGER, probability density function of the invention according to wind speed, with reference to the characteristics of output power and forced outage rate of blower fan, the probability density function of blowing machine power output is derived, the multimode discrete probabilistic model that blower fan is exerted oneself is set up；According to the network topology of power distribution network, line parameter circuit value, node load level, the Wind turbines capacity of injection, reference voltage, reference power, power distribution network Branch Power Flow equation is set up, and second order cone relaxation processes are carried out to power flow equation；To install the object function of economic benefit that capacitor brought as idle work optimization, it is considered to the constraint of trend second order cone relaxation equation, voltage constraint and condenser capacity constraint, the GA for reactive power optimization model containing intermittent energy source is set up.Optimizing ability of the present invention is strong, it is ensured that the optimality solved, practical.

title_en: A kind of Study of Risk Evaluation Analysis for Power System method based on deterministic parsing
abstract_en: A kind of Study of Risk Evaluation Analysis for Power System method based on deterministic parsing, has considered the change of the power flow transfer after system is disturbed and node voltage, proposes more perfect power network fragility comprehensive analysis index.The present invention is comprised the following steps：1) the trend distribution after analysis system topological structure, computing system steady-state operation and disturbance, including the effective power flow and reactive power flow of each branch road, each node voltage and its phase angle difference.2) each evaluation index in the evaluation system, including the pre- risk assessment factor and the network synthesis risk assessment factor are calculated.3) the index grade according to setting carries out risk assessment to power system.Study of Risk Evaluation Analysis for Power System method of the invention, more comprehensively reflect the risk information of system,, Voltage Instability out-of-limit to system trend that may be present and cascading failure make unified metric decision in the face of risk, be conducive to operations staff to make quickly and accurately to judge, take measures guarantee system safe and stable operation in time.

title_en: A kind of power transformer Forecast of Economic Life method based on lifetime data
abstract_en: At present both at home and abroad there is no the unified definition for forming the transformer economic life, research is concentrated mainly in economic evaluation.The present invention proposes a kind of power transformer Forecast of Economic Life method based on lifetime data.Present invention structure is with the transformer Forecast of Economic Life model of the year minimum foundation of equivalence cost; for the key parameter in computation model; the life-cycle data of transformer are subjected to classification and critical data extraction, failure rate and the probability distribution of downtime duration are calculated using the proportional hazards model and Monte Carlo Analogue Method of distribution-free；Then economic factor is analyzed, on the basis of annual overhaul cost, annual outage cost and the annual operating cost for calculating power transformer, realizes the quantitative forecast of power transformer economic life.The present invention can not only efficiently use equipment life data, and prediction result is reasonable, and the planning and improvement of O＆M decision and future substation to transformer has directive significance.

title_en: Smart disaster managing system for combined disaster management
title_ko: 통합적인 재난관리를 위한 스마트 재난관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart disaster managing system for integrated disaster management, and the smart disaster managing system for integrated disaster management of the present invention is configured to integrate disaster-related weather information, a radar image, a satellite image, a CCTV, a steep slope-land fragility, high tide danger prediction, a flooding forecast chart, bit data (Tweeter) , and a field survey data, and to display the integrated data on one map screen, so that a sign of a disaster can be detected. As the smart disaster managing system for integrated disaster management of the present invention is configured as above, a disaster risk area can be visually recognized at a glance by displaying real-time weather information on a map, and, by utilizing SNS information through Twitter, the sign of disaster and real-time information can be collected, and, further, the public response to a disaster scene can be recognized. The smart disaster managing system therefor can be utilized as an open platform through which information can be effectively managed by collecting information scattered in several places.

상기와 같이 구성되는 본 발명의 통합적인 재난관리를 위한 스마트 재난관리 시스템은 실시간 기상정보를 지도에 표현함으로써, 재난위험지역을 시각적으로 한눈에 파악할 수 있게 되고, 트위터 SNS정보를 활용함으로써 재난에 대한 전조 및 실시간 정보를 수집할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라, 재난현장에 대한 국민들의 반응을 파악할 수 있으며, 여러 곳에 흩어져 있는 정보를 한데 모아 효율적으로 관리할 수 있는 오픈 플랫폼으로 활용할 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of power grid important infrastructure vulnerability inder Establishing method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to power grid important infrastructure Evaluation of vulnerability technologies, and in particular to a kind of power grid important infrastructure vulnerability inder Establishing method.Include the following steps: step 1: evaluation unit and evaluation object are determined based on evaluation purpose；Step 2: power grid important infrastructure fragility is characterized in terms of pressure-state-response three；Step 3: establishing power grid important infrastructure Evaluation of vulnerability three-level index system；Step 4: reduction is carried out to three-level index system based on rough set theory；Step 5: Evaluation of vulnerability being carried out to power grid important infrastructure using the index system after reduction.It is a set of with systematicness, the power grid important infrastructure vulnerability inder system of operability that the present invention is based on PSR model foundations.The index system can effective evaluation difference power grid important infrastructure to the fragility of the fragility and specific important infrastructure of particular incident disaster distinct device inside synthesis fragility and infrastructure during Accidents Disasters.

title_en: A kind of power network infrastructure Vulnerability Assessment
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of power network infrastructure Vulnerability Assessment, comprise the steps：(1) assessment indicator system of power network infrastructure is built；(2) obtain and achievement data and it is handled in assessment indicator system；(3) pressure index value VP, the state indices value VS and response index value VR in power network infrastructure fragility are determined；(4) according to pressure index value VP, state indices value VS and response index value VR, the basic model of axonometric projection is set up；(5) triangle classification chart is built, the fragility classification and fragility trend to power network infrastructure are evaluated.The present invention has important directive function for formulating the safeguard measure of power network important infrastructure; the evaluation method can provide effective technological means for safety management, hidden troubles removing, safety evaluatio of each important electrical network facilities of Utilities Electric Co.'s system etc.; it can prevent because of all kinds of accidents that power network important infrastructure fragility triggers, the economic loss that reduction accident is caused.

title_en: A kind of transformer analysis method for reliability based on enlistment age and load level
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of transformer analysis method for reliability based on enlistment age and load level, comprise the following steps：(1) transformer load grade is determined；(2) load value of transformer in an initial condition is determined；(3) hot(test)-spot temperature of transformer is obtained；(4) insulation life of transformer is obtained according to the hot(test)-spot temperature of transformer；(5) the probability of malfunction Cumulative Distribution Function of transformer is obtained；(6) the failure rate index under the failure rate index and malfunction of transformer in an initial condition is obtained；(7) obtain cascading failure and start probability level P ic With cascading failure fragility link indicatrix P vc ；By to P ic With P vc Rate sorts, and identifies the transformer that critical condition is in system；Analysis method for reliability provided by the invention, with reference to influence of the coupled relation between transformer in transformer structure itself, function, operation age and regional power grid to equipment dependability, improve the transformer fail-safe analysis degree of accuracy under cascading failure scene.

title_en: Predictive human behavioral analysis of psychometric features on a computer network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a predictive network behavioural analysis system for a computer network, IT system or infrastructure, or similar. More particularly, the present invention relates to a behavioural analysis system for users of a computer network that incorporates machine learning techniques to predict user behaviour. According to a first aspect, there is provided a method for predicting a change in behaviour by one or more users of one or more monitored computer networks for use with normalised user interaction data, comprising the steps of: identifying from metadata events corresponding to a plurality of user interactions with the monitored computer networks; testing the identified events using one or more learned probabilistic models, each of said learned probabilistic models being related to a behavioural trait and being based on identified patterns of user interactions; and calculating a score using said one or more learned probabilistic models indicating the probability of a change in a behavioural trait of the user.

title_en: A kind of power system weak link identification method based on cascading failure
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of power system weak link identification method based on cascading failure, cascading failure model is incorporated into the state analysis of risk assessment, consider and originate fault progression as the influence after cascading failure to power network, suit large-scale blackout dynamic, the chain rule of development, the weak link for influenceing large-scale blackout can be recognized by means of cascading failure process analysis procedure analysis, the element to be played a crucial role in large-scale blackout really is filtered out, the weak link result drawn is more comprehensively accurate, has more reference value；The maturation theory of the invention effectively inherited based on Monte Carlo Analogue Method risk assessment, without carrying out the derivation of complex relationship formula, without enumerating for failure is carried out, when especially system is larger, advantage of the invention will be apparent from.

title_en: Comprehensive meteorology and the transmission line forest fire trip risk control method of artificial fire break's measure
abstract_en: A kind of transmission line forest fire trip risk control method of comprehensive meteorology and artificial fire break's measure, comprise the following steps: first pass through transmission line forest fire monitoring and warning system and obtain the history mountain fire disaster monitoring data near power transmission line corridor, set up the transmission line forest fire tripping operation probabilistic model P considering rain factor according to the data obtained R , consider Vegetation condition transmission line forest fire tripping operation probabilistic model P T , consider the transmission line forest fire tripping operation probabilistic model P of mountain fire distance and fire prevention measure factor F With the transmission line forest fire tripping operation probabilistic model P that consideration punctures type V , finally give transmission line forest fire tripping operation comprehensive probability model P=P R ·P T ·P F ·P V , and take corresponding control measure, to tackle transmission line forest fire trip accident according to monitoring the transmission line forest fire tripping operation combined chance acquired in real time.The present invention have simple to operate, practical, data acquisition is easy, speed is fast, predict the outcome the advantage such as more accurately and reliably.

title_en: Comprehensive assessment method for vulnerability of high-voltage transmission lines in freezing disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive assessment method for vulnerability of high-voltage transmission lines in a freezing disaster, and belongs to the technical field of power grid safety analysis. The assessment method comprises: for a small world network based high-voltage transmission line vulnerability analysis result, a Monte-Carlo weather sampling based high-voltage transmission line freezing disaster vulnerability analysis result, and an expert scoring based high-voltage transmission line freezing disaster vulnerability analysis result, conducting united-decision by using a DS evidence fusion theory, and taking a final fusion result as a comprehensive index for assessing the vulnerability of the high-voltage transmission lines in the freezing disaster; and then, according to the value of the index, removing lines with relatively high vulnerability, and calculating a lost load percentage of a power system, thereby finally determining the vulnerability of the high-voltage transmission lines in the freezing disaster. The assessment method has the advantages that the method is a fused decision of a plurality of theories or methods, the accuracy of assessment of a power grid system on the vulnerability of the high-voltage transmission lines in the freezing disaster is improved, and an effective basis is provided for high-voltage transmission line inspection.
assignees: UNIV YUNNAN;INST ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCES YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power system partition reliability evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power system partition reliability evaluation method. The method comprises the steps of inputting the data of a to-be-evaluated power grid, marking the partition of a power system in a power grid topology structure to respectively marking out five regions in the power system, grading the rates of the five regions according to the sizes of loads, evaluating the reliability of the power grid at all voltage levels based on the Monte Carlo Simulation method, recording the result of the reliability evaluation, conducting the statistics on the accident information in each region according to the result of the reliability evaluation, classifying accidents based on the two standards of the out-of-load ratio and the power-outage user ratio, calculating the accident risk index value of the power grid, and adopting the obtained index value as the result of the reliability evaluation in each region of the power grid. According to the technical scheme of the invention, during the planning and running stage of the power grid, the risk levels of the power grid at different accident levels can be evaluated, so that improvement measures are conveniently and correspondingly provided for the power system. Therefore, the risk of the system is reduced. Meanwhile, the power supply capability of the power system is improved.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY ECONOMIC & TECH RES INST

title_en: Method and system for evaluating wind power plant operation risk by combining weather and wind speed
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for evaluating the operation risk of a wind power plant by combining weather and wind speed, which comprises the following steps: a. determining the outage probability of the equipment element in the evaluation period under the current weather; b. constructing a time sequence by adopting an ARMA model and carrying out matrix transformation to obtain a wind speed sequence of each wind power plant; c. obtaining a system state according to the outage probability of the current weather, and sampling by adopting a non-sequential Monte Carlo method; d. adding 1 to the sampling number to obtain the wind speed of each wind power plant at the current moment, and calculating the output of each wind power plant; e. screening out load buses meeting preset conditions and corresponding load shedding values thereof according to the output of each wind power plant, and accumulating the load buses and the corresponding load shedding values to be used as the minimum load loss of the system; f. calculating a risk index according to the minimum load loss; g. returning to the step d when the variance of the risk index is smaller than the precision each time; otherwise, outputting the risk index. By implementing the method, the accuracy and the reliability of the wind power plant operation risk assessment can be improved, so that the assessment result is more scientific and reasonable, and the method has expandability.

title_en: A kind of electric power rack timing recovery optimization method considering element potential damage probability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of electric power rack timing recovery optimization methods for considering element potential damage probability, this method for natural calamity may result in a wide range of power outages and to force device bring potential damage, carry out the recovery of electric power rack using timing recovery strategy.Restore in the period at each, substep carries out unit starting sequential optimization and sequential optimization is restored in path.The first step is up to objective optimization unit starting sequence with system generating capacity in rack recovery time；Second step path optimizing recovery sequence, establishes transmission of electricity component wear probabilistic model and recovery time model.First step unit starting sequential optimization and second step path recovery sequential optimization passage path operating time are associated, effectively realize two compatibilities of goals optimizations.The present invention considers the transmission of electricity element such as route, transformer, and there are different degrees of potential damage probability scenarios, have been formed simultaneously the rack recovery scheme of timing to Guiding Practice, have had more realistic meaning.

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster critical rainfall probability analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent disaster critical rainfall probability analysis method. The method comprises the following steps: extracting no disaster-caused rainstorm information and solving an upper limit curve and a lower limit curve of critical rainfall; constructing a nonlinear model of critical rainfall-pro-phase rainfall, and comparing the nonlinear model with a linear relation model which is established on the basis of classical discriminant analysis, so as to illustrate the superiority of the new method; and fitting a probability distribution model of the critical rainfall by utilizing logarithmic normal distribution, approximatively taking a taking value interval formed by the upper limit curve and the lower limit curve as a 3(Sigma) confidence interval of the critical rainfall, carrying out inquiry to obtain distribution parameters of the critical rainfall, and carrying out inquiry to obtain mountain torrent disaster critical rainfalls under different probability conditions. Compared with the critical rainfall analytical calculation method recommended by the national mountain torrent disaster control program, the critical rainfall probability analysis method disclosed in the invention has feasibility and reliability.
assignees: BUREAU OF HYDROLOGY CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION

title_en: A kind of power distribution network Lightning Disaster failure prediction method
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of power distribution network Lightning Disaster failure prediction method, this method are as follows: based on it is more when time thunder and lightning range forecast to determine thunder and lightning subregion；The direct attack thunderbolt probability and thunder and lightning induction voltage probability of happening of route where determining each shaft tower；According to the thunderbolt of route where shaft tower tripping probability and counterattack tripping determine the probability lightning stroke trip probability；The thunder and lightning induction voltage tripping probability of route where determining shaft tower according to induced overvoltage maximum value on conducting wire, the thunder and lightning induction voltage failure rate of shaft tower place route is obtained by constructing fuzzy mathematical model, to obtain the thunder and lightning induction voltage tripping probability of route where considering each shaft tower of intensity of lightning current；By establishing distribution line temperature model, according to distribution line, active time determines that transient fault probability occurs for region feeder line section to be measured；It establishes and considers that distribution line breaks down probabilistic model under ageing failure and amendment distribution line Lightning Disaster；Predict the probability that region feeder line section to be measured breaks down.

title_en: Street tree wind-caused damage rapid evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a street tree wind-caused damage rapid evaluation method. A simplified model of street tree wind-caused damage is established, and according to finite element theory, tree materials are hypothesized to be isotropic and uniform, and then material physical parameters of dynamic behaviors affect tree individuals are abstracted. By giving consideration to the different types and the growth conditions of the trees, and the individual shape and character differences of the trees are great, and the material physical parameters of the street tree wind-caused damage model are regarded as the random variables. Davenport spectrum is used to represent input fluctuating wind speed, and a pseudo excitation method is used for street tree wind-caused response fast calculation. A street tree wind-caused damage criterion is defined based on bending strength, and by adopting Monte Carlo simulation, fast evaluation of street tree damage probability under a condition of different wind load levels. The street tree wind-caused damage rapid evaluation method is advantageous in that wind disaster damages on the street trees in the city areas are accurately and effectively predicted, and practical meaning is provided during making of corresponding defense measures.

title_en: Wind hazard risk assessment system and method for responding to climate change
title_ko: 기후 변화 대응을 위한 도시 풍해 위험도 평가 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for analyzing a city wind hazard risk to respond to a climate change. The system and the method for analyzing a city wind hazard risk to respond to a climate change is invented for necessity of proper preparation of a national level and management technique as a loss of a life and a loss of a property occur due to an increased wind-related disaster caused by recent climate and environment change. The present invention relates to the IT-based system for analyzing a city wind hazard risk to respond to a climate change and, specifically, to a system for assisting a decision maker so that the decision maker rapidly responds, by analyzing a wind hazard in a city region by considering the climate change and displaying an analyzed hazard result on a WEB-GIS-based system. To achieve the purpose of the present invention, the system for analyzing a city wind hazard risk to respond to a climate change includes: a) a strong wind hazard factor analyzing module of simulating a wind speed due to typhoon using a moving path and a central air pressure change of the typhoon and statistically analyzing future typhoon by considering the climate change; b) a weakness analyzing module of analyzing weakness of each facility using weakness DB of the facility; c) a wind hazard risk analyzing module calculating a damage probability by each grid and each administrative district using a strong wind hazard factor and strong wind fragility; and d) a wind hazard risk index analyzing module expressing a wind hazard risk index on a unit administrative district by analyzing damage probability information by each region and exposure rate information for preparing for and restoring damage.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 최근 기후 및 환경변화로 인하여 바람관련 재해가 증가하고 이로 인하여 인명손실과 재산상의 손실이 발생함에 따라 국가차원의 적절한 준비와 대응 관리 기술의 필요성으로 고안되었다.  
본 발명은 기후변화 대응을 위한 도시 풍해 위험도 평가 IT 기반 시스템에 대한 것으로, 보다 자세하게는 기후변화를 고려하여 도시지역의 풍해 위험도를 평가하고 평가된 위험도결과를 WEB-GIS기반의 시스템에서 표출하여 의사결정자에게 신속한 대응을 할 수 있도록 보조해주는 시스템에 대한 것이다.  
상기 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 발명의 기후변화 대응을 위한 도시풍해위험도 평가 시스템은; a) 태풍의 이동경로와 중심기압변화를 이용하여 태풍으로 인한 풍속을 시뮬레이션하고 기후변화를 고려하여 미래태풍을 통계적으로 분석하는 강풍위험요인평가 모듈; b) 시설물의 취약성 DB를 활용하여 각 시설물의 취약성을 평가하는 취약성평가모듈; c) 강풍위험요인과 강풍취약도를 활용하여 격자별,행정구역별 피해확율을 산출하는 풍해위험도평가모듈; d) 지역별 피해확율 정보와 피해에 대비하고 복구할 수 있는 정도인 노출도정보를 분석해서 단위 행정구역에 대한 풍해위험도 지표를 표출하는 풍해위험도지표평가모듈을 그 특징 징으로 한다.

title_en: Power generation system reliability rapid evaluation method based on state clustering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quickly evaluating the reliability of a power generation system based on state clustering, which belongs to the technical field of power system reliability evaluation and mainly adopts a non-sequential Monte Carlo sampling and state clustering method to evaluate the reliability of the power generation system, by providing a non-sequential Monte Carlo sampling method of the conventional unit operation (fault) state of the system and taking into account the forced outage rate of the generator set, the method not only replaces the conventional method of increasing the spare capacity of the system to ensure the reliability of the system, and fully takes into account the operational randomness and uncertainty of all the units in the system, establishes a probability model of the available generating capacity of the system, by clustering the sampled available power generation capacity samples into a typical available power generation capacity scene, the workload of reliability calculation is reduced, the reliability evaluation speed is greatly improved, and the purpose of quickly evaluating the reliability of a large-scale power system is achieved.

title_en: Bulk power grid critical circuits recognition methods based on FP-growth algorithm
abstract_en: The present invention proposes a kind of bulk power grid critical circuits recognition methods based on FP-growth algorithm, it is characterized by comprising the active incidence relation matrix of route is obtained using DC power flow algorithm, line disconnection probabilistic model is established based on operation of power networks state, Line Flow constraint condition and the active incidence relation matrix of route；Monte Carlo simulation is carried out to cascading failure based on line disconnection probabilistic model, generates cascading failure collection；Based on FP-growth algorithm, frequent-item is carried out to cascading failure collection, determines critical circuits.Route effective power flow generation minority routes jumpy can be identified and are controlled within failure short time early stage using technical solution of the present invention, be of great significance to the safe and stable operation for inhibiting cascading failure guarantee electric system.

title_en: Flood disaster risk response method based on three-layer risk evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood disaster risk response method based on three-layer risk evaluation. The method comprises the following steps: performing regulable characteristic and regulation approach analysis on danger, exposure degree, fragility and disaster prevention and mitigation capabilities formed during flood disaster and related to flood disaster risk factors; establishing flood disaster first-layer risk evaluation; establishing flood disaster second-layer risk evaluation; establishing flood disaster third-layer risk evaluation; proposing flood disaster risk countermeasures. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that a 'nature-manual work' two-dimensional water circulation theory is taken as a principal line, and the flood disaster risk response method is constructed in terms of population and urban sizes, regional water resource carrying capacity, industrial structure adjustment, hydraulic engineering swarm optimized layout, disaster prevention and reduction capacity building, land and water resource regulation and risk prevention and control management, based on the historical development regularity and future development trend of flood disasters in combination with flood disaster risk division and risk predication results.

title_en: Disaster response method that is based on the machine to machine
title_ko: 사물지능통신을 기반으로 하는 재난대응방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster response method based on machine-to-machine communication. The disaster response method based on machine-to-machine communication according to an embodiment of the present invention includes the steps of: collecting surrounding situation information (S100); analyzing and checking the collected surrounding situation information (S110); setting an accident risk radius (r1) around a corresponding machine intelligent disaster prevention sensor unit (100) to transmit the surrounding situation information sensing an accident (S120); generating a risk propagation avoidance-based minimum route (MR) (S130); displaying the risk propagation avoidance-based minimum route (MR) and transmitting the risk propagation avoidance-based minimum route (MR) to terminals (200) (S140); and controlling electronic valves of a harmful dangerous gas pipe (P) to be blocked (S150). Therefore, the present invention can minimize damage due to the explosion and leakage of a dangerous gas.

title_en: The Stochastic Production Simulation computational methods of energy efficiency power plant
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of Stochastic Production Simulation computational methods of energy efficiency power plant, by simulated failure state and working condition so as to more accurately simulating exerting oneself for large-sized photovoltaic power station and wind energy turbine set, with reference to the innovation of this " virtual plant " dsm of energy efficiency power plant, the start-stop time of the production cost and unit of power system is calculated based on equivalent electric quantity frequency method, simultaneously, by " exerting oneself " for changing some periods of energy efficiency power plant, find the minimum scene of producing cost, probe into impact of the large-sized photovoltaic wind-power electricity generation with the power producing characteristics of energy efficiency power plant to Operation of Electric Systems, it is simple with method, practical advantage.With reference to stratified sampling and Monte Carlo theory, outage cod and unit activity charge computation model, the accuracy rate of result of calculation is further improved, makes analog result more accurately reflect practical situation.

title_en: GIS-based typhoon disaster risk assessment method for power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a GIS-based typhoon disaster risk assessment method for a power grid. Through analysis and assessment of risk of typhoon, topographical sensitivity, fragility of the power grid and disaster prevention and mitigation capabilities, the typhoon disaster risk assessment method for the power grid is created. On one hand, compiling of a typhoon disaster risk zoning map for the power grid can be realized, and on the other hand, systematization and integrity of disaster risk division can be perfected to provide technical support for making a countermeasure for regional disaster prevention and mitigation.

title_en: Chemical industry park real-time quantitative risk assessment method based on multi-disaster real-time coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to a chemical industry park real-time quantitative risk assessment method based on multi-disaster real-time coupling, introduces a Monte Carlo analysis method and solves the problem of uncertainty of setting of a model probability parameter. By effective integration of the Monte Carlo analysis method and a risk distance calculation method, a chemical industry park site selection risk protection distance is initially determined. According to an environmental risk system principle, by combining characteristics of the chemical industry, a chemical industry park enterprise comprehensive risk assessment index system based on inherent risks of a risk source, effectiveness of a prevention and control mechanism and vulnerability of a receptor is constructed. A catastrophe rating method is introduced to assess an environmental risk comprehensive level, a chemical industry enterprise environmental risk comprehensive assessment method based on a catastrophe principle is proposed, and comprehensive assessment grades are divided into five grade levels so as to discriminate a comprehensive risk level of a chemical industry park enterprise and timely take emergency response strategies. According to the chemical industry park real-time quantitative risk assessment method disclosed by the invention, planning evaluation and risk management of a chemical industry park can be implemented, and a risk prevention ability and a risk management level of the chemical industry park can be improved.

title_en: A kind of consideration wind pressure relevance and wind speed direction metal Roof disaster caused by a windstorm estimation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of consideration wind pressure relevances and wind speed direction metal Roof disaster caused by a windstorm estimation method, estimate the charming appearance and behaviour loss of metal structure roof boarding.In calculating process, the external wind pressure of roofing is obtained using POD interpolation；Internal pressure is obtained by simulation；Roof boarding connecting elements internal force is calculated using face method is influenced, and corresponding extreme value internal force is acquired by Gumbel conversion；With Monte Carlo simulation, roof boarding failure probability and integral roofing loss late are estimated, wherein connecting elements internal force correlation is considered by Nataf transformation；By the directionality of wind in view of obtaining the integrated charming appearance and behaviour earthquake loss estimation methodology of metal roofing board in charming appearance and behaviour estimated amount of damage.The method of the present invention carries out the reconstruction of roofing external wind pressure by POD method interpolation, to consider existing relevance between wind pressure, influence of the wind load correlation for roof boarding charming appearance and behaviour loss appraisal is quantified, and at the same time considering that wind pressure relevance and wind speed direction carry out charming appearance and behaviour estimated amount of damage to sheet-metal roofing.

title_en: Circuit mountain fire Disaster Assessment method and system without real-time collection site information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of circuit mountain fire Disaster Assessment method without real-time collection site information, including：Determine vegetation pattern and vegetation height；Judge scene of a fire fire behavior type；Obtain alarm transmission line information；Obtain mountain fire and opening position meteorological data occurs；Calculate mountain fire flame zone, ion area and smog area height；Calculate flame zone breakdown voltage；Calculate ion area breakdown voltage；Calculate smog area breakdown voltage；Computing electric power line tripping operation probability；Assess mountain fire grade.The present invention also provides a kind of circuit mountain fire Disaster Assessment system without real-time collection site information.Beneficial effects of the present invention：Consider that supporting body transmission line parameter, mountain fire are interior in fire behavior feature, external environment condition, establish accurate line fault probabilistic model, Forest database is based on using data and meteorological data numerical result obtains, without arriving collection in worksite, realize that mountain fire causes transmission line of electricity tripping operation probability quantitatively to calculate, there is very strong adaptability, improve power network and resist mountain fire disaster ability.

title_en: A kind of Study of Risk Evaluation Analysis for Power System method for considering rain-induced landslide geological disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Study of Risk Evaluation Analysis for Power System method for considering rain-induced landslide geological disaster, peripherally matter data message estimates the deflection degree that the accumulation rainfall and slip mass of the meteorological induced landslide disaster of rainfall cause transmission tower to deform for methods described foundation rainfall meteorological data information and transmission tower；Transmission tower is obtained using curve-fitting method and damages joint probability distribution；Based on the integrated figure layer of gridding technology formation " meteorology-power network-grid ", the corresponding effective transmission tower quantity of transmission line of electricity and computing electric power line failure probability of statistics rainfall covering；Then acquisition system is sampled to transmission line of electricity using non-sequential Monte Carlo method and loses load condition；Optimal reduction plans model computing system based on AC power flow loses system loading resection under load condition；Last statistical system risk indicator.

title_en: The temperature rise optimization method and system of a kind of UHVDC converter station tab terminal
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of temperature rise optimization method of UHVDC converter station tab terminal, the tab terminal after design parameter optimization is set to avoid or mitigate the loss that causes of power network disaster accident caused by tab terminal generates heat, while it also avoid that butt joint terminal size design is excessive and the economic waste that causes.Methods described is：Design parameter is chosen, corresponding tip side daughter board overlap maximum temperature rise T is drawn max , and T max ≤T u When, functional relation between maximum temperature rise and design parameter is drawn, tab terminal reliability R value is drawn by Monte Carlo methods with reference to tab terminal plate limit state equation, as R >=R u When, choose initial designs point, and different parameters near initial designs point are combined, calculate corresponding overlap maximum temperature rise value and then draw reliability, draw the functional relation between design parameter and reliability, using tab terminal cost as optimal conditions sets target function, the optimal design parameter of tab terminal is obtained using reliability as constraints.

title_en: Calculation method for number of function restoration days in disaster
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To develop a system of correctly estimating a restoration period required for starting to operate the plant again from the damage caused by the disaster such as an earthquake.SOLUTION: A calculation method for the number of function restoration days is provided, in which, a failure that occurs by an earthquake is predicted with a highly accurate production device of a semiconductor plant and the like in which a monetary damage becomes tremendous when the earthquake occurs as an object, and with a fragility curve (a probability distribution of the damage) based on a vibration amplification factor of the production device derived from a vibration test and earthquake damage data in the past as a base, and when the restoration of a life line and other elements are assumed outside a period in which actual operations are performed, even these elements are added to be regarded as the number of restoration days, and by comparing each of these elements, an estimation system rich in flexibility and developable over a complicated facility configuration or a high level dependency relation is provided.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: A kind of development of information system common support method analyzed based on system vulnerability and platform
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of development of information system common support method analyzed based on system vulnerability and platform, including step 1, obtains user basic information and analysis requirement item, and be stored in database；Step 2, according to given analysis requirement item, system vulnerability analysis is carried out, the fragility value of the system under different disaster situations is obtained；Step 3, the result to be formed is analyzed according to system vulnerability, provide the user improve system vulnerability decision-making opinion, and consider decision-making opinion under system fragility value；Step 4, the system vulnerability analysis result and improvement opinion user confirmed, forms new vulnerability analysis case, extends in case library.The present invention can be according to the specific application demand of user, intelligently help user to carry out vulnerability analysis to the system to be analyzed and provide the user improvement system vulnerability decision scheme, to reduce the technical threshold of vulnerability analysis application and development, efficiency, quality and the level of application system development are improved.

title_en: A kind of historic building structure residual life Predicting Reliability method suitable for corrosive environment
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of historic building structure residual life Predicting Reliability method suitable for corrosive environment, comprise the following steps：（1）Analyze the material time-varying model under corrosion impact；（2）Set up the Load resistance ratio for considering corrosion；And timber structure bearing capacity life prediction is realized, it is modified using Monte Carlo join probability density function method to predicting the outcome, realizes the residual life interval prediction of structure；（3）Using finite element simulation obtain consider corrosion deformation when variate, the reliability life prediction of malformation value is realized based on Weibull models coupling DSMCs；（4）Decision-making goes out the earliest time limit that structure is most likely to occur failure.The present invention can provide the range intervals for the ancient architecture timber structure ultimate life for considering corrosion and influence of damaging by worms, so as to make the decision-makings such as disaster prevention scheme and strengthening by reparative method；The present invention is except considering that bearing capacity index is realized in material aspect in addition to predicting residual useful life, it is also contemplated that the influence that deformation values index is predicted structural life-time on component or even structural level, life prediction criterion is more reasonable.

title_en: A kind of active power distribution network various visual angles collaboration vulnerability assessment method for considering information system effect
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of active power distribution network various visual angles collaboration vulnerability assessment method for considering information system effect, and the randomness occurred first against power distribution network external disaster sets up certainty randomness topology controlment；Based on system panoramic information, the information physical element fault probability of Multiple Time Scales collaboration influence under hazardous condition is determined；Then the active power distribution network function group failure probability model for considering information system effect is set up；Various running statuses and grid structure under the source net load interaction pattern of active power distribution network are estimated, the vulnerability assessment system under the source net load interaction pattern that active power distribution network is merged with information system is built, while assessing between distribution network structure structure and running status, physical system cooperates with fragility with the interphase interaction of information system；Local collaboration vulnerability inder, Regional Synergetic vulnerability inder and the global collaborative vulnerability inder system finally set up on space scale, more comprehensively, specifically assess the fragility of active power distribution network.

title_en: The urban waterlogging risk assessment index for coupling population and POI points is built
abstract_en: A kind of urban waterlogging risk assessment index structure for coupling population and POI points, including step：A, urban waterlogging risk assessment index built based on population and POI points；B, urban waterlogging risk assessment Index Content include：Urban population quantity, urban population density, city POI points quantity, city POI point distribution densities；C, the fragility for assessing with urban population quantity and city POI point quantity two indices urban waterlogging disaster；D, the exposed property for assessing with urban population density and city POI point distribution densities two indices urban waterlogging disaster.The present invention is the important acceptor based on urban waterlogging risk --- urban population and urban public utilities, on the sign exposure basis of analysis urban population and communal facility to urban waterlogging risk, build urban waterlogging risk assessment index, assessment more objective to urban waterlogging security risk, comprehensive is realized, science support is provided for urban waterlogging disaster prevention and reduction management.

title_en: Power distribution network operation and power supply reliability assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating the operation and power supply reliability of a power distribution network. The method comprises the following steps: designing an equipment outage model according to the influence of equipment aging factors and incomplete preventive maintenance factors on equipment failure conditions; randomly sampling a plurality of devices in a power distribution network to be evaluated; calculating equipment reliability parameters corresponding to each sampling equipment according to the equipment shutdown model; and calculating the operation and power supply reliability indexes of the whole power distribution network according to the Monte Carlo algorithm and the reliability parameters of the plurality of random devices. The method for evaluating the operation and power supply reliability of the power distribution network fully considers the influence of incomplete preventive maintenance on equipment operation, simultaneously considers the influence of equipment aging, can effectively avoid the situation that the evaluation error of the reliability of the power distribution network is continuously increased along with the increase of the equipment operation time, and can accurately predict the long-term operation and power supply reliability level of the power distribution network.

title_en: Power transmission system reliability assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating reliability of a power transmission system. The method comprises the following steps: designing an equipment outage model according to the influence of equipment aging factors and incomplete preventive maintenance factors on equipment failure conditions; randomly sampling a plurality of devices in a power transmission system to be evaluated; calculating equipment reliability parameters corresponding to each sampling equipment according to the equipment shutdown model; and calculating the reliability index of the whole power transmission system according to the Monte Carlo algorithm and the reliability parameters of the plurality of random devices. The method for evaluating the reliability of the power transmission system fully considers the influence of incomplete preventive maintenance on equipment operation, simultaneously considers the influence of equipment aging, can effectively avoid the error of evaluating the reliability of the power transmission system from continuously increasing along with the increase of the equipment operation time, and can accurately predict the medium-term and long-term reliability level of the system.

title_en: A kind of appraisal procedure of electric power networks fragility
abstract_en: This application discloses a kind of appraisal procedure of electric power networks fragility, the application uses improved cascading failure Markov chain model, cascading failure state transition probability is with next fault branch definite inside p probability selection neighbourhood grid, with the branch road outside 1 p probability selection neighborhood, calculated load loss late, electrical energy transportation network characterization parameter rate of descent, total load loss, electrical energy transportation network characterization parameter, are assessed power network fragility.The embodiment of the present application constructs the neighborhood chain reaction of failure and the cascading failure model of non-neighborhood approximate random, is advantageous to the research of the cascading failure mechanism of transmission.Meanwhile as p=1, solve the shortcomings that catastrophe failure border can not definitely be defined based on probability theory cascading failure method, using minimum electrical energy transportation network characterization parameter as next fault branch, clear and definite direction is provided for the N K analyses and early warning of electric power networks.

title_en: A kind of cascading failure in power system appraisal procedure for considering relay protection latent defect
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of cascading failure in power system appraisal procedure for considering relay protection latent defect, and methods described comprises the following steps：(1) data are read and are related to variable and simulation rules operation；(2) Quasi-Monte-Carlo analysis and progress loss probability calculating；(3) loss index is subjected to visualization output displaying.The present invention has carried out loss appraisal to the cascading failure of system based on probability space technology, and the loss index of the quantization obtained after assessment shows the weak link of system, can provide strong support for system operation planning personnel's decision-making.

title_en: A kind of urban road road ability evaluation method for considering building earthquake collapse
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of urban road road ability evaluation method for considering building earthquake collapse, belongs to civil engineering and prevents and reduces natural disasters technical field.This method establishes the road net model that becomes more meticulous in GIS platform first；Then according to multilayer shear model region groups of building are carried out with the time-history analysis of seismic response, it is determined that the destruction of building, situation of collapsing；Building destruction, coverage of collapsing are calculated according to building collapse accumulation area probabilistic model afterwards；Building destruction, the influence collapsed to road are calculated according to the distance of width of roadway, building to road edge；Finally according to road passage capability damage situations and it is expected that departure place and the optimal path of the act of rescue and rescue, evacuation after shake in the calculating earthquake of destination.The present invention provides accurately and efficiently method to consider that the urban road road ability of building earthquake collapse is evaluated.

title_en: Power grid line section differentiation planning method considering risks
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk-considered power grid line section differentiation planning method. According to the method, an economic risk assessment index after a line fault occurs is introduced, a line sectional differentiation planning design method with the minimum sum of risk and differentiation cost is provided, by taking ice disaster as an example, a Pearson III type distribution function is used for forming different line comprehensive fault probability models, then a line economic risk assessment method is established according to the line comprehensive fault probability and the load loss of a power line after the fault, and then a line sectional differentiation planning model with the minimum sum of risk and differentiation planning cost is established; and reasonably selecting a segmented line strengthening standard by adopting a Monte Carlo-random sampling algorithm, solving the optimal solution of the model, and carrying out differential planning design on the segmented line according to the optimal solution.
