The method is suitable for line differentiation planning of the power grid across meteorological areas, minimizes line fault risks under the condition of meeting the minimum strengthening cost, and improves the disaster prevention and resistance capability of the power grid.

title_en: A kind of Method of Stochastic for assessing public supply mains reliability
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of Method of Stochastic for assessing public supply mains reliability, belong to public supply mains quake-resistant safety technical field.The present invention includes step：Pipeline earthquake rate calculates；The damaged scene generation of water supply network based on Monte Carlo simulation；Low pressure water supply network hydraulic analysis based on " substep iteration " method；Aseismic reliability index calculates.The present invention, which need not change pipe network system file or write additional code, solves low-pressure pipe network waterpower equation, has the advantages of computational efficiency height and good stability.The present invention for earthquake when water supply network hydraulic analogy and reliability assessment provide new approaches, there is certain guidance meaning to the disaster relief, repair after earthquake.

title_en: Consider the risk assessment of interconnected network cascading failure and the alarm method of communication fragile degree
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of interconnected network cascading failure risk assessment for considering communication fragile degree and alarm method, for the forward delay interval of communication link, propagation delay, queue delay, link utilization, unified experience is constructed respectively to be most worth, do normalized, go pulverised processing, equal weight to be added, obtain the fragile degree of the different time section similarly hereinafter communication link of standard；Using performance fragile degree of the communication node based on the node number of degrees, the topological fragile degree based on business route matrix, business criticality, the fragile degree of communication node is constructed.Consider communication fragile degree, establish the stoppage in transit probabilistic model of interconnected network branch roads at different levels；Mistake load, voltage pulsation degree, average communication link utilization, the unobservable rate of communication are defined as to the consequence index in cascading failure path, assessment is ranked up to cascading failure path, and provide a variety of alarms.The present invention assesses electrical hazards and communication fragility combines, and makes interconnected network wide area observing and controlling system trouble analysis and control more comprehensively reasonable.

title_en: Attitude control method and device for unmanned aerial vehicle, unmanned aerial vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of computers, and provides an attitude control method and device of an unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of acquiring flight information of the unmanned aerial vehicle at the current moment through a sensor on the unmanned aerial vehicle, setting the flight information into observation data of a variable-structure discrete dynamic Bayesian network, generating flight attitude information of the unmanned aerial vehicle at the next moment through the variable-structure discrete dynamic Bayesian network, sending the flight attitude information to a ground station associated with the unmanned aerial vehicle, translating the flight attitude information into flight attitude instructions through the ground station, receiving the flight attitude instructions returned by the ground station, and controlling the flight of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to a preset time-varying sliding mode controller and the flight attitude instructions, so that the robustness and the precision of the flight control of the unmanned aerial vehicle under a complex dynamic scene (such as a disaster relief scene) are effectively improved, and the flight stability of the unmanned aerial vehicle is effectively improved.

title_en: Identification method for critical risk factors and critical risk transmission path of cascade hydropower station based on Bayesian risk network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying key risk factors and a risk transmission key path of a cascade hydropower station based on a Bayesian risk network, and relates to the field of hydraulic and hydroelectric engineering. Based on the Bayes risk network model of the cascade hydropower station, a key risk factor and risk transfer key path identification method is provided, and theory and method support are provided for applying the Bayes risk network model of the cascade hydropower station to risk identification and prevention control. The method is simple and clear, has strong operability, and has important application prospect in risk identification and prevention and control of cascade hydroelectric engineering and similar system engineering of civil engineering by using the Bayesian network.

title_en: Transmission line of electricity fragility recognition methods based on cascading failure network
abstract_en: The present invention discloses the transmission line of electricity fragility recognition methods based on cascading failure network, comprises the following steps：Step a：Numbering is proceeded by from 1 to the transmission line of electricity in electric power networks, and obtains the data message in the electric power networks；Step b：Transmission line of electricity vulnerability assessment Index Formula (I) is established, establishes system loading loss late formula (II)；Step c：The failure chain of electric power networks is built by formula (I) and formula (II)；Step d：According to the failure chain building cascading failure network topological diagram of electric power networks；Step e：The out-degree and in-degree of every transmission line of electricity are calculated according to cascading failure network topological diagram；Step f：Transmission line of electricity out-degree size in electric power networks, successively record circuit number；Transmission line of electricity in-degree size in electric power networks, successively record circuit number.The present invention can effectively be distinguished by the calculating to the out-degree and in-degree of Weighted Coefficients in cascading failure network to fragility circuit.

title_en: A kind of vulnerability assessment method of power information physics emerging system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of vulnerability assessment method of power information physics emerging system, in the technical program, the vulnerability assessment method of the power information physics emerging system of offer, illustrates the reciprocal effect and cascading failure of information and physical space in power information physics emerging system.Consider that physical message virtual link can effectively assess the fragility of power information physics emerging system using the method for the present invention, analyze the fragile link of system.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: A kind of disaster monitoring damage identification method based on meteorology with Remote Sensing Data Fusion Algorithm
abstract_en: The invention belongs to agricultural insurance technical field, it is more particularly to a kind of based on the meteorological disaster monitoring damage identification method with Remote Sensing Data Fusion Algorithm, from agrometeorological hazard risk assessment, spatial analysis statistical function of the setting loss assessment with reference to GIS after disaster area remote sensing monitoring and calamity, using risk analysis of natural disaster as basic principle, from the danger of disaster Flood inducing factors, hazard-affected body fragility and mitigation ability is combated a natural disaster to build Flood inducing factors model, Flood inducing factors are used as to calculate accumulation monthly precipitation anomaly data by TRMM satellite datas, agricultural disaster is monitored from meteorological disaster, formulation for agricultural restructuring and disaster-proof measures provides foundation.With can a wide range of, round-the-clock, accurate in real time the advantages of grasping apparent and yield effect degree of the meteorological condition to crops, foundation is provided for work such as Making A Strategic Decision of The Agricultural Productions and post-disaster rescue and agricultural insurances.
assignees: HENAN RAINBOW REMOTE SENSING TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of photovoltaic electric station grid connection methods of risk assessment for considering meteorologic factor
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of photovoltaic electric station grid connection methods of risk assessment for considering meteorologic factor, first, is formed cluster feature vector with meteorological index, force data is gone out to photovoltaic history and carries out cluster analysis, establishes the photovoltaic plant output power probabilistic model for considering meteorologic factor；Then, according to element outage model, extract photovoltaic plant and conventional generator is in the metastasis sequence of operation, drop volume and stoppage in transit state；Then, the photovoltaic output power sequence containing outage model, the conventional generator sequence containing outage model and load sequence are chronologically superimposed, obtains the available nargin model of system, negative allowance needs appropriate reduction plans, and positive nargin needs suitably abandon light；Finally, sequential Monte Carlo method, calculated load loss risk and power loss risk indicator are utilized.It is contemplated that considering influence of the meteorologic factor of the strong correlations such as irradiation level and temperature to photovoltaic output power probabilistic model, and then analyze photovoltaic plant and access the risk brought to power grid.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Pipe gallery disaster chain methods of risk assessment
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of pipe gallery disaster chain methods of risk assessment.The described method includes：The risk assessment parameter of pipe gallery is determined according to pipe gallery O＆M monitoring risk data, the O＆M monitoring risk data is the frequency of the environmental monitoring data and generation corresponding to the alert event or Disaster Event occurred during pipe gallery O＆M；The Bayesian network model of pipe gallery disaster chain is built according to the risk assessment parameter；The risk assessment of pipe gallery disaster chain is carried out according to the Bayesian network model；Corresponding mitigating the disaster by cutting the disaster chain in the headstream measure is implemented according to assessment result.The present invention can build Bayesian network model according to the Evolution of Potential hazards in pipe gallery, the probability and the assessment piping lane extent of damage that each disaster of prediction piping lane occurs, so as to propose scientific and effective pipe gallery mitigating the disaster by cutting the disaster chain in the headstream mechanism and measure.
assignees: GUOTONG GUANGDA BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of power distribution network methods of risk assessment under distributed generation resource Thief zone
abstract_en: The invention discloses the power distribution network methods of risk assessment under a kind of distributed generation resource Thief zone, the characteristics of considering the access of large-scale distributed power supply, risk assessment, step are carried out to power distribution network：1) consider the fluctuation and intermittence that distributed generation resource is contributed, establish distributed generation resource output model；2）Line outage model is established according to circuit historical failure information；3) consider the probability and consequence of power distribution network operation risk under distributed generation resource Thief zone, establish and consider power distribution network operational reliability and abundance Risk Assessment Index System；4) the power distribution network risk evaluation model under distributed generation resource Thief zone is solved using Monte Carlo simulation population breadth first search integration algorithm, determines risk assessment desired value, complete the power distribution network risk assessment under distributed generation resource Thief zone.
assignees: SUQIAN POWER SUPPLY BRANCH STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: A kind of power generation analogy method for considering regenerative resource and load multi-space distribution character
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power generation analogy methods for considering regenerative resource and load multi-space distribution character, consider that regenerative resource shares 16 scene compositions with load spatial and temporal distributions characteristic, consider the four seasons, working day and day off, be combined round the clock, then count and the spatial coherence of regenerative resource and load；Consider the auto-correlation coefficient of regenerative resource and load, the distributed constant of regenerative resource and load under each scene is obtained using Pair Copula and the Quasi-Monte-Carlo method of sampling；Consider to carry out outage cod calculating under regenerative resource and 1 fault conditions of N of load multi-space distribution character.The present invention considers regenerative resource and load distribution performance and spatial coherence under different scenes, reduce the calculation error caused by different scenes and spatial coherence, so that power generation simulation is more accurate, power generation simulation can be carried out for Electric Power Network Planning personnel, guidance instruction is provided.
assignees: ECONOMICS & TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;EAST CHINA ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD CHINA POWER ENG CONSULTING GROUP;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Systems and methods for cognitive control of data acquisition for efficient fault diagnosis
abstract_en: Remote sensing techniques are being increasingly used for periodic structural health monitoring of vast infrastructures. Conventionally, analysis of visual and other signals captured from sensing devices are used to diagnose faults. Such data collection and analysis is expensive in terms of both computational overheads as well as towards robotic maneuvering of data collection systems, such as a UAV. In accordance with the present disclosure, the data acquisition system is modeled as an intelligent situated agent that autonomously controls data gathering and analysis activities through a cognitive cycle of perception-recognition-action, in order to optimize the cost of efforts in identifying faults that may exist. Also, a reactive, economical planning algorithm around Qualitative Bayesian Network (QBN) that controls the sequence of data collection and analysis has been implemented.

title_en: Dynamic mine disaster integral early warning method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses dynamic mine disaster integral early warning method and devices, it is related to coal mining dynamic disaster prediction and evaluation technical field, this method by mine planted agent force signal, sound signal, electric field signal, temperature signal and Gas Signal, and pre-stored stress signal reference value, sound signal reference value, electric field signal reference value, temperature signal reference value and Gas Signal reference value, corresponding stability function is established, error function is established according to the theoretical value of stability function and stability function；And Constrained equations are established to error function, and the Constrained equations are solved with the α for current time error minimum of sening as an envoy to according to Monte Carlo EGS4 method i (n) and β i (n) namely by above-mentioned steps solution the α for current time error minimum of sening as an envoy to i (n) and β i (n) it can estimate the stability function value at current time, the safety in the moment mine be may determine that with the difference of stability function value and the theoretical value of stability function, so as to reach the safety in dynamic evaluation mine.

title_en: A kind of online dynamic decision method and system of unit recovery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of units to restore online dynamic decision method and system, comprising: determines black starting-up power supply when system is restored, and chooses the unit for needing preferentially to start from all units as unit set to be restored；Generate the tape label training set for covering each state in unit recovery process as far as possible.Construct valuation network；The scope of power outage of judgement system identifies that the availability of various equipment in judgement system obtains machine unit characteristic to the state of system；Using valuation network, it is search target with unit total generating capacity, carries out the search of Monte Carlo tree.Using the method for parallel computation, constraint checking is carried out to each alternative route；Summarize Monte Carlo tree search result, chooses the transmission line of electricity that will restore in next step and investment.Restore real time data according to system, the transmission line of electricity for needing to put into online dynamic decision unit recovery process instructs the unit recovery of power system recovery early period.

title_en: Method of providing comprehensive analysis on safety status
title_ko: 안전현황 종합 분석도 생성 방법
abstract_en: A method of generating a comprehensive analysis map of a safety status may be performed by a server for generating a comprehensive analysis map of a safety status which is connected to an external system including space data about a facility via a network. The method of generating a comprehensive analysis map of a safety status comprises: a step of generating a thematic map showing distributions of vulnerable facilities in a danger list by overlay analysis and statistical analysis on the space data, wherein the danger list includes the facilities vulnerable to a disaster and the vulnerability levels of the vulnerable facilities; a step of dividing the vulnerable facilities into N (N is an integer higher than or equal to 2) grades; a step of calculating a vulnerability index for a first area based on the thematic map and the vulnerability levels of the danger list, wherein the first area includes at least one among the vulnerable facilities; and a step of generating a comprehensive analysis map of a safety status for the first area based on the vulnerability index.
abstract_ko: 안전현황 종합 분석도 생성 방법은 시설에 대한 공간 데이터를 포함하는 외부 시스템과 네트워크를 통해 연결되는 안전현황 종합 분석도 생성 서버에서 수행될 수 있다. 안전현황 종합 분석도 생성 방법은 상기 공간 데이터에 대한 중첩 분석 및 통계 분석을 통해 위험목록 상의 취약시설들 각각의 분포를 나타내는 주제도를 생성하는 단계 - 위험목록은 재난에 취약한 상기 취약시설들 및 상기 취약시설들 각각의 취약도를 포함함-; 상기 취약시설들을 N(단, N은 2 이상의 정수)개의 등급들로 구분하는 단계; 상기 주제도 및 상기 위험목록의 상기 취약도에 기초하여 제1 구역에 대한 취약지수를 산출하는 단계 - 제1 구역은 취약시설들 중 적어도 하나를 포함함 -; 및 상기 취약지수에 기초하여 상기 제1 구역에 대한 안전현황 종합 분석도를 생성하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Multiple current Tsunami disaster appraisal procedure based on Monte Carlo stochastic simulation
abstract_en: The multiple current Tsunami disaster appraisal procedure based on Monte Carlo stochastic simulation that the invention discloses a kind of, method include：S1 establishes potential tsunami source region seismicity parameters logic tree using a variety of focal shock parameter methods of estimation；S2 establishes tsunami unit source Green's function database using linear tsunami numerical simulation；S3 generates Stochastic earthquake event set according to above-mentioned logic tree, using Monte Carlo stochastic simulation；S4 is simulated using random slippage according to tsunami unit source Green's function database and Stochastic earthquake event set and is generated tsunami wave amplitude collection；S5 is according to tsunami wave amplitude collection, the analysis of uncertainty to multiple current Tsunami disaster distribution results statistics and result.The above method can solve the problems, such as that risk evaluation result is higher in the prior art and can not provide its correspondence probability of happening, a variety of uncertainties are fused in final assessment result, increase the confidence level of result, operational efficiency is improved simultaneously, policymaker is facilitated targetedly to make prevent and reduce natural disasters deployment and physical construction planning.

title_en: Method for evaluating resilience of power system under disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating restoring force of an electric power system under disasters, which comprises the following steps: 1) determining the type and nature of the disaster; 2) obtaining the type and the related fault probability of the vulnerable component under the disaster; 3) acquiring the running state of the vulnerable equipment in the disaster environment by utilizing Monte Carlo simulation; 4) performing system minimum load shedding calculation based on the direct current optimal power flow; 5) and (5) index calculation and system resistance analysis are carried out. The method can be used for rapidly solving the expected operation state and the robustness of the power system under various natural disasters and artificial disasters, the type and the characteristics of the disasters are considered in the solving process, and the restoring force promotion limiting factors of the system under the disasters can be analyzed, so that the method can be used for providing reference suggestions for disaster prevention planning and construction of the power system.

title_en: Method of constructing risk register
title_ko: 위험목록 구축 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for constructing a risk list. The method for constructing a risk list can be performed in a risk list construction server connected to user terminals via a network. The method for constructing a risk list includes: a step of transmitting preliminary survey information including a first preliminary survey item on a disaster type and a second preliminary survey item on an object weak against a disaster, to the user terminals; a step of receiving preliminary survey answer information corresponding to the preliminary survey information from the user terminals; a step of determining a disaster type list and a disaster object list based on the preliminary survey answer information; a step of generating main survey information including a first main survey list about an occurrence possibility of the disaster type included in the disaster type list and a second main survey list about a vulnerability rate of the disaster object included in the disaster object list; a step of transmitting the main survey information to the user terminals; a step of receiving main survey answer information corresponding to the main survey information from the user terminals; a step of calculating the vulnerability on the disaster object by each disaster type and a disaster occurrence possibility by the each disaster type based on the main survey answer information; and a step of generating the risk list based on the vulnerability and the disaster occurrence possibility. The method for constructing a risk list is to construct the risk list capable of expressing not only the risk list of a scenario type but also a risk area and facilities on a disaster with the high occurrence possibility.
abstract_ko: 위험목록 구축 방법은 사용자 단말들과 네트워크를 통해 연결된 위험목록 구축 서버에서 수행될 수 있다. 위험목록 구축 방법은, 재난의 유형에 대한 제1 사전 조사 항목 및 상기 재난에 취약한 대상에 대한 제2 사전 조사 항목을 포함하는 사전 조사 정보를 상기 사용자 단말들에 전송하고, 상기 사용자 단말들로부터 상기 사전 조사 정보에 대응하는 사전 조사 답변 정보를 수신하며, 상기 사전 조사 답변 정보에 기초하여 재난 유형 목록 및 재난 대상 목록을 결정하고, 상기 재난 유형 목록에 포함된 재난 유형의 발생 가능성에 대한 제1 본 조사 항목 및 상기 재난 대상 목록에 포함된 재난 대상의 취약 정도에 대한 제2 본 조사 항목을 포함하는 본 조사 정보를 생성하고, 상기 본 조사 정보를 상기 사용자 단말들에 전송하며, 상기 사용자 단말들로부터 상기 본 조사 정보에 대응하는 본 조사 답변 정보를 수신하고, 상기 본 조사 답변 정보에 기초하여 상기 재난 유형별 재난 발생확률과 상기 재난 유형별 상기 재난 대상의 취약도를 산출하며, 상기 재난 발생확률과 상기 취약도에 기초하여 위험목록을 생성할 수 있다.

title_en: Method for evaluating recovery capability of power system after disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the recovery capability of a power system after a disaster, which comprises the following steps: 1) determining the damage condition of the power system and obtaining a system recovery scheme; 2) simulating the repair process of the line, and performing time sequence sampling on the running state of the fault line by utilizing time sequence Monte Carlo simulation; 3) analyzing the system state, and calculating the minimum load shedding of the system based on the direct current optimal power flow; 4) and calculating the recovery capability evaluation index and drawing a recovery process curve. The method can be used for quickly evaluating the equipment and the load recovery capability of the power system after being damaged by disasters, the evaluation process takes the transportation process of disaster relief personnel and disaster relief materials into consideration, the response speed, the recovery efficiency and the recovery economy of the post-disaster system can be analyzed by using related evaluation indexes, and the expected effects of different recovery strategies can be compared, so that the method can be used for providing reference suggestions for the formulation of the post-disaster recovery strategy and disaster prevention and reduction planning of the power system.

title_en: User-side comprehensive energy system operation risk assessment method considering multi-energy coupling interaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the running risk of a user-side comprehensive energy system by considering multi-energy coupling interaction, which adopts Monte Carlo method simulation, comprehensively considers the energy supply and the demand of the user-side comprehensive energy system and establishes a collaborative analysis model of the user-side comprehensive energy interaction system; calculating the operation risk evaluation index of the comprehensive energy system at the user side by combining the outage rate parameters of each energy transmission and conversion element; the method can more accurately evaluate the operation risk of the user side comprehensive energy system, and can improve the flexibility and the safety and the stability of the user side energy utilization strategy.

title_en: A kind of information physical emerging system vulnerability assessment method under cascading failure mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of information physical emerging system vulnerability assessment methods under cascading failure mode, include the following steps: S1, according to Complex Networks Theory, establish information layer model and physical layer model；S2, according to information layer model and physical layer model, the dependence of Information Level and physical layer is modeled using interdependent theory, obtains coupling model；S3, according to coupling model, electric power CPS cascading failure is modeled using seepage theory, whole surviving nodes of output coupling model；S4, vulnerability assessment index is established, and according to the surviving node of vulnerability assessment index and coupling model, the fragility of electric power CPS is assessed；The present invention solves the problems, such as that step of the existing technology is complicated, validity is low, practicability is low and lacks versatility, avoids the serious consequence of power loss, causes huge economic loss and social influence.
assignees: INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION COMPANY STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Landslide disaster prediction method based on improved Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide hazard prediction method based on an improved Bayesian network, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing a landslide body monitoring and early warning system, acquiring initial landslide hazard impact factor data, carrying out standardization processing, extracting by using a PCA algorithm, and screening out main impact factors; dividing the screened main influence factor sample data into a training sample set and a test sample set according to a proportion, and dividing a landslide occurrence grade; then, a landslide prediction model based on improved Bayes is constructed, the landslide occurrence probability after the feature quantity is introduced is calculated through weighting processing, and a closed-loop learning process is added to complete landslide disaster prediction; the method disclosed by the invention is used for weighting the characteristic quantity and outputting the landslide occurrence probability by screening the main influence factors of landslide disasters in an improved Bayes model and adding a closed-loop learning link, so that the fault tolerance rate is increased, and the forecasting precision is improved.

title_en: The method that triple exponential models portray snow disaster in pastoral area restoring force space-time characterisation
abstract_en: The present invention relates to snow disaster in pastoral area restoring force appraisal procedure field, the method that especially triple exponential models portray snow disaster in pastoral area restoring force space-time characterisation.Method includes the following steps: (1) triple index characteristic indexs and calculating, triple indexes are as follows: Index A I, geographical mitigation index GI are combated a natural disaster in cause disaster index SI, herding of accumulated snow；(2) calculating of cattle-breeding system fragility is carried out；(3) calculating of cattle-breeding system restoring force is carried out；(4) cattle-breeding system restoring force STRUCTURE DECOMPOSITION function is established；(5) space expression of triple indexes and restoring force is carried out.The present invention is by portraying triple exponential models of snow disaster in pastoral area restoring force space characteristics, snow disaster in pastoral area restoring force is resolved into cause disaster index, herding of accumulated snow and combats a natural disaster the comprehensive function of index, geographical mitigation index triplen variable, discloses the spatial and temporal variation of snow disaster in pastoral area restoring force and its triplen variable.It is promoted for snow disaster in pastoral area restoring force and sustainable development provides safeguard.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: A kind of natural gas line fire incident hazard analysis method based on danger level
abstract_en: The natural gas line fire incident hazard analysis method based on danger level that the invention discloses a kind of, the accidents such as jet bubble reactor, the scintillation occurred first using FDS fire disaster simulation software simulation natural gas line due to leakage, obtain the thermal radiation flux distributed data around accident point；Secondly, using Crystal Ball risk analysis software the data at different location are fitted with the probability distribution for obtaining thermal radiation flux at the position according to distributed data；Then, by gained probability distribution in conjunction with fire heat radiation probability equation, the distribution situation that the simulation based on Monte Carlo finds out Death probit amount is carried out；Finally, finding out the danger level of corresponding position, the risk in each region of quantitative analysis according to the reversion accumulated probability that random sampling calculates gained Death probit amount.It realizes that fire incident, which occurs, to natural gas line carries out more accurate risk analysis, and advises accordingly to administrative staff, improves safeguard procedures.

title_en: Merge the face identification method of EM algorithm and probability two dimension CCA
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of face identification methods for merging EM algorithm and probability two dimension CCA, initially set up probability two dimension CCA model, calculate separately the log-likelihood expectation of left probabilistic model and right probabilistic model；Then it maximizes log-likelihood desired value to estimate model parameter using EM algorithm, optimizes left and right probabilistic model；The probability two dimension CCA projection matrix that finally application obtains will observe data projection to concealed space, realize high dimensional data dimensionality reduction, the accuracy of recognition of face is improved while substantially reducing operand；A large amount of tests of AR face database identify, robustness and superiority of the method proposed by the invention when coping with illumination variation, expression shape change and attitudes vibration face sample are demonstrated, dimension disaster and small sample problem when existing face identification method reply high dimensional data are solved.

title_en: Transmission line of electricity trip risk appraisal procedure under a kind of typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The present invention relates to power transmission circuit caused by windage trip risk appraisal procedures under a kind of typhoon disaster, Typhoon Information, every Transmission Line Design information and environmental information including inputting survey region, the Transmission Line Design information includes electric power line pole tower information, line conductor information and suspension insulator information；With Monte Carlo method and rigid body straight-bar method, the windage yaw tripping probability calculation model of transmission circuit insulator string under typhoon disaster is established；Information needed is inputted in the model built up, insulator chain windage yaw tripping probability of this transmission line of electricity under the secondary typhoon is obtained, to the prediction for instructing to work before calamity with loss of outage after calamity.It present invention can be suitably applied to the case where typhoon does not fix wind field, there is preferable prediction effect for unknown typhoon, it can obtain the windage yaw tripping probability of whole transmission circuit insulator string under typhoon disaster, the distribution of materials, loss of outage prediction all have great importance after the condition of a disaster before instructing typhoon to pass by is predicted and passed by.

title_en: Method for calculating loss load loss value of multi-element parallel power supply system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for calculating the loss load loss value of a multi-element parallel power supply system, in particular to a method for calculating the interlinked overload probability of the multi-element parallel power supply system, meanwhile, the uncertainty and the randomness of the operation mode of the line and the load are considered, the data of the line and the load are obtained through an Energy Management System (EMS) of the power grid, introducing a probabilistic model of transformer and line overload while considering uncertainty of line or transformer faults, overload, overhaul or lightning strikes, introducing a probabilistic model of the line operation when the uncertainty of the line operation mode is considered, introducing a probabilistic model of the load fluctuation when the uncertainty of the load is considered, assuming that both the line operation mode change and the load fluctuation follow a normal distribution, the probability of failure outage of the power grid with two parallel power transmission and transformation stages and multiple elements is calculated on the basis of probability analysis, and necessary technical support is provided for power supply management and power grid dispatching operation.

title_en: A kind of Vulnerability of Regional Hazard Bearing Body evaluation method
abstract_en: The present invention at present the deficiency of hazard-affected body fragility area research and there are aiming at the problem that, a kind of Vulnerability of Regional Hazard Bearing Body evaluation method is provided.The present invention carries out in the following manner: 1) establish assessment indicator system, the principal element of Vulnerability of Regional Hazard Bearing Body index system is: population, intrinsic wealth, the mankind creates the wealth, life line system engineering；2) grade classification is carried out to Vulnerability of Regional Hazard Bearing Body index；3) evaluation criterion weight is determined；Evaluation of vulnerability index weights are calculated using analytic hierarchy process (AHP), then determine the typical value of loss caused by risk case again.Summation can arrive Vulnerability Model after each corresponding weighted value and loss typical value make product.The present invention is comprehensively analyzed and researched using region hazard-affected body as research object, to fragility, is conducive to improving and supplementing for Regional Disaster mitigation guiding theory.Meanwhile it optimization to region contingency management and improving there is positive effect.

title_en: A kind of multiple transformers power supply system overload outage probability calculation method arranged side by side
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of multiple transformers power supply system overload outage probability calculation method arranged side by side, the following steps are included: S1: obtaining the data of route and load by energy management system EMS, S2: consider transformer and line short, the probabilistic model of transformer and circuit overload is introduced when the uncertainty of ground fault, the probabilistic model of lead-in road transport row when considering the uncertainty of the route method of operation, the probabilistic model of load fluctuation is introduced when considering the uncertainty of load, S3: multiple transformers power supply system overload outage probability arranged side by side is calculated on the basis of probability analysis.The present invention calculates multiple transformers power supply system overload outage probability arranged side by side on the basis of probability analysis, runs the support that provides the necessary technical for power supply management and dispatching of power netwoks.

title_en: A kind of underground pipe gallery big data visualization system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to pipe gallery field of engineering technology, disclosing a kind of underground pipe gallery big data visualization system and method, the underground pipe gallery big data visualization system includes: video monitoring module, environmental data detection module, central control module, cloud service module, device management module, risk evaluation module, alarm module, display module.The equipment of security protection, ventilation, power supply, draining, illumination and fire-fighting in piping lane and Cloud Server platform are established Internet of Things communication framework by management module by the present invention, and technology of Internet of things is utilized, greatly facilitates the management of O&M and equipment；Simultaneously, the present invention passes through risk evaluation module, pipe gallery disaster chain Bayesian network model can be constructed according to the Evolution of Potential hazards a variety of in pipe gallery, the probability and the assessment piping lane extent of damage that each disaster of piping lane occurs are predicted, to propose scientific and effective pipe gallery mitigating the disaster by cutting the disaster chain in the headstream mechanism and measure.
assignees: CHINA CONSTR 2ND BUREAU INSTALLATION ENG CO LTD

title_en: The curved analysis system of house earthquake damage matrix and method based on ground motion parameter
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of curved analysis method of house earthquake damage matrix and corresponding system based on ground motion parameter, based on the corresponding relationship between earthquake intensity and ground motion parameter, using maximum Likelihood, two-parameter fragility curves are converted than result by the destruction that correct house Seismic Vulnerability Matrixes or practical earthquake count, the deficiency based on earthquake intensity fragility curves is compensated for, the structure type for being difficult to carry out sunykatuib analysis especially for building, masonry etc. provides the approach of more easy acquisition fragility curves；Relationship based on earthquake intensity and ground motion parameter provides the seismic vulnerability analysis curvilinear characteristic parameter of all kinds of building structures, and the building construction earthquake assessment that may be based on ground motion parameter provides basic data.This method and system reliability are high, widely applicable, can be used for carrying out existing Seismic Vulnerability Matrixes or curve verifying and perfect, preferably to serve the fields such as earthquake disaster rapid evaluation, risk assessment and insurance estimation.

title_en: Power transmission and transformation two-stage multi-element parallel power grid maintenance outage probability calculation method
abstract_en: A power transmission and transformation two-stage multi-element parallel power grid maintenance outage probability calculation method comprises the following steps: s1: determining the maintenance rate of the line by adopting a Monte Carlo simulation method, and S2: determining the overhaul rate of the transformer by adopting a Monte Carlo simulation method, and S3: constructing a line maintenance probability density function, S4: constructing a transformer overhaul probability density function, S5: constructing a joint probability density function of the maintenance of a plurality of lines, S6: constructing a joint probability density function for overhauling a plurality of transformers, S7: calculating the combined probability of overhauling and outage of the power grid with two power transmission and power transformation stages and multiple elements in parallel; the invention can help and guide operators to accurately master the running states of the line and the transformer, provides a technical method for running and overhauling work, and provides technical support for power grid dispatching.

title_en: A kind of distribution system overload outage probability appraisal procedure
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of distribution system overload outage probability appraisal procedure, the following steps are included: S1: obtaining the data of route and load by energy management system EMS, S2: consider transformer and line short, ground fault uncertainty when introduce the probabilistic model of transformer and circuit overload, the probabilistic model of lead-in road transport row when considering the uncertainty of the route method of operation, the probabilistic model of load fluctuation is introduced when considering the uncertainty of load, S3: multiple transformers power supply system overload outage probability arranged side by side is calculated on the basis of probability analysis.The present invention calculates distribution system overload outage probability on the basis of probability analysis, runs the support that provides the necessary technical for power supply management and dispatching of power netwoks.

title_en: A kind of disaster-ridden kind of coupling physical vulnerability assessment method based on PTVA model
abstract_en: The present invention relates to Disaster Assessment methods, and in particular to a kind of disaster-ridden kind of coupling physical vulnerability assessment method based on PTVA model.It includes the classification of physics vulnerability index and fragile grade, establish disaster-ridden kind of physics vulnerability assessment index system, the calculating of single calamity kind physics vulnerability index, the identification of coupling effect and the foundation of coupling model, the calculating of disaster-ridden kind of comprehensive physical fragility and etc..The present invention is more suitable for disaster-ridden kind of vulnerability analysis than traditional PTVA model index system, while also improving the accuracy of disaster-ridden kind of vulnerability assessment.

title_en: Consider the comprehensive energy electric-thermal net methods of risk assessment of comprehensive time-varying outage model
abstract_en: The present invention discloses the comprehensive energy electric-thermal net methods of risk assessment for considering comprehensive time-varying outage model.The present invention is based on the probabilistic model methods of risk assessment of electric-thermal net coupling, include that multipotency Source Type sets up evaluation index for integrated energy system.This method fully considers the key index demand of all kinds of energy nets by taking the failure probability model of the key equipments such as photovoltaic, wind-driven generator as an example.Furthermore it considers garden operating condition, sets up power supply, the Requirements Risks such as heat supply is insufficient, and temperature, pressure is not up to standard.
assignees: HUANAN INDUSTRIAL TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ZHEJIANG UNIV;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Coupling process based on electric system node importance
abstract_en: The present invention discloses coupling process and device based on electric system node importance, and for the device for realizing this method, this method includes creating cascading failure model based on electric power system model；Cascading failure attack is implemented to the electric power networks in model, it is obtained under conventional input power in guarantee electrical nodes, the real output of each supply node of dynamic regulation, output power of each supply node under each stable state is obtained in dynamic regulation, egress influence power and node fragility are calculated separately, the two weighted sum obtains node d 0 Importance, sorted from small to small based on the importance of node and generate new electric power networks, by new electric power networks and communication network carry out it is different match couple, generate new electric power system model.The present invention is calculated node importance by DC flow model and obtains more accurate simulation result, then new electric power networks are different with coupling with communication network progress, improves robustness of the power system network under attack.

title_en: Methods for differentiation of earthquake signal and prediction of earthquake intensity using randomly generated artificial seismic training data for an arbitrary zone
title_ko: 임의 지진구역 대상 무작위 생성 지진학습데이터를 이용한 지진여부판별 방법 및 이에 의한 진도예측 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an earthquake determination method using randomly generated seismic learning data for arbitrary seismic zones. The earthquake determination method, an earthquake determination method using an artificial neural network technique, performed by an earthquake intensity prediction system for predicting an earthquake intensity using seismic waves in a target zone, comprises the steps of: collecting past earthquake data of the target zone and deriving seismic wave characteristic data from the collected past earthquake data; performing a pseudo earthquake probability model which reflects the derived seismic wave characteristic data to randomly generate learning data on general vibration and seismic vibration for the target zone; providing the learning data generated through the pseudo earthquake probability model to artificial neural network learning; inputting, if an actual P wave is detected, the P wave to an artificial neural network to determine whether an earthquake occurs; and generating an artificial S wave to estimate a structure′s response through the artificial neural network technique and predicting a damage scale of the structure using the generated artificial S wave to provide an earthquake warning. Therefore, the earthquake determination method of the present invention can be applied to smart seismometers in a house, a building, or the like, to improve the accuracy and reliability of earthquake warnings. The earthquake determination method can be also employed in a structural health monitoring (SHM) technology in construction and civil engineering fields to analyze a seismic impact on a structure. Moreover, the earthquake determination method is applied to a construction site to enable quick early evacuation and facility control in case of a natural disaster on the construction site.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 임의 지진구역 대상 무작위 생성 지진학습데이터를 이용한 지진여부판별 방법 에 관한 것으로서, 대상 지역의 지진파를 이용하여 지진 판별 진도를 예측하는 진도예측 시스템에 의해 수행되는 인공신경망 기법을 이용한 지진여부판별 방법에 있어서, 대상 지역의 과거 지진 데이터를 수집하고, 상기 수집된 과거 지진 데이터에서 지진파 특성 데이터를 도출하는 단계; 상기 도출된 지진파 특성 데이터를 반영하여 상기 대상 지역에 대한 일반 진동 및 지진 진동의 학습 데이터를 무작위로 생성하는 의사 진동 확률 모델을 수행하는 단계; 상기 의사진동 확률 모델을 통해 생성된 학습 데이터를 인공 신경망 학습에 제공하는 단계; 실제 P파가 감지되면, 상기 감지된 P파를 상기 인공 신경망에 입력하여 지진 여부를 판별하는 단계; 및 상기 인공 신경망 기법을 통해 구조물 응답 추정을 위해 인공 S파를 생성하고, 상기 생성된 인공 S파를 이용하여 구조물의 피해 규모를 예측하여 지진 경보를 제공하는 단계를 포함한다. 
따라서, 본 발명은 주택이나 건물 등의 스마트 지진계에 적용되어 지진 경보의 정확도와 신뢰도를 향상시킬 수 있고, 건축 및 토목 분야의 구조물 건전성 모니터링(SHM) 기술에 적용되어 구조물의 지진 영향을 분석할 수 있으며, 시공 중인 구조물에도 적용되어 공사 현장에 자연재해 발생 시 신속히 조기 대피 및 조기 설비 제어를 수행할 수 있다.

title_en: Early warning method for damage of power transmission line under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for early warning damage of a power transmission line under typhoon disasters. The method comprises the steps of collecting meteorological information, equipment operation information, micro-terrain information and real-time damage information to construct a training set; information quantization, default value processing and standardization processing are carried out on the information in the training set; establishing a power transmission line damage probability hybrid prediction model based on extreme value I type probability distribution, a random forest method and a Monte Carlo method, and calculating damage probability; and calculating risk indexes according to the damage probability, and performing emergency repair after the disaster. The prediction model has stronger adaptability and higher reliability, and can reasonably estimate the needed emergency repair resources from the macroscopic view.

title_en: Ensemble forecast storm damage response system for critical infrastructure
abstract_en: A storm damage response system includes a storm ensemble database that stores ensemble forecast models associated with respective potential storm paths of a given storm across a geographic area and an inventory database that stores inventory data associated with location and characteristics of power-providing equipment and characteristics of a consumer population in the geographic area. A storm damage model algorithm generates a storm response plan comprising an operational procedure for repairing or maintaining power transmission and distribution electric systems to mitigate storm damage impact based on generating a probabilistic model for each of the ensemble forecast models based on the inventory data and calculating a statistical impact value associated with the probabilistic model based on an aggregate of iterative probabilistic simulations for the respective ensemble forecast model. The storm response plan can be generated based on the relative statistical impact value of the probabilistic model of each of the ensemble forecast models.

title_en: A kind of meizoseismal area power grid fragility geological environment mud-rock flow probability of happening calculation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of meizoseismal area power grid fragility geological environment mud-rock flow probability of happening calculation methods, it solves existing mud-rock flow analysis and assessment method etc. occurs and is not associated with specific meizoseismal area geology Condition of Fragile Environment condition, the probability of happening of Geological Hazards of debris is not provided, the problem of a possibility that causing meizoseismal area power grid fragility geological environment mud-rock flow to occur, is indefinite, reduces the initiative that power grid is prevented and reduced natural disasters.The present invention includes extracting the relevant evaluation points of meizoseismal area power grid fragility geological environment mud-rock flow, it is carried out using CRITIC method without guiding principle quantification treatment, between each evaluation points to specific strength and correlation quantification treatment, weight calculation, and the calculating of mud-rock flow probability of happening is realized according to the above results, there are the present invention evaluation points to extract rationally, and calculating is with clearly defined objective, and calculating process is succinct, the advantages that calculated result obtains simplicity, and calculating process is objective and calculated result is reliable.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Urban masonry residential safety assessment method based on uncertainty analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a town masonry residential safety assessment method based on uncertainty analysis, and belongs to the field of engineering structure performance assessment. The method comprises the steps of firstly, carrying out acceleration acquisition on a structure under environmental vibration to obtain acceleration data. And secondly, automatically identifying structural modal parameters and uncertainty thereof by adopting a multi-reference-point covariance driven random subspace method and a convolutional neural network. And then, correcting the initial finite element model of the structure by taking the obtained uncertainty modal parameters as input and adopting a Bayesian model correction method based on a progressive Markov chain Monte Carlo method (TMCMC), so as to obtain the town masonry residential safety assessment model with uncertainty parameters. And finally, performing safety assessment on the model by simultaneously considering load action and structural parameter uncertainty. According to the invention, an effective town masonry residential security assessment model can be constructed, so that the aims of long-term security management and disaster early warning of the type of houses are fulfilled.

title_en: Nonlinear smearing language power distribution network node Vulnerability Assessment based on complex network
abstract_en: This application involves the nonlinear smearing language power distribution network node Vulnerability Assessments based on complex network, comprising: according to distribution network data, constructs power distribution network complex network model；It determines the importance measurement index of power distribution network node, constructs network node Assessment of Important database；Determine the parameter of fuzzy rule in power distribution network complex network model；Data clusters analysis is carried out to database using clustering method；Establish the nonlinear smearing language power distribution network node Evaluation of vulnerability model based on complex network；Carry out parameter optimization；Power distribution network node fragility is analyzed using the evaluation model after optimization；Power distribution network node is safeguarded based on the analysis results.Analysis and the accurate evaluation of power distribution network node fragility are realized using nonlinear smearing language, to be safeguarded to power distribution network node, reduce cascading failure risk, ensure the safe and stable operation of power distribution network, and then meet the power demand of user, promote the economic benefit of user power utilization quality and power grid enterprises.

title_en: A kind of appraisal procedure of the power system component different degree based on restoring force
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power system component different degree appraisal procedures based on restoring force: 1) determining the property of the type and generation of disaster；2) fallible component type and relevant probability of malfunction under disaster are obtained；3) the fault configuration situation of element in system after disaster occurs is obtained using non-sequential Monte Carlo simulation；4) optimal recovery policy model after calamity is established, proposes objective function and constraint condition；5) recovery process after calamity repeatedly simulate and obtain each element reparation moment and be ranked up using the ranking method of Aaron Copland, to obtain component importance sequence.Electric system can be sought in all kinds of natural calamities and the component importance under man-made disaster using the method for the invention, finding process has taken into account Disasters Type and feature.It can provide to refer to for the determination of element Scheme of Strengthening before the formulation and calamity of recovery policy after calamity using the component importance result that this method obtains and build.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Consider extreme meteorological dynamic power distribution network scope of power outage prediction technique and system
abstract_en: This application involves extreme meteorological dynamic power distribution network scope of power outage prediction technique and system is considered, using history meteorological disaster data, the power outage that power distribution network may occur is emulated, and obtains distribution power-off event emulation data；Establish the Bayesian network with meteorological dynamic and distribution net equipment incidence relation；The training that Bayesian network is carried out using history meteorological disaster data and distribution power-off event emulation data, is determined simulation parameter, obtains the Bayesian network of training completion；The prediction of power distribution network scope of power outage is carried out in conjunction with weather forecast.Consider the dynamic process that meteorological DYNAMIC DISTRIBUTION situation especially fully considers meteorological disaster, consider influence situation of the meteorological dynamic to power distribution network, scope of power outage is predicted in terms of the structure of power distribution network and meteorological dynamic two, avoiding condition missing causes to predict that there are more serious inaccurate situations, it can be realized accurate power distribution network scope of power outage prediction, and have the advantages that the longer prediction result of application time is more accurate.

title_en: Parallel multilayer Monte Carlo double-fed asynchronous fan parameter optimization method
abstract_en: The invention provides a parallel multilayer Monte Carlo double-fed asynchronous fan parameter optimization method, which reduces the time of group intelligent decision through a parallel multilayer simulation system. The method has the technical effects that: the method can realize quick parameter optimization decision and avoid the problem of dimension disaster in the common Monte Carlo method. The method can optimize the parameters of the proportional-integral-derivative controller of the double-fed asynchronous fan.

title_en: Power system reliability assessment method considering optimized scheduling of cascade hydropower station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system reliability assessment method considering cascade hydropower station optimized dispatching, which is used for improving the reliability of a power system and is characterized in that: the method comprises the following steps of establishing an electric power system optimization model; inputting 24h time sequence wind speed, runoff and load data; extracting the state duration of the three types of units according to the reliability parameters of the units and a sequential Monte Carlo method, and segmenting by taking 24h as a period; calculating the 24h time sequence output of the wind power plant according to the wind speed data and the state of the wind power set; calculating the load loss per hour according to the states of the water and thermal power generating units and the optimization model; optimizing 365 days according to the method in the step 4, and calculating a reliability index; and judging whether convergence occurs or not, and if not, continuously repeating the steps S3 to S7 until convergence occurs. The beneficial effects of the invention include: and the reliability of the wind, fire and water power system is evaluated by considering the optimized dispatching of the cascade hydropower station, so that the reliability of the system can be improved.

title_en: Method for predicting residual life of rotating machinery of multilayer bidirectional gate control circulation unit network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for residual life of a rotary machine of a multilayer bidirectional gating circulation unit network, which comprises the steps of collecting vibration signals; constructing a health index; constructing a network training set; constructing a multi-layer bidirectional gating circulation unit network; training a multi-layer bidirectional gating circulation unit network; network testing, estimation of residual life and acquisition of a confidence interval; and (4) predicting and evaluating the residual life. The method combines the advantages of strong feature extraction capability of deep learning, utilizes the neural network of the bidirectional gating circulation unit to carry out regression prediction, and obtains the confidence interval of the residual life by a Bootstrap method. Aiming at the problems that the model precision of a recurrent neural network model is sensitive to the value of the learning rate in the training process, and the prediction performance of the model is influenced by overhigh and overlow, the natural index is utilized to attenuate the learning efficiency to train the neural network efficiently. The method can accurately predict the residual life and the confidence interval of the rotary machine, can greatly reduce expensive unscheduled maintenance, and avoids the occurrence of disasters.

title_en: Mixed calculation method for reliability of high-medium-low voltage integrated power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a mixed calculation method for the reliability of a high-medium-low voltage integrated distribution network, which considers the mutual influence of high-medium-low voltage distribution networks and establishes a distribution network integrated model, wherein firstly, the reliability of the high-voltage distribution network is evaluated based on the quasi-sequential Monte Carlo simulation of a state transition sampling method to obtain the annual average fault frequency and the annual average power failure time of the high-voltage distribution network; secondly, obtaining the outgoing line outage rate and the restoration rate of a transformer substation connecting a high-voltage distribution network and a medium-voltage distribution network; finally, the outgoing line outage rate and the repair rate of the transformer substation are used as the input of the reliability calculation of the medium-low voltage distribution network, and the reliability index of the medium-low voltage distribution network is calculated by using a minimum path method; the invention comprehensively considers the mutual influence among the power distribution networks with high, medium and low voltage grades, improves the accuracy of the evaluation result, relates to the low-voltage distribution network topology for the evaluation of the power distribution network, and improves the calculation accuracy of the power supply reliability of low-voltage users.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN;URUMQI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Emergency regulation and control equipment reliability assessment method and system under disaster causing factor condition
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating the reliability of emergency control equipment under the condition of disaster causing factors, which integrate artificial intelligent machine learning into a reliability model, improve the accuracy and scientificity of an evaluation result and provide guidance for engineering practice of emergency control technical equipment. The method comprises the following steps: disaster situation feature simulation, namely determining a disaster situation disaster factor distribution rule according to a disaster factor evolution rule of fire, gas explosion and coal rock dynamic, and performing disaster situation simulation; the reliability analysis of the emergency control equipment comprises the steps of analyzing constituent units of the emergency control equipment, determining fault modes, fault reasons and fault influence factors of the constituent units, acquiring probability information of the fault modes, the fault reasons and the fault influence factors of the constituent units by using statistical data, determining logic relations among the fault influence factors, and carrying out the reliability analysis of the emergency control equipment based on a Bayesian network.

title_en: Power distribution network disaster situation inference method and system based on tree-shaped Bayesian network
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a power distribution network disaster situation inference method and system based on a tree-shaped Bayesian network, which comprises the following steps: constructing a tree-shaped Bayesian network; determining a key node set and an outage combination set related to an evidence set of the key node set, and acquiring the joint probability of each outage combination in the outage combination set based on a tree Bayesian network; and determining the maximum value in the joint probability of each outage combination as a final result of disaster inference under the evidence set. According to the power distribution network disaster situation inference method and system based on the tree-shaped Bayesian network, provided by the embodiment of the invention, the tree-shaped Bayesian network is established by optimizing the structure and inference algorithm of the Bayesian network; and the key load in the power distribution network is deduced based on the analysis of the joint probability of the outage combination, so that the complexity of probability calculation is effectively simplified, and the second-level real-time disaster situation deduction of the large-scale power distribution network is realized.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Network security situation assessment method based on random forest and Bayesian network
abstract_en: The network security situation assessment method based on the random forest and the Bayesian comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a random forest method, and acquiring factors influencing network security by using the method; s2, constructing a network security situation assessment model by integrating the stability, vulnerability, threat and disaster tolerance of the network; s3, analyzing and summarizing factors influencing network safety, constructing a directed acyclic graph, and forming a Bayesian network; and S4, calculating a network security situation value, and acquiring the security state of the network. According to the invention, the random forest method is used for mining the factors influencing the network security, and the Bayesian network security method is used for carrying out association recombination and analysis on the factors influencing the network security, so that the most accurate and detailed network security situation information is obtained.

title_en: Water resource risk assessment method aiming at multiple risk sources of cascade reservoir group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water resource risk assessment method aiming at multiple risk sources of a cascade reservoir group, which comprises the following steps: identifying the structural characteristics of a cascade reservoir group system of the water transfer project; identifying risk sources corresponding to the reservoirs of all units in the water diversion project respectively; constructing a nested Bayesian network risk assessment model of the water diversion project step reservoir group according to the structural characteristics and the risk source, and obtaining the risk level of the water diversion project water resource through model analysis; carrying out sensitivity analysis through a nested Bayesian network risk assessment model, finding out key factors of risks, and making remedial measures; the method comprises the steps of utilizing a model to analyze the overall risk level of the stepped reservoir group of the water diversion project after renovation, stopping analysis if the overall risk level reaches an acceptable risk level, and searching a new risk key factor for further analysis if the overall risk level does not reach an expected risk level until the acceptable risk level.

title_en: Device for Predicting Fragility of Structures due to Disasters and the Method
title_ko: 재난에 의한 구조물의 취약도 예측 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for predicting the vulnerability of a structure to a disaster and a method thereof. To this end, the apparatus for determining the vulnerability of a specific structure predicted in case of a specific disaster by using a database storing disaster information including the scale of each of a plurality of past disasters and the degree of damage to each structure caused by the disasters, includes: a vulnerability curve deriving part deriving a vulnerability curve by section in regard to a disaster scale and a structure damage degree by using the disaster information of the database; an information input part inputting information about a specific disaster scale and a specific structure to be predicted; and a vulnerability calculation part calculating vulnerability, predicated based on the inputted information about the specific disaster scale and the specific structure, based on the derived vulnerability curve.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 재난에 의한 구조물의 취약도 예측 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위하여 본 발명은 과거에 발생된 복수의 재난에 대하여 각각의 재난 크기와 상기 재난에 따른 각 구조물 손상도를 포함하는 재난 정보가 저장된 데이터베이스를 활용하여 특정 재난의 발생시 예측되는 특정 구조물의 취약도를 결정하는 장치에 있어서, 상기 데이터베이스의 재난 정보를 이용하여 재난 크기와 구조물 손상도에 대하여 구간별로 취약도 곡선을 도출하는 취약도 곡선 도출부; 예측하고자 하는 특정 재난 크기와 특정 구조물에 대한 정보를 입력하는 정보 입력부; 및 도출된 취약도 곡선에 기반하여 입력된 특정 재난 크기와 특정 구조물의 정보를 바탕으로 예측되는 취약도를 산출하는 취약도 산출부;를 포함한다.
assignees: UNIV SEJONG IND ACAD COOP FOUD;INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION OF KYUNGNAM UNIV

title_en: Method for calculating secondary electron emission coefficient of metal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating the secondary electron emission coefficient of metal, which considers the scattering of incident electrons in a material and excites inner secondary electrons, the inner secondary electrons move to the surface and generate cascade scattering, the inner secondary electrons at the surface cross a surface potential barrier to form secondary electron emission, establishes a semi-empirical formula of the secondary electron emission coefficient of metal sequentially considering the physical mechanisms involved in the process, optimizes the electron range and the energy distribution function of the inner secondary electrons, considers oblique incidence and back scattering correction to obtain the semi-empirical formula of the secondary electron emission coefficient of metal, and the result shows that the relative error between the calculation result of the optimization formula and the experimental measurement result is not more than 20 percent, and is at least 10 percent lower than the relative error of the previous formula, thereby verifying the reliability and universality of the optimization formula, compared with other traditional experimental measurement methods and Monte Carlo calculation methods, the method can greatly shorten the calculation time, is more concise and convenient to use, and has accurate results.

title_en: Underground comprehensive pipe gallery crack water seepage prevention treatment method based on smart city
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of seepage prevention of pipe gallery cracks, and discloses an underground comprehensive pipe gallery crack seepage prevention water treatment method based on a smart city. The method solves the problems that the crack identification precision is low and the crack fluid cannot be identified in the prior art, thereby achieving the technical effects of effectively improving the crack identification precision and quantitatively identifying the crack fluid; meanwhile, a comprehensive pipe rack disaster chain Bayesian network model can be constructed according to the evolution law of various potential disasters in the comprehensive pipe rack through the pipe rack risk assessment equipment, the probability of each disaster of the pipe rack is predicted, the loss degree of the pipe rack is assessed, and an effective comprehensive pipe rack pregnancy source chain breakage disaster reduction mechanism and measure are provided.
assignees: LUOYANG CITY CONSTRUCTION INVESTIG & DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Urban range electric vehicle charging demand prediction method considering geographic information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city range electric vehicle charging demand prediction method considering geographic information. The method comprises the steps of extracting driving and charging behavior characteristics of the electric automobile based on large-scale automobile traveling statistical data, simulating the driving of the electric automobile through a Monte Carlo simulation method, and analyzing charging demand characteristics of the large-scale electric automobile in an urban range. The charging demand prediction method provided by the invention can provide reference information for the dispatching operation of the power grid, and has higher reference value for the operation strategy of an operator of the electric vehicle charging infrastructure.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;EAST CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Pre-deployment method for pre-disaster repair personnel for improving recovery speed of power grid
abstract_en: The invention provides a pre-deployment method for pre-disaster emergency repair personnel for improving the recovery speed of a power grid, which comprises the following steps: 1) After the impending disaster is predicted, combining weather prediction with the geographical information of the power grid, obtaining the fault probability of each element according to the vulnerability curve of the power grid element, and generating a fault scene under the disaster through sequential Monte Carlo simulation; 2) Acquiring information of a power grid, a repair team and a deployable position, and establishing a two-stage random planning model, wherein a deployment scheme of emergency repair personnel is formulated in the first stage, and repair and restoration collaborative optimization is performed according to a fault scene in the second stage, so that power failure loss is minimized; 3) The two-stage stochastic programming model is solved for decoupling by a Progressive Hedging (PH) algorithm. According to the method, emergency repair personnel are deployed in a key link of the power grid before the upcoming weather disaster is predicted, so that the emergency response capacity of the power grid after the disaster is improved, the repair of fault elements is accelerated, and reasonable advice is provided for the formulation of an emergency plan of the power grid.

title_en: Distribution network disaster prevention material allocation method, device, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a distribution network disaster prevention material allocation method, a device, a terminal and a storage medium, which take account of the uncertainty of disaster conditions and utilize the result of Bayesian network disaster condition inference, namely node outage probability of each node, and then fuse the node outage probability on the basis of the distribution network importance degree information such as weight coefficient and load quantity of the nodes, and the elastic risk index of the whole distribution network is taken as a judging objective function to obtain node material allocation quantity of each node when the elastic risk index meets the optimization requirement, thereby realizing the optimization of distribution network overall material allocation and solving the technical problems of unreasonable disaster prevention material allocation and high resource waste degree of the conventional distribution network disaster prevention material allocation mode.

title_en: Automatic driving test scene construction method, device and equipment and readable storage medium
