abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and equipment for constructing an automatic driving test scene and a readable storage medium, wherein an element scene is extracted from a real traffic scene to establish an element scene description model, a description variable value is selected from an element scene description variable distribution interval, and the description variable is randomly sampled according to the description variable distribution by an importance sampling-based Monte Carlo method to generate a test element scene; the method can directly simulate an actual complex system, effectively solve the problem of result distortion caused by the simplification of the complex system and avoid the problem of dimension disaster that numerical solution errors of high-dimension problems rapidly increase along with the increase of dimensions; by adopting the high-risk scene strengthening generation method, more high-risk scenes are generated with smaller calculation overhead, the number of the high-risk scenes in the generated scenes is effectively increased, the number of the low-risk scenes is reduced, and the testing efficiency is improved.

title_en: River mouth area extreme storm surge water level calculation method based on JPM-OS-Q model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a JPM-OS-Q model-based estuary region extreme storm surge water level calculation method, which comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a hydrodynamic force numerical model and verifying the reliability of the model; s2, clearly researching main influence factors of the extreme water level of the storm surge in the area, introducing upstream runoff, and establishing a probability model of each driving element; s3, generating astronomical tides based on a Monte Carlo stochastic model, generating typhoon paths changing along with time based on historical typical typhoons and mobile wind field and air pressure field parameters caused by each generated typhoon; and S4, predicting the extremely high water level of the estuary region based on the discrete product-solving joint probability optimization model. The method for calculating the extreme storm surge in the estuary area improves the parameter selection, typhoon path and other settings of the original JPM-OS-Q model, simulates and calculates the extreme storm surge high water level in the high recurrence period of the estuary area, improves the prediction level of the extreme water level, improves the marine disaster prevention and reduction capability, and can be widely applied to the calculation of the extreme storm surge in the estuary area.

title_en: Fire risk early warning method and system based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire risk early warning method based on a Bayesian network, which respectively takes 3 variables of a risk source, a fire event state and a fire risk as a row variable and a column variable to construct an incidence matrix; traversing the matrix, and connecting corresponding row variables with column variables by using directed edges to finally form a network structure generally accepted by each expert; according to the method, 3 sub-networks of a risk source, a fire event state and fire risk are established, according to the 3 established sub-networks, a fire event state variable and a disaster-bearing state variable are used as common nodes, and the 3 sub-networks are combined to form a Bayesian network model for fire event prediction. The invention flexibly judges and determines the fire risk and the loss degree of the area or the unit according to the existing data, and provides auxiliary decision support and risk early warning for fire prevention and control.
assignees: JIANGSU JINGE NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Pipeline corrosion leakage fire deduction system based on Bayesian network inference model
abstract_en: The invention provides a pipeline corrosion leakage deduction system based on a Bayesian network inference model. The pipeline detection module is included: the method is used for monitoring the pipeline in real time. Pipeline risk rehearsal module: the method is used for calculating all fire source factors and excavating risk nodes. Pipeline fire deduction module: used for calculating fire accidents and calculating disaster factors according to probability. The invention can monitor the air pressure difference, the temperature and the acid-base concentration in the pipeline in real time, and further judge the corrosion condition in the pipeline and whether the pipeline leaks, thereby judging whether the pipeline leaks to generate fire factors, and further judging whether fire accidents and other derived accidents occur through the fire factors. The invention is based on the reasoning and pre-deduction of the Bayesian network reasoning model, not only carries out deduction and budget on the fire-causing factors, but also carries out deduction and budget on the fire accidents, and judges the specific fire occurrence probability, thereby realizing the advance deduction of the fire accidents, strengthening the self-checking and protection before the fire, and further reducing the occurrence of the fire accidents.

title_en: Storm surge extreme water level prediction method based on random statistical model and hydrodynamic model coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a storm surge extreme water level prediction method based on coupling of a random statistical model and a hydrodynamic model, and belongs to the technical field of ocean science and ocean engineering. The method comprises the following steps: s1, collecting hydrological and topographic data in the area, establishing a Delft3D hydrodynamic model and verifying; s2, establishing a main historical typhoon database and a Roche storm surge driving element set; s3, recombining storm surge driving elements based on Monte Carlo; s4, selecting and verifying a proper typhoon field model; and S5, simulating and predicting the extreme high water level based on the storm surge of the typical historical typhoon. The method comprehensively considers the influence of climate change and sea level rise on the extreme water level value, can be used for predicting the extreme water levels in different reappearance periods and numerical forecasting of storm surge, is favorable for preventing and reducing disasters so as to reduce the disaster loss of coastal vulnerable areas, and is favorable for reasonable planning and design.

title_en: Substation operation risk assessment method considering time-varying state of electric main equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a substation operation risk assessment method considering a time-varying state of an electric main device, which comprises the following steps: obtaining state scores of all parts in the electric main equipment according to the layering and grading of the fault tree, determining weight coefficients of all the parts through a hierarchical analysis method, obtaining fuzzy comprehensive evaluation results of all the electric main equipment, and classifying the states of the electric main equipment; considering the influence of the state of the electric main equipment and weather conditions on the fault probability, and solving the fault probability of the electric main equipment in the current period; determining the normal operation or fault outage state of the main equipment by adopting a Monte Carlo method, and evaluating short-time operation risk indexes of the transformer substation by taking connectivity between the inlet wire of the power supply of the transformer substation and a load point as risk quantification indexes; and if the short-time operation risk index of the transformer substation meets the preset condition, sending out early warning information. The method is beneficial to taking preventive measures in advance, reducing the influence of accidental faults and weather disasters of the electric main equipment on the transformer substation, and improving the operation reliability level of the transformer substation.

title_en: Disaster analysis method and electronic device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster analysis method and electronic equipment, wherein after an induced event possibly causing a target disaster occurs, parameter values of the induced event of the target disaster are acquired, a pre-trained Bayesian network model is adopted to analyze the parameter values of the induced event, and the probability of the target disaster and secondary derivative disaster possibly caused by the induced event is determined according to the analysis result of the parameter values of the induced event. Since the pre-trained bayesian network model in the embodiment of the present disclosure is constructed based on the secondary derivative disaster event graph, by analyzing and processing the accident data through the model, the direct disaster (i.e., target disaster) and the secondary derivative disaster related influence possibly caused by the induction time can be obtained, so as to prevent the disaster in advance, thereby improving the capability of preventing the disaster risk in the handling of the urban dangerous disaster.

title_en: Apparatus and method for calculating multi-hazard fragility
title_ko: 복합재해 취약률 계산 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device and a method for calculating the vulnerability to multiple disasters. The method includes: a step of receiving the input of predetermined parameters related to first and second disasters with regard to the destruction probability of an object for each disaster intensity; a step of converting a first model-based first parameter, which is one of the predetermined parameters, into a second model-based second parameter; a step of calculating the response value of each of a plurality of the objects with regard to the first and second disasters and the proof value of the object with regard to the disaster by disaster intensity of each of the first and second disasters based on at least one of the median value indicating the disaster intensity at the point where the destruction probability is half in the predetermined parameter, correlation data indicating the probability of the objects including the object to be destructed in association with the disaster, and the second parameter; a step of comparing the response value to the proof value; and a step of calculating the vulnerability of the system including the objects in relation to the first and second disasters based on the result of the comparison.
abstract_ko: 일 실시예에 따른 복합재해 취약률 판단 방법에 있어서, 재해 세기 별 객체의 파괴 확률과 관련된, 제 1 재해와 제 2 재해 각각에 대한 소정의 파라미터를 입력받는 단계; 상기 소정의 파라미터 중 제1 모델에 기초한 제1 파라미터를 제2 모델에 기초한 제2 파라미터로 변환하는 단계; 상기 소정의 파라미터 중 상기 파괴 확률이 절반이 되는 지점에서의 재해 세기를 나타내는 중앙값, 상기 객체를 포함하는 복수 개의 객체가 상기 재해로 인해 상관되어서 파괴될 가능성을 나타내는 상관성 데이터 및 상기 제2 파라미터 중 적어도 하나에 기초해서, 상기 제 1 재해 및 제 2 재해의 각각의 재해 세기 별로, 상기 복수 개의 객체 각각이 상기 제 1 재해 및 상기 제 2 재해에 대해 갖는 응답값 및 해당 재해에 대해 갖는 내력값을 계산하는 단계; 상기 응답값과 상기 내력값을 비교하는 단계; 및 상기 비교하는 단계에서 비교된 결과에 기초하여, 상기 복수 개의 객체를 포함하는 시스템이 상기 제 1 및 제 2 재해에 대해 갖는 취약률을 계산하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Distribution line lightning stroke tripping probability evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating lightning stroke tripping probability of a distribution line, wherein the method comprises the following steps: identifying a current lightning strike area based on historical lightning monitoring information; acquiring all power distribution towers in the lightning falling area, and calculating the lightning falling probability of all the power distribution towers; calculating lightning trip-out probabilities of the power distribution lines built by all the power distribution towers based on an electrical geometric model and a Monte Carlo method; and calculating the predicted thunder outage probability of the distribution line by combining the thunder falling probability of all the distribution towers and the lightning trip-out probability of the distribution line. In the embodiment of the invention, reference can be provided for the operation and maintenance of the distribution line of the power distribution network under the weather of lightning disasters, and the fund utilization level is improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Multi-disaster-species coupling and secondary derivative evolution prediction system based on disaster chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-disaster coupling and secondary derivative evolution prediction system based on a disaster chain, which comprises: the disaster chain relevance knowledge modeling module, the multi-disaster emergency dynamic comprehensive management module and the multi-disaster coupling prediction module are used for predicting the disaster chain relevance knowledge; the disaster chain relevance knowledge modeling module is used for constructing a disaster chain for a natural disaster by using a disaster source to form a semantic network diagram, and representing disaster chain knowledge by using a Bayesian network method in combination with the actual background demand analysis of a causal disaster chain; the multi-disaster emergency dynamic comprehensive management module is used for realizing dynamic management of real-time processing, analysis and decision of natural disaster information; and the multi-disaster coupling prediction module divides the prediction process based on the disaster chain into single disaster prediction and multi-disaster coupling prediction according to two factors of catastrophe and disaster-bearing body. The invention can analyze the disaster in all directions and at multiple angles and perform various emergency disposals after the disaster occurs through the multi-disaster coupling evolution model.
assignees: NANJING LES INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Alarm position positioning method, system, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, computer equipment and a storage medium for positioning an alarm position, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical alarm data and corresponding real alarm situation position information; calculating and obtaining credibility weights of alarm information of different sources in the historical alarm data according to the real alarm situation position information; and calculating to obtain a confidence interval of the current alarm position according to the alarm information of different sources of the current alarm position and the corresponding reliability weights of the alarm information of different sources. The scheme can rapidly carry out reasoning and positioning on the actual position of the case from the alarm information of various different sources, is favorable for helping fire rescue teams to realize rapid and accurate command and improve rescue efficiency, and avoids wasting time, manpower and material resources, thereby avoiding a great amount of property loss and casualties caused by accident disasters as far as possible.

title_en: Dynamic risk analysis method for hazardous chemical substance fire domino accident under multi-disaster coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic risk analysis method for a hazardous chemical substance fire domino accident under multi-disaster coupling, which comprises the steps of collecting basic information; analyzing the vulnerability of the equipment under the action of natural disasters to determine a possible initial accident scene; analyzing the equipment states at different time steps by using a distribution model of accident parameters; counting the states of the devices appearing at different time steps through Monte Carlo simulation; after all Monte Carlo simulations are completed, the dynamic domino accident probability is calculated. Under the coupling of multiple disasters, the evolution process of the fire domino accident has close time correlation, and the accident risk is larger. By adopting the method, the dynamic risk assessment of the fire domino accident of the large-area chemical equipment can be realized, and important decision support is provided for domino accident prevention and control.

title_en: Method for analyzing risks of earth-rock dam of cascade reservoir group under extreme working conditions
abstract_en: The invention discloses a step reservoir group earth-rock dam risk analysis method under extreme working conditions of 'dam break flood + earthquake'. Firstly, calculating break dam flood of an A-step reservoir by using a break dam flood analysis model based on erosion and flood evolution analysis through an earth-rock dam break flood calculation and flood evolution analysis, and evolving to a downstream B-step reservoir, and obtaining a large number of dam front water levels of the B-step reservoir in different time periods according to a fixed time period length method provided by the invention; secondly, randomly sampling by a Monte Carlo method according to the shear strength parameters and the distribution profile of the dam body material of the step-B dam, simulating the influence of earthquake on the stability of the dam slope by adopting a pseudo-static method, and calculating by adopting a simplified Bishop method in soil mechanics to obtain the dam slope anti-skid stability safety factor F of the step-B dam under the earthquake working condition of different combinations of the shear strength parameters of the dam body material and the water level in front of the dam; finally, calculating a reliable index beta sum by fitting the safety factor F sample distributionProbability of conditional failure P F Further realizing the dam slope failure probability P of the step B earth-rock dam under the simultaneous action of' break of the step A earth-rock dam and earthquake F0 . According to the method, the stability analysis of the dam slope of the step earth-rock dam considering the combined action of the earthquake and the dam break flood is realized from the aspect of system safety, and a technical support is provided for the risk analysis and evaluation of the large dam of the watershed step reservoir group.
assignees: CHINA RENEWABLE ENERGY ENGINEERING INST;POWER CONSTRUCTION CORP OF CHINA

title_en: Method for calculating fault probability and reliability of same-tower multi-circuit power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power transmission line fault calculation, and particularly relates to a method for calculating fault probability and reliability of a same-tower multi-circuit power transmission line; it comprises the following steps: calculating the fault probability of the same-tower multi-circuit power transmission line by a statistical analysis method; carrying out state simulation on the same-tower multi-circuit power transmission line by a Monte Carlo method; calculating the operation reliability index of the same-tower multi-circuit power transmission line; the method comprises the steps of firstly carrying out statistical analysis on fault probabilities of various natural disasters, then simulating the state of the line based on a Monte Carlo method, and finally calculating the reliability indexes of the line, wherein the reliability indexes comprise three indexes of load loss probability (LOLP), expected value of power shortage (EDNS) and expected value of power shortage (EENS).
assignees: ZHUMADIAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Disaster prediction method and system based on natural disaster chain
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster prediction method and a system based on a natural disaster chain, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a risk event incidence relation matrix based on a historical natural disaster record text and a disaster-bearing body event corresponding to the risk assessment area within an assessment period range; establishing a Bayesian network based on the risk event incidence relation matrix, and acquiring a conditional probability table corresponding to the Bayesian network; and acquiring the probability that the natural disaster will occur and/or the disaster-bearing event will occur in the risk assessment area according to the natural disaster occurrence and condition probability table in the risk assessment area. According to the embodiment of the invention, the natural disaster chain of the area is found out through the historical natural disaster recording text and the disaster-bearing body event, then the risk event incidence relation matrix is established, the conditional probability table of the Bayesian network is calculated, then the probability of risk occurrence is predicted according to the natural disaster which has occurred, the risk is quantitatively analyzed and predicted, and the risk is favorably evaluated, prevented and controlled.
assignees: BEIJING RES CENTER OF URBAN SYSTEM ENGINEERING

title_en: Disaster scenario deduction method for disaster medical rescue
abstract_en: A disaster situation deduction method for disaster medical rescue relates to the technical field of medical rescue, the method adopts a DEMATEL algorithm to analyze six factors driving disaster evolution from disaster history data, then constructs five types of knowledge meta-models for disaster medical rescue by the six driving factors, describes disaster situation information by the five types of knowledge meta-models, and further constructs a disaster medical rescue dynamic Bayesian network; and then inputting five types of knowledge metadata of the current disaster into nodes of a disaster medical rescue dynamic Bayesian network, deducing the follow-up scene of the current disaster by using the disaster medical rescue dynamic Bayesian network, calculating the follow-up scene with the largest occurrence probability, and preparing a follow-up disaster medical rescue processing scheme according to the calculation result. The method provided by the invention can improve the accuracy of predicting the disaster evolution trend and the effectiveness of medical rescue scheme formulation.

title_en: Reliability assessment method and system for offshore multi-platform interconnected power system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a reliability assessment method and a system for an offshore multi-platform interconnected power system, which comprise the following steps: determining the load power cut to each grade according to the priority tripping load cutting model to form a load cutting residual power meter; generating an equivalent virtual connection diagram containing a virtual power supply and a virtual full load node according to the load shedding residual power table, and generating element outage tables of all elements in the system; calculating the probability of the load level triggering preferential tripping and the overall power failure probability of the power distribution system by grades; the influence of the power generation and transmission system on the power distribution system is equivalent to the power distribution system, and the reliability of the whole system is calculated by adopting a Bayesian network. The method can evaluate the reliability and weak links of the offshore multi-platform interconnected power system, can calculate quickly and accurately, and is used for rebuilding and expanding the offshore multi-platform power system; the method can be widely applied to the technical field of reliability evaluation of the power system.
assignees: CHINA NAT OFFSHORE OIL CORP;CNOOC RES INST CO LTD;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Method for identifying fragile line of electric power system in response to hurricane disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying a fragile line of an electric power system for dealing with hurricane disasters, which comprises the following steps of firstly, respectively quantifying the influence of hurricane wind speed and line tide out-of-limit on line fault probability; then, the failure of the power system under an extreme disaster such as hurricane is described as a continuous disturbance process considering the continuous influence of strong wind; then, simulating the faults of the system under the disaster by adopting a Monte Carlo simulation method to obtain a large number of cascading fault accident chains; and then constructing a fault association diagram CFGPD under continuous disturbance describing a line fault sequence and loss conditions, and finally providing a fragile line identification mode based on the CFGPD. According to the method, the influence degree of the disaster on the power system is calculated from two dimensions of time and space, and the load loss of the system is greatly reduced by taking corresponding reinforcement measures on the identified fragile line, so that support is provided for disaster prevention.

title_en: Flow process analysis method for intensity index space variation flow state landslide
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flow process analysis method of an intensity index space variation flow state landslide, which comprises the steps of inputting boundary conditions of the flow state landslide, the geometric dimension of a landslide body and rock and soil body intensity index space variation parameters into a program, initializing the boundary conditions, the geometric dimension of the landslide body and the rock and soil body intensity index space variation parameters, utilizing a Karhunen-Lo e expansion method as a stochastic theory, modeling uncertainty and space propagation of a random variable to generate a random sample of the space variation flow state landslide, carrying out deterministic analysis on the flow process of the flow state landslide based on an SPH method, combining the stochastic theory with an SPH model, carrying out Monte Carlo simulation in the SPH method, and finally carrying out statistical analysis on simulation results of different stochastic examples to obtain a probability statistical rule of flow state landslide sliding distance and sliding speed; the method can evaluate the sliding distance, the sliding speed and the disaster causing range of the landslide under the influence of the spatial variability of the strength parameters.

title_en: Industrial park off-grid scheduling method considering uncertainty of power outage duration
abstract_en: The invention provides an industrial park off-grid scheduling method considering the uncertainty of power failure time length, which comprises the following steps: establishing an industrial production flow model according to the transmission of the material flow of the industrial park; establishing a steady-state energy flow unified model of the industrial park according to the energy hub and the industrial production flow model of the industrial park; establishing an off-grid industrial park optimal scheduling model; calculating probability distribution of the power failure time of the external power grid, and generating sample scenes with different power failure time by adopting a Monte Carlo method according to the probability distribution of the power failure time of the external power grid; adopting a K-means clustering algorithm to reduce sample scenes with different power failure time lengths; and according to the reduced multiple sample scenes, taking the occurrence probability of each scene in the reduced multiple sample scenes as a weight coefficient, and adopting a random optimization method to perform collaborative optimization on the off-grid industrial park optimal scheduling model to obtain an off-grid scheduling strategy with the minimum power failure loss.

title_en: Power distribution network outage node prediction method based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network outage node prediction method based on a Bayesian network, which comprises the following steps: constructing a tree-shaped Bayesian network corresponding to the power distribution network; giving a key node set and an evidence node set in the tree Bayesian network, and calculating a joint probability P1 of the evidence node set; selecting a shutdown combination in the key node set, combining the shutdown combination with the evidence node set, and calculating the overall joint probability P2 so as to obtain the posterior probability P2/P1 of the shutdown combination; circularly calculating the posterior probability of each outage combination in the key node set; and selecting the outage combination with the maximum posterior probability as the most possible outage state, namely the outage node prediction result of the power distribution network. Compared with the prior art, the method fully considers the possibility of various shutdown combinations, and has strong result reliability; the multivariate joint probability problem of the original exponential complexity is converted into the linear complexity problem by combining the characteristics of the tree-shaped Bayesian network through a recursion idea; the dimension disaster is overcome, and the calculation time is reduced.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Uncertainty quantification method for wind speed of atmospheric boundary layer
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of boundary layer wind speed numerical calculation in atmospheric science, and particularly relates to an uncertainty quantification method for wind speed of an atmospheric boundary layer. The method comprises the following steps: 1, decorrelating the viscosity coefficient of the random turbulence by utilizing K-L decomposition; 2, projecting the multivariate response value to a dimension by using a projection resampling method; 3, solving a full dimension reduction conversion matrix by using a slice inverse regression method; 4, regarding the dimension reduction space obtained in the step 3 as a control variable to restrain the error of the Monte Carlo method; and 5, solving the mean value and the variance of the wind speed of the atmospheric boundary layer along with the height change. The effect of inertia item has been kept in this application, has considered the change of torrent stickness coefficient along with the height, and calculates portably, is a practical and effectual mode of research atmospheric boundary layer, and its result is more accurate, and belongs to non-invasive method, can effectively overcome the problem of "dimension disaster", can also guarantee that the precision of result is more excellent simultaneously under the circumstances that the calculated amount is less than the Monte Carlo method.

title_en: Integrated flood disaster accurate monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to flood disaster monitoring and early warning, in particular to an integrated flood disaster accurate monitoring and early warning method, which comprises the steps of collecting heterogeneous multi-scale monitoring data, rapidly extracting a flood inundation area from large-scale flood disaster data based on a multi-source satellite remote sensing platform through multi-scale super-pixel segmentation, carrying out image splicing on medium-scale flood disaster data based on an unmanned aerial vehicle platform based on an optimal suture line to obtain a flood disaster receiving result of an unmanned aerial vehicle image, acquiring a multi-dimensional characteristic from small-scale flood disaster data based on an Internet of things platform by combining a multi-mode deep neural network and a structured sparse classification selection model, constructing a Bayesian network risk assessment model, and providing a basis for flood disaster early warning and decision making; the technical scheme provided by the invention can effectively overcome the defects that comprehensive and integrated heterogeneous multi-scale monitoring data cannot be effectively utilized and the problems of spatial heterogeneity, dynamic risk change and multi-level risk of flood disasters cannot be effectively solved.

title_en: Flood disaster risk assessment method based on heterogeneous multi-scale monitoring data
abstract_en: The invention relates to flood disaster risk assessment, in particular to a flood disaster risk assessment method based on heterogeneous multi-scale monitoring data, which comprises the steps of obtaining the heterogeneous multi-scale monitoring data, establishing an index system after analysis, screening and determining a basic risk factor set, determining each network node and causal relationship, establishing a Bayesian network risk assessment model based on each network node and causal relationship, carrying out fuzzy evaluation on the network nodes, defuzzifying, calculating posterior probability of a target event, and carrying out flood disaster risk assessment based on the posterior probability of the target event; the technical scheme provided by the invention can effectively overcome the defects that the spatial heterogeneity of flood risks cannot be effectively coped with in the prior art, and the problems of dynamic risk change and multi-level risks in the inoculation, generation and development processes of flood disasters cannot be effectively solved.

title_en: Method and system for improving toughness of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for improving the toughness of a power distribution network, which are used for evaluating the importance of power distribution network components in typhoon weather, establishing an element fault rate model under the action of storm wind, sampling the state of a wind power generation system by adopting a non-sequential Monte Carlo simulation method, establishing an optimal recovery strategy model and sequencing the importance of the components; acquiring a fault condition when a disaster occurs, and preferentially recovering elements with high importance according to a determined sequence to improve the robustness of the power distribution network; the method comprises the steps of forming a plurality of micro-grids through pre-deployment of the mobile emergency power generation cars before disasters and real-time scheduling after disasters, establishing an objective function with the minimum power failure time of important loads in different scenes as a target, forming an MILP problem through the objective function and constraint conditions, obtaining the real-time distribution condition of the mobile emergency power generation cars after the disasters by solving corresponding problems, and completing recovery and promotion of the power distribution network. The invention realizes the improvement of the robustness of the power distribution network; the power distribution network fault recovery time is shortened, and the rapidity of power distribution network recovery is realized.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Cascading arbitrator method for battle scheme sequencing optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade arbitrator method for the sequencing optimization of combat plans, which comprises the following specific steps: starting from aspects such as battlefield environment, combat targets, judgment principles and the like, extracting combat scheme evaluation indexes, and associating each combat scheme evaluation index to a corresponding importance level; constructing a cascading resolver network by using a hierarchical Bayesian network method, wherein the cascading resolver network comprises an index layer, a sequencing layer and a deciding layer, the index layer is connected with the sequencing layer, the sequencing layer is connected with the deciding layer, and each layer comprises a plurality of nodes; and forming a network evidence set by the virtual evidences of all the fighting scheme evaluation indexes, substituting the network evidence set into the cascade arbitrator network, and sequencing and optimizing the fighting schemes. The method does not need to distribute index weight or arrange the order of the importance of the indexes, directly obtains the advantages and disadvantages of the scheme through the posterior inference of the discrete Bayesian network, has lower use cost and higher computational efficiency, and is beneficial to improving the stability and credibility of the result.
assignees: XINYUN LINGCHUANG BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid operation risk situation sensing method for disaster weather
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid operation risk situation perception method facing to disaster weather. The method is based on a Bayesian network with time-varying wind speed, and a power grid time-varying risk propagation model considering the trend transfer caused by wind speed and disconnection faults is established; solving the running state parameters of the power grid by adopting a Monte Carlo simulation method of Latin hypercube sampling and combining an optimal direct current flow model; and constructing a power grid operation risk situation perception index system, and realizing presentation and prediction of line risk situation, load level situation and power grid toughness situation. An effective real-time perception method is provided for the power grid operation risk situation facing to the disaster weather.

title_en: Urban power grid cascading failure risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a city power grid cascading failure risk assessment method and system, wherein tidal current probability models of wind power generation, photovoltaic power generation and electric vehicle charging stations are respectively built, and compared with the prior art, the consideration factors are more comprehensive. In the process of solving the probability trend, a semi-invariant method is used for converting random variables into semi-invariant, and meanwhile, compared with a Monte Carlo method, the semi-invariant method adopting a Cornish-Fisher series expansion formula has higher calculation speed and is more beneficial to realizing online evaluation; compared with the semi-invariant method of the Gram-Charlie series expansion, the situation that the probability density function has negative values does not occur. The urban power grid cascading failure risk assessment method based on the probability trend has the advantages that the established model is more complete, the considered factors are more comprehensive, the solving method is more efficient and the like. Therefore, the technical problem that the risk of the actual power grid cascading failure can not be quickly and accurately evaluated in the prior art is solved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ZHUHAI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Multi-disaster power distribution network elasticity assessment method considering fault linkage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-disaster power distribution network elasticity evaluation method considering fault cascading, which comprises the following steps: step S1, modeling various disaster feature failure rates; step S2, based on sequential Monte Carlo simulation, the time sequence characteristics of the element in the disaster process are reserved, and an element running state model formed by a basic range fault rate and a characteristic fault rate is established; s3, analyzing the nonlinear association degree of the trend state characterization quantity sequences of the lines and the nodes in the N-1 scene set and the N-2 scene set through the gray theory, and establishing a coupling relation between fault scenes; s4, establishing a LLD index, an SEDT index and an economic index which comprehensively consider the load loss degree and the maximum frequency change rate of the active unbalance initial moment to form a weighted elasticity-economic space evaluation system, and carrying out elasticity evaluation by measuring the composite entropy weight Euclidean distance between the scene cluster center and the perfect elasticity point; the fault linkage in the disaster process can be prevented and inhibited, and the elasticity of the power transmission network in extreme weather is improved.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for predicting power outage number of power system station
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a medium for predicting the power failure number of a power system station, which can generate an initial population by a Monte Carlo method, avoid the problem of low algorithm searching capability caused by uneven distribution of solutions caused by random initialization of the population by most algorithms, dynamically adjust scaling factors and cross probability in the evolution process by a self-adaptive differential evolution algorithm, and improve the local searching capability of the algorithm. By adopting the embodiment of the invention, the XGBoost classification algorithm can be subjected to super-parameter optimization based on the Monte Carlo method and the self-adaptive differential evolution algorithm, so that the accuracy of a model prediction result is improved, manual optimization is not required, and the complexity of parameter optimization of a combined model is simplified.

title_en: Power transmission and distribution coordination planning method considering generalized load random characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission and distribution coordination planning method considering generalized load random characteristics, which decomposes a power transmission and distribution coupling system into a plurality of small systems according to a physical structure and then constructs a distributed decision framework of power transmission and distribution iteration interaction. Firstly, fitting a probability density function of generalized load containing distributed new energy according to actual measurement data, randomly sampling generalized load values by using a Monte Carlo sampling method, and sequentially connecting the generalized load values into a power distribution network with new energy power generation. And independently operating each power transmission system and each power distribution system, and solving the boundary power between power transmission and power distribution. The invention provides the method for realizing information transfer between the power transmission system and the power distribution system by using the mean value and standard deviation of boundary power as shared variables and using a probabilistic target cascading algorithm, and writing the target function with the Lagrange penalty function by using the lowest total running cost of the system as a target column, thereby not only not reducing the calculation precision, but also greatly improving the calculation speed.

title_en: Power distribution network resilience and reliability assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating the resilience and reliability of a power distribution network, which are used for establishing a reliability model of power distribution system elements and determining the type of the influence of each element fault on each load in the reliability model of the power distribution system elements by using a minimum path method; establishing a fault influence table, simulating the operation of the power distribution system by using a Monte Carlo method, and reconstructing a power distribution system network when a fault occurs; and inquiring the corresponding influence type in the fault influence table, counting the power failure times and the power failure time, and calculating the reliability index according to the power failure times and the power failure time to realize reliability evaluation. The method can recover more loads, reduce the load shedding amount, improve the restoring force of the system after disaster and improve the elasticity of the power system.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power grid emergency repair and restoration scheduling cooperative decision method and system under natural disaster
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system recovery decision-making, and provides a cooperative decision-making method and a cooperative decision-making system for power grid emergency repair and recovery scheduling under natural disasters, wherein the method considers the influence of equipment damage on the recovery scheduling, adjusts the emergency repair scheme on line, completes the repair of a power transmission line, a communication link and a transformer substation load outgoing line, effectively processes the mutual influence between the emergency repair and the recovery scheduling, and realizes the effective cooperation between the emergency repair and the recovery scheduling; the Monte Carlo tree search and the mathematical planning method are combined, so that emergency repair and scheduling recovery decisions can be completed in effective time, and the decision is ensured to be realized on line.

title_en: Mountain area shallow landslide risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention provides a mountainous area shallow landslide risk assessment method, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring mountain rainfall data, soil strength parameters and terrain data through rainfall station field monitoring and indoor tests; s2, calculating the soil saturation condition by using the rainfall infiltration hydrological geological model, calculating the slope safety coefficient by combining the slope stability physical mechanical model, finally calculating the slope instability probability by using the Monte Carlo simulation method, and drawing the corresponding landslide risk map in the mountain area. The method is based on a physical mechanics control equation, considers the rainfall infiltration and slope stability change process, simultaneously considers the uncertainty of soil body parameters, realizes shallow layer landslide risk assessment under the condition of rainfall in the mountainous area, and provides an important theoretical basis for disaster prevention and reduction and emergency rescue work of geological disasters of landslides in the mountainous area.

title_en: Product supply chain risk propagation method based on complex network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a product supply chain risk propagation method based on a complex network, which comprises the following steps: and (3) a step of: complex product cooperative network construction: according to the cooperative relationship among enterprises in the complex product cooperative network process, a complex product cooperative network is constructed, a supply chain network is divided into four levels, from a part provider, a part provider and a primary provider to a main manufacturer from top to bottom, the cooperative relationship between the upper level and the lower level is set, a single enterprise can be associated with a plurality of enterprises on the upper level or the lower level, and the cross-level cooperative relationship does not exist between different levels; 2. building a complex product collaborative mechanism network risk transfer model: describing by adopting a load-capacity model in cascade failure, introducing a concept of supply chain risk flow, enabling nodes to be attacked and disabled, and redistributing the load until no other overloaded enterprises or the whole network is paralyzed in the whole complex product cooperative network, so that the cascade failure process is terminated; 3. and (5) cascading failure simulation.

title_en: Systems and methods for monitoring technology infrastructure
abstract_en: Systems and methods of monitoring technology infrastructure using alerts indicative service events and tickets indicative of incidents reported to the support system, including transmitting, to a client via a network, structured support data including issue data and correlation data. The issue data represents issues, which are fewer than the number of tickets, generated by processing textual data of the tickets through a clustering engine implementing a generative probabilistic model and generating the correlation data by associating alerts and tickets by correlating alert-specific identifiers and ticket-specific identifiers. The identifiers are of least one of identifier times, locations, names, or descriptions. A prioritization engine is also disclosed.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating disaster resistance of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating disaster resistance of a power distribution network, comprising the following steps: inputting the power distribution network to be evaluated into a fault prediction model to obtain the power loss probability of each load in the power distribution network to be evaluated in each disaster stage; obtaining capability values of the power distribution network to be evaluated in each disaster stage according to the power loss probability of the load in each disaster stage, and evaluating the disaster resistance of the power distribution network to be evaluated in each disaster stage according to the capability values; the fault prediction model comprises a structural analysis layer for analyzing the topological structure of the power distribution network to be evaluated and a probability prediction layer for acquiring the power failure probability of each load in the power distribution network to be evaluated at each disaster stage under different disaster scenes based on a time sequence Monte Carlo method according to the analysis result. The method and the device are used for solving the defect of low result accuracy caused by single evaluation factors or insufficient detailed evaluation factors in the evaluation of the disaster resistance of the power distribution network in the prior art, and realizing the overall accurate evaluation of the power distribution network on various disaster resistance.

title_en: Post-disaster circuit-circuit cooperative repair method, system and equipment based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster electric-circuit cooperative repair method, a system and equipment based on reinforcement learning, wherein a time sequence Markov decision network is constructed through network topology, fault information, a maintenance station position and a maintenance team position of a power distribution network and an urban traffic network, a Monte Carlo tree search method is used for selecting a repair object of a maintenance team according to the current state and an action set which can be taken of a circuit-circuit combined system and the time sequence Markov decision network to form a data set which takes the state of the circuit-circuit combined system as a sample and takes the best repair object in the current state as a sample label, a quick decision network which takes the state of the circuit-circuit combined system as input and takes the next repair object of the circuit-circuit combined system as output is constructed, the invention considers the contradiction and the cooperativity of the repair plan of the circuit-circuit combined system, the constructed reinforcement learning algorithm is beneficial to improving the cooperative repair efficiency of the two algorithms and enhancing the resistance of the circuit-circuit combined system to natural disasters.
assignees: UNIV XIAN JIAOTONG;STATE GRID JIANGXI PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY

title_en: Multi-state association infrastructure network elasticity optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network elasticity optimization method for a multi-state association infrastructure, which comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting the structure and operation information of a related infrastructure network; step 2, establishing an operation strategy optimization model of the associated network; step 3, establishing a two-stage stochastic programming model; step 4, processing the two-stage random programming model into a mixed integer linear programming model; step 5, generating a large number of disaster scenes by using a Monte Carlo simulation method and reducing the number of the generated scenes by using a scene reduction technology; step 6, solving the two-stage random programming model after the linearization treatment by adopting an L-shaped method; and 7, solving the optimal protection strategy of the first-stage associated network and displaying the optimal protection strategy in an image mode. The invention can help a decision maker to seek the optimal protection strategy of the transport node and the link of the associated infrastructure network, improve the overall elasticity and the capacity of meeting the requirement of the associated network to the maximum extent, and reduce the influence of various disaster events.

title_en: Method for generating average shear wave velocity maps using proxy-based prediction models for earthquake disaster prediction, recording medium and device for performing the method
title_ko: 지진재해 예측을 위한 광범위 레이어 기반 예측 모델을 이용한 평균 전단파 속도 지도 작성 방법, 이를 수행하기 위한 기록 매체 및 장치
abstract_en: A method for generating an average shear wave velocity map using a wide range layer-based prediction model for earthquake disaster prediction comprises: a step of building a dataset including a shear wave velocity soil column map, topographic information, geological information, and distance information from mountain land; a step of analyzing a shear wave velocity in accordance with a soil layer, the type of soil, geological classification, and a rock formation from the built dataset; a step of generating a shear wave velocity estimation model in accordance with the geological classification and the topographic information based on the analyzed shear wave velocity; a step of correcting the generated shear wave velocity estimation model in accordance with the property of each geological age; and a step of using the corrected shear wave velocity estimation model to generate a shear wave velocity map based on the thickness of a sedimentary layer in accordance with the distance information from mountain land. Accordingly, the uncertainty from a land amplification effect can be lowered through accurate V_S30 estimation, and the reliability of Korean peninsula earthquake disaster analysis and seismic designs can be secured by using V_S30 for the Korean peninsula.
abstract_ko: 지진재해 예측을 위한 광범위 레이어 기반 예측 모델을 이용한 평균 전단파 속도 지도 작성 방법은, 전단파 속도 주상도, 지형 정보, 지질 정보 및 산지로부터의 거리 정보를 포함하는 데이터 셋을 구축하는 단계; 구축된 데이터 셋으로부터 토층, 흙의 종류, 지질 분류 및 암반층에 따른 전단파 속도를 분석하는 단계; 분석된 전단파 속도를 기반으로 지질 분류 및 지형 정보에 따른 전단파 속도 추정모델을 생성하는 단계; 생성된 전단파 속도 추정모델을 지질 시대별 특성에 따라 각각 전단파 속도 추정모델을 보정하는 단계; 및 보정된 전단파 속도 추정모델을 이용하여 산지로부터의 거리 정보에 따른 퇴적층의 두께를 기반으로 전단파 속도 지도를 생성하는 단계;를 포함한다. 이에 따라, 정확한 V S30 의 추정을 통해 부지증폭효과의 불확실성을 낮추고, 한반도용 V S30 을 사용하여 한반도 지진재해 분석 및 내진설계의 신뢰도를 확보할 수 있다.

title_en: Design construction supervision contractor performance evaluation system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric power infrastructure, in particular to a design construction supervision contractor performance evaluation system which comprises a contractor selection unit, a historical database unit, an index system construction comparison unit, a design construction supervision contractor performance evaluation unit and a design construction supervision contractor performance scoring form output unit, wherein the contractor selection unit is used for selecting a design construction supervision contractor performance scoring form; the design construction supervision contractor performance evaluation system provided by the invention is used for respectively grading each project type by combining the vertical performance conditions of the design construction supervision contractor enterprise and correcting by utilizing the Wilson confidence interval, so that dynamic evaluation is realized, manual statistics is not needed, the performance evaluation efficiency and precision are greatly improved, the performance conditions of the contractor enterprise can be stored, valuable reference information is provided for subsequent design and construction, and the benefits of power grid enterprises are ensured.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY;ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID FUJIAN PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Method and system for acquiring influence degree of urban factors on inland inundation disaster loss
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for acquiring the influence degree of urban elements on waterlogging disaster loss, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a hierarchical Bayesian network structure under the scale of a city domain and a block, and respectively corresponding the structure in the ontology model of the influence mechanism of the city elements on the waterlogging disaster to the hierarchical Bayesian network structure; performing parameter learning training on the hierarchical Bayesian network structure by adopting a parameter learning algorithm to obtain the conditional probability of each node; and carrying out sensitivity analysis on each node according to the conditional probability of each node in the hierarchical Bayesian network structure so as to quantify the influence degree of the urban elements on the waterlogging disaster loss. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, the influence degree of the urban elements on the loss of the waterlogging disaster can be quantized, so that on one hand, the influence degree of each urban element on the loss of the waterlogging disaster can be visually observed by people, and on the other hand, a quantitative evaluation basis can be provided when the loss degree of the waterlogging disaster is evaluated.

title_en: Small hydropower station outage risk assessment method under typhoon disaster based on opportunity constraint model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small hydropower station outage risk assessment method under typhoon disasters based on an opportunity constraint model, which comprises the steps of carrying out Latin hypercube sampling according to a probability distribution function of predicted output of a small hydropower station, carrying out Monte Carlo simulation, substituting a sample value into an electric power system containing the small hydropower station to carry out probability flow calculation, analyzing the small hydropower station outage as an independent event, establishing an opportunity constraint optimal cut-load model when calculating the result of the small hydropower station outage risk and the uncertainty output of the rest small hydropower station of the system, converting the opportunity constraint optimal cut-load model into a deterministic equivalent model and solving the deterministic equivalent model by CPLEX, and multiplying the small hydropower station outage probability by the minimum cut-load cost of the electric power system containing the small hydropower station to obtain a small hydropower station outage risk value. The method effectively solves the contradiction that the safety and the economical efficiency of the power grid cannot be coordinated due to the shutdown of the small hydropower station, and can be used for evaluating the risk caused by the shutdown of the small hydropower station under typhoon disasters.

title_en: Landslide disaster evaluation method and system considering space dangerousness
abstract_en: A landslide hazard evaluation method and system considering space danger are disclosed, wherein a least square fitting landslide point rain intensity regression model is used for obtaining empirical parameter values of rainfall induced landslide experience statistics; according to different confidence interval threshold value curve parameter values of a least square fit line, carrying out early warning grade grading of rainfall-triggered landslide disasters; adding the frequency ratios of different landslide disaster influence factors at the position of the designated space area to obtain an occurrence susceptibility result of the designated disaster at the position of the designated space area; carrying out landslide disaster space danger early warning grade division according to the occurrence easiness result; and coupling the obtained early warning grade of the rainfall-triggered landslide hazard with the obtained early warning grade of the landslide hazard space danger to obtain a rainfall threshold early warning grade of the comprehensive space danger factors for inducing the landslide hazard. According to the method, landslide disaster space danger zoning is combined, the precision of the rainfall landslide early warning threshold prediction in the area is improved, and a scientific basis is provided for landslide geological disaster monitoring early warning decision-making.
assignees: GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCE AND RESOURCE RES INSTITUTE OF CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES;FUJIAN PROVINCE METEOROLOGICAL SERVICE CENTER FUJIAN PROVINCE METEOROLOGICAL MOVIE AND TELEVISION CE;FUJIAN PROVINCE GEOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING CENTER FUJIAN PROVINCE GEOLOGICAL DISASTER EMERGENCY TECHN

title_en: Underground complex flood evolution prediction method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting the flood evolution of an underground complex, which comprises the steps of collecting original flood data, and carrying out flood grade conversion on the original flood data according to a preset criterion to obtain a flood event; carrying out time generalization processing, space correlation analysis and time correlation analysis on the flood incident to obtain space-time processing data; constructing a flood evolution topological network; acquiring a time-space correlation event; defining a spatio-temporal association rule, excavating the spatio-temporal association rule meeting preset conditions in the spatio-temporal association events and correcting the flood evolution topological network to obtain a flood evolution Bayesian network structure; and determining the variable and the value range of the sensor node, learning conditional probability distribution by using monitoring data, and establishing a flood evolution Bayesian network to realize the prediction of the flood probability. The method solves the problem of lack of water disaster data mining in the prior art, realizes the real-time dynamic prediction of disaster development, and improves the accuracy and efficiency of the evolution prediction of the underground complex flood.

title_en: Method for analyzing vulnerability of buckling failure of vertical storage tank under coupling action of flood and hurricane
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for analyzing the vulnerability of buckling failure of a vertical storage tank under the coupling action of flood and hurricane. The method comprises the following steps: determining basic information of the vertical storage tank; determining the acting force applied to the vertical storage tank; calculating the resisting load of the vertical storage tank; calculating the external acting force of the vertical storage tank; establishing a limit state equation of the storage tank buckling failure under the coupling action of flood and hurricane according to the storage tank buckling failure judgment basis; counting the number of times of buckling failure of the target storage tank by adopting a Monte Carlo simulation method, and calculating failure probability; and (4) drawing a vulnerability curve of the storage tank under the coupling action of flood and hurricane, and analyzing the influence of different wind speeds, water depths and filling rates on the storage tank. The method can accurately calculate the buckling failure probability of the vertical storage tank under the coupling action of flood and hurricane, and provides a powerful basis for vulnerability evaluation under the multi-disaster coupling action of chemical process equipment.

title_en: Multi-type distributed power supply two-stage planning method for power distribution network restoring force improvement
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-type distributed power supply two-stage planning method for improving the restoring force of a power distribution network, which comprises the following steps: 1, counting fault rates of distribution network lines under different disaster conditions and availability rates of different types of distributed power Supplies (DGs) according to regional historical disaster data; 2, simulating and generating a damage scene of the circuit after the power distribution network is subjected to extreme disasters of various types and levels by using a Monte Carlo method; 3, respectively optimizing planning positions of the distributed photovoltaic, wind power and a conventional distributed unit aiming at each scene; and 4, respectively counting the optimal planning positions of the distributed power supplies in all scenes contained under different disasters, sorting according to the descending order of the occurrence times of the positions, and taking the first several times of positions with the same number as the planning number of the power supplies as the optimal planning positions of the power supplies under the corresponding disasters. The invention can improve the capacity of supplying power to the load and the speed of recovering the load after the power distribution network encounters an extreme disaster, thereby improving the recovery power of the power distribution network.

title_en: Fire risk assessment method, system, terminal equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire risk assessment method, a fire risk assessment system, terminal equipment and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the fire risk assessment method comprises the following steps: constructing a fire risk structural equation model, training the fire risk structural equation model to obtain a model output parameter, displaying the model output parameter through a knowledge graph, and obtaining a path coefficient in the model output parameter; acquiring a dynamic fire development influence parameter, and determining fire development trend probability through a dynamic Bayesian network based on the dynamic fire development influence parameter and the path coefficient; and obtaining a dynamic fire evaluation network based on the fire evolution trend probability, a preset dynamic fire evaluation index system and preset expert knowledge, so as to quantitatively evaluate the risk of the fire through the dynamic fire evaluation network. The invention can improve the evaluation efficiency when the risk evaluation is carried out on the dynamic fire disaster.

title_en: Power system elasticity evaluation method considering cascading failure evolution under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system elasticity evaluation method considering cascading failure evolution under typhoon disasters, and relates to the field of power system analysis. The method comprises the steps of generating a fault scene through a power transmission line fault model under a typhoon disaster; utilizing a cascading failure evolution model based on short and long time scales to simulate cascading failures and an evolution process thereof of a power system caused by transient stability and thermal stability problems; and (4) evaluating the elasticity index value of the power system according to the system performance condition by combining a power system recovery model and adopting a sequential Monte Carlo simulation method. Compared with the electric power system elastic evaluation method without considering cascading failure evolution, the method can effectively simulate the initial failure condition and cascading failure evolution process caused by typhoon disasters, is more comprehensive and objective in describing the failure scene and closer to the actual failure development condition of the electric power system under the typhoon disasters, so that the elastic evaluation result is more accurate, and is beneficial to accurately evaluating the ability of the electric power system to cope with the typhoon disasters by power grid operators and formulating a targeted recovery strategy.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating vulnerability of wind disaster of vertical overlock metal roof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating vulnerability of a vertical overlock metal roof, which take a Monte Carlo simulation method as a probability analysis method to conduct vulnerability research on the metal roof, conduct random simulation through random sampling, acquire a large number of samples through a finite element model analysis method, then conduct simulation calculation on the samples, and obtaining the mean value and the logarithmic standard deviation of the sample, quantifying the performance level according to the sample data to obtain a damage parameter so as to establish a probability function of vulnerability to wind disasters, and finally fitting the probability function of vulnerability to wind disasters established under different wind speeds by combining the capacity demand ratio to obtain a final fitting function. According to the assessment method disclosed by the invention, the probability change rule of the roof system along with different performance levels of extreme wind pressure can be intuitively seen, and the probability of reaching different performance levels under the action of wind pressure with different polarity values is obtained, so that the assessment of the vulnerability of the vertical overlooking metal roof under different wind speeds can be completed.

title_en: Emergency scheme dynamic adjustment method and system based on scene element evolution link
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency scheme dynamic adjustment method and system based on a scene element evolution link, belonging to the field of emergency scheme adjustment, wherein the adjustment method comprises the following steps: obtaining t  1  A plurality of current scene elements of a moment; acquiring historical disaster situations of various disaster bearing bodies, and determining a plurality of historical scene elements; determining a single scene element link of the disaster bearing body according to the current scene element and the historical scene element; determining t according to single scene element link of each disaster bearing body  1  A composite scene element link of a time; determining each scene element in the composite scene element link at t  1  Disaster grade of time and determining each scene element at t  2  An initial emergency scheme at a moment; converting the composite scene element link into a Bayesian network; predicting each scene element at t by adopting Bayes formula  2  Disaster level at the moment; according to the situationElement is at t  1  Time and t  2  And adjusting the initial emergency scheme according to the disaster grade at each moment to obtain a final emergency scheme. The effectiveness and the rationality of the emergency scheme are improved.

title_en: Multi-target comprehensive evaluation system and method for comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-target comprehensive evaluation system and method for a comprehensive energy system, and relates to the technical field of energy system evaluation; the method comprises the steps of evaluating the reliability of an energy system based on a sequential Monte Carlo simulation method, obtaining the system average outage duration and the system average energy supply reliability of the energy system, calculating and obtaining the energy utilization rate of the energy system, analyzing the system average outage duration, the system average energy supply reliability and the energy utilization rate based on a fuzzy analytic hierarchy process to obtain a target function, and obtaining the evaluation value of the energy system based on the target function f; the system comprises an energy system reliability evaluation module, an energy utilization rate module and an evaluation module; the reliability evaluation and the energy utilization rate are combined for analysis, and the like, so that the higher working efficiency and the better effect of the energy evaluation are realized.
assignees: SHIJIAZHUANG CITY GAOCHENG DISTR POWER SUPPLY BRANCH COMPANY STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;SHIJIAZHUANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH CO STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Emergency repair method under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The application provides an emergency repair method under a typhoon disaster, which comprises the steps of firstly determining a power grid disaster area according to typhoon monitoring information before the typhoon, namely a first stage, collecting meteorological data, distribution network data, geographic data and the like of the disaster area, calculating line fault probability based on the collected data, establishing a temporary allocation center site selection model according to the fault probability and the position, and solving to obtain the position of a temporary allocation center. Secondly, generating a post-disaster line breaking scene by utilizing a Monte Carlo simulation and synchronous back-substitution scene reduction method in the post-disaster stage, establishing a post-disaster distribution network emergency repair recovery optimization model based on the post-disaster line breaking scene, solving the model to obtain a post-disaster distribution network emergency repair recovery optimization strategy, and realizing rapid emergency repair recovery of distribution network faults under typhoon disasters.

title_en: Landslide disaster danger based rural house building and site selection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide disaster danger area-based rural house building site selection method, which utilizes a TRIGRS model in combination with underground pore waterObtaining stability coefficient expressions of grid unit bodies at different depths through the change of pressure; acquiring hydraulic change in a slope based on a rainfall infiltration theory according to regional rainfall conditions, generating N groups of random numbers which accord with the random distribution of rock-soil body strength parameters by using a Monte Carlo method according to the random distribution of the rock-soil body strength parameters, substituting the random numbers into a grid unit body stability coefficient expression, and acquiring N stability coefficient results for the same grid unit body, wherein M values in the N stability coefficient results are less than or equal to 1, and the instability probability of the grid unit body is The regional damage probability distribution map can be obtained, the spatial position and scale of rainfall landslide occurrence can be accurately predicted, a specific calculation method is provided for landslide disaster damage probability region division, specific standards are provided for building site selection, and reference is provided for government work.

title_en: Method for evaluating and managing risk of slope-cutting landslide hazard in rural house building
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for evaluating and managing risk of landslide hazard in slope cutting during building of rural areas, which comprises the steps of calculating stability coefficients of grid unit bodies at different depths in an area through a TRIGRS model, obtaining an area damage probability distribution map by combining a Monte Carlo method, converting the grid units into slope units by using an ArcGIS platform to obtain an area risk distribution map, and determining whether building is allowed in the area according to risk; dividing the cut slope into a soil cut slope and a rock-soil mixed cut slope, calculating a cut slope stability coefficient and a potential sliding area under different parameter combinations based on Geostudio simulation, and determining whether to allow the cut slope according to the cut slope stability coefficient; obtaining a house design safety distance based on the potential sliding area; after a slope cutting design scheme is selected, evaluating slope cutting risks according to the safety evaluation standard of the slope cutting stability coefficient, and adopting corresponding prevention and control schemes according to different risk levels; all information is stored in the digitizing platform. The contents in the aspect of geological disaster prevention and control are systematically considered for the scientific site selection of rural house building.

title_en: Deep and long tunnel water inrush prediction method based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of tunnel engineering disaster prediction, and particularly relates to a Bayesian network-based deep and long tunnel inrush water prediction method, which comprises the steps of determining influence factors of deep and long tunnel inrush water, perfecting grading of disaster factors and inrush water evaluation indexes, and establishing a tunnel inrush water sample library; establishing a hierarchical structure relation of the inrush water influence factors by applying an explanation structure model method, determining the ordering and interlayer directional connection of the influence factors, and establishing an explanation structure model; based on the explanation structure model, the construction method of the Bayesian network structure is improved; aiming at the conditions of different sample libraries, constructing a Bayesian network model by applying an improved method; and (4) carrying out quantitative prediction on the inrush water of the deep and long tunnel according to the Bayesian network model. The method can realize qualitative and quantitative comprehensive analysis, has applicability to complete data samples and incomplete data samples, has applicability to small samples, is independent of subjective judgment, and can predict the burst water of the deep and long tunnel more accurately and objectively.

title_en: Ensemble forecast storm damage response system for critical infrastructure
abstract_en: A storm damage response system includes a storm ensemble database that stores ensemble forecast models associated with potential storm paths of a storm across a geographic area and an inventory database that stores inventory data associated with location and characteristics of power-providing equipment in the geographic area.
