A storm damage model algorithm generates a storm response plan comprising an operational procedure for repairing or maintaining power transmission and distribution electric systems to mitigate storm damage impact based on generating a probabilistic model for each of the ensemble forecast models based on the inventory data and calculating a statistical impact value associated with the probabilistic model based on an aggregate of iterative probabilistic simulations for the respective ensemble forecast model. The storm response plan can be generated based on the relative statistical impact value of the probabilistic model of each of the ensemble forecast models.

title_en: Buried pipeline deformation monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of municipal engineering and geotechnical engineering, in particular to a buried pipeline deformation monitoring and early warning method, which combines a neural network time sequence model with a Monte Carlo method to monitor and early warn the deformation trend of the buried pipeline. The method has the advantages that abrupt change damage of the pipeline due to construction, natural disasters and the like can be timely found in daily monitoring, meanwhile, the middle-long-term deformation trend of the pipeline is predicted, unsafe states and specific parts are found in advance, and countermeasures are taken for finding reasons to prevent the reasons from being happened.

title_en: Mobile energy storage planning method considering reliability and elasticity of power distribution network in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile energy storage planning method considering reliability and elasticity of a power distribution network in extreme weather, which comprises the following steps: establishing an element fault rate model, and modeling an uncertainty scene of a power distribution network with fault disasters; extracting an extreme weather scene by a Monte Carlo method, reducing the extreme weather scene by adopting a K-means algorithm, and extracting the load, the distributed power output and a power distribution network fault scene by adopting Latin hypercube sampling in consideration of the uncertainty of the load and the distributed power output; selecting evaluation indexes from multiple angles, calculating objective weight of each index and constructing a power distribution network reliability and elasticity evaluation index system; taking two indexes of pre-disaster loss and post-disaster recovery rate as optimization targets, and establishing a mobile energy storage optimization planning model considering the whole disaster time period; and solving the mobile energy storage optimization planning model by using a COBL-PSO algorithm. According to the invention, the reliability and elasticity of the power distribution network are improved through the mobile energy storage optimization planning scheme.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Elasticity assessment method for information physical fusion power transmission network under ice disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elasticity assessment method of an information physical fusion power transmission network under ice disaster, which aims at a power transmission network taking OPGW as a unique communication medium, and comprises the steps of firstly establishing an information physical fusion power transmission network model, then fully considering information physical fusion characteristics of the information physical fusion power transmission network during fault, response and overhaul processes, and finally assessing the elasticity capability of the information physical fusion power transmission network under ice disaster through a Monte Carlo method. The invention analyzes the coupling characteristics of the information network and the physical network in the 'disaster response' and 'post-disaster recovery' stages, and simulates the further aggravation process of the information network fault to the physical network fault and the influence of the information network overhaul to the physical network. The invention overcomes the defect of consideration of single physical dimension, can more accurately reflect the fault and recovery characteristics of the power transmission network under ice disaster, quantitatively evaluates the elasticity of the power transmission network for power engineering personnel, researches the elasticity lifting strategy in three stages of 'pre-disaster resistance', 'response during disaster' and 'recovery after disaster', and provides effective evaluation theoretical support.

title_en: Kriging-based power transmission tower structure wind disaster vulnerability modeling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Kriging-based power transmission tower structure wind damage vulnerability modeling method, which comprises the steps of taking the average strength of a wind field, a wind direction angle and a power transmission line span as basic parameters, taking a tower-line structure design wind load calculation method as a basis, combining Kriging equivalent technology and a big data analysis algorithm, solving a wind resistance surface of a power transmission tower structure, constructing a self-adaptive equivalent modeling process of the wind resistance surface of the power transmission tower, carrying out power transmission tower wind induced vulnerability calculation by utilizing Monte Carlo simulation on the basis, establishing a four-dimensional vulnerability model of the failure probability of the power transmission tower structure with respect to wind speed, the wind direction angle and a horizontal span, and realizing high-dimensional vulnerability calculation and evaluation of the power transmission tower structure under the combined influence of the space-time change of the wind field and the space distribution of the power transmission line.

title_en: Monte Carlo algorithm-based power distribution network toughness evaluation method under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network toughness evaluation method based on a Monte Carlo algorithm under typhoon disasters, which comprises the following steps: s1: establishing a typhoon field model by taking the maximum wind speed radius as a boundary according to the rule that the wind speed is distributed in a vortex shape under typhoon disasters; s2: according to the mechanical effect of the power distribution network element under the typhoon disaster, a power distribution network element fault probability model based on the mechanical load effect theory is established; s3: obtaining fault probability data through a fault probability model, and determining a random fault scene of the power distribution network element by using Monte Carlo method simulation; s4: calculating to obtain a toughness evaluation index value by taking the difference integral of the total load and the operation load under the typhoon disaster as a toughness evaluation index of the power distribution network; the method provided by the invention only needs to consider the influence of the distribution network elements on the load points of the distribution network, can effectively solve the problem of calculated amount caused by excessive elements in the system, is suitable for large-scale distribution network toughness evaluation calculation, and has good comprehensiveness and operability for distribution network toughness evaluation.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital city all-item supporting system, computer and digital city all-item supporting equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of digital technology, and discloses a digital city whole item supporting system, a computer and a digital city whole item supporting device, wherein the system specifically comprises: the data acquisition module acquires data related to factors such as social resources, infrastructure, humanity, economy and the like; the data cleaning module cleans the repeated data and the interference data of the data collected by the data collecting module; the data analysis module utilizes a Bayesian network machine learning algorithm to compare, analyze, calculate and process the acquired data and outputs each element grade; the city positioning module is used for outputting each element grade according to the data analysis module and positioning the city; and the planning and designing module makes a corresponding planning and designing according to the city positioning result output by the city positioning module and the auxiliary decision module. The invention provides a big data platform for the construction of digital cities, and reduces the labor amount of analysts and developers in the process of data acquisition and analysis.

title_en: Monte Carlo tree search-based disaster prevention data synchronization method and terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a terminal for synchronizing disaster prevention data based on Monte Carlo tree search, which receive a data synchronization request; selecting one of all nodes to be synchronized as a root node according to the data synchronization request, determining a first evaluation value of the node to be synchronized based on time complexity, current time interval weight, current region weight, historical disaster incidence of a current region and historical daily average load data of the data synchronization, performing Monte Carlo tree search from the root node in all the nodes to be synchronized based on the first evaluation value, determining child nodes of the root node, and adding the child nodes to a planning path of the data synchronization; synchronizing disaster prevention data of each node in the planned path; and the Monte Carlo tree is adopted to search and quickly and accurately determine the nodes needing to be subjected to disaster prevention data synchronization by combining a specific application scene, so that the high efficiency and the real-time performance of the disaster prevention data synchronization are ensured.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Distribution line-oriented lightning trip probability analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electric power, and particularly relates to a lightning trip-out probability analysis method and system for a distribution line, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the ground flash density of a lightning area and an effective lightning receiving area of the power distribution line to determine the ground flash density of the effective lightning receiving area; calculating the flashover rate of the distribution line by using a Monte Carlo method; and obtaining the lightning trip-out probability of the distribution line according to the ground flash density, the flashover rate and the arc establishment rate of the effective lightning receiving area. Determining the ground flash density of the effective lightning receiving area by acquiring the ground flash density and the effective lightning receiving area of the distribution line; calculating the flashover rate of the distribution line by using a Monte Carlo method; according to the ground flash density, the flashover rate and the arc establishing rate of an effective lightning receiving area, obtaining the lightning trip-out probability of the distribution line; the lightning trip-out occurrence can be reasonably predicted, and lightning protection work can be guided, so that damage caused by lightning disasters is reduced.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for identifying key links of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for identifying key links of an electric power system, which are used for predicting the element fault rate data of the electric power system by acquiring disaster intensity characteristic data and element topology data of the electric power system in extreme events and according to the disaster intensity characteristic data; the method comprises the steps of determining the fault scale of the power system according to element fault rate data by using a Monte Carlo sampling method, identifying the key links of the power system according to the fault scale and the element topology data by using a preset key link identification model to obtain key nodes and key lines of the power system, describing the correlation between the disaster intensity and the element fault rate and between the element fault state and the power supply state of the load node through a machine learning model, and effectively avoiding the display expression of complex functions, thereby researching the disaster defense and strengthening capacity of the elastic power system and providing technical support for the power system to deal with extreme events in the follow-up process.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Flame-retardant, low-temperature-resistant and brittleness-resistant electrical casing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti fire-retardant low temperature resistant fragility electrician's sleeve pipe, which comprises a pipe body, one side of body is equipped with fire-retardant structure, fire-retardant structure includes fire-retardant layer one and fire-retardant layer two, the outer wall of fire-retardant layer one and the inner wall fixed connection of body, the outside of fire-retardant layer one is equipped with fire-retardant layer two, the inner wall fixedly connected with low temperature resistant layer of fire-retardant layer two. The flame-retardant low-temperature-resistant brittleness-resistant electrical casing pipe is characterized in that the flame-retardant layer I and the flame-retardant layer II are aluminum silicate refractory fiber layers by matching the pipe body, the flame-retardant layer I and the flame-retardant layer II, the aluminum silicate refractory fiber is prepared by taking clay clinker with low impurity content as a raw material and melting at 1800-2000 ℃, jetting or spinning into fibers, the content of Al2O3 in the fibers is about 45%, the long-term use temperature is not more than 1000 ℃, the flame-retardant capability of the electrical casing pipe is improved, and the damage of the electrical casing pipe and the damage of electric wires caused by fire disasters in the surrounding environment are avoided.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for identifying fragile line of power transmission network under ice disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for identifying a fragile line of a power transmission network under ice disasters, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the ice coating thickness of each line in the power transmission network under ice disasters; determining the fault probability of each line according to the thickness of each ice coating; on the basis of the fault probability of each line, adopting Monte Carlo simulation to obtain a plurality of line cascading fault accident chains, and constructing a cascading fault incidence matrix according to the line cascading fault accident chains; wherein each element in the cascading failure incidence matrix is: the associated weight of the fault line corresponding to the element and another fault line; determining the node weight degree of each line according to the cascading failure incidence matrix; and taking the first M lines with the maximum node weight degrees as fragile lines. By implementing the method, the fragile line in the power transmission network under ice disasters can be effectively identified.

title_en: Toughness assessment method for storage tank facility defense system under multi-disaster coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a toughness assessment method of a storage tank facility defense system under multi-disaster coupling, which comprises the steps of obtaining basic information, analyzing safety barrier performance degradation and equipment vulnerability under natural disasters, identifying initial accident scenes and accident expansion possibility, constructing a dynamic Bayesian network to obtain node probability values of all equipment at different time points, assessing system functions according to possible economic losses of a system in a tank area at different time points, assessing system toughness according to the system functions, and drawing a system toughness time-varying curve. Due to the cascade effect of multi-disaster coupling accidents, the performance of the original defense system can be reduced due to natural disasters, so that the toughness of the system is reduced, and the further expansion of the accidents is difficult to resist. By adopting the method, the system toughness assessment at different stages of accident evolution under multi-disaster coupling can be realized, and theoretical basis and decision support are provided for multi-disaster coupling accident prevention and control and defense system optimization.

title_en: An efficient radionuclide analysis method using a CZT detector-based portable neutron and gamma-ray simultaneous measurement system
title_ko: Czt 검출기 기반 휴대용 중성자 및 감마선 동시측정 시스템을 활용한 핵종분석방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a nuclide analysis method using a CZT detector-based portable neutron and gamma ray simultaneous measurement system. The nuclide analysis method comprises: a pre-processing step of calculating a pure coefficient density using equation 1 and a pure gamma dose rate using equation 2 by using raw data obtained from a CZT detector-based measurement system and determining whether the calculated pure gamma dose rate exceeds the reference set value (R1) that can establish a reasonable judgment on the possibility of the existence of a suspected source to be distinguished from environmental radiation, taking into account the measurement uncertainty of the CZT detector-based measurement system itself to determine the possibility of the existence of a neutron or gamma ray emission source; and a post-processing step of precisely evaluating and confirming the detection of neutrons, the energy level thereof, and the type, energy, and radioactivity of the gamma ray emission source when it is determined that there is the possibility of the existence of the neutron or gamma ray emission source in the pre-processing step. The present invention makes it possible to visually and clearly confirm and analyze whether or not the neutron emission source that is difficult to confirm is detected and its energy level by using a compound semiconductor, a CZT (Cd-Zn-Te; Cd (cadmium)-Zn (zinc)-Te (tellurium)) detector, and neutron and gamma ray response characteristics and to more efficiently identify and analyze the type, energy, and radioactivity of the gamma ray emission source.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 CZT 검출기 기반 휴대용 중성자 및 감마선 동시측정 시스템을 활용한 핵종분석방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 이를 위해 CZT 검출기 기반 측정 시스템으로부터 취득되는 원시자료(raw data)를 활용하여 [수학식 1]을 적용한 순수 계수밀도, [수학식 2]를 적용한 순수 감마선량률을 산출하고, 산출된 순수 감마선량률이  CZT 검출기 기반 측정 시스템 자체의 계측불확실성을 감안하여 환경방사선과 구분되게 의심 선원의 존재 가능성에 대한 합리적 판단을 수립할 수 있는 기준설정치(R1)를 초과하는지 여부를 판별하여 중성자 또는 감마선 방출선원의 존재 가능성을 판별하는 전처리 단계; 및 전처리 단계에서 중성자 또는 감마선 방출선원의 존재 가능성으로 판별된 경우 중성자 검출 여부 및 에너지 준위 그리고 감마선 방출선원의 종류, 에너지 및 방사능을 정밀하게 평가 및 확인하는 후처리 단계;가 포함된다. 
상기와 같이 구성된 본 발명은 화합물반도체인 CZT(Cd-Zn-Te; Cd(카드뮴)-Zn(아연)-Te(텔루늄))검출기와 중성자 및 감마선 반응특성을 활용하여 확인이 어려운 중성자 방출선원의 검출 여부와 그 에너지 준위를 가시적으로 명확하게 확인하고 분석할 수 있도록 하고, 감마선 방출선원의 종류, 에너지 및 방사능을 보다 효율적으로 확인 및 분석할 수 있도록 한 것이다.

title_en: Power distribution system operation optimization method and system based on artificial bee colony and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of operation scheduling and control in a distribution network, and discloses a method, a system and computer equipment for optimizing operation of a power distribution system under the regional power exchange constraint based on an artificial bee colony, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining uncertain photovoltaic output parameters in the power distribution network by adopting a Monte Carlo method, and constructing a photovoltaic output model; optimizing DG active power output in a dispatching area power grid by taking the minimum network loss of the operation of the power distribution network as a target, constructing an optimized dispatching model containing various DGs and setting constraint conditions; and adopting an artificial bee colony algorithm to solve the model, and calculating an optimal scheduling scheme for optimizing the distribution system of the regional power exchange and a disaster island division strategy. Compared with the prior art, the operation strategy obtained by the invention fully considers the uncertainty of photovoltaic output, can ensure that the safety constraint is met under various conditions, has a simple model, is easy to solve, and has certain theoretical value and engineering value.
assignees: HUAIAN POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Fire risk prevention and control method for complex electrical equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire risk prevention and control method for complex electrical equipment, which comprises the following steps of (1) constructing a system risk side topology network model of the complex electrical equipment by combining historical electrical fire accidents with a physical structure working principle of equipment to form a coupling relation between risk points and basic attribute distribution of the risk points, (2) calculating a risk propagation Score value between the risk points according to a generalized risk fuzzy ordering theory to quantify coupling strength between risks, and (3) constructing a complex electrical fire prevention key path generation algorithm considering risk propagation characteristics to form a key propagation path set so as to prevent and control the fire of the complex electrical equipment. The method can be used for clearing accident links of electrical fires of complex electrical equipment and realizing accurate prevention and grasp of system risk situations. Experimental results show that the method has good prevention effect and can effectively block fire disasters of complex electrical equipment.

title_en: Method and apparatus for compensating photovoltaic output prediction uncertainty and intermittency
title_ko: 태양광 발전의 출력 예측 불확실성 및 간헐성 보상 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: A method performed by a device for compensating the output prediction uncertainty and intermittence of photovoltaic power generation according to one embodiment comprises the steps of: additionally generating an independent variable for reflecting a time unit delay value of photovoltaic power generation amount and the characteristics of time series data based on the past power generation amount data of a photovoltaic power generation facility as a dependent variable and disaster prevention weather observation data as an initial independent variable; selecting the variables to be used as an input, based on the correlation between the dependent variable, the initial independent variable, and the additionally generated independent variable; predicting the photovoltaic power generation amount of the photovoltaic power generation facility as an output of a deep learning artificial neural network by inputting the selected variables to the pre-learned deep learning artificial neural network; applying the intermittence by multiplying an actual photovoltaic power generation data value of the photovoltaic power generation facility by a random value following a Gaussian distribution; comparing the predicted photovoltaic power generation amount with the photovoltaic power generation amount to which the intermittency is applied; and determining an operation mode of a BESS as one of stop, a charging operation, and a discharging operation according to a result of the comparison. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the problem of limiting the output of renewable energy due to an imbalance in supply and demand can be alleviated.
abstract_ko: 일 실시예에 따른 태양광 발전의 출력 예측 불확실성 및 간헐성 보상 장치가 수행하는 방법은, 종속변수로서 태양광 발전설비의 과거 발전량 데이터와 초기 독립변수로서 방재기상관측 자료에 기초하여, 태양광 발전량의 시간 단위 지연값 및 시계열 데이터의 특성을 반영하기 위한 독립변수를 추가 생성하는 단계와, 상기 종속변수, 상기 초기 독립변수 및 상기 추가 생성된 독립변수 간의 상관 관계에 기초하여, 입력으로 사용할 변수들을 선정하는 단계와, 상기 선정된 변수들을 기학습된 딥러닝 인공신경망에 입력하여, 상기 딥러닝 인공신경망의 출력으로서 상기 태양광 발전설비의 태양광 발전량을 예측하는 단계와, 상기 태양광 발전설비의 실제 태양광 발전량 데이터 값에 가우시안 분포를 따르는 랜덤 값을 곱하여 간헐성을 적용하는 단계와, 상기 예측된 태양광 발전량과 상기 간헐성을 적용한 태양광 발전량을 비교하는 단계와, 상기 비교의 결과에 따라, BESS의 동작 모드를 정지와 충전 동작 및 방전 동작 중 어느 하나로 결정하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Uncertainty quantification method for multidimensional parameters in electrical impedance imaging technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for quantifying uncertainty of multidimensional parameters in an electrical impedance imaging technology. According to the method, a deep neural network is trained to construct a substitution model of an original uncertainty system, and then the uncertainty parameter analysis and quantification are carried out on the basis of the deep neural network substitution model and combined with a single-variable-element dimension reduction method, so that the distribution of uncertainty output is finally obtained. And compared to a baseline method to evaluate the performance of the method of the invention. The result shows that the method has high calculation precision and can accurately quantify the uncertainty of output; when the uncertainty dimension of the parameters is increased, the uncertainty quantization problem of the high-dimensional parameters can be effectively solved, the dimension disaster is relieved, the limitation of whether interaction exists between variables is avoided, and the calculation cost is effectively reduced. In addition, the method can be widely applied to the uncertainty system quantification in other complex fields.

title_en: Method for evaluating fragility of immovable cultural relics
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vulnerability assessment method of immovable cultural relics, which comprises the following steps: 1. determining a vulnerability assessment index; 2. determining a grade standard of a vulnerability value of an evaluation index; 3. obtaining evaluation index data and fragile value assignment; 4. determining vulnerability assessment index weight; 5. constructing a vulnerability assessment model; 6. dividing the vulnerability grade; 7. calculating a vulnerability index; 8. and determining the vulnerability grade of the immovable cultural relics. The method can well evaluate the vulnerability of immovable cultural relics under different scales under the influence of natural disasters such as flood, earthquake and the like, and has universal applicability.

title_en: Lifting type automatic stereo parking garage scheduling method based on improved DQN
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lifting type automatic stereo garage scheduling method based on improved DQN; the current state of the garage is obtained through the internet of things technology, an improved DQN is adopted to train a scheduling model of the lifting type automatic three-dimensional parking garage, the Q network with the optimal decision making capability under random interference is obtained by taking the minimum user waiting time and the minimum mechanical loss cost as targets, and the Q network is used for guiding the garage to perform real-time scheduling. The deep reinforcement learning method provided by the invention solves the problem of dimension disaster possibly caused by large-scale complex state space, and can realize dynamic real-time scheduling. In addition, different from the traditional DQN reinforcement learning method, the improved DQN algorithm combines the Monte Carlo thought, and estimates the state value by sampling a plurality of complete state sequences, so that the influence of each step of garage scheduling on subsequent scheduling can be fully considered, and the practical requirement of garage scheduling is better met.

title_en: Power transmission line maintenance sequence optimization decision method under extreme ice and snow disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power transmission line maintenance sequence optimization decision method under extreme ice and snow disasters, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: according to the extreme ice and snow disaster meteorological characteristics, an extreme ice and snow disaster meteorological model which comprehensively considers instantaneous wind and icing gravity borne by the line from the double-layer angle of time and space is constructed, the influence condition of the line is calculated by combining a power transmission network, and the line breakage and outage probability is simulated; determining a fault scene set based on a Monte Carlo state sampling method and in combination with the line outage probability, and realizing system toughness evaluation by using a toughness evaluation index according to system response and recovery conditions; and carrying out optimization decision on the maintenance sequence of the power transmission line under the extreme ice and snow disaster, comparing and analyzing the maintenance sequence with the maintenance effect according to the line breakage sequence, and analyzing the influence of the maintenance sequence optimization decision method of the power transmission line on the toughness of the system by comparing the evaluation result of the toughness of the power system. Has the advantages of scientific and reasonable structure, strong applicability and good effect.
assignees: STATE GRID HEILONGJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV NORTHEAST DIANLI

title_en: Real-time risk probability calculation method for domino accident of fire disaster in chemical storage tank area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time risk probability calculation method of domino accidents of fire disaster in a chemical storage tank area, which relates to the technical field of fire risk assessment in the chemical storage tank area, and is characterized in that basic data related to a chemical storage tank is obtained, then the vulnerability parameters of the chemical storage tank are calculated, monte Carlo simulation is carried out by setting simulation parameters, so that a failed chemical storage tank is determined, the time and space synergistic effect are not considered, and the incident heat radiation intensity, theoretical failure time and equivalent heat radiation flux of the residual chemical storage tank are respectively calculated; and (3) respectively calculating the cooperative theoretical failure time, probability unit value, accident upgrading probability and time-varying failure probability of the chemical storage tank by considering the time and space cooperative effect, carrying out multiple simulation, and counting the occurrence frequency of each accident scenario to obtain the accident scenario probability and the failure time and time-varying failure probability of the storage tank under the cooperative effect, thereby realizing the function of real-time probability calculation.

title_en: Natural disaster chain-power system-carbon emission estimation method based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Bayesian network-based natural disaster chain-power system-carbon emission estimation method, which uses an emergency model to carry out basic modeling on a natural disaster chain-power system-carbon emission change process, utilizes the advantages of the Bayesian network on uncertainty event analysis on the basis, analyzes a basic model, extracts the association relation between key elements and elements to form a node table and an adjacent matrix, builds the Bayesian network on the basis to carry out reasoning calculation, and realizes the carbon emission change analysis of a power system under the action of multiple natural disasters. The method provides support for subsequent disaster prevention optimization, energy structure optimization, emission reduction and carbon fixation measures and the like of the power system, and can be applied to analysis of other complex carbon emission processes.

title_en: Vulnerability model construction method suitable for wind power tower structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for constructing a vulnerability model applicable to a wind power tower structure. The method comprises the steps of establishing a finite element model of a wind power tower structure, judging the type of disasters to be considered according to the geographic position and basic form of the model, simulating load time courses corresponding to the disasters to be considered, carrying out damage level on each part of the wind power tower, defining quantization indexes corresponding to each damage level, carrying out calculation analysis on the quantization indexes in finite element numerical simulation, carrying out nonlinear power time course analysis and incremental power analysis based on the finite element model and the simulated load time courses, constructing a fragility model, determining a loss ratio probability distribution model corresponding to the performance level of each part of the wind power tower, and establishing a vulnerability model based on the fragility model and the loss ratio probability model or the loss ratio constant value of each part of the wind power tower. The method aims at the vulnerability assessment of the wind power tower structure, and fills the gap in the technical field of the current wind power tower disaster risk assessment.

title_en: Method for evaluating operation reliability of power system under heavy rainfall
abstract_en: The invention provides an evaluation method for the operation reliability of an electric power system under heavy rainfall, aiming at solving the problem that the conventional electric power operation and maintenance lacks the risk perception capability under the consideration of extreme heavy rainfall, and the evaluation method comprises the following steps: acquiring running state data of the power system under heavy rainfall; sampling the running state of the power system by a Monte Carlo simulation method; analyzing the running state of the sampled power system based on a direct current load flow optimal load shedding algorithm; the evaluation index of the operation reliability of the power system is calculated, the evaluation of the operation reliability of the power system under strong rainfall is realized, the risk perception capability of the power system under extreme weather conditions is improved, the decision of the disaster prevention and relief scheduling work of the power system is assisted, the influence of the strong rainfall and waterlogging disasters on the power system and the impact of the strong rainfall and waterlogging disasters on the society are effectively coped and reduced, and the efficient and orderly power scheduling and disaster reduction and relief under extreme disasters are realized.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD JIAXING POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Tool for business resilience to disaster
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and computer programs are presented for estimating downtime and recovery time after a disaster. One method includes an operation for calculating component fragility functions for components of a facility that are vulnerable to damage after a disaster. Further, the method includes calculating component recovery functions for the components of the facility. The component recovery functions indicate a probability of recovery after a disaster over time. The method further includes operations for calculating a facility fragility function and a facility recovery function based on the component fragility functions and the component recovery functions, and for determining a downtime for the facility for a given intensity associated with the disaster. Further, the method includes an operation for causing presentation of the downtime for the facility on a user interface (UI).

title_en: Coastal region ocean disaster risk refined assessment research method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for finely evaluating and researching marine disaster risks in coastal areas, which comprises the following steps: 1. identifying risk factors, selecting evaluation indexes and acquiring data; 2. analyzing each index weight by an AHP method; 3. implementing fine research by adopting a Lawson algorithm and an origin Kriging interpolation method; 4. constructing a risk evaluation model, and calculating risk values of all evaluation units; 5. and drawing a risk assessment graph and a risk division graph. The method comprehensively considers the natural attributes and the social attributes of the marine disasters, comprehensively considers the marine disaster risks based on four dimensions of dangerousness, fragility, exposition and defensiveness, and is convenient for index evaluation and calculation. The method is used for constructing an index evaluation system based on AHP, and realizes refinement by adopting a Lawson algorithm and an orbit Kriging interpolation, thereby realizing refined evaluation of the risk of the marine disaster and improving the evaluation accuracy.
assignees: SHANGHAI WATER ENG DESIGN & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Electric power traffic coupling network vulnerability assessment method based on probability map
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the vulnerability of an electric power traffic coupling network based on a probability map, which comprises the following steps: establishing a Bayesian network model of the outage event of the power distribution network equipment under the typhoon disaster, and predicting the outage probability of the power distribution network equipment based on the Bayesian network; establishing an alternating current optimal power flow model, analyzing the overload condition of a power distribution network line, and carrying out load removal on a power system; evaluating the capacity of the coupling network for resisting external interference by using a power traffic coupling network vulnerability evaluation model based on a probability map; the method is supported by a probability chart, a vulnerability assessment model of the electric power traffic coupling network is established, and calculation of elasticity measurement of the electric power traffic coupling network is achieved; based on historical meteorological data, the method can realize prediction of a cascading failure propagation mechanism of the electric power traffic coupling network under typhoon disasters, ensure the accuracy and rapidity of real-time estimation, and provide a theoretical basis for emergency plans under typhoon weather.

title_en: Analysis method for possible maximum disaster of cascade hydropower junction group
abstract_en: The invention discloses an analysis method of a possible maximum disaster of a cascade hydroelectric junction group, which divides the generation factors of the cascade hydroelectric junction group dam break into an extreme load action unit and a dam break influence unit, divides the influence result of the hydroelectric junction dam break into a disaster-bearing body disaster-bearing loss unit, considers the extreme load combination of 4 disaster-causing factors of extreme floods, giant earthquakes, barrier lakes and giant landslide, and utilizes the dam break influence unit to transmit continuous-break influence in the Bayesian network by constructing the analysis method of the possible maximum disaster of the cascade hydroelectric junction group based on the Bayesian network, so that the maximum possible disaster of 3 disaster-bearing bodies of the cascade hydroelectric junction group, such as dam affiliated facilities, downstream building damages, casualties and ecological interference caused by the cascade hydroelectric junction group continuous-break, can be calculated simply and scientifically, thereby being beneficial to quantitatively analyzing the disaster influence degree of the cascade hydroelectric junction group and helping to determine a reasonable hydroelectric junction risk control decision.

title_en: Double-layer power distribution network toughness evaluation method and system considering disaster response and recovery
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of toughness evaluation of distribution networks, and particularly discloses a method and a system for evaluating toughness of a double-layer distribution network by considering disaster response and recovery, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical ice disaster, power distribution network structure and equipment information of a power distribution network to be evaluated; constructing a double-layer multi-dimension index system of a toughness planning layer and an operation layer of the power distribution network; sampling a fault line by adopting a Monte Carlo method to obtain a fault scene, and screening a typical fault scene based on scene information entropy; adopting a minimum cut load model and an optimal line rush-repair sequence model based on the load importance degree to realize the whole process simulation of a typical fault scene and generate a system performance change curve; and respectively calculating comprehensive evaluation values of the toughness of the power distribution network of the planning layer and the running layer according to the system performance change curve and the structure and equipment information of the power distribution network, and evaluating the toughness of the power distribution network. The toughness evaluation index system of the double-layer distribution network avoids repeated quantitative calculation of the toughness index value.

title_en: Distribution terminal optimal configuration method considering extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution terminal optimal configuration method considering extreme weather, which comprises the following steps: generating a typical fault scene under extreme weather through Monte Carlo simulation and scene clustering; constructing a quantification system of power failure loss under a large-scale fault scene of the power distribution system; establishing a distribution terminal configuration model with minimum weighted annual power outage loss cost under various typical fault scenes; solving a distribution terminal configuration model by utilizing a self-adaptive improved bat algorithm; and obtaining the configuration position and type of the distribution terminal with the minimum weighted annual power outage loss, and outputting the configuration result of the distribution terminal. According to the invention, the running condition of the power distribution network in extreme weather is considered, and the power failure loss quantification method for considering the recovery faults of the power distribution terminal is improved, so that the power distribution terminal planning considering economy and reliability is realized, and the extreme disaster coping capability of the power distribution system is further effectively improved.

title_en: Flood risk space-time dynamic propagation analysis model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood risk space-time dynamic propagation analysis model, which comprises the following steps: s1, determining a model framework for urban flood risk propagation analysis; s2, selecting subdivision indexes and a calculation formula to quantize; s3, acquiring satellite remote sensing data and urban meteorological data, and searching historical related data; s4, determining an urban flood disaster occurrence area, a flood inundation area and disaster loss; s5, calculating to obtain a numerical value of urban flood risk; s6, carrying out space-time dynamic propagation analysis of flood risks. According to the invention, the flood risk space-time dynamic propagation analysis model is adopted, and by constructing the urban flood risk propagation analysis model and combining urban historical data and future prediction data, the risk distribution of different areas of the city is identified, the capability of the city to cope with the flood disasters is evaluated, the state and degree of the flood risk propagation in the urban area can be dynamically monitored, and the purpose of urban flood monitoring and early warning is achieved.

title_en: Elasticity evaluation method for power distribution network containing distributed energy sources
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution system elasticity assessment method containing distributed energy, which comprises the steps of firstly adopting Gumbel probability distribution to generate disaster scenes; then randomly sampling the element fault state according to the vulnerability equation, and dividing the network state based on a graph searching algorithm; then establishing an island micro-grid optimization problem based on mixed integer programming, taking the minimum total cost of load shedding compensation and distributed energy running cost as an objective function, and taking reactive power and voltage control problems into consideration to carry out linearization treatment on alternating current power flow; and finally, considering time-varying characteristics of the distributed renewable energy output and the load demand, adopting non-sequential Monte Carlo simulation to simulate, recording the load state under each disaster simulation, and calculating to obtain the elasticity evaluation indexes of the node level and the system level. According to the invention, a set of complete elastic evaluation index system is established by considering various uncertainty factors, so that the defending and recovering capabilities of the distribution network system to extreme events are quantified.
assignees: HUANGGANG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Urban water supply pipe network anti-seismic toughness comprehensive calculation method considering water quality and water quantity indexes
abstract_en: A comprehensive calculation method for the earthquake-resistant toughness of an urban water supply pipe network taking water quality and water quantity indexes into consideration belongs to the field of water supply pipe network earthquake-resistant performance evaluation. The method comprises the following steps: probability P of pipeline shock hazard  f  Is calculated; pipeline lineConfirming the post-earthquake state; determining the area of a leakage hole of a leakage pipeline; establishing a pipe network hydraulic model of the earthquake damage scene; simulating a pipe network post-earthquake recovery process, and adopting a pipeline dynamic importance ranking method to collect the pipeline water source distance to determine the post-earthquake recovery sequence; establishing a hydraulic power and water quality model of a pipe network in the post-earthquake recovery process; calculating the anti-seismic toughness; and (5) calculating the mean value of the anti-seismic toughness. According to the method, the water quality index is incorporated into the evaluation index of the anti-service performance of the urban water supply network, and the anti-seismic toughness of the urban water supply network is comprehensively calculated; the method for integrating the pipeline water source distances by adopting the pipeline dynamic importance sorting method is adopted to determine the post-earthquake repair order, so that the determined pipeline repair order is more reasonable; the water supply toughness evaluation index disclosed by the invention can comprehensively reflect the post-earthquake anti-seismic toughness, the hydraulic power and water quality change characteristics and the relative difference of a pipe network, considers the uncertainty of pipeline damage under an earthquake scene and the uncertainty of leakage type of a leakage pipeline, and generates a sufficient number of random earthquake damage scenes through Monte Carlo simulation. Has guiding significance for post-earthquake disaster relief and repair work.

title_en: Market force assessment method considering multiple uncertainties under ice disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a market force assessment method considering multiple uncertainties under ice disaster, which comprises the following steps: establishing a fault probability model of the overhead line and the wind turbine generator under the ice disaster according to meteorological data under the ice disaster and initial data of the power system; forming an overhead line and a wind turbine generator set fault set by using a Monte Carlo sampling method based on a fault probability model of the overhead line and the wind turbine generator set under ice disaster; constructing a direct current power flow model taking the minimum power generation set MGI as an objective function according to the overhead line and the wind turbine generator set fault set, and calculating a space-time market force evaluation index; by comparing the sizes of the space-time market force evaluation indexes, key generators with higher market force risks and key time periods are identified. The method can effectively identify key power generators and key time periods with higher market force risks under frozen disasters, prevent market participants from carrying out market force abuse, and provide effective guidance for a supervision organization to establish a risk prevention and control strategy under extreme weather.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Multi-dimensional risk dynamic evaluation method and system for large-scale vehicle exhibition fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-dimensional risk dynamic assessment method and system for a large-scale vehicle-mounted fire disaster. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of identifying a vehicle-mounted fire risk in multiple dimensions, determining risk factors related to vehicle-mounted fire accidents, determining risk factor related information, and establishing a dynamic Bayesian topological structure of the vehicle-mounted fire accidents; based on the state Bayesian topological structure, carrying out data fusion on expert experience weights through DS theory, determining the prior probability of a basic event, constructing a conditional probability table, and determining the occurrence probability of a vehicle-spread fire accident by utilizing the forward reasoning technology of a dynamic Bayesian network; determining the probability of occurrence of a vehicle-mounted fire accident based on the prior probability of the basic event, deeply researching the sensitivity of the Bayesian network, and determining a sensitive event; and entering a unit event accident state through the unit event initial normal working state, completing dynamic mode transition, generating a dynamic simulation model, and predicting the accident occurrence trend according to the dynamic simulation model. The invention can realize multi-dimensional, full-scale and dynamic risk assessment.

title_en: Research and development type building multi-combustible fire coupling result evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a research and development type building multi-combustible fire coupling result evaluation method, which belongs to the technical field of building risk evaluation and specifically comprises the following steps of: summarizing synergistic effect events of the research and development type building, wherein the synergistic effect events comprise two synergistic effect events of visibility reduction and poison leakage caused by fire; qualitative description of synergistic effect events, namely two synergistic effects of visibility reduction and poison leakage caused by fire disaster; quantitatively analyzing the synergistic effect of the multiple combustible fire accidents of the developed building; and constructing a Monte Carlo simulation model, and analyzing the fire coupling accident results of the multiple combustibles of the developed building. The invention constructs the coupling result evaluation model capable of realizing the coupling result evaluation of different combustible fire and toxic substance leakage accidents of the research-type building, realizes the accurate evaluation of the research-type building fire result, and has very important practical significance for planning the research-type building intrinsically safe layout and guiding the research-type building emergency evacuation.
assignees: NANJING NANGONG EMERGENCY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method of calculating the vulnerability index of water treatment facilities due to natural disasters
title_ko: 자연재해에 따른 수처리 시설의 취약도 지수를 산출하는 방법
abstract_en: A method of calculating a vulnerability index of a water treatment facility due to natural disasters according to one embodiment of the present invention relates to a method of calculating a vulnerability index of a water treatment facility such as a water purification plant and wastewater treatment plant due to natural disasters such as floods, typhoon inundation, and earthquakes, and to a method of calculating a vulnerability index of a water treatment facility due to natural disasters, comprising: a necessary information acquisition step of acquiring information necessary to calculate a vulnerability index; an evaluation item determining step of determining evaluation items to calculate the vulnerability index; a primary vulnerability index calculation step of primarily calculating the vulnerability index based on detailed items of the determined evaluation items; a suitability calculation step of calculating a suitability for the determined evaluation items and the primarily calculated vulnerability index based on standard information obtained from an external device; an evaluation item weighting step of assigning weights to the evaluation items based on the calculated suitability; and a secondary vulnerability index calculation step of calculating a secondary vulnerability index based on the assigned weight.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 자연재해에 따른 수처리 시설의 취약도 지수를 산출하는 방법은 홍수, 태풍에 의한 침수, 지진과 같은 자연재해에 따른 정수장 및 폐수처리장과 같은 수처리 시설에 대한 취약도 지수를 산출하는 방법에 관한 것으로서, 취약도 지수를 산출하기 위해 필요한 정보를 획득하는 필요 정보 획득 단계; 취약도 지수를 산출하기 위한 평가 항목을 산정하는 평가 항목 산정 단계; 산정된 평가 항목에 대한 세부 항목을 기초로, 1차적으로 취약도 지수를 산출하는 1차 취약도 지수 산출 단계; 외부 장치로부터 획득한 기준 정보를 기초로, 산정된 평가 항목 및 1차적으로 산출된 취약도 지수에 대한 적합도를 산출하는 적합도 산출 단계; 산출된 적합도를 기초로, 평가 항목에 대해 가중치를 부여하는 평가 항목 가중치 부여 단계; 및 부여된 가중치를 기초로, 2차 취약도 지수를 산출하는 2차 취약도 지수 산출 단계;를 포함하는, 자연재해에 따른 수처리 시설의 취약도 지수를 산출하는 방법 일 수 있다.

title_en: Urban water supply network water quality risk and water supply reliability calculation method considering post-earthquake negative pressure effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for calculating the water quality risk and water supply reliability of a city water supply pipe network by considering the action of negative pressure after earthquake, and belongs to the field of water quality safety evaluation after disaster of the city water supply pipe network. The method comprises the steps of calculating the area of a pipeline leakage opening under a daily operation scene, simulating and sampling by Monte Carlo to generate an earthquake damage scene of a pipeline in a pipeline network under the action of an earthquake, determining the scene of invasion of pollutants into the pipeline network after the earthquake, establishing a pipeline network model of the pollutant invasion scene, calculating average water quality risks of nodes, calculating the reliability of water supply of the pipeline network, calculating the average water quality risk average value of the nodes and calculating the reliability average value of the pipeline network. The invention calculates the water quality risk and the water supply reliability of the urban water supply network through the pollution invasion scene based on the negative pressure scene of the urban water supply network under the action of earthquake damage, and has great significance for guiding post-earthquake water quality early warning and coping strategies of the urban water supply network, and earthquake-resistant upgrading reconstruction and post-earthquake emergency repair measures of the urban water supply network.

title_en: Hydropower plant power generation control method considering power grid operation stability
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hydropower plant power generation control method considering the operation stability of a power grid, and belongs to the technical field of hydropower. The method includes the steps that based on historical electricity price data, a date with the highest similarity to working conditions on an operation day is identified by considering electricity price influence factors, and electricity price data on the similar day is used as a prediction training set; adopting a Gaussian process regression method to predict a probability interval, and determining a confidence interval and an interval discrete electricity price point of each time interval on the operation day; establishing an upstream hydropower station day-ahead market application and return optimization model; solving by adopting a self-adaptive particle swarm optimization algorithm; further obtaining a day-ahead market declared volume curve of the upstream hydropower station in each time period all day; then generating a downstream power station declared rating curve based on the cascade output coupling relation; and finally, performing power generation control based on the reported electric quantity. The method can prevent the water abandon of the power station, not only can save the waste of water resources, but also can ensure the safety and stability of the operation of the power grid, and is easy to popularize and apply.
assignees: KUNMING ELECTRIC POWER TRANSACTION CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Transformer substation dynamic flood risk assessment method based on fuzzy Bayesian and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fuzzy Bayesian-based substation dynamic flood risk assessment method and a readable storage medium. Firstly, from a disaster theory angle, selecting multi-mode factors such as a disaster-tolerant environment, disaster factors, a disaster-bearing body and the like to construct a dynamic flood risk assessment index system of the transformer substation, thereby establishing a Bayesian network prior model; secondly, discretizing meteorological data by adopting K parabolic membership functions, combining a disaster-tolerant environment and a disaster-bearing body membership degree to obtain a flood condition priori data fuzzy table, and deriving to obtain a dynamic flood condition risk probability calculation table of the transformer substation; and finally, carrying out fuzzification treatment on the dynamic meteorological data with the fuzzy boundary by using a fuzzy Bayesian classification method, fusing polymorphic data, analyzing causal association between the data and the flood of the transformer substation, and calculating a probability value so as to obtain a dynamic flood risk assessment result of the transformer substation.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power system risk assessment method, device and storage medium in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system risk assessment method, a device and a storage medium in extreme weather, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical data of different types of extreme weather, and generating a weather scene within one year by using a sequential Monte Carlo simulation method; based on the weather scene, obtaining disaster-causing factor distribution conditions in different time periods in one year by adopting a random sampling method according to a preset disaster-causing factor probability distribution model; obtaining the corresponding fault probability of the power element according to the disaster causing factor distribution condition and the vulnerability curve of the power element, and obtaining the states of the power element in different time periods within one year by adopting a random sampling method; and calculating to obtain the medium-and-long-term risk assessment index of the power system according to the power element state and the direct current power flow model. The method can evaluate the medium-and-long-term risk condition of the power system more comprehensively and accurately, and provide reference for further planning of the power system so as to resist the threat brought by extreme weather events.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Comprehensive assessment method and system for flood control capacity of transformer substation based on information gain fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive assessment method and system for flood prevention capability of a transformer substation based on information gain fusion, and belongs to the technical field of power risk assessment. Firstly, from a disaster theory angle, establishing a substation static flood control capacity assessment index system covering multi-mode factors such as a disaster-tolerant environment, a disaster-bearing body and the like, weighting each assessment index by using a hierarchical analysis method in combination with prior knowledge of expert fields, and establishing a substation static flood control grade assessment sub-model by a fuzzy comprehensive assessment method; then taking disaster factors into consideration to construct a dynamic risk prevention evaluation index system of the transformer substation, and obtaining a dynamic flood prevention capability evaluation sub-model of the transformer substation by using a fuzzy Bayesian network; and finally, carrying out weight distribution on the two sub-models by utilizing an information gain fusion strategy, and establishing a comprehensive assessment model of the flood control capacity of the transformer substation based on the information gain fusion, thereby realizing high-precision assessment of the flood control risk capacity of the transformer substation.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV WUHAN TECH

title_en: Three-dimensional lightning positioning method suitable for complex terrain
abstract_en: The invention relates to a three-dimensional lightning positioning method suitable for complex terrains, and belongs to the technical field of meteorological disaster monitoring. According to the invention, a database of lightning electromagnetic wave propagation is established by a time domain finite difference method, and the actually measured electromagnetic wave waveform of the lightning detection equipment is matched with the simulation waveform in the database to determine the possible occurrence position of lightning. Based on the time difference method, monte Carlo random test and time finite difference, real surface relief and finite conductivity are considered, and inversion is carried out to obtain more accurate lightning positions. The invention is suitable for the real ground surface, especially in the fields of meteorological early warning, public safety, serious disasters and the like in complex terrain areas, and has wide application value in the aspects of detection of thunder and lightning, early warning and protection of thunder and lightning disasters.
assignees: YUNNAN ELECTRIC POWER TEST & RES INSTITUTE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic prediction method for secondary domino accident of fire disaster in pressure storage tank area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic prediction method of a fire disaster secondary domino accident in a pressure storage tank area, which relates to the field of data processing systems specially used for prediction purposes, considers the influence of the fire accident of the pressure storage tank on the accident spread among adjacent storage tanks and the influence of coupling factors on the accident spread, evaluates the accident chain probability by combining a Bayesian network method, provides a determination method of the most probable accident chain and the most probable accident storage tank of the fire disaster secondary domino accident in the pressure storage tank area under the influence of time and space coupling, carries out effective risk evaluation on the pressure storage tank area, effectively controls and reduces the occurrence of the fire disaster secondary domino accident in the pressure storage tank area, has extremely important theoretical significance and application value for the prevention and control of the fire disaster domino effect in the pressure storage tank area, and provides guidance for the pressure tank area layout and the fire emergency treatment of chemical enterprises.

title_en: Dynamic evaluation method for urban deep karst collapse risk based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: A dynamic evaluation method for urban deep karst collapse risk based on Bayesian network mainly comprises the steps of deep karst collapse risk identification, deep karst collapse risk level standard, deep karst collapse risk dynamic Bayesian network structure learning, deep karst collapse risk dynamic Bayesian network parameter learning, deep karst collapse risk probability analysis, deep karst collapse risk loss analysis, deep karst collapse risk evaluation and the like; through the steps, the method solves the problems of low effectiveness, practicality and accuracy of the existing assessment method for the deep karst collapse disasters, more accurately reflects the change rule of the risks of the deep karst collapse disasters in the dense urban buildings and the lifeline corridor areas, timely obtains the risk states of the deep karst collapse disasters, and provides decision basis for subsequent control.
assignees: BEIJING URBAN CONSTR DESIGN & DEV GROUP CO LTD

title_en: N-k fault risk assessment method and system based on probabilistic load flow calculation
abstract_en: The application provides an N-k fault risk assessment method and system based on probability power flow calculation, comprising the following steps: based on semi-invariant and Gram-Charlier series, calculating the power system expansion probability flow taking the random fluctuation of new energy output into consideration; obtaining a branch outage probability model based on the branch power probability distribution characteristics in the power flow calculation result; analyzing a possible N-k fault chain in the power system to obtain a cut load corresponding to the fault chain; calculating occurrence probability of each N-k fault chain based on the related variables and the Bayesian network; taking the product of the occurrence probability of the N-k fault and the severity of the N-k fault result as an N-k fault risk index, calculating the N-k fault risk of each fault chain, and grading the risk index to obtain an evaluation result. The technical problems that the influence of the randomness of the new energy of the actual power system and the reliable guarantee of important user power supply are not fully considered in the existing evaluation method are solved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Characterization method, device, equipment and storage medium of dynamic load response characteristics of anchor rod
abstract_en: The invention provides a characterization method, a device, equipment and a storage medium of dynamic load response characteristics of an anchor rod, which are implemented by acquiring a preprocessed test data set; the preprocessed test data set comprises the rod body load and the accumulated rod body elongation of the anchor rod; calculating through a moving average algorithm, a standard deviation algorithm, a confidence interval algorithm, a maximum and minimum value algorithm or a quantile algorithm to obtain a target data set; drawing a target curve corresponding to the target data set by taking the accumulated elongation of the rod body as an abscissa and the load of the rod body as an ordinate; the target curve includes an upper envelope, a lower envelope, and a median. The method can obtain the target curve of the dynamic load response characteristic of the anchor rod, can intuitively reflect the trend and the fluctuation of test data through the target curve, is favorable for detecting abnormal values, and can provide key basic data support in aspects of anchor rod support selection of a mine tunnel, tunnel support scheme optimization, tunnel rock burst disaster prevention and control and the like.
assignees: CCTEG COAL MINING RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Multi-mode data fusion and uncertain estimation water level prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water level prediction method and system for multi-mode data fusion and uncertain estimation, which utilize various spatial-temporal data related to reservoir water level prediction to generate a plurality of parallel CNN branches for feature fusion and dimension reduction, and the parallel CNN branches are processed as input vectors of Bi-LSTM models to predict water level, and a Monte Carlo technology is introduced to evaluate uncertainty and confidence of a prediction result. According to the invention, a multi-mode data fusion technology is adopted, different CNN branches are built for parallel operation aiming at different types of space-time data, a Bi-LSTM network is built for prediction through PCA dimension reduction, a Monte Carlo technology is introduced for prediction and uncertainty and confidence assessment of a model, so that the prediction error of the model is effectively reduced, and the prediction reliability is improved. The method has higher practicability, can be widely applied to the fields of water conservancy, weather and the like, and provides more rigorous and effective prediction and decision for application scenes such as water resource management, disaster early warning and the like.

title_en: Wind-light-cascade reservoir deep reinforcement learning short-term random optimization scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind-light-cascade reservoir deep reinforcement learning short-term random optimization scheduling method which comprises the steps that a cascade reservoir describes randomness through a Copula function based on pearson III type distribution and generates corresponding random scenes based on a Markov Monte Carlo sampling method, wind power output and photovoltaic output describe randomness based on a non-parameter estimated nuclear density estimation method and generate corresponding random scenes based on the Markov Monte Carlo sampling method, scene reduction is respectively carried out on the random scenes based on a Bisecting k-means algorithm of a related distance, then the random scenes of a complementary system are combined and constructed, calculation efficiency is improved, parameter optimization is carried out on the complementary system based on a deep reinforcement learning DQN algorithm, and an optimal strategy is solved.

title_en: Disaster chain reasoning prediction method and system based on knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster chain reasoning prediction method and system based on a knowledge graph, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing an ontology model of a disaster event knowledge graph; extracting entity information of disaster events by performing dependency syntactic analysis on the text data, and performing knowledge fusion on entity information with the same meaning by a clustering algorithm; storing the fused entity information into a graph database and constructing a disaster event knowledge graph based on the ontology model; coupling the disaster event knowledge maps and mining disaster chain knowledge maps of the disaster events; constructing a Bayesian network model corresponding to the disaster chain knowledge graph according to the disaster chain knowledge graph; and determining the probability that the event node to be predicted is in the target state according to the Bayesian network model and the known parent node state set of the event node to be predicted. The method aims at mining complete links of disaster events and carrying out probability prediction on states of event nodes in the links.

title_en: Tunneling roadway coal and gas outburst prediction method based on dynamic probability reasoning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tunneling roadway coal and gas outburst prediction method based on dynamic probability reasoning, and belongs to the field of tunneling roadway coal and gas outburst disaster prediction methods. In order to make risk variable reasoning more comprehensive and accurate and to construct 13 variables and introduce expansion (dynamic Bayesian network) in Bayesian network reasoning, the development of underground tunneling working faces with risk connection is provided as a time slice, a risk prediction scheme of continuous probability reasoning is realized, and two methods of parameter learning under a expectation maximization algorithm and expert reasoning decision under a fuzzy set theory are combined to determine the probability distribution of initial Bayesian network nodes without influence. The structure is compact and coherent, the prediction is flexible, and the accuracy is high.

title_en: State early warning method, system, storage medium and terminal based on fragile curve
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a state early warning method, a state early warning system, a storage medium and a terminal based on a fragility curve, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the support displacement working condition of the transmission tower according to the ground surface deformation state; establishing a failure criterion of the transmission tower according to the failure level; establishing a finite element structure model of the transmission tower according to the yield strength and the elastic modulus of the material; carrying out displacement step-by-step loading on the finite element structure model of the transmission tower according to the support displacement working condition and the failure criterion, and obtaining a displacement stress curve; and determining the fragile curves of the displacement and failure probability according to the displacement stress curves, and determining the states of the transmission towers under different earth surface deformation states according to the fragile curves of the displacement and failure probability. The disaster prevention prediction and early warning can be carried out in the operation and maintenance management of the transmission tower through the fragile curve of the displacement and failure probability; reliability check can be performed under the ground surface deformation state, so that the disaster prevention and resistance of the power grid can be improved. Meanwhile, reference data can be provided for insurance pricing under the power geological disaster.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Power distribution network optimization method and system under typhoon disaster based on two-stage planning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network optimization method and system under typhoon disasters based on two-stage planning, comprising the following steps: modeling wind speed uncertainty, line uncertainty and load uncertainty by using the acquired power distribution network information, meteorological information and geographic information to obtain a distribution function about typhoon wind speed and power distribution line damage probability of the power distribution network, and generating load scenes by Monte Carlo simulation to obtain reactive load and active load in each scene; on the basis of a distribution function, a distribution line damage probability, reactive loads and active power in each scene, constructing a two-stage random planning elastic lifting model for the distribution network; and solving the model under the first-stage constraint condition and the second-stage constraint condition to obtain an optimization decision result, and optimizing the power distribution network through the optimization decision result. By adopting the embodiment of the invention, the accuracy of the decision aiming at the power distribution network is improved, and the elastic coping capacity of the power distribution network is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Quantitative risk assessment method and system based on real-time monitoring of multiple disaster species in park
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of environmental monitoring, and provides a quantitative risk assessment method and a quantitative risk assessment system based on real-time monitoring of multiple disaster species in a park, wherein the quantitative risk assessment system comprises a detection module and a storage module, the storage module comprises a park public area storage unit, a park workshop storage unit and a park storehouse storage unit, real-time detection data of the detection module are stored in the corresponding storage units, and the detection module comprises temperature detection information, gas concentration detection information and fire detection information; the investigation and acquisition of the historical information data of the storage module, through the historical information data of the storage module, comprises the following steps: step one: identifying a major hazard source in the park by using an FMEA method; step two: carrying out accident scenario modeling and occurrence probability calculation by using a bow tie diagram; step three: performing risk update by using a Bayesian network; step four: and analyzing and calculating the accident scenario results. Through above-mentioned technical scheme, solved among the prior art manual work and patrolled and examined not in place, patrol and examine the lower problem of efficiency simultaneously.
assignees: HEBEI JIEYUAN ANPING ENVIRONMENTAL PROT CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Automatic monitoring system for disaster of expressway high slope
