abstract_en: The invention relates to a method or a device for identifying a mode, in particular to an automatic monitoring system for disaster of a highway high slope, which comprises the following steps: the system comprises a data collection and feature extraction module, a deep learning training module, a risk assessment model construction module, an early warning notification module and an automatic early warning and processing suggestion module. According to the risk assessment method, a complete risk assessment framework is formed through the risk data collection and basic credibility grading module, the Bayesian network algorithm calculation and weight weighting module and the risk level calculation module, the risk assessment framework has high systematicness, the basic credibility of each risk factor after adjustment is calculated through the Bayesian network algorithm, and the weight weighting is carried out, so that the risk assessment result is more accurate, and different risk levels of high, medium and low can be effectively distinguished.
assignees: HENAN JIAOYUAN ENGINEERING TECH GROUP CO LTD;HENAN VOCATIONAL COLLEGE OF TRANSP HENAN TRANSP SECONDARY SPECIALIZED SCHOOL

title_en: Quantification method, system and medium for ship accident risk influence by intelligent technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantification method, a quantification system and a quantification medium for ship accident risk influence by an intelligent technology, which are applied to the technical field of ship safety, can quantitatively evaluate the ship collision accident risk influence by the application of the intelligent technology, effectively improve the navigation safety of intelligent ships and reduce the occurrence probability of ship accidents. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a scene analysis frame according to a preset disaster system theory; analyzing according to the scene analysis framework and combining with the characteristics of the water traffic accident to obtain a preset analysis result; constructing a Bayesian network model of the ship collision accident according to the preset analysis result; the occurrence probability of the preset risk influence factors is obtained through expert questionnaires and a hypothesis analysis method and a preset fuzzy set theory analysis calculation; and inputting the ship collision accident case data and the occurrence probability of the preset risk influence factors into the ship collision accident Bayesian network model for quantitative analysis to obtain a quantitative analysis result.

title_en: Large-scale urban power grid anti-vulnerability capacity lifting planning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for improving and planning the anti-fragile capacity of a large-scale urban power grid, which comprises the following steps: s1, generating a fault scene based on Monte Carlo simulation; s2, screening representative extreme scenes based on k-means cluster analysis; s3, establishing an urban power grid planning optimization model oriented to limit viability improvement; s4, after the model is solved, the corresponding power supply configuration condition under the line reinforcement scheme is obtained. The distributed power supply is deployed in the planning stage, the important power transmission paths are reinforced/upgraded, and island operation of the power distribution network is guaranteed to be realized through topology reconstruction under the limit natural disasters, so that uninterrupted power supply of more important loads is guaranteed.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Probabilistic Inference Methodology and System for Evaluating Process-Plant-System based on Bayesian Network
title_ko: 베이지안 네트워크의 확률추론 연산 알고리즘에 기반한 산업시설물의 리스크 평가정보 제공 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for providing risk evaluation information on industrial facilities based on the probabilistic inference computation algorithm of a Bayesian network, which calculate the probability that the entire industrial facility will not operate normally due to the abnormal operation of devices, or that the respective devices constituting the industrial facility will malfunction or operate abnormally, by using the probabilistic inference computation algorithm of the Bayesian network, in case of the abnormal operation in which in industrial facilities such as gas plants, petrochemical plants, and steel plants, the devices forming the industrial facility malfunction due to earthquakes, various natural disasters, or other various causes, and provides the same to an operator, thereby enabling the operator to accurately identify the current status of the industrial facility and establish reasonable measures, such as which devices to repair or replace to resolve abnormal operating conditions of the industrial facility and further which devices to repair preferentially. The method comprises a step of enabling an algorithm execution module to perform probabilistic inference operations according to the algorithm of the Bayesian network to calculate the probability of destruction of all nodes forming the Bayesian network.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가스플랜트, 석유화학 플랜트, 제철플랜트 등과 같은 산업시설물에 대하여 지진이나 각종 자연재해 내지 기타 다양한 원인으로 인하여 산업시설물을 구성하는 설비가 고장 나는 등의 비정상적인 작동을 하는 경우, 이러한 설비의 비정상적인 작동으로 인하여 산업시설물 전체가 정상적으로 운영되지 않거나 또는 산업시설물을 이루는 각각의 설비들이 고장 내지 비정상적인 작동을 하게 될 확률을 확률추론 연산 알고리즘으로서 베이지안 네트워크(Bayesian Network)를 이용하여 산출하여 운영자에게 제공함으로써, 운영자로 하여금 산업시설물의 현상을 정확하게 파악할 수 있게 하고, 산업시설물의 비정상적인 운영상태를 해소하기 위하여 어떠한 설비를 보수 내지 교체할 것인지, 더 나아가 어떠한 설비에 대해 우선적으로 보수 등을 수행할 것인지 등의 합리적인 대책을 세울 수 있게 하는 "베이지안 네트워크의 확률추론 연산 알고리즘에 기반한 산업시설물의 리스크 평가정보 제공 시스템 및 제공 방법"에 관한 것이다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENG & BUILDING TECH

title_en: Three-dimensional geologic body sectioning method based on Markov chain and Monte Carlo simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional geologic body sectioning method based on Markov chain and Monte Carlo simulation, which comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring PRB data, drilling data and a digital elevation model; s2, calculating a geological interface hidden function equation according to PRB data; s3, extracting a DEM point set in the digital elevation model to obtain a tetrahedral geological model; s4, utilizing the hidden function property to carry out section division; s5, simulating the stratum state of the virtual geological drilling by using a Monte Carlo method; s6, defining corresponding geological properties of geological areas in the section according to section combination to form a section model; the method is based on Markov chain and Monte Carlo simulation, can generate a deterministic model which cannot capture the uncertainty of stratum attributes through implicit three-dimensional geological modeling, can better reflect the complex spatial cutting relationship and stacking relationship among geological structures and the specific form inside the structures, and has the characteristics of being more modified, being capable of accurately explaining the ground, carrying out disaster early warning analysis decision and the like on underground excavation engineering.
assignees: UNIV XIAN ARCHITECTUR & TECH;CHINA ROAD & BRIDGE CORP

title_en: Power distribution system reliability assessment method considering meteorological factors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution system reliability evaluation method considering meteorological factors, which comprises the following steps: firstly, acquiring average temperature, maximum wind speed and precipitation of each hour in a local certain time, clustering the three groups of data by using a Density Peak Clustering (DPC) algorithm, and forming a class library corresponding to one fault rate in each class of scenes by acquiring the real fault rate of a local overhead line in each class of scenes; then, evaluating the average temperature, the maximum wind speed and the precipitation of each hour of the network location of the reliability according to the requirement, and judging the category of the network location, so that the fault rate of the corresponding category is selected as the fault rate of the network line; and finally, based on the line fault rate, evaluating the reliability of the network by adopting a method of combining sequential and non-sequential Monte Carlo simulation on the basis of distinguishing conventional faults and extreme disaster faults by meteorological data of the place where the network is located.

title_en: Quick coal rock destabilization damage judgment method based on seismic source spatial distribution
abstract_en: The application discloses a coal rock destabilization damage judgment method based on seismic source spatial distribution, which comprises the following steps: constructing an initial voronoi diagram based on the calibrated initial point of the coal rock; constructing a sliding time window; establishing a union voronoi diagram of any window based on the sliding time window; calculating the volume of the Veno area of each seismic source event point of the union Veno diagram in any window by adopting a Monte Carlo algorithm; acquiring the total volume of control areas of all the seismic source event points in each window based on the sliding time window; acquiring a time-varying line based on the total volume of the control area and the sliding time window; if a preset type trend section exists on the time-varying line, judging that the coal rock is instable and damaged; the method can rapidly acquire the complete information of the coal rock mass, realize rapid judgment and identification of the coal rock destabilization damage precursor characteristics, more accurately predict the damage state of the corresponding coal rock mass, further reveal the coal rock destabilization damage precursor law, and have important significance for realizing coal rock dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning.

title_en: Multi-source heterogeneous disaster situation data fusion understanding method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source heterogeneous disaster situation data fusion understanding method, and belongs to the field of information fusion. The method includes the steps that the data types of input multi-source disaster data are divided into four types of text, images, videos and audios, different feature extraction algorithms are respectively used for extracting features of different types of data, and feature sets are classified according to support vector machines of multiple kernel functions; and carrying out weight distribution by using a multi-attribute weight algorithm based on information entropy, judging whether disaster occurs or not by combining Bayesian network reasoning, and realizing polymorphic multi-scale space-time fusion understanding of disaster information semantics.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating toughness of park comprehensive energy system under extreme weather condition
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating toughness of a comprehensive energy system of a park under extreme weather conditions, and relates to the field of toughness evaluation of comprehensive energy systems. According to the method, a unified toughness evaluation index system is constructed, the toughness evaluation index system comprises a plurality of first-level indexes, each first-level index comprises a plurality of second-level indexes, and the comprehensive evaluation of the toughness of the park comprehensive energy system is realized; adopting a Monte Carlo simulation method to simulate a selected extreme weather disaster scene so as to obtain a second-level index value of each park comprehensive energy system to be evaluated under a toughness evaluation index system, constructing a standardized matrix, and realizing a scientific and reasonable index calculation method; acquiring the comprehensive weight of each secondary index by adopting an analytic hierarchy process-Critic method, and constructing a comprehensive weight coefficient matrix; and according to the standardized matrix and the comprehensive weight coefficient matrix, acquiring the toughness evaluation result sequence of each park comprehensive energy system to be evaluated, so that the toughness evaluation result of the comprehensive energy system under extreme weather conditions is more reliable.

title_en: Disaster recovery and backup exercise network node health early warning method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster recovery drilling network node health early warning method, a disaster recovery drilling network node health early warning system, disaster recovery drilling network node health early warning equipment and a disaster recovery drilling network node health early warning storage medium; the method comprises the following steps: calculating the total energy consumption of the network node for completing the calculation task, and grading the energy consumption of the node according to the total energy consumption; acquiring service data volume transmitted by each network node from a historical database, and judging service weight scores of the network nodes according to the service data volume; performing health scoring on the network node according to the historical alarm times of the network node; adding the energy consumption score, the business weight score and the health score to obtain a total score of the network node; the network nodes with the highest scores form an optimal disaster recovery drilling link; and predicting the quality probability of the data transmitted by the optimal disaster recovery drilling link by using the quantum Bayesian network, and triggering the health early warning if the quality probability is lower than a threshold value. According to the invention, the power resource health state of the node is monitored in the full process of disaster recovery and backup exercise, the quantum Bayesian network is utilized to replace the traditional Bayesian network, the subjective probability of Bayesian probability prediction is corrected, and smooth progress of disaster recovery and backup exercise is ensured.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM DIGITAL INTELLIGENCE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic panel vulnerability modeling method based on Bayesian theory under typhoon
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of photovoltaics, in particular to a photovoltaic panel vulnerability modeling method based on Bayesian theory under typhoons, which comprises the steps of analyzing faults of a photovoltaic module to obtain fault reasons and disaster data; establishing an updating model of a Bayesian formula based on prior distribution of wind speed and likelihood functions of faults of the photovoltaic module; and generating samples of posterior distribution by using a Monte Carlo Markov algorithm to obtain a probability density function of the posterior distribution, and obtaining an updated vulnerability function through integration. According to the invention, by updating the vulnerability function of the photovoltaic module of Goodman, more reasonable vulnerability function estimation is obtained than based on numerical value estimation, and the method is used for constructing the risk indexes of the photovoltaic module affected by typhoons in different regions, so that the problem of analysis of the operation condition of the photovoltaic unit under typhoon disasters is solved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Risk assessment method for power transmission and transformation system containing multi-state wind power plant
abstract_en: The invention provides a power transmission and transformation system risk assessment method comprising a multi-state wind power plant, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of constructing a wind turbine generator power model, discretizing a wind turbine generator output power curve to obtain the probability of corresponding fan capacity outage rate at random wind speed, constructing a risk assessment model of a power transmission and transformation combined system, performing risk assessment calculation on a bus element in the power transmission system equivalent to a transformer substation, sampling by using double-layer Monte Carlo, combining the obtained power transmission and transformation system element operation state and wind power plant output to form the operation state of the whole system, calculating the probability and load shedding condition of various states of the power transmission and transformation system according to the system operation state formed by sampling, and forming the reliability index of the power transmission and transformation combined system by statistics. The method can reflect the influence of the multi-state characteristics of the wind turbine generator on the risk assessment of the power transmission and transformation combined system during large-scale wind power grid connection, and can make up for the gap that no effective method exists at present for quantitative calculation of the risk of the power transmission and transformation combined system under the wind power grid connection.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;UNIV WUHAN TECH

title_en: Building structure Bayesian system identification and model selection method based on self-adaptive sequence Monte Carlo
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of building structures, and discloses a building structure Bayesian system identification and model selection method based on a self-adaptive sequence Monte Carlo. The method solves the problems of the identification of the building structure Bayesian system and the selection of the model class in a unified way, and the proposed new formulas of the model class evidence values can efficiently calculate the high-dimensional integral which cannot be calculated by the traditional method, and the formulas can respectively quantify the data fitting degree and the information gain of the model class so as to select the optimal model class, so that the model accuracy is ensured and meanwhile the model class is not excessively complex. The invention can efficiently solve the problems of Bayesian system identification and model class selection of a real complex building structure, so as to accurately predict the structure behaviors under different loads, and provide accurate models and theoretical supports for disaster prevention and reduction of the later-stage building structure.

title_en: WLPG viability evaluation method, device and storage medium under extreme external environment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power grid viability evaluation, and particularly relates to a WLPG viability evaluation method, a WLPG viability evaluation device and a WLPG storage medium under an extreme external environment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring system data of a weak contact power grid WLPG; according to the definition of extreme events aiming at WLPG, external disasters are divided into a plurality of classes of extreme events according to severity; establishing three-level evaluation indexes, wherein the first-level indexes of the three-level evaluation indexes are comprehensive survival indexes; carrying out Monte Carlo sampling evaluation on the viability indexes under various extreme events to obtain three-level index values of the viability under each type of extreme events; respectively synthesizing the three-level indexes of the survivability under various extreme events into two-level indexes by using a preset information entropy model; and using a preset principal component evaluation model, and combining the secondary indexes into a primary index to obtain comprehensive survival indexes under various extreme events. The invention can accurately and objectively evaluate the survivability of WLPG in extreme environment.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Electric heating energy network toughness assessment method and system in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating toughness of an electrothermal energy network in extreme weather, which belong to the field of toughness evaluation, and comprise the following steps: establishing a line fault model of an electric heat energy network in extreme weather; the line fault model comprises an external force fault model and an overload fault model; simulating extreme weather by adopting a Monte Carlo simulation method, and cutting off fault lines caused by the extreme weather based on an external force fault model; balancing islanding, calculating power flow, and cutting off overload lines based on an overload fault model; reconstructing an electrothermal energy network based on a two-stage optimization model, balancing power, and calculating the weight of a cascading failure graph edge; and establishing a cascade fault diagram of the electric-thermal energy network, and calculating element-level toughness indexes and system-level toughness indexes. The method considers the influence of continuous disturbance and cascade faults on the electrothermal energy network, more accurately identifies the weak links of the electrothermal energy network, and improves the toughness of the electrothermal energy network.

title_en: Power distribution network toughness assessment method considering distributed power supply support
abstract_en: A toughness evaluation method of a power distribution network considering distributed power supply support relates to the technical field of power, and comprises the following steps: according to the related parameters such as the load curve, the grid structure, typhoon meteorological data and the like of the power distribution network, calculating the fault rate of each element of the power distribution network under extreme disasters and the fault probability of the power distribution network line; 10000 scenes are generated by adopting a Monte Carlo method, the fault power failure range and the influence time under each scene are determined, and the occurrence probability of each scene is calculated; and determining derated running load by considering the supporting effect of the distributed power supply on the micro-grid load in the fault area, and calculating the toughness index of the power distribution network. According to the method, a plurality of fault scenes are generated by using a Monte Carlo method, the probability and the running load of each scene are considered, and the toughness index is obtained by adopting comprehensive calculation of the loss load proportion of the power distribution network. The model can be used for evaluating disaster adaptability of the power distribution network with the distributed power supply, provides a basis for further proposing distributed power supply layout optimization and improving toughness research of the power distribution network, and guides construction of the power distribution network.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID QIANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Typhoon storm surge disaster risk assessment method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon storm surge disaster risk assessment method and device, comprising the following steps: step S1, acquiring typhoon storm surge disaster risk evaluation indexes; step S2, obtaining a Bayesian network structure containing a typhoon storm surge disaster risk index set according to the hierarchical structure of the typhoon storm surge disaster risk evaluation index; s3, obtaining a typhoon storm surge disaster risk assessment model according to the Bayesian network; and S4, inputting a preset typhoon storm surge situation into a typhoon storm surge disaster risk assessment model to obtain the associated risk level and probability of the typhoon storm surge disaster risk assessment index. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, the quantitative prediction of the typhoon storm surge disaster risk level is realized.

title_en: Scene deduction and result prediction method and system for dust explosion accident
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for deducing and predicting consequences of dust explosion accident situations, which relate to the technical field of dust explosion disaster research and comprise the following steps: constructing a dust explosion accident scene deduction model based on a dynamic Bayesian network; constructing a dust explosion accident result prediction model based on a dynamic Bayesian network; based on a dust explosion accident scene deduction model and a dust explosion accident result prediction model, formulating a dust explosion accident acceptable level criterion, and constructing a two-dimensional matrix; based on the two-dimensional matrix, a dust explosion accident scene deduction and result prediction model is obtained, and the dust explosion accident is predicted. The invention makes up the defect of acceptable risk criteria in the field of dust explosion in China, and further improves the risk management of dust explosion industry in China. The method provides reference basis and technical support for predicting the evolution direction of dust explosion accidents, deployment of emergency rescue decisions and prediction and evaluation of disaster damage results.

title_en: Post-earthquake disaster evacuation behavior rule analysis method based on social network data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-earthquake disaster evacuation behavior rule analysis method based on social network data, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of preprocessing data by acquiring the occurred seismic event, constructing an evacuation behavior theory and a Bayesian network structure model, converting the Bayesian network structure into a junction tree, further optimizing the performance and accuracy of the model, and revealing the evacuation behavior rule of the disaster victims in a short time after earthquake from a quantitative angle by calculating node probability distribution. The invention provides scientific basis and decision support for earthquake disaster handling, and finally can extract the regularity information of the evacuation behaviors of post-earthquake disaster people from the social network data, and the discovery and interpretation of the regularity has important scientific significance and decision value for earthquake disaster handling so as to better understand and predict the evacuation behaviors of people.

title_en: Typhoon storm surge disaster chain catastrophe risk assessment method based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster risk management, and discloses a typhoon storm surge disaster chain catastrophe risk assessment method based on a Bayesian network, which comprises the following steps: constructing a disaster chain catastrophe scene library of typhoon-storm tide-flood-embankment based on the typhoon scene and catastrophe driving element combination scene; constructing a Bayesian network model according to the catastrophe mechanism and the chain transfer rule of a disaster chain of typhoon-storm tide-flood-embankment; and evaluating the catastrophe risks under different catastrophe scenes in the catastrophe scene library by adopting a Bayesian network model. The invention is based on the complex catastrophe mechanism of typhoon-storm tide-flood-embankment disaster chain and the chain transfer relation among elements affecting catastrophe, develops the Bayesian complex system network reasoning modeling of the disaster chain, simulates and analyzes the catastrophe risks of various disasters of the disaster chain under different catastrophe scenes, and has important significance for the risk management and disaster reduction work of typhoon disasters in coastal areas.

title_en: Method, equipment and medium for evaluating line toughness under tornado disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating line toughness under a tornado disaster, which relates to the technical field of power transmission line risk evaluation and is used for filling the blank that the prior art lacks in carrying out power transmission line risk evaluation on tornados, and the method comprises the following steps: calculating parameter probability distribution according to the historical data; generating a tornado path according to the parameter probability distribution, and constructing a position relationship between a power transmission line and the tornado; the wind field model is used for calculating the point location wind speed at the power transmission line; establishing vulnerability curves of all elements of the power transmission line, and calculating the failure probability of the elements of the power transmission line according to the wind speed; and calculating the fault probability of a single line according to the element fault probability, and calculating by combining a Monte Carlo state sampling method and a toughness evaluation index to obtain a toughness evaluation result. The invention also discloses electronic equipment and a computer storage medium for evaluating the line toughness under the tornado disaster. The method effectively estimates the toughness of the power transmission line under the tornado disaster through the Monte Carlo method.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Hydrologic detection equipment layout method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hydrological detection equipment layout method and system based on the Internet of things, which belong to the technical field of hydrological monitoring, and are used for acquiring multi-frame continuous image information of a target detection area in a preset time period, introducing a hidden Markov model and a Baum-Welch algorithm for analysis to generate a time sequence dynamic model of the target detection area, calculating the occurrence probability of hydrological natural disaster types in a Bayesian network algorithm based on the time sequence dynamic model, analyzing and planning to obtain a first installation area, constructing a hydrological detection equipment simulation model, introducing the hydrological detection equipment simulation model into the first installation area for simulation measurement and screening the installation area to obtain a second installation area, constructing a quadratic polynomial regression curve model, and screening the final layout points of the second installation area based on the model to obtain a final layout scheme. The method can screen and plan the measurement layout points of the hydrologic detection equipment, realizes accurate and efficient measurement effect and has high reliability.

title_en: Dam flood discharge energy dissipation structure safety risk assessment method based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dam flood discharge energy dissipation structure safety risk assessment method based on a Bayesian network, which comprises the steps of constructing a finite element simulation model of a dam and a Bayesian network of the dam flood discharge energy dissipation structure; searching a damage path in the finite element simulation model by adopting a flood discharge energy dissipation structure damage criterion; calculating the damage probability p  o  of each structural damage mode by adopting a Monte Carlo method according to the risk agent model, the mechanical parameters of the dam and foundation materials and the hydraulic parameters of the overflow surface; calculating the structural system damage probability p  α  of the flood discharge energy dissipation structure; when any damaged path o is assumed to be absent, calculating damage probability of flood discharge energy dissipation structure when disaster factors of damaged path o are not damaged based on the rest damaged paths and Bayesian network ; According to p  α  and Calculating the importance of disaster factors of the damaged path o; and selecting a failure path corresponding to the disaster causing factor with the highest importance as a main control path for destroying the flood discharging and energy dissipating structure.

title_en: Urban storm waterlogging disaster chain risk assessment system based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: A Bayesian network-based risk assessment system for urban storm waterlogging disaster chains utilizes the probability reasoning capability of the Bayesian network and the feature extraction capability of deep learning to encode, correlate and fuse the storm data of each link in the urban storm waterlogging disaster chains so as to obtain the predicted value of the occurrence probability of the disaster, thereby realizing the risk assessment of the urban storm waterlogging disaster chains.

title_en: Risk propagation pattern graph-based contact network part association characteristic analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a contact net part association characteristic analysis method based on a risk propagation pattern diagram, which specifically comprises the following steps: acquiring historical fault associated data of contact net parts; defining a simultaneous fault incidence relation and a time sequence fault incidence relation; constructing a risk coefficient model of the fault association relationship; constructing a virtual path, acquiring a virtual path set between two parts, and acquiring a shortest virtual path set according to a reduction rule; mapping the set of shortest virtual paths into a risk association graph; defining the risk coefficient weight of each virtual path in the risk correlation diagram; constructing a risk propagation pattern diagram taking any fault part as a starting point, and evaluating risk levels of each fault association relation; the invention can evaluate the risk degree of the known fault association relationship and the risk degree of the potential fault association relationship, can reveal the association characteristics among the contact net parts under different time scales and provides decision basis for preventing occurrence of cascading faults.

title_en: Residential building fire disaster overfire area prediction method, system, storage medium and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, a storage medium and a device for predicting fire disaster area of residential building, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a fire disaster area prediction model of the residential building based on a fire disaster heat release rate and a ventilation control type combustion mode; determining combustion parameters of the overfire area according to the fire overfire area prediction model; fire history data of the combustion parameters are obtained, and probability distribution of the combustion parameters is determined according to the fire history data; randomly sampling probability distribution of combustion parameters to obtain a plurality of groups of combustion parameters corresponding to different probabilities; based on a fire area prediction model and a plurality of groups of combustion parameters corresponding to different probabilities, performing Monte Carlo simulation to obtain cumulative probability distribution of the area of the fire of the residential building; and determining the fire risk level of the residential building according to the cumulative probability distribution of the overfire area. The invention can accurately predict the fire disaster area of the residential building and determine the fire disaster risk level so as to formulate effective fire disaster prevention and control measures.
assignees: CHINA IPPR INT ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Disaster broadcasting wireless relay system that compensates for synchronization signals and improves broadcasting quality of radio shaded areas
title_ko: 동기신호를 보상하고 전파음영지역의 방송품질을 개선한 재난방송 무선중계시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a disaster broadcasting wireless relay system that compensates for a synchronization signal in a wireless section where data loss may occur and improves broadcasting quality in a radio shadow area so as to improve the reliability of disaster broadcasting. The disaster broadcasting wireless relay system that compensates for a synchronization signal and improves broadcasting quality in a radio shadow area comprises: a disaster broadcasting receiving device having an FPGA module for noise reduction to reduce noise caused by the surrounding environment when receiving a disaster broadcasting RF signal, and converting a digital demodulated signal from which the noise has been removed into Internet packet data and outputting the same; a main relay device that receives the Internet packet data output from the disaster broadcasting receiving device through a wired network and outputs the same as a short-range wireless signal; a sub-relay device that receives the short-range wireless signal output from the main relay device, modulates the same into a synchronized disaster broadcasting RF signal, and outputs the same; and a user terminal having a disaster broadcasting reception communication module for receiving the disaster broadcasting RF signal output through the sub-relay device.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 동기신호를 보상하여 불확실성을 갖는 무선구간의 신뢰성을 향상시키고 전파음영지역에 용이하게 재난방송을 전달할 수 있도록 하는 동기신호를 보상하고 전파음영지역의 방송품질을 개선한 재난방송 무선중계시스템에 관한 것으로, 전파음영지역의 건물내부에 설치되며 재난방송용 RF신호를 수신하는 경우에 주변환경으로 인한 노이즈를 저감시키기 위한 노이즈 저감용 FPGA모듈을 구비하여 노이즈가 제거된 디지털 복조신호를 인터넷 패킷 데이터로 변환하여 출력하는 재난방송 수신장치, 상기 건물내부를 구성하는 층별로 설치되고 상기 재난방송 수신장치에서 출력되는 인터넷 패킷데이터를 유선망으로 수신하여 근거리 무선신호로 출력하는 메인중계장치, 상기 메인중계장치가 설치된 층에 적어도 하나 이상 설치되며 상기 메인중계장치에서 출력되는 근거리무선신호를 수신하여 동기화된 재난방송용 RF신호로 변조하여 출력하는 서브중계장치, 및 상기 서브중계장치를 통해 출력되는 재난방송용 RF신호를 수신하기 위한 재난방송수신용 통신모듈을 구비하는 사용자 단말기;를 구비한다.

title_en: Power system risk assessment method considering carbon balance under forest fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system risk assessment method considering carbon balance under mountain fire disasters, which comprises the following steps of S1: establishing a deduction model of the mountain fire disaster time-space evolution process; step S2: a carbon unbalance severity calculating method considering carbon emission increase and carbon sink loss is provided; step S3: constructing a carbon price increase model based on the severity of carbon imbalance; step S4: the power system operational risk is assessed based on the carbon price sensitivity of the power source-load. According to the invention, the carbon unbalance risk caused by the mountain fire disaster is considered, and the influence of the mountain fire disaster on the operation risk of the power system can be effectively evaluated based on the Monte Carlo sampling algorithm.

title_en: Toughness evaluation method for multi-microgrid system for taking hydrogen transportation into account under typhoon
abstract_en: The invention discloses a toughness evaluation method for a multi-microgrid system for calculating and transporting hydrogen under typhoons, which comprises the following steps: modeling typhoons and quantifying the damage of typhoons to the power distribution network; based on a vehicle path planning model, a hydrogen transportation multi-micro-grid model is established to meet hydrogen demand load (hydrogen adding station, chemical plant and the like) in a multi-micro-grid system, and the influence of typhoons on a hydrogen transportation system in a transportation network is quantified by taking the transportation cost of a hydrogen truck as an index; based on a Monte Carlo method, typhoon disturbance is set, and the fault state of the multi-microgrid system is simulated; aiming at the system fault state, an optimal load shedding model is established, and the load loss is calculated to quantify the damage of typhoons to the multi-microgrid system; finally, the index evaluation toughness is proposed from the two layers of infrastructure and system operation.

title_en: Coal mine digital twin model building method based on Bayesian network algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal mine digital twin model building method based on a Bayesian network algorithm, which relates to the technical field of machine learning and comprises the steps of S1 determining a target mine, acquiring real-time data, S2 building an initial digital twin model, S3 determining the disaster type of the target mine and corresponding disaster causing factors, further building and training to obtain a disaster causing factor analysis model, outputting the disaster causing factor analysis model to obtain a topological relation of the disaster causing factors, S4 building a Bayesian model, performing iterative training on the Bayesian model by using superposition weight analysis, and S5 embedding the disaster causing factor analysis model and the Bayesian model into the initial digital twin model in series by using an antagonism framework to obtain a final digital twin model. The invention is integrated with a Bayesian network algorithm, can analyze and predict input data to obtain the occurrence probability of mine disasters, and can take countermeasures or rectifying measures in advance for different disasters, thereby effectively improving the safety coefficient of the coal mine.

title_en: Visual geographic cloud image data processing system for intelligent aerial view map customer service risk
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electric power risk, and particularly relates to a visual geographic cloud image data processing system for intelligent aerial view map customer service risk, which comprises the following components: the system comprises a geographic sampling module, a probability evaluation module, an asset statistics module and a risk output module. According to the scheme, a GIS technology is adopted to analyze a flood disaster graph, the failure risk probability of the electric power asset and the potential influence thereof are quantized, and a process for monetizing and visualizing the generated risk results is established; the method comprises the steps of creating a cloud-shaped sampling point which is uniformly distributed in an influence area of each power distribution cabinet, generating a position of a sampling shape by using a Monte Carlo simulation method, randomly shifting the position of the cloud-shaped sampling point, and simulating the uncertainty of the position by using a fuzzy boundary; by means of the vulnerability profile without safeguarding or improvement measures, the losses or the extent of impact suffered by the electrical installation are evaluated in order to operate more robustly in the face of threats.
assignees: NANNING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Bridge toughness assessment method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a bridge toughness assessment method and electronic equipment, belonging to the technical field of bridge infrastructure safety monitoring, wherein the method comprises the following steps: applying a plurality of sets of seismic wave data to a pre-established finite element model of the bridge to be evaluated, and obtaining a plurality of sets of seismic response displacement vectors corresponding to the bridge to be evaluated under the action of the plurality of sets of seismic wave data; expanding the number of the plurality of groups of earthquake response displacement vectors by using a Monte Carlo simulation method; calculating an initial toughness index of the bridge to be evaluated corresponding to each seismic response displacement vector by using each seismic response displacement vector based on the seismic response displacement vectors with the number expanded; and carrying out lognormal distribution fitting on all initial toughness indexes, and carrying out toughness evaluation on the bridge to be evaluated according to fitting results. The method realizes the quantitative evaluation of the toughness of the bridge, has the advantages of strong operability, relatively reliable data and good standardized suitability, and has popularization value.

title_en: Surge chain life disaster evaluation method considering failure probability of reservoir landslide
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of evaluation of inland reservoir landslide surge disaster risk, and discloses a surge chain-generated disaster evaluation method considering reservoir landslide failure probability, which comprises the following steps: step 1, defining a research area range; step 2, obtaining topographic data and rock-soil parameters according to the research objects and the range of the research area, and obtaining annual warehouse water level data and daily rainfall data in the research area; and 3, selecting a typical section of the potential landslide body, and performing 5000 Monte Carlo simulation calculations on the failure probability of the potential landslide body according to a Monte Carlo method. According to the landslide surge chain life disaster evaluation method, the potential landslide body failure probability of the landslide is introduced to reflect the influence of the failure probability of the landslide on the landslide surge chain life disaster evaluation, and the landslide failure probability, the landslide surge disaster risk and the landslide surge disaster bearing body vulnerability are multiplied to obtain the landslide surge disaster risk evaluation, so that the risk evaluation result is more reasonable, and a systematic landslide surge chain life disaster evaluation method is formed.
assignees: WUHAN CAMPUS OF YANGTZE UNIV;UNIV CHONGQING;SICHUAN YANJIANG PANNING EXPRESSWAY CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for simulating construction process of steel box girder bridge based on hybrid simulation model
abstract_en: The application provides a method for simulating a construction process of a steel box girder bridge based on a hybrid simulation model, and relates to the technical field of intelligent construction for infrastructure construction, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a construction process simulation model based on multiple agents; constructing a construction control model based on system dynamics; constructing a construction risk prediction model based on a Bayesian network model; constructing a construction period simulation model based on discrete events; and constructing a hybrid simulation model based on the correlation of the constructed multiple models and the multiple models in the construction process, and simulating the construction process of the steel box girder bridge by changing the hybrid simulation model. The application adopting the scheme realizes the hybrid simulation of the construction process of the steel box girder bridge.

title_en: Landslide vulnerability analysis method based on causal discovery and structure learning
abstract_en: The application provides a landslide vulnerability analysis method based on causal discovery and structure learning. Firstly, multi-source geologic data and landslide catalog of a monitoring area are acquired, a disaster causing factor set is constructed, the disaster causing factor set is used as a causal discovery factor set and a vulnerability analysis factor set, discretization processing is needed for the vulnerability analysis factor set, the monitoring area is divided into the causal discovery area and the vulnerability analysis area, a sample set is sequentially constructed, a non-supervision causal discovery algorithm is adopted for data-driven causal directed acyclic graph construction, the vulnerability analysis factor set and redundant data in the sample set are removed according to the result, a Bayesian network model is constructed by the causal directed acyclic graph, training, prediction and model evaluation are sequentially conducted by the vulnerability analysis sample set, and landslide vulnerability analysis is finally conducted on the monitoring area. The method can fully excavate the coupling relation between the landslide and the disaster-causing factor, construct a model with low redundancy and high interpretability, and realize more accurate landslide susceptibility analysis.

title_en: Mine underground debris flow risk analysis method based on coupling weighting network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for analyzing underground mine debris flow risk based on a coupling weighting network, which relates to the field of mine safety risk prevention and control, and comprises the following steps: performing risk factor interaction analysis on the mine underground debris flow risk analysis index model to construct a multi-layer structure network model; mapping the multi-level structure network model into a Bayesian network to construct a Bayesian network structure analysis model; constructing inter-node connection weights according to the coupling degree of the risk factors, and executing coupling weighting of the Bayesian network structure analysis model according to the inter-node connection weights to obtain a coupling weighted Bayesian network structure analysis model; and carrying out diagnosis and reasoning according to the coupling weighted Bayesian network structure analysis model to obtain a mining underground debris flow risk analysis result. The method solves the problem that in the prior art, key risk factors and key disaster-causing paths are difficult to determine due to complex relationships of mine underground debris flow risk factors.

title_en: Method and device for analyzing coupling risk of energy and traffic system in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for analyzing coupling risk of energy and a traffic system in extreme weather. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: respectively establishing a power system simulation operation model, a heating system simulation operation model, a traffic system simulation operation model and an extreme weather simulation model; after the electric power system simulation operation model, the heating system simulation operation model and the traffic system simulation operation model are coupled, an energy-traffic simulation operation model is established by considering the damage influence of the extreme weather simulation model; and based on the energy-traffic simulation operation model, carrying out risk analysis on the coupled energy-traffic system by utilizing Monte Carlo simulation. The invention can capture the mutual coupling and interdependence relation of different infrastructure systems when facing disaster damage, fully reveal the risks faced by the energy-traffic coupling system under the action of extreme weather disasters, and better assist the prevention and response of extreme weather events.
assignees: STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster early warning misalignment risk analysis method based on Monte Carlo simulation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent disaster early warning misalignment risk analysis method based on a Monte Carlo simulation method, which comprises the steps of extracting and analyzing initial indexes of mountain torrent disasters, screening sensitive indexes and reducing weight to obtain a mountain torrent disaster index set, and constructing a mountain torrent disaster index system; weighting the mountain torrent disaster indexes to obtain comprehensive weights of the mountain torrent disaster indexes, and constructing a mountain torrent disaster early warning model; extracting historical mountain torrents data of a research area, inputting the historical mountain torrents into a mountain torrents disaster early warning model to obtain mountain torrents disaster early warning, setting an early warning misalignment threshold value based on a mountain torrents index system, and calculating mountain torrents disaster early warning misalignment probability; and (3) adjusting the decision of the mountain torrent disaster index weight and feeding back the mountain torrent disaster index weight into the mountain torrent disaster early warning model, setting iteration preset times, extracting the mountain torrent disaster early warning model after the iteration is input, and stopping iteration when the result after the iteration and the expected deviation are within the early warning misalignment threshold. The invention can effectively improve the early warning accuracy and the response efficiency of the mountain torrent disaster and is beneficial to reducing the loss caused by the mountain torrent disaster.

title_en: Farmer behavior prediction method based on agent modeling and Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a farmer behavior prediction method based on agent modeling and a Bayesian network, and belongs to the technical field of farmer behavior simulation prediction. The method comprises the following steps: a data collection stage; a Bayesian relation network and a group effect influence mechanism construction stage; a peasant household disaster prevention consciousness change mechanism construction stage; a peasant household long-term disaster response adaptation behavior prediction model construction stage; setting model parameters; and in the model information importing and simulating stage, inputting the external conditions of the target area, then simulating random outbreaks of geological disasters for a plurality of times, counting the decision behaviors of each simulated target agent, and taking an average value to obtain a peasant household behavior prediction result. The ABM method is adopted, so that the response behaviors of farmers in various disaster scenes can be simulated, influence factors and rules of the farmers are analyzed, and the method has high predictability and applicability; the phenomenon of emergence of the behaviors of the farmers can be mined in the simulation process.

title_en: Power distribution network and drainage network topology collaborative reconstruction method for coping with storm water logging disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network and drainage network topology collaborative reconstruction method for coping with storm water-logging disasters, which comprises the following steps: step S1, constructing an electric power-drainage network coupling model based on partial differential constraint of pressure and non-pressure unsteady flow hydrodynamic force, and representing dynamic interactive evolution processes of power failure, rainwater overflow and road ponding of a power grid under a storm disaster; s2, establishing an equivalent linear complex algebraic equation of a drainage network nonlinear hydrodynamic partial differential equation in a frequency domain; s3, deducing a multi-hyperplane formula of an electric power-drainage composite safety area, and representing a feasible operation boundary of an electric pump-sluice group under the injection conditions of complex electric power and rainwater; and S4, taking rainfall uncertainty in heavy rain into consideration, adopting multi-scene random optimization based on Monte Carlo simulation, and solving an emergency scheduling decision scheme at the current moment through rolling optimization. The invention realizes the coordination reconstruction of the network topology of the power distribution network and the drainage network under the disaster of rainstorm and waterlogging.

title_en: Event probability prediction method, system and terminal under tsunami disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses an event probability prediction method, an event probability prediction system and a terminal under tsunami disasters, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a global tsunami historical data set, screening variables and initial data sets corresponding to the variables from the global tsunami historical data set, filling missing values of the discretized data sets through a Markov blanket node state value combination strategy, and obtaining a complete data set; learning the Bayesian network structure by using the complete data set to obtain a basic Bayesian network structure; constructing a causal edge candidate set, correcting the basic network structure by using the causal edge candidate set, pruning the corrected network structure, and obtaining a target network structure; and acquiring variable data under the tsunami disaster to be predicted, and inputting the variable data into a target network structure to obtain the probability of occurrence of a corresponding event under the tsunami disaster to be predicted. The invention constructs the Bayesian network with complete structure, and can accurately predict the occurrence probability of the event when the tsunami disaster comes, thereby making a correct emergency decision.

title_en: Power failure processing method, device, equipment and medium for power guarantee area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power outage processing method, device, equipment and medium for a power guarantee area, wherein the method comprises the steps of marking time at the moment when a power outage occurs according to a high-precision time synchronization method, collecting historical operation data of all nodes of a power system at the same time point, extracting features of the operation data based on a deep learning algorithm, extracting depth feature vectors reflecting the intrinsic structure and time scale features of the data, establishing a power outage risk assessment model according to the depth feature vectors, optimizing the power outage risk assessment model by adopting a Bayesian network or Markov decision process method, obtaining current operation data of the power system, inputting the current operation data into the optimized power outage risk assessment model, outputting an assessment result, and constructing a power outage processing strategy matched with the assessment result and executed by a safety early warning terminal. The method provided by the invention realizes accurate monitoring and effective control of the power failure risk of the power system.

title_en: Loess slope stability reliability analysis method, loess slope stability reliability analysis system, loess slope stability reliability analysis equipment and loess slope stability reliability analysis medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of slope engineering safety evaluation, and discloses a loess slope stability reliability analysis method, a loess slope stability reliability analysis system, loess slope stability reliability analysis equipment and loess slope stability reliability analysis media, wherein the loess slope stability analysis method comprises the following steps: constructing a slope finite element model; carrying out slope stability analysis on the slope finite element model to obtain a slope stability coefficient; constructing a mapping relation between random parameters and slope stability coefficients based on a response surface method, and calculating slope failure probabilities under different rainfall conditions based on the mapping relation and a Monte Carlo method; wherein the random parameter is a slope loess intensity parameter added with a correlation coefficient or a variation coefficient. The technical scheme of the invention can provide reference for researching the stability of the multi-step loess slope and disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION THE 20TH GROUP MUNICIPAL ENG CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY 20 BUREAU GROUP CORP

title_en: Risk evolution assessment method, device, equipment, medium and product for tripping of natural disaster-induced power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk evolution assessment method, a device, equipment, a medium and a product for tripping a natural disaster induced power transmission line. The method comprises the following steps: determining a plurality of events corresponding to each natural disaster type and occurrence probabilities corresponding to the plurality of events based on the historical comprehensive accident statistical information; determining an accident tree corresponding to each natural disaster type based on a plurality of events and occurrence probabilities corresponding to the plurality of events; the accident tree corresponding to each of the natural disaster types is converted into a Bayesian network diagram; in the Bayesian network diagram, determining the sensitivity of each relevant node of each layer corresponding to the natural disaster type based on the occurrence probability of each relevant node of each layer corresponding to the natural disaster type; determining a target node of each layer based on the sensitivity of each related node of each layer; and determining a risk evolution path corresponding to the natural disaster type based on the target nodes of each layer. The embodiment can provide support for emergency decision and reduce the occurrence of tripping accidents of the power transmission line.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ENERGY RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power system cascading failure emergency blocking control method and device based on risk assessment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of safe operation and control of power systems, and provides a power system cascading failure emergency blocking control method and device based on risk assessment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: designing each action strategy, objective function and constraint condition of emergency blocking control; setting a cascading failure simulation round, simulating cascading failures, and counting average load loss and average unit loss; based on each action strategy of the optimal emergency blocking control of the Monte Carlo tree searching method, model training is carried out based on an improved depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm, and a cascading failure emergency blocking control model is established; predicting and obtaining the load shedding action quantity of the emergency power shedding machine in various states to form an emergency blocking control scheme of the power grid to be predicted; the invention gives consideration to the safe operation and economy of the system, effectively blocks the cascade fault process and ensures the safe stability of the operation of the new energy grid-connected system.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for analyzing failure disaster chain of gas pipeline
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for analyzing a failure disaster chain of a gas pipeline, which relate to the technical field of gas pipeline analysis and comprise the following steps: when the natural gas transmission pipeline fails, taking all disaster events of the current natural gas transmission pipeline as nodes in a network, taking induction factors among the disaster events as directed continuous edges in the network, and constructing a disaster chain network according to the nodes and the directed continuous edges; calculating topological structure parameters comprising an input degree, an output degree, a total degree value and a clustering coefficient in a disaster chain network, and determining an evolution mechanism of failure disaster chain risk propagation of the current natural gas transmission pipeline based on the topological structure parameters; calculating the risk degree of a failure disaster chain of the current natural gas transmission pipeline based on the disaster rate, the loss degree and the directed continuous edge weakness degree of the disaster chain network; analyzing the current natural gas pipeline according to an evolution mechanism of the risk propagation of the failure disaster chain of the current natural gas pipeline and the risk degree of the failure disaster chain of the current natural gas pipeline.

title_en: Dynamic Bayesian network assessment method for urban storm waterlogging evolution toughness
abstract_en: A dynamic Bayesian network evaluation method for urban rainstorm waterlogging evolution toughness comprises the following steps: s1, collecting dynamic indexes and static indexes of the evolution toughness of rainstorm and waterlogging, and acquiring comprehensive toughness indexes of disasters, society, economy, environment and infrastructure based on the initial stage, the flood stage and the recovery stage of secondary rainstorm; s2, establishing a DBN topological relation; s3, calculating the DBN prior probability and weight of the comprehensive toughness index, calculating the DBN conditional probability of the comprehensive toughness index, determining a dynamic toughness index threshold value, acquiring time-varying evidence of the dynamic toughness index, and forming DBN input data; s4, constructing a DBN based on the comprehensive toughness index, the DBN topological relation and the DBN input data to form a total toughness graph of urban storm waterlogging evolution time-varying, analyzing the evolution process of toughness in the initial stage, the flood and the recovery stage of the storm waterlogging from a dynamic angle, and identifying a critical threshold value of toughness change. The method is beneficial to improving the accuracy of the toughness level evaluation of the sponge city.

title_en: Building function probability prediction method under flood disasters based on deep learning algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building function probability prediction method under flood disasters based on a deep learning algorithm, which comprises the following steps: s1, collecting basic data and historical storm time sequence data of a research area; s2, processing the data; s3, constructing an FFC model based on a deep learning algorithm, training and verifying the FFC model, optimizing the affected building attention coefficient to obtain the optimal affected building attention coefficient for each building type, and testing the performance of the FFC model; s4, inputting the forecast rainfall time sequence into the FFC model tested for each building type, and performing repeated rolling iteration prediction to obtain probability distribution results of different functions of each building in a certain time range in the future of the research area. The obtained building function probability distribution result is beneficial to providing more information and uncertainty quantification for decision-making of decision-makers, thereby providing a good basis for the determination of the subsequent evacuation requirements.

title_en: Construction method of industrial brain system for industrial chain
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction method of an industrial brain system for an industrial chain, which comprises the steps of constructing the industrial brain system based on an autonomous cognition thinking atlas functional module, an autonomous interactive decision functional module and a dynamic behavior active regulation functional module, wherein the autonomous cognition thinking atlas functional module is used for autonomously executing sensing, cognition, decision and regulation tasks on various situations of ductile seepage phase transition of an industrial chain supply chain network, the autonomous cognition thinking atlas functional module is used for real-time sensing, measurement, cognition and storage of the ductile seepage phase transition of the industrial chain supply chain network, the autonomous interactive decision functional module is used for ductile situation identification, event accurate positioning and situation comprehensive research and judgment of all elements, and the dynamic behavior regulation module is used for regulating the vulnerability and risk propagation dynamic behavior of the industrial chain supply chain network according to a generated decision scheme. Thus, various situations of the ductile seepage phase transition of the complex giant chain network are accurately identified, measured, predicted in disaster and actively regulated and controlled in behavior.

title_en: Toughness evaluation method and equipment for electric-thermal comprehensive energy system under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to a toughness technology of a power distribution network under extreme natural disasters, in particular to a toughness evaluation method and equipment of an electric-thermal comprehensive energy system under typhoon disasters, wherein the method builds an element fault probability model under typical typhoon disasters and establishes a typical fault scene based on a Monte Carlo method; aiming at three core characteristics of toughness, a time-period assessment system for an electric-thermal comprehensive energy system is established, and multi-level and multi-angle assessment of the toughness of the system is realized through three primary indexes of pre-disaster strain, in-disaster defensive power and post-disaster restoring power and six secondary indexes of load energy supply path redundancy, system standby state, network retention rate, load retention rate, unit adjustment time and element repair time. Compared with the traditional electric heating system, the evaluation method has the advantages that the operation level of the electric-thermal integrated energy system taking the dual inertia of the heat supply network into consideration in the disaster environment is higher, the load loss is smaller, and the toughness level is higher.

title_en: Power grid risk assessment method and device based on dynamic evolution of sudden natural disaster chain
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid risk assessment, in particular to a power grid risk assessment method and device based on dynamic evolution of sudden natural disaster chains. The method comprises the following steps: calculating according to regional weather information, geographical geological information, power grid equipment information and power grid electrical information to obtain the fault probability of the power transmission line; based on a risk element theory, according to the fault probability of the power transmission line, carrying out disaster chain construction through qualitative analysis of power grid disaster causes under sudden natural disasters to obtain a power transmission line disaster chain and a disaster chain Bow-tie model; calculating according to a preset expert questionnaire of the power transmission line fault to obtain the prior probability of the power transmission line fault; and according to the prior probability of the power transmission line fault and the disaster chain Bow-tie model, performing posterior probability calculation through Bayesian simulation software Netica to obtain a power grid risk assessment result. The power grid risk assessment method is strong in timeliness and high in accuracy according to dynamic evolution of natural disaster chains by combining a Bayesian network.
assignees: STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING SCIENCE & TECH;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;XUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH CO STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Flood disaster chain scene deduction method and system based on dynamic Bayes
abstract_en: The application provides a flood disaster chain scene deduction method and system based on dynamic Bayes, which relate to the technical field of natural disasters, and the method comprises the following steps: constructing an ontology model of a city storm waterlogging disaster chain scene; constructing a city storm waterlogging disaster chain scene according to the body model and the city storm waterlogging historical disaster event; according to the urban storm waterlogging disaster chain scene, the attribute of the disaster bearing body and the countermeasures, constructing a dynamic Bayesian network model corresponding to the urban storm waterlogging disaster chain scene; and determining the probability that the scene element node to be predicted in the dynamic Bayesian network model is in the target state in the time period to be predicted according to the scene element node and the countermeasure node with known states in the dynamic Bayesian network model. The method aims at comprehensively considering the influence of various influencing factors on the scene deduction process of the disaster chain, so that the accuracy of scene deduction of the disaster chain is improved, and scientific selection of various disaster coping schemes is realized.

title_en: Knowledge graph-based natural disaster risk assessment method for photovoltaic project
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic project natural disaster risk assessment method based on a knowledge graph, and relates to the field of key infrastructure risk assessment; firstly, utilizing big data depth of a disaster text to mine microscopic causal structures of risk components hidden in a large sample of historical disaster events, and drawing a generalized natural disaster risk knowledge graph of a photovoltaic project; based on the knowledge graph and the complex network view angle, describing the dynamic process of the composite risk system through machine simulation, and identifying key nodes and main paths of risk conduction; finally, constructing a photovoltaic project natural disaster risk assessment model based on the Bayesian network based on the key nodes and the main paths of risk conduction; the method can overcome the limitations of the current comprehensive index method and the mechanism model method in the aspects of strong subjectivity of risk assessment, difficult model verification and the like, and provides an innovative approach for objective and accurate assessment of natural disaster risk in photovoltaic projects.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORPORATION SICHUAN ENERGY INVEST CO LTD;CHINA THREE GORGES CORP

title_en: Off-grid power system reliability assessment method considering marine environmental influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reliability evaluation method of an off-grid power system considering marine environmental influence. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a power equipment reliability model considering marine environmental influence, obtaining reliability according to the power equipment reliability model, dividing states, calculating outage time, and obtaining an equipment outage probability matrix according to the reliability model; and simulating the equipment outage condition according to the equipment outage probability matrix, and performing reliability evaluation on the off-grid power system by adopting a Monte Carlo method to obtain the load loss and power shortage condition in the off-grid power system. The method can effectively evaluate the reliability of the off-grid power system influenced by the marine environment, overcomes the defect that the conventional power system evaluation method ignores the long-term influence of the environment on equipment, solves the problem of lower accuracy of the reliability evaluation result of the power system under the influence of the marine environment, and can reduce the running risk of the power system.

title_en: Mobile energy storage configuration method for improving power distribution network capacity under ice disaster influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile energy storage configuration method for improving the capacity of a power distribution network under the influence of ice disaster, which comprises the following steps: according to the obtained line fault probability, considering the space-time transfer characteristic of the ice disaster, generating a fault state of each period of each line by using a time sequence Monte Carlo simulation method, and completing 1-time complete sampling of a fault scene of the distribution network under the ice disaster; repeating the sampling process until a plurality of scene sets are generated, and reducing the number of scenes by adopting a K-means clustering method to obtain S typical fault scenes; taking the minimum expected loss cost of the load of each node in S typical fault scenes in the ice disaster attack process as a target, and establishing a power distribution network mobile energy storage pre-disaster pre-layout random optimization model considering the dynamic evolution of the fault scenes in consideration of the readjustment process of the pre-disaster layout position of the mobile energy storage in each fault scene in the ice disaster dynamic evolution process; and converting nonlinear constraint in the model into linear constraint based on a Big-M method, generating a mixed integer linear programming model, solving, and outputting a dynamic scheduling scheme of the optimal pre-disaster distribution position of the mobile energy storage and each fault scene in the disaster period.
assignees: UNIV NORTHEAST ELECTRIC POWER;STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Optimized scheduling method and device for wind power and cascade hydropower combined system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power and cascade hydropower combined system optimal scheduling method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a daily random optimization scheduling model of the wind power and step hydropower combined system based on Monte Carlo tree search, wherein the daily random optimization scheduling model is used for maximizing the generated energy of the wind power and step hydropower combined system in one day and minimizing the total fluctuation of power generation; determining constraint conditions of the daily random optimization scheduling model; defining a step hydropower station with solar regulation capacity as an intelligent body, taking a wind power and step hydropower combined system as an interactive environment, and performing discretization treatment on a state space and an action space; randomly generating wind power plant output by adopting a fractional regression long-short-term memory neural network model; and solving a daily random optimization scheduling model by using a Monte Carlo tree searching algorithm to obtain an optimal scheduling scheme. The method realizes the dual goals of maximizing the generated energy of the combined system and minimizing the total fluctuation through the Monte Carlo tree search of reinforcement learning, and remarkably improves the energy utilization efficiency and the power grid stability.

title_en: Position pre-dispatching system in movable emergency resource disaster
