abstract_en: The invention discloses a position pre-dispatching system in a movable emergency resource disaster, which is characterized in that a transportation vehicle is decoupled from movable energy storage, the movable energy storage is taken as an independent unit, and a plurality of energy storage units are transported by the vehicle at the same time; obtaining typhoon data and geographic data, predicting the distribution of typhoon fields, establishing a comprehensive wind field model based on extremum distribution, and carrying out accurate wind speed prediction; determining failure probability of the distribution line by adopting a structural vulnerability model of a stress-intensity interference theory; generating a typical fault scene by adopting Monte Carlo sampling and an SBR algorithm; establishing a mobile energy storage access point optimization model taking the minimum load loss as an objective function through a fault scene; and determining the running time of each road section of the road network system through the traffic flow of the road network, and scheduling the mobile energy storage to an optimal position. The time expectation of accessing the network is minimum in all possible fault scenes by the mobile energy storage, so that the aim of minimizing the expected load loss in all fault scenes is fulfilled, and the power supply stability of the load is ensured.
assignees: HULUDAO ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Near-shore storm surge and typhoon wave forecasting method based on process and data dual driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a near-shore storm surge and typhoon wave forecasting method based on process and data dual driving, which comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source weather data, processing by adopting a multi-model self-adaptive integrated forecasting method to obtain high-precision weather forecasting data, processing by adopting a multi-dimensional characteristic typhoon path extraction and probability forecasting method based on the high-precision weather forecasting data to obtain probability typhoon path forecasting data, processing by adopting a physical constraint variation assimilation wind field correction method based on the probability typhoon path forecasting data to obtain corrected wind field data, processing by adopting a multi-grid wind-wave-current coupling model solving method based on the corrected wind field data to obtain near-shore storm surge and typhoon wave forecasting data, and calculating by adopting an integrated learning near-shore disaster forecasting and uncertainty quantification method to obtain a final forecasting result. The invention realizes the rapid and accurate prediction of the wind, wave, tide and flow of the important offshore areas during typhoons.

title_en: Power information physical system safety assessment method considering wind power and cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety evaluation method of an electric power information physical system considering wind power and cascading faults, which comprises the steps of constructing a mathematical model of the electric power information physical system, starting network attack aiming at the electric power information physical system, designing a wind power randomness model based on a Markov-Monte Carlo method after the cascading faults occur, acquiring active and reactive power injection of each node in the electric power system according to wind power at each cascading fault simulation moment, calculating voltage of each node and power transmission line trend in the electric power system by using an improved linearization alternating current power flow calculation method, updating running temperature of the power transmission line according to the power transmission line trend at each simulation moment, calculating the disconnection probability of the power transmission line, and providing cascading fault safety evaluation indexes considering output and load fluctuation of a wind turbine generator set simultaneously according to entropy theory, wherein the influence of the power transmission line disconnection on subsequent evolution of the cascading faults can be analyzed, and the dynamic safety of the system in the cascading fault process is evaluated.

title_en: Special equipment for intelligent analysis edge calculation of non-coal mine risk
abstract_en: The invention provides intelligent analysis edge computing special equipment for non-coal mine risk, which relates to the technical field of edge computing. The device comprises a data access module, a data exchange module, a data transmission module, a data storage module, an analysis processing module, an information alarm module and an information safety module, and intelligent analysis and edge early warning are carried out by collecting internet of things sensing, industrial production and video data through various protocols. And the high-bandwidth PCIE bus ensures efficient data exchange and processing by adopting a modularized design and a Linux operating system. The built-in safety isolation unit guarantees network isolation and data safety through optical unidirectional transmission, provides a Bayesian network logic reasoning and disaster occurrence probability calculation model, improves risk early warning and management capacity, and provides firm data support and guarantee for safety production of non-coal mine enterprises.
assignees: EMERGENCY MAN DEPARTMENT BIG DATA CENTER

title_en: Water-wind-solar complementary system cascade pre-flood energy storage risk analysis and control method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power system power generation scheduling, and discloses a method for analyzing and controlling energy storage risk before cascade flood of a water-wind-solar complementary system. The method comprises the steps of taking pre-flood energy storage as constraint, establishing a dead period hydro-fluctuation model and a flood period water storage scheduling rule to determine a simulation operation criterion, establishing a dead period electricity shortage, flood period water abandon, annual end energy storage shortage and wind-solar energy electricity abandon index set to quantify multi-stage multi-source operation risks, coupling Monte Carlo and fuzzy membership to represent a multi-dimensional uncertainty scene and probability thereof, and determining quantitative relation of complementary benefits, risk probability and risk loss of pre-flood energy storage and water-wind-solar energy by adopting simulation analysis. Through the example analysis of a water-wind-light complementary system of a certain oversized river basin, the result shows that the risk can be comprehensively described in terms of occurrence probability and loss, the verification result shows that the power generation amount of the system is increased by 5.8 hundred million kWh through the accurate description of the risk and the reasonable control of energy storage, and the risk loss is reduced by 42% on average, so that the method has good practicability.

title_en: Regional sluice system scheduling optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional sluice system scheduling optimization method and a regional sluice system scheduling optimization system, comprising the following steps: deep learning and graph neural network technology is adopted to perform multi-source heterogeneous data fusion and feature extraction, so as to realize multi-scale analysis of hydrodynamics features; generating an countermeasure network by using a dynamic Bayesian network and conditions, and generating a high-resolution hydrological scene set; constructing a multi-scale hydrodynamic model, and improving the accuracy and timeliness of the model by combining a self-adaptive grid technology and a data assimilation method; and (3) optimizing the sluice group cooperative scheduling by applying a deep reinforcement learning and game theory method to realize multi-objective intelligent scheduling. The method remarkably improves scientificity, efficiency and adaptability of sluice scheduling, and effectively balances flood control and disaster reduction, water resource utilization and ecological protection requirements.

title_en: Thunderstorm weather early warning method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of disaster event response alarm, in particular to a thunderstorm weather early warning method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting observation data information; determining a forecasting factor, wherein the forecasting factor at least comprises a quantized amplitude V  e , a quantized differential change rate ring ratio V  p  and a quantized Euclidean distance ratio V  f ; establishing condition expectations and acquiring an early warning threshold; executing a Monte Carlo test to obtain an optimal weight combination and an early warning threshold under the condition that the forecasting critical success index in the three-stage early warning is maximum; and executing early warning. According to the application, the lightning early warning is realized by adopting the ideas of sample selection, factor normalization processing, condition expected establishment and Monte Carlo test, the obvious contradiction between the prediction hit rate and the blank report rate exists by adopting the prior art limited to an assignment threshold method or a change rate threshold method, and the problem that the hit rate and the blank report rate are not balanced is rapidly and effectively solved.
assignees: JIANGSU METEOROLOGICAL DISASTER PREVENTION TECH CENTER

title_en: Method for predicting and analyzing stability of reservoir bank soil slope based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predicting and analyzing the stability of a reservoir bank soil slope based on a Bayesian network. The method comprises the steps of statistically analyzing influence factors of the stability of the bank slope, performing single factor sensitivity analysis on the counted influence factors, perfecting classification of disaster causing factors and the stability evaluation indexes of the bank soil slope, establishing a prediction evaluation index system, applying an improved interpretation structure model to determine ordering and interlayer directivity connection of the influence factors, improving a construction method of a Bayesian network structure, establishing a bank slope stability prediction model based on the Bayesian network, and performing the stability prediction and destabilization mechanism analysis of the bank soil slope based on causal reasoning and diagnosis reasoning functions of the Bayesian network model. The method can predict the stability of the bank slope, discover hidden danger in time, immediately take corresponding measures to treat, and provide technical support and safety guarantee for long-term safe operation of reservoirs and tailing reservoirs.
assignees: MCC WUKAN ENGINEERING TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Power infrastructure toughness assessment method considering multi-factor coupling influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power infrastructure toughness assessment method considering multi-factor coupling influence, which comprises the steps of calculating response result data corresponding to each preset index type based on seismic intensity historical data, processing the response result data according to a maximum correlation minimum redundancy algorithm, determining key influence factor types and secondary influence factor types from the preset index types, creating a plurality of power infrastructure seismic simulation events based on Monte Carlo simulation, respectively extracting first simulation data corresponding to the key influence factor types and second simulation data corresponding to the secondary influence factor types according to simulation results, correcting the response result data according to the first simulation data and the second simulation data to obtain corrected result data, and inputting the corrected result data into a preset assessment result calculation formula to obtain a power infrastructure toughness assessment result. According to the method, the coupling influence of a plurality of index types on the toughness evaluation of the electric power infrastructure is considered, so that the quantitative evaluation of the seismic toughness is realized.

title_en: Confidence calibration for systems with cascaded predictive models
abstract_en: In general, techniques are described that address the limitations of existing conformal prediction methods for cascaded models. In an example, a method includes receiving a first validation data set for validating performance of an upstream model of the two or more cascaded models and receiving a second validation data set for validating performance of a downstream model of the two or more cascaded models wherein the second validation data set is different than the first validation set; estimating system-level errors caused by predictions of the upstream model based on the first validation data set; estimating system-level errors caused by predictions of the downstream model based on the second validation data set; and generating a prediction confidence interval that indicates a confidence for the system based on the system-level errors caused by predictions of the upstream model and based on the system-level errors caused by predictions of the downstream model.

title_en: Fire disaster early warning device and fire extinguishing system for electrical power distribution cabinet
abstract_en: A fire early warning device and fire extinguishing system for electrical power distribution cabinet belongs to the alarm technical field. The fire disaster early warning device comprises a fire disaster recognition model which is trained through a Bayesian network, wherein the training process comprises the following steps of deducing the distribution of hidden variables Z through the parameters of the current time of the Bayesian network and the data vector of an ith training set, calculating the expectation of log likelihood about Z, acquiring the parameters of the Bayesian network at the next time t+1 according to the expectation, calculating the error of the data vector of the ith training set for training the Bayesian network, further updating the parameters of the Bayesian network according to the error, repeatedly executing the steps for training the Bayesian network, and verifying on a verification set until the stopping condition is reached, and completing the training of the Bayesian network to obtain the fire disaster recognition model. According to the invention, the Bayesian network is trained into the fire disaster recognition model through the observable variable and the hidden variable, so that the fire disaster recognition capability is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG ZHONGKEHUIJU TECH CO LTD;GUANGZHOU CHANGYING SAFETY EMERGENCY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire disaster treatment system and method applied to lithium battery energy storage power station of rail transit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire disaster treatment system and a fire disaster treatment method applied to a lithium battery energy storage power station of rail transit. The sensor collects temperature, smoke concentration, combustible gas concentration, humidity and other data in the power station in real time, the data are transmitted to the control module, and the control module performs probabilistic reasoning analysis on the real-time data according to the Bayesian network model to predict fire risks. The system starts the gas fire extinguishing device to spray perfluoro-hexanone for local inhibition at the initial stage of fire, and if the fire is enlarged, the system is switched to a high-pressure water mist system for large-area fire extinguishing. Meanwhile, the waste liquid treatment system is started, and waste liquid generated by fire extinguishment is collected, monitored and treated, so that the emission is ensured to meet the environmental protection standard. The invention has the advantages of accurate early warning, high fire extinguishing efficiency, environment-friendly waste liquid treatment and the like, and is particularly suitable for the safety protection of industrial energy storage power stations such as rail transit and the like.

title_en: Landslide risk evaluation method and system based on substation failure model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster risk research, in particular to a landslide risk evaluation method and system based on a transformer substation failure model. The method comprises the steps of carrying out detailed investigation on landslide of a transformer substation to obtain physical and mechanical properties of a rock-soil body, calculating seepage characteristics of the rock-soil body by using a rainfall infiltration hydrologic model, simulating landslide stability under different rainfall working conditions by using FLAC3D software, calculating annual instability probability by combining a Monte Carlo method, and calculating economic losses of the transformer substation under the working conditions by using a deformation damage model of various facilities in the transformer substation in the FLAC3D simulation landslide instability process to carry out fixed values on vulnerability of various facilities. The invention also comprises a corresponding system implementation. The method realizes comprehensive, quantitative and accurate assessment of landslide risk of the transformer substation by integrating geological investigation, hydrologic model, numerical simulation and statistical methods, provides scientific basis for security management of the power grid in the mountain area, and can be popularized and applied to risk assessment of other similar geological disasters.

title_en: Multifunctional calculation and analysis system and method for community toughness influence factors
abstract_en: The invention provides a multifunctional computing and analyzing system and method for community toughness influence factors, and belongs to the field of data analysis. The method adopts a decision laboratory analysis method to establish a Bayesian network structure model, and calculates the failure probability of each non-root node by introducing default nodes and using a Bayesian conditional probability formula. And acquiring a priori probability value of a community toughness BN network root node by using an expert questionnaire and a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, and finally, finding out a maximum cause chain for invalidating the community toughness by a reverse deduction function. In coordination with this approach, corresponding analysis systems have also evolved. The system has higher practicability and convenience, can quantitatively analyze the community toughness, can intuitively and intuitively understand the influence of each influence factor on the community toughness, and has important guiding significance for community disaster resistance planning and decision.
assignees: BEIJING ACADEMY OF SCIENCE AND TECH

title_en: Method and system for calcualting estimated probability of volcanic ash damage for social infrastructure
title_ko: 사회기반시설의 화산재 예상 피해율 산출 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a system for calculating a degree of volcanic ash vulnerability and a probability of occurrence for each damage state of infrastructure. According to the present invention, past volcanic eruption weather data indicating weather information for each date after a past volcanic eruption of volcanoes in/around the Korean peninsula is obtained from a weather database and past volcanic ash thickness data indicating a thickness of the accumulated volcanic ash during the past volcanic eruption and past infrastructure damage data indicating a degree of damage to the infrastructure due to the volcanic ash are obtained from a disaster database. A volcanic ash thickness range according to a damage step for each infrastructure is determined based on the obtained data. A probability distribution of a volcanic ash vulnerability and a volcanic ash concentration for each damage step for each infrastructure is calculated based on the determined volcanic ash thickness range according to the damage step for each infrastructure. An expected damage rate for each infrastructure due to the volcanic ash can be calculated based on the calculated volcanic ash vulnerability and the calculated probability distribution of the volcanic ash concentration.
abstract_ko: 사회기반시설의 손상상태 별 화산재 취약도 및 발생확률 산출 방법 및 시스템은 기상 데이터베이스로부터 한반도 및 한반도 주변 화산의 과거 화산폭발 이후 일자별 기상정보를 나타내는 과거 화산폭발기상 데이터를 획득하고, 재난 데이터베이스로부터 과거 화산폭발 시 누적된 화산재의 두께를 나타내는 과거 화산재 두께 데이터 및 화산재로 인하여 사회기반시설의 손상정도를 나타내는 과거 사회기반시설 손상 데이터를 획득하고, 획득된 데이터에 기초하여 사회기반시설 별 손상단계에 따른 화산재 두께 범위를 결정하고, 결정된 사회기반시설 별 손상단계에 따른 화산재 두께 범위에 기초하여 각 사회기반시설에 대하여 손상단계 별 화산재 취약도 및 화산재 농도의 확률 분포를 산출하고, 산출된 화산재 취약도 및 화산재 농도의 확률 분포에 기초하여 화산재로 인한 각 사회기반시설에 대한 예상 피해율을 산출할 수 있다.

title_en: Landslide hazard risk evaluation method and system based on transmission tower failure model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster risk evaluation research, in particular to a landslide disaster risk evaluation method and system based on a transmission tower failure model. The method comprises the steps of carrying out detailed investigation on a landslide area to obtain a deformation relation between a transmission tower and the ground surface, obtaining a deformation failure model and a mechanism of the transmission tower by utilizing FLAC3D and ANSYS numerical simulation software, calculating the annual instability probability of the landslide by adopting a FLAC3D-Monte Carlo method, establishing a vulnerability evaluation model of the transmission tower under the action of the landslide, and completing the landslide risk evaluation of the transmission tower based on a model of risk=risk×vulnerability×economic value. The invention also provides a corresponding risk evaluation system. According to the method, the transmission tower failure model is built, landslide deformation is associated with the tower failure, quantitative and fine assessment of the risk of the transmission tower in the landslide area is achieved, and a new technical means is provided for geological disaster risk management and control of power grid facilities in the mountain area.

title_en: Collapse geological disaster risk evaluation method and system for transformer substation structure damage model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster risk evaluation research, in particular to a collapse geological disaster risk evaluation method and system of a transformer substation structure damage model. The method comprises the steps of carrying out detailed investigation on a collapse dangerous rock body, evaluating stability by adopting a red flat projection graph method, calculating instability probability by adopting a Monte Carlo method, simulating a collapse dynamics process by utilizing FLAC3D and PFC3D coupling, completing dangerous evaluation by combining ArcGIS, establishing a substation electrical facility physical model and a structural damage model, establishing a vulnerability evaluation model based on collapse rock impact strength and electrical facility structural resistance, carrying out risk evaluation by adopting a matrix analysis method, and estimating economic loss. The invention also comprises a corresponding system implementation. According to the method, through combination of geological investigation, numerical simulation and structural analysis, comprehensive quantitative evaluation of the collapse disaster risk of the transformer substation is realized, the accuracy, reliability and pertinence of evaluation are improved, and scientific basis is provided for disaster prevention and reduction of the transformer substation in the mountain area.

title_en: Power distribution network power supply reliability assessment method considering distributed power supply
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power supply reliability assessment method of a power distribution network, which comprises the steps of identifying weak links of the power distribution network according to power outage information of an active power distribution network, establishing a distributed power output and load uncertainty model according to weak link data, establishing a power supply reliability model according to the distributed power output and load uncertainty model, dividing minimum areas of the power distribution network according to the power supply reliability model, dividing islands based on the minimum areas of the divided power distribution network and reducing loads to ensure stable operation of the islands, establishing an active power distribution network reliability assessment model based on sequential Monte Carlo simulation according to the divided islands, calculating annual average outage rate and annual average outage time of load points by using the active power distribution network reliability assessment model, and calculating power supply reliability indexes of a system.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ECONOMIC RES INST

title_en: Landslide event determining method and related device
abstract_en: The application provides a landslide event determining method and a related device, which are used for determining daily rainfall disaster causing probability in each region through a rainfall disaster causing probability model based on rainfall simulation data in a target time period, determining first landslide probability corresponding to each slope unit in each day based on the rainfall disaster causing probability and slope instability probability corresponding to each slope unit, randomly extracting in a [0,1] interval through a Monte Carlo method to obtain second landslide probability corresponding to each slope unit in each day, and determining that a landslide event occurs to each slope unit when the second landslide probability is smaller than or equal to the first landslide probability. According to the method, the possibility that each slope unit has a landslide in actual conditions can be considered through random extraction of the Monte Carlo method, so that whether the landslide occurs is determined without completely depending on the probability of the first landslide, and further whether a result of a landslide event occurs in a certain slope unit is determined to be more in line with the actual conditions, and the result is more accurate.
assignees: CHINA REINSURANCE GROUP CORP;CHINA REINSURANCE GROUP CATASTRIAL RISK MAN CO LTD

title_en: Satellite operation risk quantitative evaluation model construction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a satellite operation risk quantification evaluation model construction method which comprises the steps of constructing an event tree model of a satellite, constructing a fault tree of the satellite, converting the satellite fault tree model into a satellite operation risk quantification evaluation model by using a Bayesian network modeling tool according to the serial-parallel connection relation of events in the fault tree model of the satellite, setting the states of all nodes in the satellite operation risk quantification evaluation model according to the single-machine on-orbit fault type and the cascade relation of the nodes in the satellite operation risk quantification evaluation model, and setting a condition probability table according to the serial-parallel connection logic relation of the nodes with connection relation according to the AND gate or OR gate relation of each event in the fault tree model of the satellite.

title_en: New energy vehicle underground garage fire disaster treatment method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy vehicle underground garage fire disaster treatment method and system based on the Internet of things, the system comprises a sensor data acquisition module, an edge calculation and risk assessment module, an early warning and emergency response module and a data storage and cloud platform module. The sensor is arranged at a parking space, a ventilation system and the like in the garage, monitors environmental parameters such as temperature, smoke, gas and the like in real time, and transmits data to the edge computing equipment through the wireless gateway. And the edge calculation module is used for evaluating the fire risk by combining the fuzzy Bayesian network. The early warning and emergency response module triggers alarm signals of different levels according to the risk level and controls equipment such as ventilation, fire fighting and the like in parallel. The data storage module is used for storing the monitoring data. The system has the advantages of real-time monitoring, intelligent evaluation, multi-stage early warning and quick response, is suitable for fire prevention and safety management of closed environments such as underground garages, and effectively improves the accuracy of fire risk prediction and the efficiency of emergency response.

title_en: Power distribution network operation safety risk assessment method considering typhoon and storm composite disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network operation safety risk assessment method considering typhoon and storm composite disasters, which comprises the following steps of generating different typhoon paths as main scenes based on typhoon and storm disaster forecast data, giving weights to the main scenes according to occurrence probability, calculating corrected wind speeds according to the influence of micro-topography and rainfall intensity on wind speeds V (r) in the main scenes, calculating total failure probability of a power distribution line between nodes i and j according to failure probability of the power distribution line between the nodes i and j and failure probability caused by a foreign matter hanging wire, calculating failure probability of power distribution equipment according to water accumulation amount in a power distribution network area, simulating and generating N fault scenes S to form a fault scene set S by using a Monte Carlo method, giving weights to the fault scenes, constructing a risk assessment model by taking the minimum expected total loss load amount under all the fault scenes as an objective function, and solving the risk assessment model by combining constraint conditions.

title_en: Sea level rising influence risk assessment method, medium and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a sea level rising influence risk assessment method, medium and system, which belong to the technical field of risk prediction assessment and comprise the steps of firstly, analyzing historical sea level data through wavelet decomposition and ARIMA model and predicting future change trend. Meanwhile, a digital elevation model is established by utilizing the Kriging interpolation, and the dynamic change of the terrain is described by combining the real-time monitoring data. Then, the key infrastructure and influencing factors are identified by using an analytic hierarchy process and principal component analysis, and key features are extracted through singular value decomposition. Based on singular value decomposition results, a sensitivity and vulnerability matrix is constructed, and the regional vulnerability is comprehensively evaluated by combining Monte Carlo simulation calculation exposure. Further, predicting asset loss by using a random forest algorithm, calculating economic loss, and establishing an ecological vulnerability index matrix to evaluate ecological influence. And finally, adopting fuzzy comprehensive evaluation of an entropy weight method and a risk prediction model supporting vector regression to realize quantitative risk evaluation.
assignees: THIRD GEOLOGICAL GROUP OF SHANDONG PROVINCIAL BUREAU OF GEOLOGY AND MINERAL EXPLORATION AND DEVELOPM;SHANDONG MARINE FORECAST AND HAZARD MITIGATION CENTER

title_en: Disaster risk early warning method and system based on big data model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster early warning and risk management, and discloses a disaster risk early warning method based on a big data model, which comprises the following steps of S1, data acquisition, namely acquiring environmental data and social data through a sensor and Internet of things equipment; S2, calculating risks, namely calculating an environmental risk index according to the environmental data and calculating a social activity risk index according to the social data, and a disaster risk early warning system based on a big data model, wherein the disaster risk early warning system comprises a data acquisition module and a data acquisition module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for collecting the environmental data and the social data through a sensor and Internet of things equipment. By constructing a social-environment interaction risk model, introducing a risk chain conduction mechanism and intervention measures, dynamically evaluating a disaster risk propagation process, simulating various disaster scenes and calculating emergency response time, and optimizing emergency resource deployment, disaster expansion is effectively predicted, loss is reduced, and accuracy and efficiency of emergency response are improved.

title_en: Method and system for estimating volcanic ash vulnerability and occurrence probability for each damage state of social infrastructure
title_ko: 사회기반시설의 손상상태 별 화산재 취약도 및 발생확률 산출 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: A method and a system for calculating a degree of volcanic ash vulnerability and a probability of occurrence for each damaged state of infrastructure acquire past volcanic eruption weather data indicating weather information for each date after a past volcanic eruption of volcanoes around the korean peninsula and the korean peninsula from a weather database, acquire past volcanic ash thickness data indicating a thickness of the accumulated volcanic ash during the past volcanic eruption from a disaster database, and past infrastructure damage data indicating a degree of damage to the infrastructure due to the volcanic ash, determine a volcanic ash thickness range according to a damage step for each infrastructure based on the acquired data, and calculate a degree of volcanic ash vulnerability and a probability of occurrence for each damage step for each infrastructure based on the determined volcanic ash thickness range according to the damage step for each infrastructure, thereby predicting damage to each infrastructure expected during the volcanic eruption, and establishing a specific countermeasure for each infrastructure during the volcanic eruption.
abstract_ko: 사회기반시설의 손상상태 별 화산재 취약도 및 발생확률 산출 방법 및 시스템은 기상 데이터베이스로부터 한반도 및 한반도 주변 화산의 과거 화산폭발 이후 일자별 기상정보를 나타내는 과거 화산폭발기상 데이터를 획득하고, 재난 데이터베이스로부터 과거 화산폭발 시 누적된 화산재의 두께를 나타내는 과거 화산재 두께 데이터 및 화산재로 인하여 사회기반시설의 손상정도를 나타내는 과거 사회기반시설 손상 데이터를 획득하고, 획득된 데이터에 기초하여 사회기반시설 별 손상단계에 따른 화산재 두께 범위를 결정하고, 결정된 사회기반시설 별 손상단계에 따른 화산재 두께 범위에 기초하여 각 사회기반시설에 대하여 손상단계 별 화산재 취약도 및 발생확률을 산출함으로써, 화산 폭발 시 예상되는 각 사회기반시설에 대한 피해를 예상할 수 있으며, 화산 폭발 시 각 사회기반시설에 대한 구체적인 대응방안을 구축할 수 있다.

title_en: Novel power system adequacy assessment method considering non-disaster extreme weather influence
abstract_en: The invention relates to a novel power system adequacy assessment method considering non-disaster extreme weather influence, belongs to the technical field of power dispatching, and solves the problems of inaccurate assessment of the existing adequacy and low utilization rate of new energy. The method comprises the steps of obtaining wind and light output predicted values, load predicted values, occurrence probability of extreme weather and resource supply rate of the extreme weather in a period to be evaluated, obtaining wind and light power generation states in each moment in the period to be evaluated by adopting a Monte Carlo sampling method according to the occurrence probability of the extreme weather and the resource supply rate of the extreme weather, constructing a adequacy evaluation model taking the operation and punishment cost of a novel power system as an objective function according to the wind and light output predicted values, the load predicted values, the wind and light power generation states and the operation state of a coal-fired unit in each moment in the period to be evaluated, and obtaining the adequacy evaluation result of the period to be evaluated by solving the adequacy evaluation model. Accurate long-term adequacy assessment is realized, and the new energy utilization rate is improved.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;STATE GRID ENERGY RES INST CO LTD;ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Multi-time-scale operation scheduling method for power grid considering pumping storage and step hydropower
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems and discloses a power grid multi-time scale operation scheduling method considering pumping storage and cascade hydropower, which comprises the following steps of S1, deducing bidirectional coupling relations of different time scales by considering the characteristics of a pumped storage multi-basin cascade hydropower station; the method comprises the steps of S2, constructing a annual scheduling model, a pericycle scheduling model and a daily scheduling model, S3, establishing a robust optimal scheduling strategy based on a confidence interval, and S4, outputting a scheduling scheme through the robust optimal scheduling strategy of the confidence interval. The invention has the advantages that each index of the long time scale plan and the short time scale plan can be considered, the two-way coupling relation of different time scales is considered, and simultaneously, the peak regulation requirements in the week and the day are ensured, so that the multiple targets of power supply protection, consumption protection and economy are achieved.
assignees: CHANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;SICHUAN ENERGY INTERNET RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF TSINGHUA UNIV

title_en: Fine monitoring and dynamic early warning method for mine dynamic disasters without scale effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine dynamic disaster fine monitoring and dynamic early warning method without scale effect, which comprises the following steps of setting a multipoint microseismic monitoring network on a coal mine working face, continuously collecting and preprocessing microseismic signals; the method comprises the steps of adopting an innovative analytic positioning algorithm to accurately analyze accurate position and time information of a micro-seismic source, innovatively applying a four-dimensional combined nuclear density estimation and confidence interval theory by combining signal characteristics and positioning data, constructing a rock burst risk assessment model, establishing a risk level classification standard, and calculating a risk index in real time and dynamically issuing early warning by a system. The method and the device remarkably improve the precision, timeliness and reliability of mining area dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning, and provide key technical support for coal mine safety production.

title_en: Collapse geological disaster vulnerability model and risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collapse geological disaster vulnerability model and a risk assessment method and system, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster risk assessment, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting target rock mass information and preprocessing; the method comprises the steps of collecting monitoring data and long-term rainfall data of a triaxial acceleration sensor, analyzing acceleration fluctuation characteristics, combining the rainfall data to identify the risk of rock mass instability, quantifying the risk of rock mass instability based on a Monte Carlo method, predicting the movement path and the accumulation range of collapse rocks by utilizing numerical simulation, evaluating the threat of the collapse rocks to peripheral electric facilities, and carrying out hierarchical management on the peripheral area of a transformer substation through a risk level model. The invention adopts the technologies of real-time monitoring, probability calculation and numerical simulation, and solves the problems of lack of dynamic monitoring, accurate evaluation and hierarchical protection of electric power facilities in the prior art. The whole scheme realizes real-time and automatic monitoring and risk grading of collapse geological disasters, and effectively improves the safety and reliability of electric power facilities under disaster conditions.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating influence of unplanned shutdown of unit on power supply guarantee
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a method and a system for evaluating the influence of unplanned outage of units on power supply guarantee, wherein the method comprises the steps of calculating the unplanned outage probability of each unit by adopting a Bayesian network based on the condition probability of unplanned outage of each unit under the condition of occurrence of each influence factor and the prior probability of occurrence of each influence factor, constructing a power supply reliability evaluation model according to the unplanned outage probability, sampling and simulating the system state, acquiring a reliability index by counting and accumulating each running state of a system, setting disturbance variables of unplanned outage parameters of the units based on the power supply reliability evaluation model, calculating the reliability index change of each node and the whole system when the unplanned outage parameters of the units slightly disturb the original value, obtaining the sensitivity of the unplanned outage probability of the nodes and the system to the power supply guarantee, and quantitatively sequencing the influence of each unit on the power supply guarantee by the sensitivity.
assignees: STATE GRID ENERGY RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Emergency material reserve dynamic optimization method and system based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency management, in particular to an emergency material reserve dynamic optimization method and system based on reinforcement learning, wherein emergency material demand prediction results are obtained through a machine learning algorithm according to disaster scene data and emergency material consumption data of a target electric power facility area; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a risk probability distribution of emergency material reserves based on emergency material demand prediction results through quantification by using a Monte Carlo simulation method, constructing a digital twin model of the emergency material reserves according to the risk probability distribution and multidimensional real-time state information of an emergency material reserve system, introducing a reinforcement learning algorithm into the digital twin model of the emergency material reserves, and obtaining an optimal emergency material reserve strategy through interactive learning. The invention combines the methods of digital twin technology, reinforcement learning algorithm and the like to improve the accuracy and efficiency of emergency material reserve, and can rapidly and accurately provide the required emergency materials, thereby remarkably improving the emergency response capability.
assignees: MAT BRANCH OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Highway construction safety monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a highway construction safety monitoring system and method, and belongs to the technical field of highway construction. The method comprises the steps of 1, collecting construction site data in real time, including environment data, video data and construction management data, 2, generating global situation awareness data, 3, evaluating safety risk probability and severity in real time, predicting a risk propagation path and a cascading effect, 4, generating a plurality of risk treatment schemes for sorting and screening, selecting optimal treatment suggestions, 5, realizing accurate early warning and differentiated management, reducing false alarm rate, finding high risk events in time, 6, displaying construction site data and risk evaluation results through three-dimensional reconstruction, superposing the construction site data and risk evaluation results, and providing mobile terminal remote monitoring and emergency command.

title_en: Method and apparatus for risk assessment of Offshore Wind Turbines Suction Bucket foundation subject to multi-hazard events
title_ko: 해상풍력터빈 석션버켓 지지구조물의 복합 위험도 평가 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and an apparatus for evaluating a complex risk of an offshore wind turbine suction bucket support structure. The method comprises the steps of: modeling an offshore wind turbine structure and the ground, and then defining an environmental load based on at least one of wind speed, wave load, and tidal speed; calculating a scour vulnerability based on a scour occurrence probability; calculating an earthquake occurrence probability from an earthquake disaster model from a PGA perspective and then calculating an earthquake vulnerability based on the earthquake occurrence probability; and calculating a complex risk by combining the scour occurrence probability, the scour vulnerability, the earthquake occurrence probability, and the earthquake vulnerability.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 해상풍력터빈 석션버켓 지지구조물의 복합 위험도 평가 방법 및 장치에 관한 것으로, 이는 해상 풍력 터빈 구조물과 지반을 모델링한 후, 풍속, 파랑하중, 조류속 중 적어도 하나에 기반한 환경하중을 정의하는 단계; 세굴 발생 확률에 기반하여 세굴 취약도를 계산하는 단계; PGA 관점의 지진 재해도 모델로부터 지진 발생 확률을 산출한 후, 지진 발생 확률에 기반하여 지진 취약도를 계산하는 단계; 및 세굴 발생 확률, 세굴 취약도, 지진 발생 확률 및 지진 취약도를 결합하여 복합 위험도를 산출하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Cross interconnection cable fault diagnosis method and system based on improved Bayesian optimization XGBoost
abstract_en: The invention provides a cross interconnection cable fault diagnosis method and system based on improved Bayesian optimization XGBoost, and aims to solve the problems of insufficient precision and low efficiency of the existing cable fault detection method in a complex environment. Firstly, a Bayesian optimization algorithm is improved, a Ma Du kernel function and a square index kernel function are multiplied and compounded to serve as a kernel function in a Gaussian process in a priori function, the improved Markov chain Monte Carlo method is utilized for optimizing parameters of the kernel function, and secondly, for an acquisition function, adjusting parameters in a traditional confidence boundary strategy are improved. Finally, the super parameters of XGBoost are intelligently searched and optimized by utilizing an improved Bayesian optimization algorithm, so that the prediction performance and generalization capability of the model are effectively improved, and the high-efficiency and accurate diagnosis of the faults of the cross interconnection cables is realized. The implementation of the invention is beneficial to improving the automation level of cable fault treatment, reducing the operation and maintenance cost and having important practical application value and popularization prospect.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Elastic power distribution network planning method based on wind-solar-energy-storage combined output
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power distribution network planning, and particularly relates to an elastic power distribution network planning method based on wind-solar-energy-storage combined output, which comprises the steps of S1, establishing a power distribution network fault rate model, S2, establishing and selecting a typical disaster scene, establishing and screening the typical disaster scene by combining a Monte Carlo simulation method with information entropy, S3, establishing an elastic power distribution network planning configuration model based on the disaster scene, establishing a power distribution network planning model under the disaster scene by combining elements such as wind power generation, photovoltaic power generation, a micro gas turbine and energy storage, S4, solving the planning model by adopting an NSGA-II algorithm, and obtaining an optimal configuration result of the power distribution network.
assignees: NANYANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Satellite internet-based power transmission corridor mountain fire spread prediction and risk assessment method and related device
abstract_en: The invention provides a satellite internet-based power transmission corridor mountain fire spread prediction and risk assessment method and a related device, and relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and early warning of power systems. The method comprises the steps of constructing a fire risk factor database based on multi-mode data of a star-ground fusion network mode, screening out key factors by using a random forest algorithm, determining fire risk contribution degrees corresponding to the key factors, extracting similar characteristics of a neighborhood of a power transmission corridor based on electric mountain fire hidden danger factors, dividing subregions by using a clustering algorithm, constructing a fire risk weighted scoring model to identify high, medium and low risk regions, constructing a mountain fire spreading model based on meteorological observation data driving, establishing a fire risk state transfer matrix, predicting a fire spreading path in real time by combining a dynamic Bayesian network, evaluating damage risk of mountain fire to a power transmission line, and generating a damage risk grading graph of the power transmission corridor. The technical effects of dynamic evaluation of forest fire risks and accurate prediction of spreading trends are achieved.

title_en: Typhoon disaster chain risk assessment method and device, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon disaster chain risk assessment method, a device, terminal equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method firstly carries out weight analysis on risk assessment indexes corresponding to various data in acquired typhoon disaster chain risk assessment data sets to obtain weight values of the risk assessment indexes; then, according to the weight value of each risk assessment index, the prior probability of the node in the pre-constructed Bayesian network is adjusted to obtain an adjusted Bayesian network; and finally, inputting the typhoon disaster chain risk assessment data set into the regulated Bayesian network, so that the regulated Bayesian network outputs the typhoon disaster chain risk grade of the region to be assessed. Therefore, by implementing the method and the device, the risk level of the typhoon disaster chain in different areas can be effectively evaluated, and the universality is high.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Real-time monitoring-based natural disaster early warning and responding method and device for electric power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a real-time monitoring-based power system natural disaster early warning and responding method, which relates to the technical field of power early warning response and comprises the following steps of data analysis and processing, wherein the data analysis and processing utilizes a long-short-period memory network to combine with a Bayesian network to analyze and process real-time monitoring data in a power system, a scheduling scheme is generated, the state of the power system is updated in real time and an optimal scheduling scheme is generated based on a multi-source data fusion and optimization method combining a Kalman filter and a genetic algorithm, an emergency response strategy is generated, the influence of a natural disaster on the power system is simulated in real time in a virtual model through a digital twin technology and a self-adaptive dynamic programming method, and an emergency response strategy is provided, and anomaly detection and self-healing are performed by combining big data analysis with edge calculation to perform anomaly detection and self-healing on the running state of the power system.
assignees: TIELING POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Intelligent charging infrastructure station optimization operation method and system considering station network interaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent charging infrastructure station optimizing operation method considering station network interaction, which comprises the following steps: and simulating the charging load of the electric automobile by adopting Monte Carlo sampling, establishing probability density functions of the initial charging time, the daily driving mileage and the expected charging time of a user, and calculating the shortest charging time. And modeling photovoltaic, energy storage, electric vehicles and flexible load resources in the light storage and charging station. And (3) considering the interaction requirement of the station network, and establishing an optical storage charging station-electric automobile user master-slave game optimization scheduling model. According to the invention, the bidirectional interaction characteristic of the power grid and the optical storage charging station is considered, the optical storage charging station can timely send electric energy to the power grid in a reverse mode, the phenomenon of peak-to-peak adding of the power grid can be weakened, and the regulation and control of the optical storage charging station on the flexible charging load are further increased.
assignees: CHANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Post-disaster risk assessment method for power distribution network considering natural disaster space-time evolution model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster risk assessment method of a power distribution network taking a natural disaster space-time evolution model into consideration, which comprises the steps of 1, taking account of causes and influence factors of various natural disaster space-time evolutions, carrying out natural disaster space-time correlation modeling, 2, providing a method for calculating the fault probability of power distribution network equipment based on the natural disaster space-time correlation model, 3, providing a power distribution network disaster risk assessment method, sampling equipment states by using a non-time sequence Monte Carlo method, simulating the operation conditions of the power distribution network equipment under the influence of various natural disasters, and 4, establishing a power distribution network disaster risk assessment system from the aspects of reliability and safety and calculating each risk index value. The method and the system can accurately evaluate the post-disaster risk of the power distribution network under the influence of various natural disasters, thereby accelerating the post-disaster recovery of the power distribution network.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Toughness assessment and toughness improvement method for distribution information physical system under disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating and improving toughness of a distribution information physical system under disasters, and belongs to the field of cooperative regulation and control and optimized operation of power systems. The method comprises the steps of randomly generating a damage scene of an urban power grid under disasters through Monte Carlo simulation sampling, establishing a multi-period dynamic joint toughness evaluation model of a power distribution network information physical system based on a scene basis, introducing toughness evaluation indexes to evaluate the toughness of the power grid, taking the recovery requirements of power network loads and communication system resources into consideration, carrying out strategy optimization by utilizing resources such as a distributed unit, energy storage equipment and the like in the power distribution network and cooperating with a mobile emergency power supply and a mobile communication vehicle, evaluating the toughness of the power distribution network information physical system under different configurations, and solving the optimal toughness improvement strategy of the power distribution network information physical system. By establishing a multi-period toughness evaluation model of the power distribution network in an extreme disaster scene and combining various resource configurations, the improvement of the toughness of the power distribution network is promoted on the basis of considering the coupling of the information network, and the method has higher application value.

title_en: Dynamic analysis method for typhoon disaster chain of power distribution network based on dynamic Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power distribution network fault analysis, and relates to a dynamic analysis method of a power distribution network typhoon disaster chain based on a dynamic Bayesian network, which comprises the steps of carding typhoon disaster mechanisms according to historical disaster events to form a typhoon disaster chain; the method comprises the steps of establishing a probability model of typhoon, establishing a space-time distribution model of typhoon wind speed, establishing a space-time distribution model of typhoon rainfall, establishing an element failure rate model, analyzing dynamic evolution characteristics of a typhoon disaster chain by utilizing a dynamic Bayesian network, combining the influence of secondary disasters of storm in the typhoon disaster chain on element failures of a power distribution network, widening the application range of the element failure rate calculation of the power distribution network in a real scene under the typhoon disaster, adopting an empirical model and a fuzzy model to replace mechanical calculation, enabling the operation to be more convenient and the application potential to be improved, adopting the dynamic Bayesian network to replace a static Bayesian network, and being beneficial to capturing key elements of the dynamic evolution of the typhoon disaster chain in time sequence.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;State grid hunan electric power co ltd;ECONOMIC TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Strong typhoon wind speed and wind direction joint probability distribution generation method based on Monte Carlo Markov chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a strong typhoon wind speed and wind direction joint probability distribution generation method based on a Monte Carlo Markov chain, which comprises the steps of firstly realizing simulation of typhoon wind field values through a Emanuel typhoon radial section model and a near-surface typhoon wind speed conversion method, as well as an average wind vertical section model and a pulsating wind model, then carrying out random simulation on a typhoon process by using a typhoon overall process random simulation method, analyzing simulation results, calculating typhoon positions of the next moment step, carrying out probability distribution calculation on the typhoon wind field on the basis of the simulation results to obtain wind speed extreme values and wind directions, and finally adopting a two-dimensional Gaussian non-parametric kernel density estimation method to construct a strong typhoon wind speed and wind direction joint probability model. The invention combines the typhoon process random simulation result and the typhoon wind field simulation method, provides a more scientific and practical solution for wind resistance evaluation of the engineering structure, and provides key data support for typhoon disaster vulnerability analysis of the engineering structure.
assignees: RES INST ECONOMICS & TECH STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power system risk assessment method in extreme weather scene based on hybrid simulation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a power system risk assessment method based on hybrid simulation in an extreme weather scene, and belongs to the field of power system risk assessment. The evaluation method comprises the steps of obtaining power grid data and extreme weather scene data, modeling according to the obtained extreme weather scene data, constructing a fault model of a line in an extreme weather scene to calculate the fault probability of the line, and calculating a risk index of the power system based on Monte Carlo simulation and the fault probability of the corresponding line. The assessment method can integrate various extreme weather factors, characterize initial faults and cascading failure dynamic evolution characteristics so as to support planning and operation decisions of the power grid.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digitization method of urban security risk assessment standard
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digitizing method of urban security risk assessment standards, which comprises the steps of identifying risk factors for historical accident time sequence data, carrying out relevance analysis to obtain a relevance function, further constructing an urban network topology structure, determining prior probability of nodes according to similarity of the nodes and pre-disaster data, generating a simulated accident scene, adding disturbance items to simulate burst risks, combining the prior probability of the nodes to obtain a risk propagation path, constructing a risk assessment model, assessing space-time influence ranges of the nodes on the propagation path, and carrying out weighted summation on assessment results of the nodes to obtain an urban security risk assessment result. The method is used for constructing the network topology structure by multi-stage analysis of the historical accident data, so that the risk propagation simulation is more accurate, the urban risk assessment can be accurately quantized, and meanwhile, the method has better interpretability.

title_en: Extreme weather prediction method based on typical weather year
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of weather prediction, in particular to an extreme weather prediction method based on a typical weather year, which comprises the steps of firstly, constructing a typical weather year data set, combining ground, analysis and satellite data, and generating high-quality weather data through interpolation and fusion technologies; the method comprises the steps of generating the enhancement data of the countermeasure network, solving the problem of insufficient extreme event samples, extracting key meteorological variables through super-resolution and feature dimension reduction, constructing a deep learning model based on a convolutional neural network and a long-term and short-term memory network to conduct multi-task prediction, introducing physical constraint rules such as energy conservation and mass conservation to ensure that the prediction accords with the meteorological rules, generating confidence intervals of prediction results through an uncertainty quantization technology, and providing risk assessment and decision support information. The method improves the accuracy and the reliability of the extreme weather event prediction, and supports disaster prevention and reduction, resource scheduling, agricultural production and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST

title_en: Dam safety monitoring system and method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dam safety monitoring system and method based on digital twinning, which belong to the technical field of data processing, and comprise the steps of acquiring acoustic emission signals of the surface of a dam and internal infrared thermal image data in real time through a multi-source sensor to generate a multidimensional damage characteristic matrix; the method comprises the steps of constructing a disaster node topological network by combining density peak value clustering and dynamic weight, calculating and improving Monte Carlo simulation based on gravitational field intensity, accurately predicting a damage chain reaction path, generating a dynamic risk thermodynamic diagram through space-time folding mapping and a bidirectional diffraction equation, extracting hidden danger indexes by adopting multi-axis domain feature distillation, dynamically comparing safety envelope functions, and generating a flood discharge scheduling and reinforcing scheme on line. The invention adopts the cross-modal fusion, the gravitational field dynamic topological network and the space-time folding mapping technology, can realize the accurate simulation of the damage energy conduction path, the carbonization-deformation bidirectional coupling prediction and the deep fusion of the intelligent treatment decision of the risk hidden danger, and improves the accuracy and the initiative of the dam safety pre-warning.
assignees: JIANGXI PROVINCE WATER CONSERVANCY ACADEMY JIANGXI PROVINCE DAM SAFETY MAN CENTER JIANGXI WATER RESO

title_en: Power distribution system recovery method and device under rainstorm waterlogging disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power distribution network fault handling and reliability research, in particular to a power distribution system recovery method and device under a storm waterlogging disaster, comprising the steps of generating a typical scene during the storm waterlogging disaster by adopting a Monte Carlo method based on a power distribution network equipment failure probability function during the occurrence of the storm waterlogging disaster; the method comprises the steps of solving a power distribution network reconstruction optimization model under a typical scene of a storm waterlogging disaster occurrence period to obtain a switch optimization result of the storm waterlogging disaster occurrence period, carrying out power distribution network reconstruction by utilizing the switch optimization result, solving a power distribution network fault recovery model after the storm waterlogging disaster is over to obtain a mobile emergency energy storage device dispatching result, carrying out power distribution network restoration after the storm waterlogging disaster by utilizing the mobile emergency energy storage device dispatching result, and obviously improving the recovery capability of a system, and particularly showing unique advantages in a complex scene of serious traffic disaster.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for evaluating power grid damage under composite chain disaster
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, equipment and a medium for evaluating power grid damage under a composite chain disaster, which comprise the steps of establishing a power grid physical model, establishing a composite chain disaster evolution model based on a Bayesian network according to sensor data, meteorological data, geographic information data and historical disaster data, integrating historical earthquake records and the power grid physical model, evaluating the power grid damage probability caused by a single disaster, evaluating the power grid joint damage probability caused by the composite disaster based on a Copula function and the composite chain disaster evolution model, and evaluating the power grid damage probability caused by the composite chain disaster as the difference between the power grid damage probability caused by the single disaster and the power grid joint damage probability sum caused by the composite disaster. According to the method provided by the application, the power grid damage under the composite chain disaster is evaluated through the power grid damage probability caused by the single disaster and the power grid joint damage probability caused by the composite disaster, so that the accurate and rapid evaluation of the power grid damage under the composite chain disaster is realized.

title_en: Power grid assessment method based on extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid assessment method based on extreme weather, which comprises the following steps of taking typhoon as a representative event, firstly comprehensively considering wind speed characteristics and electric pole running states when typhoon logs in, building a power distribution network electric pole fault correction model under typhoon disaster conditions according to the relation between electric pole load and electric pole bending strength, further providing a load shedding risk index reflecting power supply capacity after power distribution network faults, calculating the load shedding risk when typhoon disasters happen by using a Monte Carlo state sampling method, and finally verifying the effectiveness of the method by using an IEEE33 system calculation example. The power grid risk assessment method based on the time sequence Monte Carlo simulation method has the advantages that the risk of the power grid under typhoon disasters can be reasonably assessed, and the safe operation level of the power distribution network is improved through risk early warning.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO;UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH

title_en: Dynamic scheduling method, system and readable storage medium for power disaster relief and repair
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power disaster relief and repair scheduling, in particular to a power disaster relief and repair dynamic scheduling method, a power disaster relief and repair dynamic scheduling system and a readable storage medium. The method comprises the steps of S1, S2, S3, S4, calculating an optimal repair strategy, wherein the dynamic network topology model G of a disaster relief scene is built, the dynamic power recovery model GP is built, the first-aid repair dynamic decision model is built through an objective function, the optimal repair strategy is calculated according to the latest dynamic network topology model G, the power recovery model GP and the current position of an electric facility node of a rescue team, and the optimal repair strategy is obtained by solving the current position of the electric facility node based on a Monte Carlo tree search algorithm. The method considers that the situation of the disaster relief site can change dynamically, and the emergency repair strategy is adjusted dynamically according to the changing situation of the site.
assignees: HUBEI CENTRAL CHINA TECH DEVELOPMENT OF ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Garden insect disaster prediction optimization method based on ecological model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a garden insect disaster prediction optimization method based on an ecological model. The technical scheme includes that garden ecological factors are divided into climate driving factors, plant health factors and insect pest biological factors according to biological levels, environmental levels and spatial levels, causality modeling is conducted on interaction relation among the factors, dynamic Bayesian network analysis ecological factors are introduced to identify potential insect disaster high risk trigger points, a Sobol sensitivity analysis method is used to identify key driving factors, decision basis is provided for model optimization, an environment pressure index including drought and illumination intensity fluctuation of an ecological system and a response relation of insect pest population dynamics are defined, a nonlinear response equation is built, an improved Lotka-Volterra model is fused, the environment pressure coefficient is added, expansion characteristics of the insect pest population under various ecological pressures are simulated, and meanwhile influence of long-term climate trend and short-term weather fluctuation on insect disaster is captured.
assignees: ANYANG GARDEN GREENING SCIENT RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Urban power grid viability assessment method and device considering main-distribution coordination
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for evaluating the viability of an urban power grid considering main and auxiliary coordination, and relates to the technical field of power grid viability evaluation. The method comprises the steps of simulating a damaged scene of a power grid by adopting a Monte Carlo algorithm, constructing a first main network scheduling model and a first distribution network scheduling model before a target disaster occurs, calculating a first evaluation index, constructing each second distribution network scheduling model and a first distribution network foldback scheduling model under each load node in the target disaster, calculating corresponding net load demands, constructing a second main network scheduling model, calculating a second evaluation index, constructing each distribution network recovery model and a second distribution network foldback scheduling model under each load node after the target disaster occurs, calculating corresponding distribution network total load demands, constructing a third main network scheduling model, calculating a third evaluation index, and evaluating the survival capability of the target urban power grid according to the three evaluation indexes. The application can improve the evaluation accuracy of the survivability of the urban power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power network dynamic toughness assessment method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a dynamic toughness assessment method, a device, equipment and a storage medium of an electric power network, wherein the method comprises the steps of splicing a storm disaster Bayesian network model, a flood disaster Bayesian network model and a waterlogging disaster Bayesian network model to obtain a storm-flood-waterlogging disaster space-time evolution Bayesian network model; according to the probability that the storm disaster, the flood disaster and the waterlogging disaster are damaged respectively by the space-time evolution Bayesian network model and the electric power facilities, the electric power network line damage evolution scene and the recovery scheme under the electric power network damage evolution scene are obtained, the electric power network dynamic toughness assessment is carried out based on the electric power network line damage evolution scene and the recovery scheme under the electric power network damage evolution scene, and theoretical support is provided for improving the electric power network toughness and reducing the disaster influence.

title_en: Fire monitoring and predicting method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire monitoring and predicting method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning, and belongs to the field of artificial intelligence and disaster prevention and control. The method is based on intelligent means to detect fire early, monitor in real time, accurately predict and respond rapidly, comprises calculation and evaluation of multiple indexes such as fire risk, fire spread, fire hazard, environmental influence factors and emergency response, and adopts a reinforcement learning method such as deep Q learning, monte Carlo tree search, strategy gradient method, actor-evaluator framework and double DQN network to improve coverage, response speed and prediction capability of fire monitoring. The method utilizes the combination of multiple agents to carry out intelligent risk assessment and spread prediction on the fire, effectively improves the efficiency and accuracy of fire prevention and control, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Searching method for determining double-critical sliding surface of side slope of heterogeneous soil layer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a search method for determining a double-critical sliding surface of a side slope of a heterogeneous soil layer. The method utilizes Monte Carlo random simulation to combine with genetic algorithm to generate and screen parameter samples, and determines optimal parameter set assignment to a model through multi-index similarity function. Two groups of sliding surface candidate sets are synchronously generated based on an improved NSGA-II algorithm, a collaborative safety coefficient is constructed by combining a strength folding method and an energy method, and the mechanical response of a side slope is comprehensively considered. And solving failure probability through Monte Carlo simulation, and judging the double-critical sliding surface. And finally, locking the optimal critical sliding surface by using a particle swarm optimization and tabu search collaborative framework. The algorithm can accurately capture the double-critical sliding surface, is widely applicable to various geological and load conditions, improves calculation accuracy and efficiency, and provides key data support for slope engineering design, safety evaluation, disaster early warning and the like.

title_en: Storm-torrent disaster chain trigger threshold identification method based on Bayesian network
