abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying a storm-torrent disaster chain triggering threshold based on a Bayesian network, which comprises the steps of sequentially cleaning an extracted historical disaster text according to a preset fuzzy character string matching algorithm and a preset text similarity algorithm to obtain a processed disaster text, extracting features of the processed disaster text to obtain key disaster features, constructing a target Bayesian network topology of the storm-torrent disaster chain, discretizing each node variable in the target Bayesian network topology to obtain a state value of the node variable, calculating the priori probability of the node variable, calculating the conditional probability of a causal relation between nodes according to the priori probability and a preset application expectation maximization algorithm, calculating the target posterior probability of a pre-disaster triggering derivative disaster, inverting the strength of the pre-disaster according to a preset posterior probability critical value and the target posterior probability, and determining the strength threshold of the pre-disaster triggering derivative disaster.

title_en: Coal and gas outburst disaster prediction method and device based on multi-physical field coupling
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of disaster prediction and discloses a coal and gas outburst disaster prediction method and device based on multi-physical field coupling. The method comprises the steps of carrying out data enhancement and normalization processing on a training sample set to obtain a model training data set, carrying out pattern recognition and parameter optimization on the model training data set to obtain an outstanding disaster prediction model, carrying out probability distribution calculation on output data of the outstanding disaster prediction model to obtain a confidence interval, carrying out multi-dimensional cross validation on the confidence interval to obtain a prediction reliability assessment result, carrying out threshold grading and risk grading on the prediction reliability assessment result to obtain an early warning grade judgment result, and carrying out space-time correlation analysis on the early warning grade judgment result to obtain target early warning decision information. According to the application, the coupling relation among the multiple physical field parameters is analyzed, and the multiple physical field coupling prediction model is established, so that the accurate prediction of the coal and gas outburst disasters is realized, and the reliability and accuracy of the prediction are improved.
assignees: GUIZHOU MINE SAFETY SCIENT RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;GUIZHOU COAL MINE DESIGN RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Drought disaster early warning method and device and related equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a drought disaster early warning method, a device and related equipment, and particularly relates to the technical field of drought disaster early warning, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the actual water storage capacity of a target river basin at a first time, the precipitation capacity of the target river basin in a target period and a water distribution function of the target river basin, and predicting target water consumption according to the water distribution function, wherein the target water consumption is used for representing the water consumption of the target river basin in the target period under a set confidence interval; and according to the actual water storage amount, the precipitation amount and the target water consumption, calculating to obtain the predicted water storage amount of the target river basin at the second time, and analyzing the predicted water storage amount according to a set drought early warning rule to obtain drought early warning information. The application can form more accurate and reliable drought early warning information.
assignees: ZHEJIANG INST OF HYDRAULICS & ESTUARY ZHEJIANG MARINE PLANNING AND DESIGN INST

title_en: Method for constructing prediction model of inflow and outflow for cascade reservoir and system thereof
title_ko: 캐스케이드 저수지 유입 및 유출 예측 모델 구축 방법 및 그 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for constructing a cascade reservoir inflow and outflow prediction model and a system thereof. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a method for constructing a cascade reservoir inflow and outflow prediction model comprises the steps of: receiving, by a preprocessing unit, data for predicting a cascade reservoir inflow amount and an outflow amount and performing preprocessing; applying, by a learning unit, a predetermined method to a training and verification group to train a prediction model; and applying, by a prediction unit, the pre-trained prediction model to the preprocessed data and quantifying accidental uncertainty and cognitive uncertainty to predict the inflow amount or outflow amount of the reservoir. As described above, according to the present invention, the cause of uncertainty is divided into accidental uncertainty and cognitive uncertainty, and accidental uncertainty and cognitive uncertainty are quantified at the same time to predict the inflow or outflow of the reservoir. In addition, it is possible to more accurately predict the uncertainty included in the cascade reservoir inflow amount or outflow amount compared to the prior art.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 캐스케이드 저수지 유입 및 유출 예측 모델 구축 방법 및 그 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따르면 캐스케이드 저수지 유입 및 유출 예측 모델 구축 방법에 있어서, 전처리부가 캐스케이드 저수지 유입량 및 유출량 예측을 위한 데이터를 입력받고 전처리를 수행하는 단계; 학습부는 훈련 및 검증 그룹에 기 지정된 방법을 적용하여 예측 모델을 학습시키는 단계; 및 예측부는 전처리가 수행된 데이터에 기 학습된 예측 모델을 적용하고 우연적 불확실성 및 인식적 불확실성을 정량화하여 저수지의 유입량 또는 유출량을 예측하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다. 
이와 같이 본 발명에 따르면, 불확실성의 원인을 우연적 불확실성 및 인식적 불확실성으로 구분하고, 우연적 불확실성 및 인식적 불확실성을 동시에 정량화하여 저수지의 유입량 또는 유출량을 예측할 수 있다. 또한, 종래에 비해 캐스케이드 저수지 유입량 또는 유출량에 내포된 불확실성을 더 정확하게 예측할 수 있다.

title_en: Comprehensive energy system load recovery method based on risk assessment and scene matching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive energy system load recovery method based on risk assessment and scene matching. The method comprises the steps of firstly generating a typical fault scene set under typhoon disasters based on a Monte Carlo model method, then constructing a comprehensive energy system load recovery model, periodically using the comprehensive energy system load recovery model to generate a recovery strategy after disasters occur and the energy system breaks down, inputting the recovery strategy to carry out load recovery, matching the typical fault scene set when the recovery strategy is generated, obtaining weights in the comprehensive energy system load recovery model according to a matching result and historical data, and obtaining the recovery strategy based on the comprehensive energy system load recovery model. According to the invention, a multi-dimensional risk evaluation system is introduced through dynamic scene matching optimization weight, and thermodynamic and natural pneumatic dynamic constraints are considered, so that the load recovery effect and the system stability are effectively improved.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method for evaluating probability of river blockage of post-earthquake rainfall induced landslide-debris flow geological disaster chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-earthquake rainfall-induced landslide-debris flow geological disaster chain river blockage probability assessment method which comprises the following steps of 1) determining a study area for constructing a landslide occurrence probability assessment model, meshing the study area into a plurality of non-overlapping grid units, constructing the landslide occurrence probability assessment model, acquiring a landslide susceptibility distribution map, 2) acquiring a joint probability distribution model of occurrence times and volume of the landslide in a region to be measured, 3) acquiring migration characteristics of the debris flow in the region to be measured, and 4) obtaining river blockage probability of a river section in the grid unit where the river is located in the region to be measured through multiple Monte Carlo simulation based on rainfall intensity and distribution data. The invention provides a complete evaluation flow, which scientifically quantifies the river-block probability of a river reach by comprehensively calculating landslide occurrence probability and debris flow migration characteristics and combining a Monte Carlo simulation technology, thereby providing important support for disaster prevention and control.

title_en: Automatic monitoring system for disaster of expressway high slope
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method or a device for identifying a mode, in particular to an automatic monitoring system for disaster of a highway high slope, which comprises the following steps: the system comprises a data collection and feature extraction module, a deep learning training module, a risk assessment model construction module, an early warning notification module and an automatic early warning and processing suggestion module. According to the risk assessment method, a complete risk assessment framework is formed through the risk data collection and basic credibility grading module, the Bayesian network algorithm calculation and weight weighting module and the risk level calculation module, the risk assessment framework has high systematicness, the basic credibility of each risk factor after adjustment is calculated through the Bayesian network algorithm, and the weight weighting is carried out, so that the risk assessment result is more accurate, and different risk levels of high, medium and low can be effectively distinguished.
assignees: HENAN JIAOYUAN ENGINEERING TECH GROUP CO LTD;HENAN COLLEGE OF TRANSP

title_en: Intelligent factory raw material inventory early warning and replenishment system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent factory raw material inventory early warning and replenishment system, which belongs to the technical field of inventory management, and comprises the steps of acquiring full-chain production data in real time, constructing a three-level digital twin model of a factory-workshop-production line, adopting a reinforcement learning algorithm to evaluate the performance of suppliers, generating a credit score and a priority list, driving a replenishment strategy generator to dynamically output a pareto optimal strategy solution set, quantifying cost-risk indexes through Monte Carlo simulation, constructing a domino effect propagation model, predicting cascade effect of raw material delay, formulating a double-track replenishment mechanism, and realizing active prediction of supply chain risks, dynamic optimization of replenishment strategies and differentiated management of suppliers by a strategy library optimization model through real-time data feedback, iteratively adjusting replenishment parameters and updating the credit score of the suppliers.

title_en: Electric power-traffic coupling charging network toughness assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating toughness of an electric power-traffic coupling charging network, and belongs to the technical field of electric power system analysis. According to the method, an electric power-traffic coupling charging network is built, a Bezier curve is combined to simulate a typhoon path and a Holland wind field model to calculate wind speed, dynamic traffic flow distribution, alternating current optimal power flow and cascading fault models are built, a Monte Carlo simulation is utilized to generate a fault data set, a dynamic Bayesian network is utilized to train a fault prediction model, a dynamic probability map is output after the actually measured wind speed is input, and dynamic toughness indexes are calculated to evaluate the toughness of the electric power-traffic coupling charging network. According to the method, the problem of fault propagation and insufficient dynamic evaluation among the systems is considered, and the toughness evaluation precision of the power-traffic coupling charging network under typhoon disasters is improved.

title_en: Power distribution system toughness assessment method based on dynamic Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution system toughness assessment method based on a dynamic Bayesian network, and belongs to the technical field of disaster assessment and power system toughness analysis. The method comprises the steps of simulating a storm disaster by using a Chicago unimodal rainfall model, simulating urban waterlogging by combining a digital elevation model and a two-dimensional hydrodynamic model, establishing a power distribution equipment failure model based on ponding depth data to obtain node failure probability, simulating a power distribution system state by using a Monte Carlo sampling method, constructing a dynamic Bayesian network to calculate power accessibility, establishing a power distribution network trend model by considering load withdrawal and line topology change, calculating load loss and voltage offset, and evaluating system risks. According to the method, the influence of the storm disaster on the power distribution network is comprehensively considered through multi-model coupling and probability analysis, the toughness of the power distribution network under the storm disaster is accurately estimated, scientific basis is provided for planning, designing and emergency management of a power system, and the disaster resistance and reliability of the power distribution network are improved.

title_en: Earthquake landslide hazard chain risk assessment method, medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, medium and equipment for evaluating the risk of a disaster chain of an earthquake landslide, and relates to the technical field of risk evaluation of a geological disaster chain; according to the knowledge graph, acquiring disaster influence factors, determining association among the disaster influence factors, determining key disaster influence factors with larger association degree, taking the key disaster influence factors as Bayesian network nodes, discretizing node variable data, performing structure learning by using a maximum and minimum hill climbing algorithm, determining a directed acyclic graph structure of the Bayesian network, performing Bayesian network parameter learning by using a expectation maximization algorithm, obtaining prior probability of the Bayesian network nodes, adjusting the association among the nodes if a model prediction result does not reach expectation, and using the model for seismic landslide disaster chain risk assessment if the prediction result reaches the expectation. The scheme of the invention can improve the reliability of the prediction result.

title_en: Method and device for optimizing arrangement of lifesaving facilities in subway station flood and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of subway station safety management and disaster emergency, and provides a method, a device and electronic equipment for optimizing the arrangement of lifesaving facilities under a subway station flood, wherein the method for optimizing the arrangement of the lifesaving facilities under the subway station flood comprises the steps of acquiring passenger position distribution data of a target subway station and disaster data during the flood; the method comprises the steps of modeling passenger density information by using a density-based noisy application spatial clustering algorithm, identifying passenger high-density areas, dividing the areas in a subway station into different danger levels by using a Bayesian network according to passenger position distribution data and disaster data, constructing a robustness optimization problem based on the passenger high-density areas and the danger levels, solving the robustness optimization problem, and determining the setting positions and the number of life-saving equipment. According to the method, the robustness optimization problem is constructed and solved, the setting positions and the number of the optimized lifesaving equipment are determined, and the rescue capability of the subway station on passengers under the flood condition can be improved by arranging the lifesaving facilities based on the setting positions and the number.
assignees: UNIV QINGDAO TECHNOLOGY;THE 3RD ENG CO LTD OF CHINA RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION ELECTRIFICATION BUREAU GROUP;CHINA RAILWAY CONSTR ELECTRIFICATION BUREAU GROUP CO LTD;ELECTRIC ENG CO LTD OF CHINA RAILWAY 23TH CONSTRUCTION BUREAU LTD

title_en: Cloud platform-based data rescuing and archiving system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data rescuing and archiving system based on a cloud platform, which relates to the technical field of data management and comprises a plurality of functional modules, a digital twin simulation module, a reinforcement learning optimization module and a data reinforcement learning optimization module, wherein the data perception and acquisition module is used for acquiring operation data in real time through deployment of edge computing nodes, the operation data comprises sensor data, service logs and historical fault data, the transmission links are encrypted by a hybrid encryption technology and are transmitted to a cloud end through a unified data interface standardization, the digital twin simulation module is used for generating a multidimensional data state vector model based on a lightweight modeling engine, dynamically updating twin body states through an integrated space-time data fusion algorithm, introducing prepositive disaster conditions of virtual-real interaction tests, simulating the execution effects of data recovery plans under different disaster conditions through a Monte Carlo method, and performing disaster spreading simulation.

title_en: E-commerce supply chain anti-outage decision system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of logistics supply and discloses an e-commerce supply chain anti-outage decision system based on multi-source data fusion, which comprises a heterogeneous graph network construction and risk prediction module, wherein the heterogeneous graph network construction and risk prediction module is used for constructing a heterogeneous graph network representing the relationship of the e-commerce supply chain based on multi-source data and predicting an outage risk propagation path by utilizing a time sequence sensitive graph annotation force network; the invention builds an abnormal composition network and realizes a time sequence sensitive graph annotation force network, so that the system can accurately capture cascading effect and risk propagation paths in a complex supply network, improve the prediction accuracy of the fault cargo risk propagation path and greatly reduce false alarm and missing alarm.

title_en: Regional bedding side slope pre-reinforcement range determining method based on limited samples
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control engineering, and particularly relates to a regional bedding side slope pre-reinforcement range determining method based on a limited sample. The method comprises the steps of firstly, counting disaster factors of regional bedding slopes, secondly, obtaining key disaster factors and distribution conditions of the key disaster factors by adopting a gray correlation method, amplifying limited samples by Monte Carlo simulation, screening out high-risk samples by taking a stability coefficient <1.0 as a standard, obtaining a pre-reinforcing range of the bedding slopes under complex geological conditions by adopting finite element simulation, and finally, establishing a correlation between the key disaster factors of the bedding slopes and the pre-reinforcing range by adopting a data preprocessing and XGBoost machine learning method to realize a regional bedding slope pre-reinforcing range determining method based on the limited samples. The method comprises the steps of amplifying a limited sample, establishing a correlation relation between a key disaster causing factor and a pre-reinforcement range, and finally obtaining the determination of the pre-reinforcement range of other bedding slopes in the area.
assignees: SICHUAN HIGHWAY PLANNING SURVEY DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE LTD;SICHUAN ROAD & BRIDGE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Quantum calculation embedded power grid elasticity assessment method considering all potential risks
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of analysis and evaluation of power systems, and relates to a quantum computing embedded power grid elasticity evaluation method considering all potential risks, which comprises the following steps of 1, obtaining typhoon weather disaster information possibly occurring in a future period of time; the method comprises the steps of 2, generating probability distribution based on vulnerability analysis by using typhoon early warning data information, 3, rapidly evaluating system fault risk loss under short-time rolling risk early warning, 4, performing overall process simulation evaluation on the fault risk loss, 5, judging whether a disaster-stricken line is repaired at the moment of t  k , 6, judging whether Monte Carlo simulation meets convergence conditions, and accelerating estimation of line fault probability by introducing a quantum amplitude estimation algorithm, wherein the rapid multi-scene parallel evaluation capability supported by quantum calculation is utilized, and the evaluation efficiency can be remarkably improved under the condition of ensuring consistent precision by combining dynamic repair and quantum embedding elastic evaluation processes.

title_en: Power grid line emergency repair scheduling and distributing method for complex multi-constraint disaster scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid line emergency repair dispatching distribution method for a complex multi-constraint disaster scene, and belongs to the technical field of power grid emergency management. The method comprises the steps of decomposing a complex rush-repair task into a plurality of quantifiable subtasks, establishing a matrix description of task requirements and technical capability requirements, establishing a multi-dimensional technical capability assessment index system, dynamically quantifying the technical capability level of emergency personnel through assessment and scoring, establishing an assessment model based on the technical capability satisfaction rate, estimating the rush-repair man-hour by combining a Monte Carlo simulation method based on Latin hypercube sampling, carrying out team internal task allocation by using a Hungary algorithm, and optimizing the multi-team task allocation by utilizing an ant colony algorithm of multiple traveling companies by combining the rush-repair man-hour estimation. The method can effectively improve the efficiency and accuracy of emergency task allocation, improve the utilization rate of limited resources and provide technical support for rush repair work in disaster scenes.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Monte Carlo simulation method-based substation flood season safe operation risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for evaluating the safe operation risk of a transformer substation in the flood period based on a Monte Carlo simulation method, which belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of power grids and comprises the steps of classifying and dividing the flood period influence factors of the transformer substation; the method comprises the steps of constructing a judgment matrix and weights according to expert scoring of key influence factors, carrying out consistency check on the judgment matrix, adjusting element values of the judgment matrix if the consistency check of the matrix does not meet preset conditions, reassigning the weights until the preset conditions are met, constructing a dynamic risk calculation model based on Monte Carlo simulation, obtaining simulation results, analyzing, judging stability of fitting degree, obtaining main risk factors and taking precautionary measures corresponding to emergency management. The method has the advantages that various factors around the transformer substation are considered into influence factors through accident tree analysis, system integration of multi-dimensional environmental factors is achieved, objectivity and comprehensiveness of transformer substation risk assessment are remarkably improved, and analysis capability of complex environmental coupling effect is enhanced.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method for dynamically reconstructing power distribution network disaster based on look-ahead-pre-algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic reconstruction method in power distribution network disaster based on a look-ahead-pre-algorithm, and belongs to the technical field of power distribution network reconstruction. The dynamic reconstruction method in power distribution network disaster based on the look-ahead-pre-algorithm comprises inputting initial running state of the power distribution network, and acquiring system state at current moment Generating all feasible action sets at the current moment For each action Executing an evaluation flow, constructing a future disaster scene by using a Monte Carlo method, simulating a system evolution process by combining a basic strategy, and evaluating actions Selecting the action with the minimum expected cost as the optimal action at the current moment to execute and update the system state Updating the time step if the current time step Returning to S2 to continue decision, otherwise, stopping algorithm execution. The reconstruction method optimizes the current decision, considers the influence of the current decision on the future, realizes the efficient and rapid dynamic reconstruction decision in the disaster, and improves the reliability and the toughness of the power distribution network.

title_en: Multi-parameter fusion-based turbine through-flow state real-time monitoring and diagnosing system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of turbine monitoring, and provides a turbine through-flow state real-time monitoring and diagnosing system based on multi-parameter fusion, which comprises a data fusion module, a dynamic diagnosing module, a distributed monitoring module and a visual display module, wherein the data fusion module is used for acquiring turbine operation parameters in a distributed mode in real time, carrying out fusion pretreatment on the turbine operation parameters based on edge calculation, outputting a data fusion set, the dynamic diagnosing module is used for pre-constructing and training a hybrid diagnosing model combining with a Bayesian network and cascade failure, identifying abnormal characteristics in the data fusion set based on the model, comprehensively analyzing through-flow monitoring nodes based on the abnormal characteristics by utilizing a dynamic decision tree, identifying abnormal through-flow nodes based on an abnormal characteristic, and generating a fault classification diagnosing result, and the distributed monitoring module is used for visually displaying a turbine through-flow virtual model based on the fault classification diagnosing result and the through-flow monitoring nodes. The invention can comprehensively reflect the running state of the steam turbine and is helpful for diagnosing the through-flow state of the steam turbine more accurately.
assignees: XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO;HUANENG POWER INT INC DANDONG POWER PLANT

title_en: Hydraulic engineering budget control system based on contract price linkage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic engineering budget management and control system based on contract price linkage, which comprises a contract data acquisition and preprocessing module, a budget reasoning model construction module, a contract change real-time monitoring module, a budget reasoning executing module, a budget model optimizing module, a management and control strategy generating module and a management and control strategy executing module, wherein the contract data acquisition and preprocessing module is used for inputting original contract data of hydraulic engineering projects and constructing a preprocessing contract data set, the budget reasoning model construction module is used for constructing a budget reasoning model, the contract change real-time monitoring module is used for acquiring information in real time and generating a structure compound change data set, the budget reasoning executing module is used for outputting a preliminary budget reasoning result, the budget model optimizing module is used for optimizing a budget reasoning model by adopting a cuckoo search algorithm, and the management and control strategy executing module is used for executing the budget management and control strategy. The invention adopts the budget reasoning and control flow combined with the dynamic Bayesian network modeling and the cuckoo search optimization algorithm to realize the dynamic generation and execution of the budget management and control strategy.
assignees: ANHUI YUSHUN WATER CONSERVANCY PROJECT MAN CO LTD

title_en: Cascade water-wind-solar long-term complementary scheduling plan optimization method, electronic equipment and computer program product
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of new energy, and provides a cascade water and wind-solar long-term complementary scheduling plan optimization method, electronic equipment and a computer program product. The method comprises the steps of carrying out multiple uncertainty quantification on new energy output and runoff to obtain a quantification result, constructing a double-layer recursion optimization model comprising a planning stage and an adjustment stage based on the quantification result, wherein the double-layer recursion optimization model takes the maximization of the long-term power generation of cascade water, wind and light as an optimization target, defining the planning stage to generate an initial scheduling plan, dynamically correcting the planned output deviation based on the quantification result in the adjustment stage, realizing state information coupling between two stages through a transfer variable, iteratively solving the double-layer recursion optimization model, and outputting the optimal scheduling plan meeting constraint conditions. The method solves the long-term scheduling problem under the multi-uncertainty of the water, the wind and the light, breaks through the limitation that the traditional deterministic model can not dynamically correct the plan, and remarkably improves the robustness of the scheduling plan and the new energy consumption capability.

title_en: Toughness improvement method for power transmission network based on improved Bayesian optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a toughness improvement method for a power transmission network based on improved Bayesian optimization, which aims to solve the problem that the existing toughness improvement method is low in efficiency in large-scale optimization of variables. The toughness improving method comprises the steps of firstly, including a plurality of power transmission lines in a power transmission network, reinforcing the power transmission tower as a measure for improving the toughness, obtaining vulnerability curves of the power transmission towers before and after reinforcement, secondly, simulating damage scenes of the power transmission towers through Monte Carlo under each typhoon scene, wherein the power transmission lines are damaged only when one power transmission tower is damaged, thirdly, determining the reinforcing sequence of the power transmission towers, fourthly, determining the relation between the number of the power transmission tower reinforcements on each power transmission line and the annual damage exceeding probability of the power transmission lines, and fifthly, improving the toughness of the power transmission network based on Bayesian optimization. The invention integrates an improved Bayesian optimization method, realizes reinforcement optimization of a large-scale network for various complex uncertainties, and can accurately evaluate the toughness improvement strategy of the electric power system under typhoon disasters.

title_en: FY-2G satellite data hail quantitative identification method based on Gaussian distribution
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of weather disaster early warning, in particular to a method for quantitatively identifying FY-2G satellite data hail based on Gaussian distribution, which comprises the steps of constructing a space-time matching data set, obtaining inversion product data, taking a ground hail point as a center, extracting hail samples, simultaneously selecting satellite data of equal numbers of non-hail periods and non-hail areas as the non-hail samples, checking the suitability of the Gaussian distribution of the data through a quantile-quantile graph, determining that indexes obey or approximately obey Gaussian distribution, calculating mathematical expectations and standard deviations of the hail and non-hail samples for the indexes, constructing a double-sample Gaussian probability density function, utilizing a numerical integration method to establish a single-side confidence interval, dividing a three-level hail probability interval, finally judging the hail occurrence probability through single-index triggering, multi-index synergy and background elimination rules, matching probability interval, and realizing quantitative identification.

title_en: Method and system for quantitatively evaluating risk of instability disaster on excavation face of shield tunnel
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of tunnel construction risk assessment, and provides a method and a system for quantitatively assessing the risk of instability disasters of a shield tunnel excavation face. The evaluation method comprises the steps of constructing a shield tunnel excavation face instability disaster risk evaluation system, converting the system into a Bayesian network topological structure, calculating membership of each disaster evaluation index according to digital characteristic calculation of a forward cloud generator and data to be evaluated, converting the membership into Bayesian network prior probability, carrying out parameter learning on historical data of the shield tunnel excavation face instability disaster according to historical data of the shield tunnel excavation face instability disaster and the Bayesian network topological structure, calculating Bayesian network model conditional probability, calculating a shield tunnel excavation face instability disaster risk quantification evaluation result according to the Bayesian network prior probability, the Bayesian network model conditional probability and the Bayesian network topological structure, and carrying out adjustment decision on shield tunneling control parameters according to the shield tunnel excavation face instability disaster risk quantification evaluation result.
assignees: JINAN RAIL TRANSIT GROUP CO LTD;UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Fire disaster early warning method and system for charging pile
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire disaster early warning method and a fire disaster early warning system for a charging pile, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multidimensional monitoring data of the charging pile in real time and preprocessing the monitoring data; the method comprises the steps of carrying out fast Fourier transform on voltage and current data in monitoring data to extract frequency characteristics, calculating current fluctuation coefficient to extract time sequence characteristics and calculating temperature change rate, constructing a data set comprising time-frequency domain characteristics and temperature change rate, outputting fire risk hidden variables by using a deep learning model, dynamically calculating fire risk posterior probability based on a Bayesian network, and generating early warning grades by combining the hidden variables and the time-frequency domain characteristics. Based on the method, a fire early warning system of the charging pile is also provided. According to the invention, the monitoring data of the charging pile and the surrounding environment thereof are collected in real time by utilizing the Internet of things technology, the rapid local data processing is performed through edge calculation, and the sensitivity of the early warning model is dynamically adjusted by adopting a self-adaptive Bayesian algorithm, so that the accuracy and response speed of fire early warning are improved.
assignees: JINAN CITY CHANGQING DISTR POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: AIS data-based sea wave disaster prevention division method, medium and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an AIS data-based sea wave disaster prevention zone determination method, medium and system, which belong to the technical field of sea wave disaster prevention zone determination, and the invention firstly establishes an initial matrix through grid division, counts the traffic situation of each grid ship for many years of AIS data, and establishes a multidimensional traffic frequency tensor and a first change matrix; the method comprises the steps of collecting sea wave re-analysis data to calculate occurrence frequencies of different levels of sea wave heights, establishing a sea wave risk degree matrix, constructing a composite disaster index model based on ship response characteristics, calculating grid aggregation degree and dispersion degree, generating a second change matrix by applying a risk propagation function, constructing a risk assessment hypergraph by fusing ship and sea wave data, carrying out regional marking through a multi-criterion threshold value and a graph coloring algorithm to form a third change matrix, optimizing a defending area boundary by adopting an improved particle swarm algorithm, outputting a final demarcating result, and realizing accurate and efficient demarcating of a sea wave disaster defending area.
assignees: NORTH CHINA SEA FORECAST DISASTER REDUCTION CENTER OF MINI OF NATURAL RESOURCES QINGDAO OCEAN CENTER

title_en: Wide area landslide rapid identification method based on interpretable intelligent algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wide-area landslide rapid identification method based on an interpretable intelligent algorithm, which relates to the field of remote sensing science and technology, and is characterized in that a dual-channel feature extraction architecture is constructed through multisource spatial-temporal data fusion and dynamic weighting of a knowledge map, wherein a light CNN captures local textures of images, a graph-convolution network models the geological space relevance, an interpretable contribution thermodynamic diagram and a rule chain are generated by combining SHAP values and causal reasoning, a knowledge map bidirectional verification system is introduced, a priori rule is utilized to verify space logic contradiction, a model and a rule library are triggered to co-evolve based on misjudgment samples, a multidimensional reliability report is output, the analysis granularity is customized and interpreted according to roles by Monte Carlo Dropout quantization uncertainty, and a terrain self-adaptive block-flow processing architecture is adopted, and edge light deployment and federal learning are combined to realize wide-area real-time early warning and dynamic updating of the model. The scheme breaks through the limitation of the traditional black box model, and forms a disaster prevention closed loop of physical driving, transparent decision and second-level response.

title_en: Power distribution network flexible supply and demand resource scheduling strategy considering random faults
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible supply and demand resource scheduling strategy of a power distribution network, which takes random faults into account, wherein S1 data acquisition is carried out, disaster parameters, power grid states and resource capacities are obtained in real time, multi-source data fusion and uncertainty quantification are carried out, a full-scene multi-source data monitoring system is constructed, S2 scene mapping is carried out, random fault scene modeling and generation are carried out based on the full-scene multi-source data monitoring system, disasters are converted into line faults and running state changes, S3 strategy generation is carried out, feasible scheduling strategies are enumerated and modeling constraints are constructed, a flexible supply and demand resource scheduling strategy library is constructed, S4 optimization solution is carried out, a robust optimization model of the random faults is established, an optimal strategy is solved according to an objective function selection algorithm, S5 feedback is carried out, issuing commands and real-time adjustment are carried out, closed-loop control is formed, dynamic closed-loop control and self-adaptive adjustment are carried out on the power distribution network, and the toughness and recovery capacity of the power distribution network in natural disasters can be improved, and the safety and reliability of power supply are ensured.
assignees: XUCHANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Multi-disaster risk early warning method and equipment for overhead transmission line based on analysis of disaster-pregnancy mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and equipment for early warning multiple disasters of an overhead power transmission line based on disaster pregnancy mechanism analysis, and belongs to the technical field of disaster early warning of power transmission lines. According to the method, dynamic and accurate multi-disaster early warning of the overhead transmission line is realized by constructing a disaster-tolerant mechanism model, quantifying disaster coupling effect, monte Carlo simulation and comprehensive risk assessment.

title_en: Intelligent tailing dam displacement prediction and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent tailing dam displacement prediction and early warning method, which belongs to the technical field of safety prediction and early warning, and comprises the steps of obtaining online monitoring historical data of a tailing dam, preprocessing data, constructing a GRU main prediction model to predict main prediction displacement, obtaining an error sequence through actual measurement data and the main prediction displacement, decomposing the error sequence into a trend item and a noise item error sequence through PSO-VMD-TOPSIS, respectively constructing a trend item and noise item error correction model based on GRU, obtaining error correction values and standard deviations of the trend item and the noise item through MC-dropout technology, constructing a dynamic weight calculation mechanism, obtaining a final displacement prediction value and a confidence interval through combining the main prediction displacement, judging whether to alarm or not, realizing high-precision real-time prediction, uncertainty quantization and real-time early warning of the tailing dam displacement, and providing intelligent decision support for the safety state assessment and disaster early warning of the tailing dam.

title_en: Submarine cable risk dynamic assessment method and system based on multi-modal deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a submarine cable risk dynamic assessment method and system based on multi-mode deep learning, and belongs to the field of marine infrastructure operation and maintenance. Aiming at the problems of incomplete data coverage, incomplete generation scene, low evaluation reliability and the like in the prior art, the method comprises the steps of 1) constructing a multi-source heterogeneous data set containing six types of data such as geology, ocean, ships and biology, adopting space-time grid coding to realize data alignment, 2) designing a physical constraint generation countermeasure network, generating risk scene data conforming to a hydrodynamic rule through Navier-Stokes equation constraint, 3) creating a layered space-time fusion network (HST-transform), combining CNN spatial feature extraction, a time sequence attention mechanism and a dynamic memory module to realize multi-mode fusion, 4) establishing a mixed uncertainty quantization frame to distinguish cognitive uncertainty and inherent data noise, and 5) integrating a digital twin platform to realize risk propagation simulation and inverse fact intervention analysis. According to the invention, the rare risk event detection rate is improved by 62%, the evaluation accuracy rate reaches 91.7%, and compared with the traditional method, the false alarm rate is reduced by 34%, so that submarine cable breakage accidents can be effectively prevented.

title_en: Urban hydropower infrastructure failure analysis method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a failure analysis method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for urban hydropower infrastructure, and relates to the field of urban hydropower failure analysis, comprising the steps of determining failure proportion of an upstream node, and determining whether the upstream node is in a failure state or not based on the failure proportion, wherein the node to be analyzed corresponds to the urban hydropower infrastructure; under the condition of non-failure state, determining the water accumulation depth of the node to be analyzed according to the water accumulation depth change model, determining the target failure probability of the node to be analyzed based on the water accumulation depth and the target failure probability model when the water accumulation depth is larger than the water accumulation depth threshold value, generating a random value of the node to be analyzed through a Monte Carlo simulation method, determining whether the node to be analyzed is in the failure state again based on the target failure probability and the random value, further determining whether the node to be analyzed is in the failure state based on the random failure probability if the node to be analyzed is still in the non-failure state, and generating a failure analysis result based on the state of the node to be analyzed to realize scientific analysis of the failure of the hydropower infrastructure.

title_en: Software development management method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a software development management method based on big data, which relates to the technical field of software development management and comprises the steps of collecting multi-source development data, transmitting the multi-source development data to a data lake in real time through a distributed message queue to generate a structured data stream with a timestamp and a time sequence relation map, carrying out Monte Carlo sampling on a three-dimensional radiation field model of a nerve radiation field and a causal influence map, simulating cascade influence submitted by a current code, outputting a risk value and a dependent chain, loading a three-dimensional code space model of the nerve radiation field, a node risk value and the dependent chain, dynamically rendering a causal influence path to generate a visual risk report, generating a code optimization task according to the visual risk report, submitting the optimized code version to a code library, and calibrating parameters of the three-dimensional code space model of the nerve radiation field. By analyzing the space-time characteristics of code change and combining Monte Carlo simulation, the method identifies the implicit dependence and risk conducting chain, and improves the comprehensiveness and the predictive capability of the architecture decomposition analysis.
assignees: XIAN HIGH PRESSURE VALVE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Fault evolution analysis method for power transmission and distribution-gas comprehensive energy system under extreme typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a fault evolution analysis method of a power transmission and distribution-gas integrated energy system under an extreme typhoon disaster, which is characterized by calculating time-varying fault probability of a power transmission and distribution network element based on a mechanical stress model of typhoon-rain load, generating an initial breaking set through Monte Carlo sampling, identifying a serious overload line caused by power flow transfer and executing protection cutting through affine power flow calculation of power transmission and distribution network coupling, analyzing a power transmission and distribution-gas load shedding strategy by adopting a dynamic affine model, combining a natural gas pipe existence equation and an electric-gas coupling equipment operation constraint, quantifying the influence of power line breaking on pressure fluctuation and pipe existence change of a natural gas system, balancing overload power of a general overload line, processing a bilinear term, adopting rotary second-order cone relaxation to convert non-convex constraint, and quantifying the natural gas system fault propagation risk caused by power transmission and distribution line breaking and power transmission and gas load shedding by combining the coupling operation constraint of an electric drive compressor, a gas turbine and electric-gas conversion equipment.

title_en: Geological disaster knowledge graph construction method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of knowledge graph construction, in particular to a geological disaster knowledge graph construction method and system based on artificial intelligence; the method comprises the steps of extracting a geological semantic triplet set by using a semantic physical collaborative type preprocessing method to construct a three-layer semantic ontology graph, generating a space section structure chain and a time sequence state chain by using a double-chain type space-time graph construction method to construct a double-chain coupling graph structure, carrying out node state propagation calculation by using a disturbance perception graph neural network mechanism to obtain a risk state prediction result of a landslide structure unit layer under each time node, generating a landslide risk propagation path chain by using a reverse causal path chain reconstruction method, and migrating propagation parameters and response rules in a historical landslide graph structure into the double-chain coupling graph structure to construct a double-chain coupling space-time geological disaster knowledge graph. According to the invention, landslide state prediction and causal path reasoning are realized through the double-chain diagram structure and the disturbance perception diagram neural network.

title_en: Agent index-based quick evaluation method and system for earthquake-resistant toughness of water supply pipe network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid evaluation method and a rapid evaluation system for earthquake-resistant toughness of a water supply pipe network based on an agent index, which belong to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of civil engineering and comprise the following steps of S1, pipe network topology modeling and information determination, S2, earthquake-resistant toughness time dimension division and index definition, S3, preparation index and agent index calculation, S4, robustness index and agent index calculation, S5, recovery index and agent index calculation, S6, adaptability index and agent index calculation, S7, monte Carlo simulation and uncertainty analysis, and S8, establishing a functional relation. The rapid evaluation method and the rapid evaluation system for the earthquake-resistant toughness of the water supply pipe network based on the agent index solve the problem of rapid evaluation of the earthquake-resistant toughness of the urban water supply pipe network and provide an effective approach for analysis and design of the earthquake-resistant toughness of the pipe network.

title_en: Sea level rising influence risk assessment method, medium and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a sea level rising influence risk assessment method, medium and system based on multi-source data fusion, belonging to the technical field of ocean disasters, which acquire basic characteristic data by constructing a multi-dimensional data acquisition network, perform nonlinear time sequence decomposition by utilizing multi-scale wavelet analysis, and establishing a prediction model based on a deep learning neural network, determining key vulnerability points by utilizing a minimum cut maximum flow algorithm, establishing an area vulnerability scoring system, generating a comprehensive risk assessment matrix by utilizing a Bayesian network integrated analysis method, calculating a variation score matrix to extract a risk variation trend, and finally generating an assessment report by utilizing a coastline adaptability gating model. The model fuses a multi-head time sequence attention mechanism and a bidirectional autoregressive code, adopts a regional adaptability gating weight function to dynamically adjust parameters, and realizes accurate assessment and dynamic tracking of sea level rising influence risks in a complex geographic environment.

title_en: Mine geological environment characteristic monitoring and recovery treatment method
abstract_en: The application discloses a mine geological environment characteristic monitoring and recovery treatment method, which relates to the field of geological environment monitoring and comprises the steps of collecting mine geological data, predicting membership information of geological disaster evolution in a future period by adopting a pre-trained LSTM neural network model, adjusting a state transition probability matrix in a Markov chain model by utilizing the membership information, predicting the evolution state of the geological disaster in the future period by utilizing the adjusted state transition probability matrix, mapping the mine geological data into nodes of a Bayesian network, constructing a directed acyclic graph containing environmental factors, calculating the occurrence probability of the geological disaster under different environmental factor combinations based on a Bayesian network inference algorithm, fusing the predicted evolution state of the geological disaster in the future period with the geological disaster occurrence probability inferred by the Bayesian network, and obtaining a geological disaster prediction evaluation result.

title_en: Universal wind speed prediction method and device for real-time typhoon rapid early warning
abstract_en: The invention provides a universal wind speed prediction method and device for rapid early warning of a typhoon in real time, and relates to the technical field of natural disaster early warning. The method comprises the steps of carrying out typhoon data analysis according to coastal city information and typhoon history information based on a simulated circle method to obtain typhoon basic information, carrying out model construction according to the typhoon basic information based on a mathematical statistics inference method to obtain a parameter probability distribution model, carrying out random sample generation according to the parameter probability distribution model by using a Monte Carlo method to obtain a first training data set, carrying out optimization training on a universal wind speed prediction model to be trained by using the first training data set and typhoon real-time information based on a dynamic elite retention strategy to obtain the universal wind speed prediction model to be optimized. The invention relates to a high-efficiency and accurate general wind speed prediction method based on a GA-BP neural network and a dynamic elite retention strategy.

title_en: Surface matrix map modification data processing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geology, in particular to a surface matrix map modification data processing method which comprises the steps of data dynamic acquisition, intelligent pretreatment, three-dimensional modeling, multi-scale nested analysis, decision deduction and dynamic visualization; compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the periodic manual acquisition and static database updating scheme is adopted, the data updating period is long, sudden environmental change is difficult to capture, the scheme adopts the multi-source data real-time access and AI dynamic cleaning scheme, the method has the advantages of real-time updating capability and automatic abnormal value correction, the earth surface matrix model can dynamically respond to environmental change, the timeliness of disaster early warning and emergency decision is remarkably improved, the deep learning fusion multi-mode data and Bayesian uncertainty quantification scheme is adopted, the method has the advantages of high-resolution three-dimensional modeling and risk area visualization, and complex geological structures can be accurately depicted and clear priority guidance is provided for manual verification.
assignees: QINGHAI GEOLOGICAL SURVEY INSTITUTE QINGHAI GEOLOGICAL MINERAL RES INSTITUTE QINGHAI GEOLOGICAL REMO

title_en: Multi-mode traffic network robustness calculation method under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode traffic network robustness calculation method under typhoon disasters, which comprises the steps of constructing an inter-city public traffic network comprising a plurality of traffic modes, generating an air pressure attenuation model and a typhoon continuous influence model by combining space-time dynamic characteristics of the typhoon disasters, calculating failure probability distribution and state of the inter-city public traffic network under the typhoon disasters based on a system vulnerability curve and a Monte Carlo simulation method, establishing a traffic network cascade failure model according to the failure probability distribution and state of the inter-city public traffic network under the typhoon disasters, simulating the structure and function loss process of traffic network sites and lines under the disaster conditions, designing a traffic network robustness index calculation system, and quantifying the performance change of the inter-city public traffic network from two aspects of topological structures and service functions. The invention can accurately quantify the influence of typhoon disasters on a traffic system.

title_en: Real-time earthquake motion numerical prediction method fusing fracture directivity effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of real-time earthquake disaster early warning of earthquake engineering, in particular to a real-time earthquake motion numerical prediction method fusing fracture directivity effect, which carries out filtering and baseline correction on a real-time observation strong vibration waveform of an earthquake table network, corrects the ground earthquake motion waveform to a bedrock site by using an empirical site effect correction model, then converts the corrected acceleration record into energy parameters, and generating a meshed bedrock seismic energy field through Kerling space interpolation, simulating a seismic energy space-time propagation process based on an RTT model by utilizing a Monte Carlo method, and obtaining a predicted seismic energy field with a plurality of time steps.
assignees: INST ENG MECH CHINA EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Transformer fire risk detection method and device and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of electric power systems, and relates to a method and a device for detecting the fire risk of a transformer and a readable storage medium, wherein the method and the device are used for acquiring the operation parameters of all parts in the transformer, and acquiring the characteristic parameters of all parts in the transformer, the combustion thermodynamic characteristic parameters of combustible substances in the transformer and the load data of all parts of the transformer under the combustion thermodynamic characteristic parameters of the combustible substances based on the type and the voltage level of the transformer; the method comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional model of the transformer based on operation parameters and characteristic parameters of all components in the transformer, gridding the three-dimensional model of the transformer to obtain a three-dimensional grid model of the transformer, dynamically simulating the three-dimensional grid model of the transformer based on load data of all components of the transformer under the combustion mechanical characteristic parameters of combustible substances to output fire risk indexes of all components in the transformer, and calculating the fire risk indexes of the transformer to be detected based on the fire risk indexes of all components and fire risk propagation coefficients among all components.
assignees: STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD EHV COMPANY;STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Line early warning judging method and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of power transmission line maintenance and provides a line early warning judging method and system based on multi-source data fusion, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-dimensional knowledge graph and establishing a semantic association network; the method comprises the steps of collecting weather and equipment state data in real time, integrating the data into a knowledge graph space through a mapping function, identifying an abnormal weather-equipment combination mode through fuzzy reasoning, calculating the thickness change rate by combining an icing growth prediction model, calculating the icing thickness and galloping probability, generating a composite early warning grade, dynamically generating a risk thermodynamic diagram on a GIS map, and visually displaying a risk propagation path. The system breaks through the limitation of single parameter criteria of the traditional early warning through semantic fusion, composite risk modeling and spatial decision of multi-source data, realizes intelligent identification and dynamic early warning of meteorological-equipment coupling risks, and remarkably improves the accuracy and operation and maintenance decision efficiency of disaster early warning of the power transmission line.
assignees: HUBEI CENTRAL CHINA TECH DEVELOPMENT OF ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Two-stage fault recovery method for improving elasticity of power distribution system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage fault recovery method for improving elasticity of a power distribution system, which comprises the steps of constructing a typhoon space-time evolution model to generate a predicted fault scene, simulating a power distribution line in the predicted fault scene by utilizing a Monte Carlo simulation method to generate a plurality of fault scenes, constructing an uncertain set based on an information entropy value of the fault scenes and a fault weight, further constructing a robust optimization model, solving the robust optimization model, determining a pre-layout scheme of a mobile energy storage system and a static reactive compensator in the worst fault scene before disaster, constructing a multi-source collaborative post-disaster multi-period multi-objective fault recovery model, and realizing recovery of a power loss load and the fault line of the power distribution system by reconstructing and optimally scheduling the mobile energy storage system, the static reactive compensator, a maintenance team and electric vehicles through a network. The invention remarkably improves the overall elasticity of the power distribution system, not only enhances the disaster resistance capability, but also improves the capability of quickly recovering power supply.

title_en: Beidou-based geological disaster intelligent monitoring and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and discloses a Beidou-based geological disaster intelligent monitoring and early warning method and system. The Beidou high-precision monitoring equipment is deployed by selecting a geological disaster prone area, surface displacement, settlement and inclination deformation data are collected in real time, and a multi-mode database is constructed by combining environmental parameters. And (3) carrying out alignment and noise correction on the space-time data by adopting Kalman filtering and weighted evidence theory, extracting short-term and long-term deformation characteristics by using a DBSCAN spatial clustering algorithm, and realizing multi-scale abnormal change pattern recognition by combining GeoHash grid indexes. The dimension difference is eliminated through Z-score standardization processing, a geological stability index and change rate model is built, a causal reasoning frame is further built based on a Bayesian network, and a risk prediction model is trained by combining a space-time neural network. The system can dynamically adjust the monitoring period threshold and automatically trigger the hierarchical early warning, and supports the full-flow tracing of hidden trouble rectification and multi-level gridding management. The scheme breaks through the limitation of traditional single-source monitoring, realizes full-chain prevention and control from deformation feature extraction, causal relationship modeling to dynamic risk prediction of geological disasters, and remarkably improves early warning timeliness and accuracy.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Mine disaster risk assessment method based on Bayesian network and three-dimensional model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine disaster risk assessment method based on a Bayesian network and a three-dimensional model, which comprises the steps of collecting first data of a preset position of a mine, including gas data, temperature data, rock stratum stress data, smoke concentration data and acoustic signal data, screening target data from the first data after preprocessing through historical disaster causing factors of the mine, constructing a Bayesian network through dependency relationship between the target data and different target data, three-dimensionally scanning in the mine to obtain point cloud data, constructing a digital twin three-dimensional model of the mine based on the point cloud data after preprocessing, acquiring second data of other positions based on the first data after preprocessing, integrating the first data and the second data according to different moments to obtain multidimensional data at different moments, inputting the multidimensional data into the Bayesian network to obtain a three-dimensional risk distribution map and a probability value, and carrying out space mapping and calculation on the three-dimensional risk distribution map and the probability value and the digital twin three-dimensional model to obtain a mine disaster risk value.

title_en: Urban hydropower infrastructure protection resource allocation method, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, equipment and a storage medium for configuring protection resources of urban hydropower infrastructure, and relates to the field of urban hydropower failure analysis and resource configuration, comprising the steps of determining failure proportion of an upstream node, and determining whether the upstream node is in a failure state or not based on the failure proportion; under the condition of non-failure state, determining the water accumulation depth of a node to be analyzed according to a water accumulation depth change model, determining the target failure probability of the node based on the water accumulation depth and a target failure probability model when the water accumulation depth is larger than a water accumulation depth threshold value, generating a random value of the node through a Monte Carlo simulation method, determining whether the node is in a failure state again based on the target failure probability and the random value, if the node is still in the non-failure state, further determining whether the node is in the failure state based on the random failure probability, determining a system reliability result based on the state of the node, and carrying out protection resource configuration on the node based on a protection resource configuration strategy to realize failure analysis and protection resource configuration on a hydropower infrastructure.

title_en: Urban road network flood risk assessment method based on Bayesian and complex network modeling
abstract_en: The invention provides an urban road network flood risk assessment method based on Bayesian and complex network modeling, which relates to the technical field of flood disaster prevention and reduction, and specifically comprises the steps of establishing a Bayesian network model by adopting influence factors constructed by multi-source data, optimizing model parameters by analyzing and researching spatial heterogeneity distribution of regional historical flood, and predicting flood liability based on the optimized Bayesian network model; and carrying out modeling analysis on the urban road network topological structure by adopting a complex network theoretical framework to obtain the road network vulnerability of the research area, carrying out comprehensive scoring on the flood risk according to the flood vulnerability and the road network vulnerability, and obtaining the dynamic change of the flood risk comprehensive scoring by adjusting the model and the road network structure. The invention combines the Bayesian network and Domirank algorithm, deeply analyzes and quantifies the complex causal relationship between each influence factor and the flood disaster, and is beneficial to improving the capability of the city to cope with the flood disaster.

title_en: Urban public safety intelligent emergency command method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban public safety intelligent emergency command method, which relates to the technical field of urban public safety and comprises the following steps of constructing a multi-source perception network in advance to collect fire data in real time, wherein the fire data at least comprises smoke concentration, temperature change and flame images, calculating a fire risk value in real time and triggering early warning based on a multi-source data fusion and early warning analysis model, predicting the occurrence probability of a fire by using a Bayesian network model, simulating the fire spreading trend and speed, scheduling emergency resources based on a multi-target optimization model, and performing post-disaster assessment. According to the invention, the analytic hierarchy process is adopted to fuse multi-source data and calculate weights, the Bayesian network model is used for predicting fire probability, the improved CellularAutomata model is constructed to simulate the spreading trend, the multi-target optimization model is combined to schedule emergency resources, the risk quantitative evaluation and the accurate resource configuration are realized, and decision bias and resource waste caused by experience judgment are avoided.

title_en: Cascade pre-flood energy storage risk analysis and control method for hydro-wind-solar complementary system
abstract_en: The present invention belongs to the field of power generation scheduling of power systems. Disclosed is a cascade pre-flood energy storage risk analysis and control method for a hydro-wind-solar complementary system. The method comprises: using pre-flood energy storage as a constraint to establish a dry-season drawdown model and a flood-season water storage scheduling rule, so as to determine a simulation operation criterion; constructing a set of dry-season power shortage, flood-season water abandonment, insufficient year-end energy storage and wind-solar power curtailment indexes, so as to quantify multi-stage and multi-source operation risks; and coupling Monte Carlo and fuzzy membership degrees to characterize multi-dimensional uncertainty scenarios and probabilities thereof, and using simulation analysis to determine quantitative relationships between pre-flood energy storage and hydro-wind-solar complementary benefits, risk probabilities and risk losses. Results of instance analysis of a hydro-wind-solar complementary system in a certain extremely-large drainage basin show that the present invention can comprehensively describe risks in terms of occurrence probabilities and losses, and a verification result shows that by means of accurate risk description and reasonable energy storage control, the system power generation is increased by 580 million kWh, and the risk loss is reduced by 42% on average, and therefore the present invention exhibits good practicability.

title_en: Knowledge-graph-based safety production risk identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety production risk identification method and a system based on a knowledge graph, which relate to the technical field of safety production risk identification, and the invention adopts a graph neural network to generate embedded representation by acquiring entity nodes and relationship edge data of the knowledge graph and extracting feature vectors, calculating node weights by using an attention mechanism to determine a risk mode, traversing the associated paths to generate a risk propagation sequence, fusing time sequence features to update entity states and determine a dynamic propagation path, extracting key node subgraphs to adjust edge weights to optimize the risk mode, and finally identifying a complete risk propagation chain by iteratively querying and integrating environmental features. The method and the system realize dynamic tracking of equipment, personnel and environmental network risks and cross-dimension cascading risk identification.

title_en: Urban fire hazard early warning analysis method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for urban fire hazard early warning analysis based on big data, which relate to the technical field of disaster early warning and comprise the steps of initializing Gaussian kernel functions and bandwidth parameters of KDE based on characteristic dimensions, constructing quenching functions and coupling parameters as constraints by combining GIS information, and calculating the simulated defect density, calculating the actual critical index and the standardized deviation by combining the time sequence, constructing a thermal diffusion equation, solving by a two-stage constant-proximity method, generating a space-time risk field, and calculating a risk propagation speed field. According to the method, through a multi-index clustering method combining entropy weight and kernel density, risk identification precision of high-dimensional heterogeneous data is improved, an odd-symmetry abnormal point identification mechanism is constructed, accuracy and stability of abnormal point identification are improved, a thermal diffusion equation is constructed, a space-time risk field is generated through solving by a two-stage constant-proximity method, dynamic evolution display of urban fire risks is achieved, and early warning response efficiency is improved.

title_en: Intelligent mountain torrent disaster early warning monitoring system
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of natural disaster early warning, and discloses an intelligent early warning mountain torrent disaster monitoring system which comprises a data acquisition unit, a risk prediction unit and a dynamic utility evaluation unit, wherein the data acquisition unit is used for acquiring multi-source dynamic monitoring data and static geographic data, the risk prediction unit is connected with the data acquisition unit and is used for generating probabilistic prediction of mountain torrent disaster states in a specific time window in the future based on the multi-source dynamic monitoring data and the static geographic data, and the dynamic utility evaluation unit is used for combining a preset decision maker risk preference model and a public trust dynamic evolution model to quantify the comprehensive utility of different early warning decisions under different disaster situations. By fusing the multi-element heterogeneous data and applying a hybrid prediction model of dynamic Bayesian network and Gaussian process regression, the accuracy and reliability of mountain torrent risk prediction are obviously improved. Compared with the early warning mode relying on a single data source or a simple model in the prior art, the method effectively overcomes the defect that the data is not fully utilized and uncertainty is difficult to quantify.

title_en: Wind deflection flashover probability prediction method for power transmission line based on conditional diffusion model
abstract_en: A method for predicting wind deflection flashover probability of an electric transmission line based on a conditional diffusion model relates to the field of wind deflection risk prediction of the electric transmission line, and a space-time joint probability generating frame is constructed by fusing meteorological data and line structural features so as to realize the refined prediction of the wind deflection flashover probability of the electric transmission line.
