The method comprises the steps of S1 obtaining meteorological data, line parameters and historical flashover data of a power transmission line, carrying out data preprocessing, S2 carrying out condition coding, diffusion processing and iterative denoising on the data based on a parameterized Markov chain, establishing a condition diffusion model, S3 completing uncertainty quantification according to hidden probability modeling, generating a confidence interval, evaluating the wind deflection flashover probability of the power transmission line, S4 constructing accuracy and uncertainty quantification evaluation indexes about model prediction results and the confidence interval, and dividing wind deflection risk grades of the power transmission line. The invention promotes the accurate prevention and control of the wind deflection flashover disaster of the power transmission line and provides technical support for constructing a novel power system safety protection system.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO RIZHAO POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Power grid dynamic risk assessment method considering fault evolution under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to a power grid dynamic risk assessment method considering fault evolution under typhoon disasters, which comprises the steps of establishing a typhoon wind speed space distribution model and a system element fault probability model, quantifying the influence of typhoon strength and paths on the output of a power transmission line and an offshore wind farm, generating a typical fault scene through Monte Carlo sampling and scene reduction based on information entropy, constructing comprehensive risk indexes of load rejection, wind rejection and line out-of-limit, analyzing a power grid abnormal propagation path driven by unit rescheduling and island processing, and outputting a space-time dynamic risk assessment result. By the dynamic entropy interval control technology, efficient screening of fault scenes is achieved, a fault-tide coupling evolution model is established, cascading fault propagation paths during typhoon passing are accurately depicted, the problems that power grid risks are not accurately quantized and fault evolution paths are not clear under extreme disasters are solved, and typhoon resistance of coastal power grids is remarkably improved.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Inclination meter monitoring abnormal data identification method based on PCA and KNN confidence interval analysis
abstract_en: A method for identifying monitoring abnormal data of an inclinometer based on PCA and KNN confidence interval analysis relates to the field of monitoring and early warning of hydroelectric engineering geological disasters. The invention relates to an inclinometer monitoring abnormal data identification method based on PCA and KNN confidence interval analysis, which is characterized by comprising the specific steps of data preprocessing, PCA dimension reduction analysis, calculation of confidence circles of each unit time, generation of final confidence circles and abnormality detection. The method comprises the steps of carrying out data dimension reduction on data of each monitoring point of the inclinometer by adopting a principal component analysis method PCA, carrying out KNN classification screening on two-dimensional circle center coordinates of monitoring data in multiple time periods, carrying out arithmetic averaging on radiuses, forming a final confidence circle, judging whether the data of each monitoring point are normal or not by judging whether the new confidence circle center coordinates are in the final confidence circle, and being suitable for a hydroelectric engineering geological disaster monitoring data analysis scene under construction or operation for rapid anomaly detection.
assignees: POWERCHINA KUNMING ENG CORP LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER UPSTREAM HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent algorithm-based high-voltage transmission line safety assessment method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system safety, and discloses a high-voltage transmission line safety assessment method based on an intelligent algorithm; the method comprises the steps of constructing a database through multi-source data acquisition and fusion processing, analyzing the relevance of meteorological conditions and an icing formation mechanism by using a deep learning model, excavating an evolution rule of the correlation, carrying out multi-scene simulation and sensitivity analysis by combining physical characteristics and topographic information of a power transmission line, and establishing a line icing risk partition assessment system. According to the method, the mechanical strength and the ice coating thickness critical value of a circuit are calculated based on a mechanical model, a grading early warning threshold standard is formulated, a time sequence prediction algorithm and a risk propagation model are constructed to realize intelligent early warning, and an anti-icing resource optimal allocation and self-adaptive generation of a deicing scheme are adopted to form an anti-icing strategy. The invention effectively improves the capacity of the high-voltage transmission line for resisting ice coating disasters and enhances the safe and stable operation level of the power grid.

title_en: Tunnel composite catastrophe intelligent early warning method and system based on tendency digital twin
abstract_en: The invention provides a tunnel composite catastrophe intelligent early warning method and system based on tendency digital twinning, which belong to the technical field of tunnel gushing water data processing and analysis and comprise the steps of obtaining three-dimensional point cloud data of a tunnel structure and design parameters of the tunnel structure, and constructing a digital twinning model based on the three-dimensional point cloud data of the tunnel structure and the design parameters; the method comprises the steps of collecting monitoring data in a tunnel structure in real time, integrating the collected data into a digital twin model, modeling space-time characteristics of the monitoring data in the tunnel structure collected in real time by utilizing a space-time diagram convolution network, outputting a space-time characteristic matrix, namely generating space-time characteristic representation of catastrophe factors, inputting the space-time characteristic representation of the catastrophe factors into a Bayesian network, wherein the Bayesian network is used for further modeling dependency relations among different catastrophe factors to calculate disaster occurrence probability, and the digital twin model identifies a region of potential disasters in the tunnel based on the calculated disaster occurrence probability.

title_en: Method for calculating vulnerability of debris flow to impact pile foundation of power transmission tower based on SPH-FEM coupling method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for calculating vulnerability of a debris flow impact power transmission tower pile foundation based on an SPH-FEM coupling method, which comprises the following steps of (1) obtaining relevant parameter information of debris flow and basic information of a power transmission tower foundation and a foundation within threat range of the relevant parameter information, (2) establishing a finite element calculation model of the debris flow impact power transmission tower foundation by using ABAQUS software, calculating impact force of the pile foundation under different debris flow parameters, establishing fitting relation between the debris flow parameters and the impact force, (3) establishing a reliability calculation model of the debris flow impact pile foundation, defining damage grade of the power transmission tower, and (4) calculating statistical rules of the power transmission tower foundation under different damage states by using a Monte Carlo random sampling calculation method, and obtaining reliable indexes of the power transmission tower foundation and distribution rules of failure probability about the debris flow velocity. The method has important significance for preventing and controlling the debris flow disasters of the power transmission line, evaluating risks and early warning, and has wide application prospect.
assignees: MCC WUKAN ENGINEERING TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Stay wire space safety early warning method based on three-dimensional topographic data
abstract_en: The invention provides a stay wire space safety pre-warning method based on three-dimensional topographic data, and relates to the technical field of power transmission line construction safety. The method comprises the steps of obtaining point cloud, combining a BIM model to complete three-dimensional coordinate fusion, constructing a multi-body dynamics and finite element model, calculating tension and safety coefficients, extracting minimum distance between a stay wire and an obstacle by adopting a hierarchical bounding box method, collecting tension and gesture by using a key position layout sensor, fusing simulation and actual measurement data, estimating a structural state by Kalman filtering, evaluating a safety level, giving early warning and adjustment advice, displaying a stress vector and a risk thermodynamic diagram on a three-dimensional platform, establishing a real-time monitoring mechanism, an abnormal automatic pushing scheme, and constructing a fault tree and a Bayesian network to identify disaster factors and fault paths. The invention realizes the integrated assessment of the wire pulling space and the stress safety, improves the detection precision and the intelligent early warning capability, and is suitable for multiple scenes of iron tower construction and operation and maintenance.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;YANCHENG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for constructing power grid icing scene library
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid icing disaster prediction, in particular to a power grid icing situation library construction method and device, comprising the steps of obtaining predetermined icing influence factor corresponding historical data and icing intensity historical data; the method comprises the steps of taking a group of preset ice coating influence factor corresponding historical data and ice coating intensity historical data as an ice coating scene, clustering all ice coating scenes, constructing a clustering cluster into an ice coating scene Jing Ku, taking the clustering center of the clustering cluster as scene description of the ice coating scene Jing Ku, generating different ice coating scenes by adopting a Monte Carlo simulation algorithm, classifying all the ice coating scenes, and adding the classified ice coating scenes to corresponding ice coating scenes Jing Ku. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, the power grid icing condition Jing Ku based on the artificial intelligence algorithm is established, the double breakthrough of the terrain quantization precision and the system dynamic property is realized, and the comprehensiveness, the accuracy and the practicability of the icing condition Jing Ku are improved.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER ENGINEERING RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Operational resilience scenario simulation
abstract_en: Simulation for business continuity includes querying a scenario repository for a specific adverse event and responding to the query by selecting and retrieving from the repository infrastructure element objects that are associated with the specific adverse event. The simulation executes a Monte Carlo scenario test of the infrastructure element objects across a range of the susceptibility values through the computation of an average of the susceptibility values for each infrastructure element object for randomly selected different degrees of severity of the event. The simulation additionally executes a recovery simulation of the infrastructure element objects across a range of recovery times by computing an average recovery time for each infrastructure element object amongst the range of the recovery times. Finally, the simulation includes applying one or more loss value rules to the scenario tested and recovery simulated infrastructure element objects in order to produce a loss estimate for the target environment.

title_en: Landslide risk dynamic early warning method and system based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide risk dynamic early warning method and system based on a Bayesian network, which belong to the field of geological disaster intelligent prediction and comprise the steps of constructing a disaster causing factor data set, screening key factors based on a Pearson correlation coefficient and an information gain method, further utilizing an FP-Growth algorithm to extract association rules among high confidence factors, guiding the optimization of a Bayesian network structure, constructing a Bayesian network model with causal relationship, supporting an incremental learning mechanism based on a newly added landslide sample, dynamically updating a condition probability table, and combining a Bayesian forward reasoning result to realize landslide probability prediction and risk classification. The intelligent risk assessment and early warning system has the advantages of strong causal reasoning capability, high model structure expression capability, excellent prediction precision and support of real-time updating and risk partitioning, and is suitable for landslide disasters.

title_en: Typhoon path prediction method, system, terminal and storage medium of multi-mode data and antique model based on sounding equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of typhoon path prediction and discloses a typhoon path prediction method, a system, a terminal and a storage medium based on multi-mode data of a sounding device and a large model of the antique, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring multi-source heterogeneous data acquired by a sounding device related to typhoon prediction, fusing and adaptively enhancing the multi-source heterogeneous data based on the large model of the antique, and generating a high-resolution three-dimensional field; the method comprises the steps of constructing a cascading AI downscaling network, introducing a physical constraint layer, carrying out local refined modeling on a typhoon eye area according to the high-resolution three-dimensional field, outputting a high-resolution three-dimensional gas image field, designing a typhoon-environment field interaction model based on a graph neural network, carrying out typhoon prediction according to the high-resolution three-dimensional gas image field, and outputting typhoon path set prediction and typhoon thermodynamic structure analysis report containing a confidence interval. The method improves the speed and the precision of typhoon path prediction, reduces the prediction time and the prediction error, and saves the calculation resources.
assignees: GUANGDONG LABORATORY OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE AND DIGITAL ECONOMIC SHENZHEN

title_en: Knowledge graph-based multi-scale safety monitoring method for power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid multi-scale safety monitoring method and system based on a knowledge graph, and belongs to the technical field of operation and control of power systems. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source heterogeneous data of a power grid to construct a heterogeneous time sequence knowledge graph, calculating real-time Risk Propagation Indexes (RPIs) of nodes according to the current running state of the power grid, dynamically generating a self-adaptive multi-scale graph hierarchical structure based on the RPIs, performing state-aware space-time feature learning on each hierarchy to generate hierarchical state embedding, performing cross-scale causal inference on an embedded input prediction model to predict a future safety event sequence and a propagation path of the future safety event sequence, and finally generating a safety situation assessment report and a preventive control strategy. The method solves the problems of single analysis scale and solidification of a hierarchical structure in the prior art, realizes active and accurate prediction of the security situation of the power grid through a risk-driven dynamic multi-scale analysis framework, and remarkably improves the prediction and defending capacity of cascading failures.

title_en: Method and system for identifying generation and influence of sudden natural disaster fault scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying generation and influence of sudden natural disaster fault scenes, belonging to the technical field of disaster risk assessment and toughness modeling of an electric power system; the method comprises the steps of calculating damage probability of each node by combining with the geographical coordinates of the nodes, generating an initial fault set by using a Monte Carlo sampling method, defining a node state vector, performing fault cascade propagation simulation until the node state vector reaches a stable state, respectively identifying an electric power failure area, a communication uncontrolled area and a traffic blocking area, and outputting the initial fault set, the stable state and the three areas together as simulated disaster scene samples to finish identification. The invention solves the problems of difficult multi-network cascade fault propagation and system interruption identification under the influence of complex disasters, supports the automatic generation of samples and the accurate identification of disaster influence areas, provides data support for the follow-up, and can be used for the evaluation of multi-network fusion and resource scheduling.

title_en: Disaster prevention strategy determination method, device, equipment and medium for main-distribution network
abstract_en: The application discloses a disaster prevention strategy determination method, device, equipment and medium of a main-distribution network, relating to the technical field of power system elasticity evaluation and comprising the steps of determining a target topology model of a system based on a preset island balance strategy and topology information of the main network and the distribution network in a power system with the cooperation of the main-distribution network; the method comprises the steps of carrying out random fault scene generation based on a preset improved Monte Carlo algorithm, carrying out trend analysis and cascading fault simulation analysis of a fault scene based on a fault generation result and a target topology model, analyzing fault coupling conditions of a main-distribution network based on a fault scene analysis result, a system collapse threshold and a seepage theory, determining a critical threshold curve in a two-dimensional failure space, and determining a criticality index corresponding to each component in the main-distribution network and a comprehensive toughness evaluation index of the system based on the critical threshold curve to determine a target disaster prevention strategy. The application can identify critical conditions of the cooperative failure of the main-distribution network and identify weak links of the system, thereby enhancing the resistance of the system.
assignees: STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO;INST ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCES STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Environment-adaptive corn emasculation period disease and pest green prevention and control system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent agriculture and green plant protection, and discloses a system and a method for controlling plant diseases and insect pests in a corn emasculation period based on environmental adaptation, wherein the control system comprises an environmental simulation unit, a plant diseases and insect pests simulation database, a predictive analysis module, an early warning decision module and an acquisition unit, according to the invention, by constructing a nonlinear mapping model of five-dimensional environment vectors (temperature, humidity, illumination intensity, rainfall and wind speed) and pest activities and adopting multiple regression analysis and Monte Carlo simulation, pest occurrence probability distribution under different climatic situations is generated, the limitation of a single threshold model is effectively overcome, and the prediction reliability under a complex environment is obviously enhanced; the method can early warn the outbreak risk of the plant diseases and insect pests by 72 hours in advance, reduce disaster loss by at least 30%, reduce the dosage of chemical pesticides by more than 40% through a grading green prevention and control strategy, and protect the biological diversity of farmlands and the ecological health of soil.
assignees: CANGZHOU ACAD OF AGRICULTURE AND FORESTRY SCIENCES

title_en: Output optimization method, system, equipment and medium under complementary scheduling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for optimizing output under complementary scheduling, wherein the method acquires data of cascade hydropower, wind farms and optical electric farms, constructs a graph neural network based on geographic position data, configures weights of edges according to historical power generation data, nodes of the graph neural network represent fans, photovoltaic arrays and hydropower stations at different geographic positions, performs weather prediction according to current short-term weather data based on the constructed graph neural network, constructs an evaluation model based on double-layer Monte Carlo-condition risk, outputs probability density functions of output prediction according to the evaluation model, and performs output optimization. According to the invention, a graph neural network is established to capture the propagation condition of weather elements possibly existing in a non-uniform observation network, comprehensive evaluation of water, wind and light is realized by constructing an evaluation model, and a reference direction for short-term complementary output optimization is given by a probability density function, so that the scheduling effect of complementary optimization is improved.

title_en: Emergency rescue path planning method and system for self-adaptive risk avoidance
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency rescue path planning method and system for self-adaptive risk avoidance, which comprise the steps of establishing an emergency rescue path network structure, carrying out risk entropy driven self-adaptive Monte Carlo simulation analysis before an actual natural disaster comes, carrying out path information statistical analysis on Monte Carlo simulation results, establishing a pre-planned path library, temporarily setting up priori risk distribution of each planned path in the pre-planned path library when the actual natural disaster comes, carrying out dynamic correction on the priori risk distribution of each planned path in the emergency rescue process by adopting sequential Bayesian inference, carrying out dynamic planning on the emergency rescue path based on path posterior risk average values of each planned path after the sequential Bayesian inference, selecting an optimal rescue path and executing an emergency rescue task until the emergency rescue activity is ended. According to the invention, by means of the path dynamic adjustment strategy, the scattered transportation strategy, the path pre-planning strategy and the network-free communication strategy, the rescue resources can be ensured to efficiently and safely reach the target site in natural disaster scenes such as flood, typhoons and the like.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for analyzing satellite meteorological data of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for analyzing meteorological data of a power distribution network satellite, wherein the method comprises the following steps of acquiring multisource satellite meteorological data and preprocessing to generate a space-time continuous meteorological element distribution map; extracting disaster related features through a meteorological element distribution map, constructing a first calculation model to train the disaster related features, outputting disaster distribution confidence intervals, performing risk space mapping on the disaster distribution confidence intervals and a power distribution network topological structure to generate a tower overturning risk assessment result, building a multi-stage early warning mechanism through the tower overturning risk assessment result, generating a three-dimensional risk map and deploying mobile terminal application. According to the invention, through a multisource satellite data fusion preprocessing technology, the problem of space-time blind areas caused by a traditional single data source is effectively solved, the collaborative acquisition and space-time registration of stationary meteorological satellites, polar orbit meteorological satellites and radar data are realized, and the problems of different satellite system resolution differences and cloud noise interference are overcome.

title_en: Probabilistic hierarchical fault scene generation method for electric comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a probabilistic hierarchical fault scene generation method of an electric comprehensive energy system, which relates to the technical field of comprehensive energy system optimization and comprises the following steps of firstly, considering the uncertainty of earthquake intensity, dispersing a target earthquake magnitude range into a plurality of equidistant intervals and calculating the occurrence probability of earthquakes of different earthquake magnitudes; the method comprises the steps of modeling disaster causes of earthquakes of different earthquake levels by adopting a vulnerability curve, calculating expected values of damaged elements of a power distribution system and a natural gas system, then randomly generating a fault scene under each classified earthquake level by using a Monte Carlo method, carrying out simulation on cascading faults of an electric comprehensive energy system under the random fault scene, recording the total loss load of the system, and finally calculating average loss load under each classified earthquake level, selecting a typical fault scene and forming a classified fault scene set. The method quantifies the tail risk of the low-probability extreme event and provides a scene basis for the toughness promotion strategy formulation of the comprehensive energy system.

title_en: Embedded landslide real-time early warning method based on space-time feature decoupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses an embedded landslide real-time early warning method based on space-time feature decoupling, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent monitoring and early warning of geological disasters. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical time sequence monitoring data of a landslide body, constructing a training data set, performing space-time characteristic decoupling on the data, decomposing the data into a global component and a detail component, constructing a double-branch lightweight time sequence convolution network comprising the global branch and the detail branch, completing joint training and self-adaptive weight fusion at a cloud end, performing differential lightweight processing on the trained network, deploying the trained network in an embedded terminal, performing characteristic decoupling and prediction by utilizing a real-time data stream at the embedded end, obtaining a predicted value and uncertainty estimation by combining a lightweight Monte Carlo Dropout method, and finally realizing dynamic threshold calculation and hierarchical early warning. The method effectively solves the problem that the existing method is difficult to consider the prediction precision and the calculation efficiency at the embedded terminal, and achieves real-time, accurate and self-adaptive early warning of landslide disasters.

title_en: In-service bridge vulnerability analysis method considering extreme climate influence
abstract_en: The invention provides an in-service bridge vulnerability analysis method considering extreme climate influence, which comprises the steps of obtaining state data, a target extreme climate data set and historical disaster data of an in-service bridge, determining vulnerable key structural components of the in-service bridge under corresponding extreme climate according to the historical disaster data, determining a dominant failure mode, constructing an in-service bridge model containing parameter uncertainty according to the state data of the bridge, the vulnerable key structural components under the corresponding extreme climate and the dominant failure mode by adopting finite elements, inputting the target extreme climate data set into the in-service bridge model, and calculating probability distribution of bridge damage states of the key structural components at the second moment under different intensities through Monte Carlo simulation of a plurality of groups of random parameter samples to generate an extreme climate intensity-failure probability vulnerability curve. By implementing the method, the efficiency and the precision are effectively balanced, and the safety risk of the bridge under extreme weather is reduced.

title_en: AI building classification method based on multi-mode remote sensing and GIS data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AI building classification method based on multi-mode remote sensing and GIS data fusion, and relates to the technical field of building classification. The invention has the advantages of high integration and automatic operation of the whole flow, great reduction of links and time cost of manual intervention, remarkable improvement of data processing efficiency, and suitability for rapid building general investigation and updating tasks in large-scale urban areas, modular design and collaborative operation mechanism, successful realization of intelligent conversion from original multi-source data to high-value space information products, high-efficiency, reliable and sustainable technical support for accurate urban perception, dynamic monitoring and scientific decision, rapid generation of a high-precision building distribution map in disaster response, auxiliary evaluation of building fragility by combining three-dimensional structural features, precise positioning of high-risk areas, and reliable space information support for emergency resource allocation and evacuation planning.

title_en: Environment risk reasoning method and system based on environment-friendly intelligent management and control platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment risk reasoning method and system based on an environment-friendly intelligent management and control platform, comprising the following steps: and (3) searching historical environment risk examples based on the production attributes of the target industrial park, and extracting the characteristic analysis evolution process to generate a risk evolution characteristic set. And deep mining the cascade relation in the feature set, constructing a risk evolution feature domain and a risk cascade feature domain, and fusing the risk evolution feature domain and the risk cascade feature domain into an environmental risk knowledge graph. And establishing an inference model by utilizing the atlas, and deducing an environmental risk situation through real-time sensor data. And when the risk is identified, calling a preset strategy to perform Monte Carlo intervention simulation and optimize a regulation scheme. And constructing a regulation response network according to equipment layout, and identifying a weak area through efficiency characteristic analysis to generate a network optimization suggestion so as to realize closed-loop optimization of a management and control system. Thereby promoting the environment treatment to be converted from passive response to active prediction and from single-point control to system control, and improving the overall efficiency and the intelligent level of regional environment risk control.
assignees: DACHENG DEXIN TECH SHANXI CO LTD

title_en: Transfer line sequencing method considering economic and social effects of power loss load of distribution network after disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transfer line sequencing method considering economic and social effects of power loss load of a distribution network after disaster, belongs to the technical field of safety planning operation of power systems, and solves the problems that the traditional sequencing relies on manual/single indexes, is difficult to cope with fault uncertainty and lacks a standardized model. The method comprises the steps of calculating load recovery weights based on population density and unit load economic loss by using an improved analytic hierarchy process, simulating and generating a multi-fault scene by using Monte Carlo, building an optimization model by taking minimum economic and social losses as targets and combining a complex electricity means and scheduling constraint, solving the model to obtain switch operation time, and determining transfer priority by using Copride sequencing. The invention provides a scientific scheme for emergency decision of complex fault scenes, meets the requirement of rapidly making an optimal transfer strategy after disaster, and reduces economic and social losses.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for quantitatively evaluating regulation capability of power system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for quantitatively evaluating the regulating capacity of an electric power system, which comprise the steps of determining probability distribution of available regulating capacity of an adjustable resource based on failure outage of the adjustable resource, determining probability quality function of the available regulating capacity based on the probability distribution, determining expected and confidence intervals of the available regulating capacity based on the probability quality function, determining probability distribution of a net load fluctuation domain, determining expected and confidence intervals of net load fluctuation based on the probability distribution of the net load fluctuation domain, and quantitatively evaluating the regulating capacity of the electric power system based on the expected and confidence intervals of the available regulating capacity and the expected and confidence intervals of the net load fluctuation. Therefore, the accurate assessment of the adjustment capability of the power system can be realized, the assessment angle can be increased, and the comprehensiveness of the adjustment capability assessment is realized.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ECONOMIC RES INST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;SICHUAN ENERGY INTERNET RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF TSINGHUA UNIV

title_en: Full life cycle management method for mountain highway electromechanical equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full life cycle management method of mountain highway electromechanical equipment, which relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic infrastructure management and comprises the steps of inputting a standardized equipment operation data set into a Bayesian network evaluation framework, analyzing posterior probability of each node under the dynamic constraint of environmental parameters through a multi-level fault propagation path, generating an equipment health evaluation report, fusing equipment control execution state records with historical electromechanical equipment operation data, constructing an equipment full life cycle degradation curve through space-time correlation analysis, extracting trend characteristics, separating signals, and generating an equipment full life cycle analysis report. The invention improves pertinence and timeliness of maintenance decision making, and realizes fine monitoring and prediction of the full-period operation performance of the equipment, thereby providing reliable basis for scientifically making maintenance plan, reducing full-life period cost and prolonging the service life of the equipment.

title_en: Dynamic evaluation method and system for investment benefit of power distribution network infrastructure project based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic evaluation method and a system for investment benefits of a power distribution network infrastructure project based on multi-source data fusion, which relate to the technical field of power distribution network evaluation and provide a reliable data basis for evaluation by eliminating data heterogeneity and quality problems through multi-source data preprocessing; the method comprises the steps of selecting a key feature, screening focus core influencing factors, reducing redundant information interference, accurately quantifying nonlinear relation and causal path between the key feature and comprehensive benefit by means of gray correlation analysis and a Bayesian network model, improving scientificity and suitability of an evaluation model, simultaneously combining additive interpretation value analysis to verify evaluation logic rationality, enabling a decision maker to clearly understand driving factors of investment benefit, effectively solving the defect of insufficient evaluation accuracy caused by weak data base, fuzzy core factors and inaccurate association relation depiction in dynamic evaluation of investment benefit of a power distribution network infrastructure project, realizing span from static evaluation to dynamic decision support, and remarkably improving the accuracy of an evaluation result.

title_en: E-SOP and mobile emergency power source collaborative multi-feeder power grid optimal scheduling method under extreme disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-feeder power grid optimization scheduling method for cooperation of E-SOP and a mobile emergency power supply under extreme disasters, belongs to the technical field of power grid scheduling, and aims to solve the technical problems that the power grid cannot realize multi-feeder cooperation optimization scheduling of E-SOP and the mobile emergency power supply under extreme disasters by adopting a Batts typhoon wind field model to calculate wind speed change at each position and building an element vulnerability curve to obtain a time-varying failure rate of a power transmission line, generating a failure scene by using a Monte Carlo method, building a mobile emergency power supply pre-layout double-layer game optimization model to determine the quantity capacity and candidate connection positions of the emergency power supply, building an E-SOP operation constraint model to realize coordination of energy storage charge and discharge and converter power output, formulating mobile emergency power supply scheduling constraint and line maintenance constraint to ensure reasonable resource allocation and finally determining a mobile emergency power supply capacity position optimal allocation scheme.

title_en: Medical service flow iterative decision method and system based on multi-source feedback information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical service flow iterative decision method and system based on multi-source feedback information, wherein the method comprises the steps of S01 obtaining multi-source feedback information of all links of a medical service flow to obtain service satisfaction degree scores and service quality scores, S02 modeling the medical service flow into a dynamic Bayesian network model, calculating emotion values after state transfer by using an emotion transfer function and quantifying transfer effects by using emotion transfer coefficients, training to obtain a time sequence cascade model, S03 adjusting feedback information weights according to deviation between expert evaluation reference data and the satisfaction degree scores, S04 carrying out iterative solution on a multi-objective optimization function, and predicting satisfaction degree variation under different medical service flows by using the time sequence cascade model in the solving process to obtain an optimal medical service flow scheme. The medical service system and the medical service method can optimize the service efficiency and the resource utilization rate of medical service and improve the medical experience of patients.

title_en: Cascade hydropower station accident evolution key node and path identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade hydropower station accident evolution key node and path identification method, which comprises the steps of collecting basic data of a target cascade hydropower station, preprocessing data of the cascade hydropower station accident text, determining association relations among accident factors, classifying, constructing a cascade hydropower station accident evolution network model by adopting a complex network method, constructing an accident propagation probability model by combining network topology characteristics and accident factor point mutual information indexes, calculating the cascade hydropower station accident propagation probability by combining a Bayesian network, operating the cascade hydropower station accident evolution network model, identifying a key path in accident propagation, introducing a node recovery function, and identifying the key node in accident propagation. The key risk nodes and the evolution paths thereof in the emergency process of the cascade hydropower station accidents can be accurately identified, the risk management and control precision of the cascade hydropower station is improved, the risk of cascade accident diffusion is reduced, and the overall safety management and control level is improved.

title_en: Power distribution network cascading failure prediction and failure defense method, system, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, and discloses a method, a system, equipment, a medium and a product for predicting and defending cascading faults of a power distribution network, wherein the method determines the fault probability of target equipment of the power distribution network through environmental data of the power distribution network when typhoon disasters occur, constructs a dynamic Bayesian network based on a power supply chain according to a power supply chain and a fault propagation path of the power distribution network, predicts the predicted probability state distribution of the power supply chain at the future time by using the dynamic Bayesian network, and according to the predicted probability state distribution, the predicted cascade fault propagation probability of the power supply chain is determined, the power distribution network fault defense optimization problem is converted into a Markov decision process problem, and according to the predicted probability state distribution and the predicted cascade fault propagation probability, the Markov decision process problem is solved based on a deep reinforcement learning algorithm, so that an optimal fault defense strategy is obtained, and the power distribution network is effectively defended against faults.
assignees: FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Intelligent dividing method for coal mine multi-disaster risk areas based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent dividing method of a coal mine multi-disaster risk area based on a graph neural network, which comprises the following steps of collecting multi-disaster monitoring data and space structure information to form original monitoring data, constructing a composite graph structure based on the original monitoring data, obtaining directional input through directional association according to the composite graph structure, introducing Hodge-Laplacian directional information transmission mechanism based on the directional input to obtain an edge state updating result, converging the edge state updating result to corresponding connection nodes to output node states, generating enhanced node representation based on the node states in a fusing mode, constructing an anisotropic thermonuclear diffusion graph model to generate a multi-disaster risk propagation graph, carrying out normalization and threshold division according to node scores according to the multi-disaster risk propagation graph, and outputting a coal mine multi-disaster risk area dividing graph layer with continuous boundaries. The invention realizes the intelligent division of the multi-disaster risk areas of the coal mine.

title_en: Multi-factor dynamic coupling geological disaster monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a multi factor dynamically coupled geological hazard monitoring and early warning method, which belongs to the field of geological hazard monitoring and early warning technology. In response to the problems of traditional methods being unable to fuse multiple factors in real time, low early warning accuracy, and delayed response, a multi-source sensor network is deployed to collect dynamic triggering factor data, combined with static background factors of the geological environment to construct a susceptibility evaluation model. Time series analysis is used to calculate dynamic weights, and dynamic Bayesian networks are used for coupling analysis to output geological hazard risk probability values in real time, thereby triggering corresponding warning levels and emergency responses. This method is mainly used for real-time monitoring, precise risk assessment, and timely early warning of geological hazards.
assignees: CHINA HIGHWAY ENG CONSULTANTS CORP;Zhongzi data co ltd

title_en: Comprehensive evaluation method for weak links of power system related to multidimensional indexes in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive evaluation method for weak links of an electric power system, which relates to multidimensional indexes in extreme weather. Firstly, a multidimensional index system comprising safety and optimized operability is established, wherein the multidimensional index system comprises line outage probability, load loss probability, electric energy deficiency expectation, line overload rate and network loss rate. And secondly, constructing a line fault model and a cascading fault model in extreme storm weather, describing the fault probability change by combining a Gaussian function and Weibull distribution, and simulating line sectional failure by using Poisson distribution. And calculating the system state after the fault through a direct current optimal power flow model, and acquiring a large amount of simulation data by combining a non-sequential Monte Carlo method. Further, subjective and objective weights are calculated by a fuzzy analytic hierarchy process and a CRITIC process respectively, subjective and objective comprehensive evaluation is realized by weighting fusion, and weak links of the system are identified. The method has the advantages of evaluating scientificity and calculating efficiency, and is suitable for real-time risk evaluation and weak link identification of a large-scale power system in extreme weather.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method for evaluating bearing capacity of power distribution network on newly-added electric vehicle charging facility
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the bearing capacity of a power distribution network to a newly-added electric vehicle charging facility, and belongs to the technical field of power system planning and operation; the method comprises the steps of firstly collecting distribution facility capacity, load and charging facility charging power of three levels of distribution transformer, circuit and transformer substation, setting a plurality of development scenes of electric vehicles according to the distribution facility capacity and load, secondly setting probability distribution of charging start time and daily driving mileage compliance of the vehicles, obtaining charging start time and daily driving mileage of the electric vehicles under different development scenes by using a Monte Carlo sampling method, extracting maximum daily charging load of the electric vehicle charging facilities, then calculating superimposed load and remaining capacity of the distribution facilities under each scene, and finally accurately calculating bearing capacity of the three levels of distribution facilities on newly-added electric vehicle charging facilities by using an interpolation method. The invention realizes accurate and efficient assessment of the bearing capacity of the power distribution network and provides effective decision support for scientific planning of charging infrastructure and safe operation of the power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD TAIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Method for evaluating toughness of receiving-end power grid considering frequency stability under typhoon disaster and related equipment thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a receiving end power grid toughness assessment method considering frequency stability under typhoon disasters and relevant equipment thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of responding to a receiving end power grid toughness assessment request, locating an area and acquiring historical typhoon data; the method comprises the steps of establishing typhoon scenes based on data fitting probability distribution and sampling, establishing a typhoon scene model by combining data and a gradient wind balance equation, generating a fault scene under each typhoon scene by combining Monte Carlo sampling according to the influence mechanism of the typhoon scene model on a power grid element, calculating the total instantaneous power deficiency of a system, establishing and simplifying a frequency deviation model by taking a system toughness assessment index as output and combining power deficiency to obtain a system frequency response deviation model, establishing an optimal frequency response optimization model with a minimum toughness index as a target by traversing scenes, solving the optimal frequency response optimization model, calculating the overall toughness assessment index of the system, establishing by using the typhoon scene and an influence mechanism, assessing the frequency stability under extreme weather by using one-time frequency modulation frequency drop integral, reflecting the frequency accumulation deviation, and accurately assessing the resistance capability of the system.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Multi-objective optimization decision system for whole life cycle of pole tower in typhoon disaster scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-objective optimization decision system for a whole life cycle of a pole tower in a typhoon disaster scene, which relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of the pole tower, and comprises a multi-source data acquisition, analysis and construction, calculation risk assessment, multi-objective optimization decision and block chain coordination module, wherein the multi-objective optimization decision and block chain coordination module acquires information by using satellites, unmanned aerial vehicles and sensors, and realizes completion and standardization through federal learning and generation of an countermeasure network; the method comprises the steps of generating a fault probability result through data driving and mechanism model double-channel fusion, deducing a dynamic updating risk by combining Monte Carlo and Bayesian in a risk assessment stage, outputting a survival rate thermodynamic diagram and collapse probability distribution, generating a reinforcement scheme, a rush repair path and a recovery time sequence by adopting an improved NSGA-III algorithm in an optimization decision stage, realizing reliable linkage by a blockchain coordination module through distributed account book and knowledge map reasoning, and realizing second-level response by combining multi-level early warning and edge calculation. And closed-loop management of data fusion, risk assessment and emergency coordination is realized.

title_en: Legal contract risk monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a legal contract risk monitoring and early warning method, which particularly relates to the technical field of risk early warning, and aims to construct a multi-contract risk propagation network by identifying propagation clauses in a plurality of legal contract texts, generate a multi-contract propagation path topology network model by adopting a graph theory algorithm, output a cascade trigger mechanism for identifying inter-contract risk propagation clauses by utilizing time sequence causal analysis, obtain propagation path sensitivity grading data by carrying out sensitivity grading on each risk propagation path, integrate the cascade risk propagation links and the propagation path sensitivity grading data, construct a contract network risk propagation comprehensive assessment model, output a comprehensive risk assessment result, and compare the comprehensive risk assessment result with a preset risk early warning threshold rule to generate corresponding risk prompt information.

title_en: Uncertainty landslide displacement prediction method based on TCN-Attention-EWT
abstract_en: The invention discloses an uncertainty landslide displacement prediction method based on TCN-Attention-EWT, and belongs to the field of intelligent prediction of geological disasters. The method comprises the steps of obtaining slope history monitoring data and normalizing, constructing a GRU deterministic prediction model to conduct displacement prediction and generate an error sequence, decomposing the error sequence into a low-frequency system error and a high-frequency random error by adopting a TCN-Attention-EWT combined method, respectively establishing a GRU error correction sub-model with Monte Carlo Dropout, calculating probability distribution dynamic fusion weights of the low-frequency system error and the high-frequency random error correction based on an information theory, fusing a deterministic prediction value with probability distribution of the two correction values, and obtaining a final displacement prediction mean value and a prediction interval through inverse normalization. The method realizes high-precision prediction and uncertainty quantification of landslide displacement and provides reliable technical support for landslide early warning.
assignees: YIBIN VOCATIONAL & TECHNICAL COLLEGE;YIBIN JIABO INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster emergency decision method and system based on self-adaptive generation type AI
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster emergency decision method and a system based on self-adaptive generation type AI, belonging to the technical field of geological disaster emergency response and artificial intelligence intersection, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, data acquisition and preprocessing; S2, landslide segmentation and uncertainty quantification, S3, feature extraction and uncertainty gating, S4, high confidence report Prompt construction, S5, low confidence retrieval enhancement processing, S6, final report generation and output, S7, active learning and model iteration. The geological disaster emergency decision method based on the self-adaptive generation type AI is used for realizing high-efficiency analysis, omitting emergency labeling and retraining cost, improving the reliability of a report, combining an external professional knowledge base which can be dynamically maintained, and enabling a power assisting system to self-evolve, so that the identification accuracy and robustness are continuously improved, and the low confidence coefficient target is reduced.

title_en: Method for predicting instability volume of reservoir side slope deformation body
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting the instability volume of a reservoir bank slope deformation body, which comprises the steps of respectively obtaining surface displacement and rock mass internal deformation data through a millimeter wave radar and an inclination angle sensor, and identifying a key deformation area and generating a data set after processing through a self-adaptive noise decomposition algorithm. And carrying out space-time alignment on the data by utilizing the engineering coordinate system and the topological relation to generate a fusion matrix. And reconstructing a potential slip surface geometric model by combining the slip surface characteristics of the historical cases, and calculating the instability volume probability distribution by adopting Monte Carlo simulation. And finally, inputting the multidimensional data into a space-time prediction model, and outputting a destabilization volume prediction result with probability distribution. The method can improve the accuracy and reliability of the prediction result, and provide scientific basis and technical support for safety monitoring and disaster early warning of the bank side slope.
assignees: POWERCHINA KUNMING ENG CORP LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER UPSTREAM HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Individual trip and charging demand deducing method based on mobile phone signaling data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of intelligent transportation and big data analysis, and particularly discloses an individual trip and charging demand deducing method based on mobile phone signaling data, which comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring original mobile phone signaling data of an operator, and filtering noise through a preprocessing module; the method comprises the steps of S2, judging moving points and stay points of cleaned data, dividing a single-day travel section of a user, S3, extracting a constant travel track through two DBSCAN clusters and Hausdorff distance, S4, combining historical travel frequencies of the user, splicing to generate a typical single-day travel chain, S5, calculating energy consumption of each travel section through an energy consumption modeling module, updating a battery SOC, and S6, calculating charging events through Monte Carlo simulation, and outputting space-time distribution of potential charging demands of the electric automobile. The individual trip and charging demand deducing method based on the mobile phone signaling data solves the problem of traditional dependence on existing charging facility data, improves potential demand identification and planning response capability, and provides support for scientific layout of urban charging infrastructure.

title_en: Method, equipment and storage medium for acquiring toughness improvement strategy of power distribution network
abstract_en: A method, equipment and storage medium for obtaining a toughness promotion strategy of a power distribution network are used for obtaining the toughness promotion strategy of the power distribution network for strong random and high-influence meteorological events and are applied to the technical field of evaluation and construction of a toughness power system, and comprise the following steps of calculating fault probability of a power distribution line from information such as meteorological data and reinforcing a high-probability line; generating a fault scene based on a Monte Carlo simulation method, taking the minimum configuration cost of an emergency vehicle and a distributed power supply and the minimum total cost at the time of disaster as an objective function of a pre-disaster toughness lifting strategy, taking the minimum loss load cost and the minimum total cost of power generation resources as an objective function of disaster resistance and recovery stages, drawing a performance curve of the power distribution network, and analyzing toughness indexes of the power distribution network. According to the invention, the line reinforcement, the distributed energy allocation and the emergency vehicle allocation are used as toughness lifting means, the optimization problem is solved to obtain an optimal scheme, the power supply capacity of the distribution network under extreme disasters is ensured, pre-disaster early warning and disaster emergency scheme making of the distribution network are facilitated, and the anti-vulnerability of the distribution network is improved.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Accident cause tracing early warning method and system based on accident tree and Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention provides an accident cause tracing early warning method and system based on an accident tree and a Bayesian network, comprising the steps of constructing an accident tree model, utilizing a predefined mapping relation to convert the accident tree model into a Bayesian network model, acquiring the prior probability of each leaf node, acquiring the prior probability of each intermediate node based on a conditional probability table and the prior probability of each leaf node corresponding to each intermediate node, acquiring the prior probability of each root node based on the conditional probability table and the prior probability of each root node by utilizing the occurrence probability of each intermediate node, carrying out early warning by utilizing the occurrence probability of the root node in the Bayesian network model, fusing the logic sharpness of the accident tree with the bidirectional reasoning advantage of the Bayesian network, accurately positioning the disaster source, quantifying the influence weight of each cause factor, and providing scientific and effective disaster prevention, control and emergency management decision basis for a coal mine.
assignees: XIAN BOSSUN SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle reinforcement learning path planning method integrating dynamic uncertainty perception
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle reinforcement learning path planning method integrating dynamic uncertainty perception, which belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous path planning and comprises the steps of constructing a city low-altitude simulation environment, calculating an unmanned aerial vehicle estimated position and an uncertainty matrix based on the city low-altitude simulation environment, constructing a 3D Gaussian probability distribution according to the unmanned aerial vehicle estimated position and the uncertainty matrix, calculating the collision probability of an unmanned aerial vehicle by combining Monte Carlo sampling, calculating rewards according to the collision probability of the unmanned aerial vehicle, maximizing accumulated entropy reinforcement rewards by adopting a strategy pi, and performing strategy learning by utilizing a Soft Actor-Critic, and further outputting an unmanned aerial vehicle path planning optimal control instruction. The method focuses on the urban complex environment, integrates dynamic uncertainty perception and reinforcement learning technologies, solves the problems of unmanned aerial vehicle positioning errors, obstacle collision risks and the like, realizes safe and efficient path planning, and is suitable for unmanned aerial vehicle application scenes requiring autonomous navigation, such as logistics transportation, post-disaster search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Risk early warning method and system for low-temperature rain, snow and freezing weather disasters
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent early warning and discloses a risk early warning method and system for low-temperature rain, snow and freezing weather disasters, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source data and constructing a heterogeneous diagram; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing data to obtain training and reasoning samples, constructing a graph neural network on a heterogeneous graph, carrying out joint learning on node time sequence characteristics and side relations to obtain graph representations representing cold air invasion, rain and snow zone movement and risk propagation delay, outputting road table temperature evolution, icing threshold arrival time and wire icing growth rate based on the physical guiding neural network, fusing characteristics obtained by the graph neural network with characteristics obtained by the physical guiding neural network, outputting asset-level risk scores and confidence intervals thereof, obtaining expected arrival time, and establishing early warning according to prediction results and observation results. The application provides finer and more reliable grading risk early warning, and improves the accuracy, the interpretability and the practicability of early warning.
assignees: HENAN METEOROLOGICAL OBSERVATORY YELLOW RIVER BASIN METEOROLOGICAL CENTER HENAN ENV METEOROLOGICAL F

title_en: Coal mine gas risk virtual deduction early warning method and system based on multi-source information fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal mine gas risk virtual deduction early warning method and system based on multi-source information fusion, and belongs to the technical field of gas risk early warning. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting geological, mining and environmental multisource data, carrying out preprocessing and feature extraction, fusing to construct a high-dimensional risk feature vector, then driving a virtual working face system comprising mining, ventilation and gas emission intelligent agents to evolve by the vector, adopting a Monte Carlo tree search algorithm to prospectively deduce future multistep states, calculating risk entropy of each path, finally generating a dynamic risk probability map based on the deduction result, and solving a Pareto optimal decision set considering safety, efficiency and economy through multi-objective optimization. The invention realizes the transition from passive monitoring to active early warning of gas risk, effectively solves the problem of early warning hysteresis, and provides advanced and accurate scientific decision support for gas disaster prevention and control through risk visualization and space positioning.
assignees: WANBEI COAL ELECTRICITY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method for analyzing inherent relevance among multi-disaster-species disaster-causing factors
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of natural disaster risk assessment, in particular to an inherent relevance analysis method between multi-disaster-causing factors, which comprises four steps of data preprocessing, bayesian network relevance model construction, space-time dynamic evolution analysis and risk early warning threshold model, and realizes the deep coupling analysis of the multi-disaster-causing factors such as torrent-mud-rock flow and the like. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting 17 disaster factor data of terrain, precipitation and the like, analyzing the dimension reduction through a kernel principal component, calculating dynamic weights by adopting an entropy method, then constructing a Bayesian network model quantization conditional probability association, introducing a space-time attention mechanism to optimize multi-scale coupling weights, and finally establishing a coupling risk early warning threshold and outputting a correlation intensity matrix. The method solves the problem that the traditional single disaster analysis method can not capture the time-space linkage effect of the disaster causing factors, improves the early warning accuracy of multi-disaster risk, and provides scientific decision support for regional disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Associated infrastructure toughness performance analysis method based on fault tree and dynamic Bayesian network and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a fault tree and dynamic Bayesian network-based related infrastructure toughness performance analysis method and a storage medium, which belong to the technical field of urban key infrastructure evaluation, and are technically characterized in that S100, key infrastructure systems related to a target building or a target community are identified, and each key infrastructure system determines the key component composition; and S200, obtaining the failure probability of each key infrastructure system in a non-disaster scene by using a fault tree analysis model, and S300, calculating the toughness performance of the disaster scene curve and the recovery strategy scene curve by adopting a dynamic Bayesian network. By adopting the technical scheme of the application, the quantitative output of the toughness performance is realized under the conditions of disaster situations and recovery strategies.

title_en: SOP (system on a chip) site selection and volume determination method, system, equipment and medium based on multi-disaster chain coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of toughness optimization of power systems, and discloses a SOP (system on demand) site selection and volume determination method, system, equipment and medium based on multi-disaster chain coupling, which comprises the steps of establishing a time-varying dynamic fault model through a meteorological physical coupling mechanism and associating a typhoon path, an icing growth process and a line fault rate; the method comprises the steps of carrying out Monte Carlo disaster chain simulation, simulating a line cascade failure process under extreme weather, recording node voltage deviation and load reduction, carrying out multidimensional sensitive node evaluation based on Monte Carlo simulation results, outputting a sensitive node list, establishing a multi-objective optimization model by taking sensitive nodes as candidate positions, and solving an SOP optimal site and volume-fixing scheme by adopting a second-order cone planning algorithm. The method realizes the full-chain technology closed loop from meteorological data acquisition and sensitive node identification to flexible resource regulation and control, and achieves the purposes of improving the toughness and reliability of the system and optimizing the operation strategy of the power distribution system.

title_en: Assessment method and system considering forced outage and station service electricity equivalent capacity
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation method considering forced outage and plant electricity equivalent capacity, which comprises the steps of obtaining original load data, setting electricity consumption simulation times, obtaining a probability density function through the original load data and the electricity consumption simulation times, calculating a demand response capacity and a response load curve according to the response degree, judging whether the set electricity consumption simulation times are reached, taking the demand response capacity and the response load curve as random samples when the set electricity consumption simulation times are reached, calculating a demand response capacity confidence interval, outputting a calculation result, obtaining an interval evaluation index of the load curve after response by using interval number operation, and providing a reference basis for more scientifically evaluating the effect of demand response.

title_en: Comprehensive energy system scheduling method considering dynamic cascade and fault chain reaction
abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive energy system scheduling method considering dynamic cascade and fault cascade reaction, and belongs to the technical field of energy. The method comprises the steps of constructing a constraint model of the comprehensive energy system based on an equipment model, a dynamic operation constraint model, a coupling constraint model and a pipe network transmission inertia model of the comprehensive energy system, constructing an objective function considering economy, new energy consumption rate, environmental protection, flexibility and reliability based on a flexibility index calculation model and a reliability index calculation model of the comprehensive energy system, optimizing operation parameters of the comprehensive energy system based on an optimization objective and the objective function, calculating flexibility indexes and reliability indexes of the comprehensive energy system under any operation parameter based on a Monte Carlo method and a space-time chain reaction relation, and scheduling the comprehensive energy system based on an objective function value of the comprehensive energy system under the operation parameter and a target value of the operation parameter. The invention can obtain the scheduling effect considering economy, new energy consumption rate, environmental protection, flexibility and reliability.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Water-wind-light-hydrogen combined system collaborative scheduling method based on ecological value accounting
abstract_en: The water-wind-light-hydrogen combined system collaborative scheduling method based on ecological value accounting respectively establishes an ecological service value assessment model, quantifies the ecological value of each energy main body through indexes such as ecological flow guarantee, carbon emission reduction and the like, establishes an ecological footprint model of a multi-energy complementary system, establishes an ecological bearing capacity assessment model in combination with regional resource environment capacity, predicts the output of a wind power plant and a photovoltaic power station by adopting Monte Carlo simulation in combination with a K-means clustering algorithm, establishes an output operation model of a cascade hydropower station and an electrolytic hydrogen production system, establishes a double-layer collaborative scheduling optimization model, solves the double-layer collaborative scheduling optimization model by adopting an NSGA-II multi-objective optimization algorithm, and obtains a Pareto optimal solution set through non-dominant sequencing and crowding degree calculation to obtain an optimal scheduling scheme which takes both ecological benefit and economic benefit into consideration. The method solves the problem that the traditional scheduling method is difficult to consider ecological protection and economic benefit by quantifying the ecological benefit of the renewable energy system and constructing an ecological-economic cooperative optimization model.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD;UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU

title_en: Power grid cascading failure probability risk assessment method considering transformer mixed failure
abstract_en: The application discloses a power grid cascading failure probability risk assessment method considering a transformer mixed failure, which comprises the steps of S1, system data acquisition, S2, life end failure modeling, S3, weather related random failure modeling, S4, current related overload protection power failure model building, S5, transformer mixed failure probability model building, S6, double-cycle non-sequence Monte Carlo simulation and S7, reliability index calculation. The power grid cascading failure probability risk assessment method considering the transformer mixed failure integrates life-end failure, weather-related random failure and current-related overload protection outage into a joint outage probability, iteratively updates unavailability of the rest equipment in NMC under new current/new temperature, explicitly simulates cascading propagation, quantitatively outputs EENS, PLC, PCFE indexes, and provides a determinable basis for planning and asset management.
assignees: SUZHOU ELECTRICAL APPLIANCE SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Security and protection fire-fighting integrated linkage system and method based on multidimensional sensing
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of intersection of computer technology and intelligent security and fire protection, discloses a security and fire protection integrated linkage method and system based on multidimensional sensing, and aims to solve the problems of isolated security and fire protection system data, single sensing dimension, delayed linkage response and difficulty in studying and judging composite risk events in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of fusing security, fire and three-dimensional space structure data, constructing a unified space-time situation map, identifying abnormal event clusters by utilizing a graph neural network, judging event types by a multi-mode classifier, predicting event evolution trend by combining a risk propagation model, and dynamically generating an integrated collaborative treatment instruction set to drive security and fire equipment to carry out linkage. The system comprises five modules of multidimensional sensing acquisition, data fusion, intelligent research and judgment, strategy generation and linkage execution. The method and the system realize data depth fusion, accurate identification of the compound event, active risk prediction and closed loop cooperative treatment, and remarkably improve the intelligentization and cooperative efficiency of safety response.

title_en: Fault propagation analysis and root cause identification method for early design stage of complex system
