abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault propagation analysis and root cause identification method for an early design stage of a complex system, which comprises the steps of developing failure modes and influence analysis, identifying potential failure modes and fault characterization of the complex system, determining a fault propagation path through fault tree analysis, quantifying causal strength of fault propagation by using a Bayesian network, fusing elements, the fault propagation Bayesian network and the fault characterization, developing causal enhanced multi-layer Bayesian networks for quantifying probability mapping relations between component fault modes and the fault characterization, providing two importance models based on the multi-layer Bayesian networks, namely cascading failure Birnbaum importance and element Birnbaum importance, respectively identifying key root causes and key components, and constructing a fault characteristic probability matrix based on the analysis. The invention can effectively identify the weak links of the complex system and identify the potential fault propagation paths and the root causes of the faults.

title_en: Pre-deployment robust optimization method and system for electric bus before disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pre-deployment robust optimization method and system before electric bus disaster, and belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of electric power systems. The method comprises the steps of obtaining power grid, bus, load and disaster prediction data, adopting Monte Carlo simulation to generate a fault scene set, establishing a robust optimization model aiming at minimizing system load shedding, considering electric bus operation, dispatching, scheduling constraint and power distribution network system constraint, describing line fault uncertainty by constructing a reinforced confidence set, and adopting a C & CG decomposition algorithm solution model to obtain an optimal pre-deployment scheme. The invention effectively solves the problems of inflexible deployment and high cost of the traditional fixed energy storage in post-disaster recovery, and remarkably improves the post-disaster recovery speed and the elasticity level of the power distribution network and reduces the economic loss of power failure while ensuring normal public transportation service by utilizing the mobile energy storage characteristic of the electric public transportation.

title_en: Method for predicting lightning strike fault probability of power transmission line based on lightning meteorological information and evaluating reliability of power transmission line and related device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting the lightning fault probability of a power transmission line based on lightning meteorological information and evaluating the reliability of the power transmission line and a related device, wherein the method comprises the steps of preprocessing multi-source data (meteorological radar data, line parameters and topographic data) and outputting a standardized feature set; predicting lightning current amplitude and distribution of 1 hour in the future through a ConvLSTM model based on the data set, determining discharge point coordinates by using the amplitude distribution, calculating a lightning side distance, inputting the amplitude, the distance, the terrain and line parameters into a XGBoost model, outputting section lightning fault probability, and calculating LOLP and EENS reliability indexes by taking the probability as forced outage probability and combining a Monte Carlo method. According to the lightning risk prediction method, accurate prediction of lightning risk is achieved through multi-source data fusion and space-time sequence modeling, scientific basis is provided for lightning protection design and operation and maintenance of a power system, and operation reliability of a power grid is improved.
assignees: HUBEI CENTRAL CHINA TECH DEVELOPMENT OF ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;WUHAN OPTICS VALLEY INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Landslide volume overrun probability prediction method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of landslide disaster prediction and discloses a landslide volume overrun probability prediction method which comprises the steps of collecting and arranging landslide volume data and landslide trigger factor data, constructing a landslide volume probability model by adopting lognormal distribution, introducing priori distribution for parameters in the landslide volume probability model, wherein the parameters comprise regression coefficients and variance parameters, sampling the parameters by using a Markov chain Monte Carlo method to obtain samples of posterior distribution, calculating overrun probability under a single sample after obtaining the samples of posterior distribution, and averaging the overrun probability under all the samples to obtain a final prediction result. The application can flexibly adapt to landslide volume distribution characteristics in different areas and under different triggering conditions, and has more universality and adaptability. Meanwhile, the occurrence probability of the ultra-large-volume landslide can be stably evaluated, and scientific basis is provided for engineering safety redundancy design and extreme disaster prevention and control.
assignees: INST OF AEROSPACE INFORMATION HENAN ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Tunnel disaster monitoring method and blocking method based on earthquake damage-flood cooperation
abstract_en: The application discloses a tunnel disaster monitoring method and a blocking method based on earthquake damage-flood cooperation, and relates to the field of intelligent prevention and control of earthquake engineering and disasters, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining damage characteristics, seepage characteristics and aftershock characteristics based on DOFS data of a section in a decoupling way; the method comprises the steps of obtaining water pressure data through simulation according to multisource sensing data in a section, determining current damage variables, damage-seepage coupling indexes and crack hydraulic opening degrees based on various characteristics and historical data, determining seepage pressure gradients among sections according to water pressure values of various sections, determining seepage velocity vectors among sections according to the crack hydraulic opening degrees and the damage-seepage coupling indexes of the sections, determining system cascade failure risk indexes according to the damage variables of the sections and dynamic risk propagation weights among the sections, and determining disaster chain propagation strength indexes of a current tunnel by utilizing an entropy weight method. The method can realize real-time monitoring and risk assessment of the secondary flood disasters after tunnel earthquake.

title_en: Power outage risk prediction method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The application discloses a power failure risk prediction method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product, and belongs to the technical field of power failure risk prediction. The method comprises the steps of receiving text information of a power system, carrying out deep semantic understanding on the text information of the power system by using a preset language model, extracting key information comprising fault equipment, fault reasons and influence ranges, carrying out scanning matching on the text information of the power system by using a preset keyword library to obtain risk keywords and corresponding real-time risk weights, finding new candidate risk keywords, inputting the key information into a pre-constructed power system knowledge graph to locate fault entities and determine associated topological subgraphs, inputting the topological subgraphs into a graph neural network model to carry out power failure risk propagation deduction to obtain potential linkage fault information, and carrying out power failure risk prediction by using a dynamic risk rule library to obtain power failure risk early warning information. The embodiment of the application can effectively improve the accuracy of power failure risk prediction.

title_en: Disaster prevention and rescue method, system, equipment and medium based on quantum computation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of structural data processing and disaster prevention and rescue, and particularly relates to a disaster prevention and rescue method, system, equipment and medium based on quantum computing. According to the invention, data are acquired by arranging a multi-mode quantum sensor at a key point, noise is reduced on the data through a lambda noise reduction filter, a quantum wavelet transformation algorithm is used for carrying out feature extraction on the noise reduction data, a quantum principal component analysis is used for carrying out dimension reduction on the feature extracted data, high-dimensional space mapping is carried out on the dimension reduced data by using a kernel function, vector classification is carried out on the mapped data, probability of occurrence of disasters is calculated on the classified data by using a quantum Monte Carlo, a disaster influence range is predicted by using a quantum diffusion model, early warning information is generated according to the probability and the disaster influence range, an early warning information is issued through a quantum communication technology, an emergency scheme is generated according to the disaster influence range, and after evaluation and optimization on the scheme are carried out, disaster prevention and rescue are carried out according to the data before and after disasters, and suggestions are provided.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 14 BUREAU GROUP CO LTD;THE 1S ENG CO LTD OF CHINA RAILWAY URBAN CONSTRUCTION

title_en: Mine working face stress monitoring and disaster early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for monitoring stress on a mine working face and early warning disasters, in particular relates to the technical field of coal mine safety monitoring, and aims to solve the problem that the reliability of disaster early warning is insufficient due to model uncertainty in the existing stress field inversion method; the method is characterized in that accurate early warning of working face dynamic disasters is realized by constructing a stress field analysis system containing uncertainty evaluation, surrounding rock strain data is obtained through an optical fiber sensing network, leading stress field distribution is obtained through inversion calculation, uncertainty transfer and amplification effects in the inversion process are analyzed, confidence intervals of stress values of all areas are calculated, the critical degree of the current stress state is evaluated by combining historical stress data, disaster early warning information is generated based on a multi-dimensional risk evaluation result, reliability of stress field analysis and accuracy of disaster early warning are effectively improved, and technical support is provided for safe production of the working face.
assignees: CHINA PINGMEI SHENMA HOLDING GROUP CO LTD;XIAN MEIKE TRANSPARENT GEOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD;INST ROCK & SOIL MECH CAS

title_en: Dynamic Bayesian network-based method for evaluating safety and toughness of structure of flue plate at top of highway tunnel after fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for evaluating the safety and toughness of a top flue plate structure of a post-fire centralized smoke-discharging highway tunnel based on a dynamic Bayesian network, which comprises the specific steps of constructing the dynamic Bayesian network by collecting related data of the top flue plate structure of the post-fire highway tunnel, and describing the evolution process of the risk level of the top flue plate structure of the post-fire highway tunnel; and calculating the change trend of the risk level of the tunnel top flue plate structure after the fire disaster by using the dynamic Bayesian network. Compared with the traditional static evaluation method, the method can predict the risk level change trend of the tunnel top flue plate structure after fire, provide scientific basis for operation management departments, help the operation management departments to formulate reasonable maintenance and repair schemes, prolong the service life of the tunnel and reduce the operation cost and risk.

title_en: Reservoir landslide displacement prediction method, storage medium and device based on dynamic hysteresis identification and fuzzy entropy optimization
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of geological disaster prediction, and particularly provides a reservoir landslide displacement prediction method based on dynamic hysteresis identification and fuzzy entropy optimization, which comprises the steps of collecting and preprocessing landslide time sequence monitoring data; combining a distributed lag nonlinear model with a maximum information coefficient, dynamically analyzing the lag relation between displacement and rainfall and reservoir water level by a sliding window, outputting a self-adaptive lag period and constructing a lag characteristic set, decomposing the self-adaptive decomposition displacement sequence by a fuzzy entropy optimized variation mode, determining the optimal mode number according to the minimum fuzzy entropy, reconstructing an eigen mode function into a trend, a period and a random term, extracting local characteristics of a multi-lag characteristic space by CNN, inputting the local characteristics and the reconstructed displacement component into GRU capturing time dependence, introducing a attention mechanism weighting key time step, and outputting a predicted value and a confidence interval by quantile regression. The method integrates dynamic hysteresis capture, self-adaptive decomposition and CNN-GRU-Attention, and realizes high-precision and high-robustness prediction.

title_en: Disaster-resistant toughness assessment method for urban comprehensive pipe rack, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster resistant toughness assessment method, a storage medium and electronic equipment for an urban comprehensive pipe rack, and relates to the technical field of urban comprehensive pipe racks. The method comprises the steps of obtaining disaster resistance toughness classification information of the urban comprehensive pipe rack, obtaining a comprehensive influence matrix based on relative influence among factors affecting the disaster resistance toughness of the urban comprehensive pipe rack in the classification information, analyzing centrality and causality based on the comprehensive influence matrix, obtaining a target reachable matrix based on the comprehensive influence matrix, constructing a layered network model for disaster resistance toughness assessment based on the target reachable matrix and analysis results of centrality and causality, mapping the layered network model into a Bayesian network, and carrying out disaster resistance toughness assessment on the urban comprehensive pipe rack by utilizing the Bayesian network after mapping. Therefore, uncertainty caused by the fact that a single expert is relied on for judgment can be reduced, and accuracy and dynamic response capability of an evaluation result are improved.
assignees: HEFEI INST PUBLIC SAFETY RES TSINGHUA UNIV;UNIV SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CHINA

title_en: Method, equipment and medium for evaluating toughness of large-scale urban power grid recovered after disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, equipment and medium for evaluating toughness of a large-scale urban power grid recovered after disaster, which are used for constructing a large-scale urban power grid fault scene and a time-varying fault probability model of a power transmission line under earthquake disaster, generating an earthquake-fault combined scene based on Monte Carlo simulation, selecting k high-risk typical scenes, constructing a grid disaster cooperative recovery model by taking the total weighted load recovery amount in a system full recovery period as a core optimization target to maximum, constructing a multi-dimensional dynamic toughness index system based on grid frame robustness, system self-recovery capacity and post-disaster repair capacity, evaluating the toughness level of the large-scale urban power grid recovered after disaster cooperatively, and outputting the priority ordering of an optimization strategy. By evaluating the toughness level of the large-scale urban power grid which is cooperatively recovered after the power grid disaster, the overall process performance of the recovery can be comprehensively quantized, the advantages and disadvantages of strategies can be effectively distinguished, the recovery speed and the recovery degree can be accurately quantized, and therefore an effective recovery strategy can not be adopted, and a reliable basis is provided for the disaster prevention and emergency of the power grid.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Comprehensive evaluation system of pedestrian safetiness according to inunddation flow of underground facility, and method for the same
title_ko: 지하시설의 침수흐름에 따른 보행 안전성 종합평가 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_ko: 지하철 역사, 철도시설 등의 지하시설 침수흐름에 따라 대피자의 보행 안전성 분석과 대피경로 설정 의사결정을 위한 보행 안전성 평가를 위해서 다양한 평가지표를 종합적으로 고려한 종합평가점수 산정을 통해 보행 위험구간을 판별할 수 있으며, 또한, 여러 평가지표를 종합 판단한 결과에 따라 홍수로 인한 재난상황 발생시 시설 관리자의 의사결정의 불확실성을 줄임으로써 시설 이용자의 대피 안전성을 향상시킬 수 있는, 지하시설의 침수흐름에 따른 보행 안전성 종합평가 시스템 및 그 방법이 제공된다.

title_en: Electric power system toughness assessment method based on deep learning under large-scale uncertainty scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system toughness evaluation method under a large amount of uncertainty scenes based on deep learning, which aims to solve the problem that the existing power system lacks effective evaluation on various uncertainty scenes. The toughness evaluation method of the electric power system comprises the steps of firstly, constructing a maximum wind speed intensity measurement graph of the electric power system in a target area, secondly, simulating and generating resistance distribution of a power transmission tower in the electric power system by utilizing Monte Carlo, constructing a power transmission line damage scene, simulating power transmission tower damage based on random fields, thirdly, performing recovery simulation on the power transmission tower in the electric power system based on a function loss value, determining a toughness evaluation index, fourthly, establishing a toughness evaluation proxy model of the electric power system under a large number of uncertain scenes based on deep learning, and obtaining the toughness evaluation index of the electric power system based on the trained deep learning model. The method can more accurately evaluate the damage condition of the target power network under various actual uncertain typhoon disaster situations and uncertain power transmission tower damage situations, and improves analysis efficiency.

title_en: Bayesian network-based large-scale liquefaction disaster quick response analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Bayesian network-based large-scale liquefaction disaster quick response analysis method and a Bayesian network-based large-scale liquefaction disaster quick response analysis system, which relate to the technical field of geotechnical engineering earthquake resistance and comprise the steps of carrying out earthquake risk decoupling on an area to be analyzed based on CPSHA, and determining the magnitude and the midrange of a plurality of earthquake events; the method comprises the steps of simulating by adopting a kinematic mixed seismic source model of fault physical rupture to obtain seismic parameters of an area to be analyzed, constructing a liquefaction sample library, constructing soil liquefaction evaluation parameters, carrying out standardized treatment on the soil liquefaction evaluation parameters to obtain raster data, respectively extracting numerical values from the raster data and the liquefaction sample library to form a sampling table, carrying out accuracy analysis and data training on the sampling table to form a conditional probability table, and calculating liquefaction probability and non-liquefaction probability of the area to be analyzed through a naive Bayesian probability model and a weighted naive Bayesian probability model based on the conditional probability table. The invention relieves the technical problems of high cost and time consumption in the prior art.

title_en: Slope and foundation pit stability monitoring and early warning method based on remote sensing data fusion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and particularly relates to a slope and foundation pit stability monitoring and early warning method based on remote sensing data fusion. According to the method, deformation monitoring precision and point density are improved through the combination optimization of a multiband SAR scattering mechanism, a weighted self-adaptive adjustment model is introduced to achieve objective fusion and uncertainty quantification of deformation-weather-background factors, and a deformation-weather coupling prediction model is constructed to achieve advanced early warning and hierarchical prevention and control. The invention solves the problems of sparse midpoint, low precision and insufficient early warning reliability in the traditional monitoring, and realizes high-precision and full-coverage stability evaluation and active prevention and control.
assignees: XINJIANG ROAD AND BRIDGE CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD;UNIV XIANGTAN

title_en: Storm disaster chain risk diffusion path identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying a storm disaster chain risk diffusion path, and relates to the technical fields of disaster risk management and disaster prevention and reduction. The method is based on historical storm disaster chain text records, disaster causing factors, disaster bearing bodies and disaster conditions are extracted to construct a disaster chain index system, a Bayesian network model is adopted to establish directed causal relation among elements, a chain type risk diffusion network is built, reliability of the model is verified through Brier, 10 total risk diffusion paths from two levels to five levels are identified through causal reasoning, chain type risk amplification and disaster condition superposition effects are revealed, a risk degree method is further introduced, broken chain disaster reduction benefits of disaster bearing bodies such as agriculture, population, houses and the like are quantized, high risk objects and risk overflow effect are identified, and basis is provided for disaster prevention and disaster reduction priority ordering. The method realizes the whole process quantitative analysis from path identification to disaster reduction decision support of the storm disaster chain, and has the advantages of strong scientificity, high operability, wide application prospect and the like.

title_en: Semantic interactive extreme scene generation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semantic interactive extreme scene generation method and system, and belongs to the technical field of meteorological disaster simulation and safety analysis of an electric power system. The method comprises the steps of receiving natural language input of a user, converting the natural language input into structural parameters comprising time, quantity, intensity levels and geographic positions through semantic analysis, dynamically selecting and calling a specialized neural network model corresponding to the intensity levels or generating typhoon full life cycle parameters based on an empirical track model according to whether the specific intensity levels are specified, further simulating typhoon wind fields and rainfall fields, calculating influences of the typhoon wind fields and the rainfall fields on a transmission tower, an overhead conductor and a wind power field, obtaining response data of a power system, and finally simulating and generating a power system extreme scene under the action of typhoon through Monte Carlo. The method realizes the whole-flow intelligent generation from natural language driving to controllable-intensity typhoon scenes, improves the accuracy, efficiency and usability of scene generation, and is suitable for the elastic assessment and disaster prevention decision support of the power system.

title_en: Method and system for post-disaster node disturbance quantification and energy storage optimization configuration of power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for quantifying node disturbance after a power grid disaster and optimizing energy storage, wherein the method and the system are used for randomly simulating disturbance influence of the typhoon disaster on each node of the power grid based on historical typhoon data by using a Monte Carlo method to obtain probability that each node is influenced by small disturbance under the typhoon disaster condition, and the method is used for reserving equivalent disturbance intensity of the nodes after reduction based on probability equivalent calculation by using a Kron reduction method, constructing a system state-space model based on the equivalent disturbance intensity, constructing an energy storage configuration optimizing problem based on the system state-space model and inertia values which can be provided by a distributed energy storage system to be configured, solving the optimizing problem by using a projection gradient descent method to obtain an optimal energy storage configuration result, accurately quantifying the disturbance intensity after the disaster on each node, effectively reflecting the influence of the disaster on the power grid node, and obviously improving the recovery capability of the power grid in case of frequency change and power disturbance after the disaster, thereby effectively improving the recovery capability and stability of the system when the power grid faces the disaster.
assignees: ECONOMIC RESEARCH INST OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Priority decision method for land utilization collaborative optimization in homeland space planning
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of homeland space planning, and discloses a priority decision method for land utilization collaborative optimization in homeland space planning, which comprises the following steps of setting a multidimensional target of land utilization planning and identifying corresponding constraint conditions; the method comprises the steps of establishing a Bayesian network model, identifying target conflicts through a dynamic perception technology, dynamically updating and generating priority weights of targets, constructing a three-dimensional geographic information model based on multi-source geographic space data, evaluating natural disaster risks by combining a big data analysis and deep learning algorithm, defining a high-risk area, designing a comprehensive treatment scheme for the high-risk area, formulating a plurality of land use planning schemes according to the priority weights of the targets and the comprehensive treatment scheme, and screening the scheme with the highest score as an optimal land use planning scheme. The application ensures the comprehensive optimization of economic, ecological and social benefits and the continuous adjustment capability of planning.
assignees: ZAOZHUANG HAOZE SURVEY PLANNING CO LTD

title_en: Regional risk assessment method based on warning information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional risk assessment method based on alarm information, which relates to the technical field of public safety and emergency management information and is characterized in that by collecting multidimensional position data of an alarm occurrence place, a home, a working place and the like of a disaster-bearing individual, and constructing a region association network under multi-level spatial resolution, defining a region risk index, a risk hot spot region and a risk source diversity index based on network side weights and spatial distances, and realizing comprehensive quantitative evaluation from microscopic individual behaviors to macroscopic region risks. The invention can fully utilize the data of the existing information system, effectively identify the risk propagation path and the hot spot area, improve the early warning accuracy and the self-adaptive capacity, and provide scientific basis for emergency decision of the emergency.

title_en: Coal rock dynamic disaster early warning method and system based on Bayesian dynamic extremum modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal rock dynamic disaster early warning method and system based on Bayesian dynamic extremum modeling, which relate to the technical field of coal rock dynamic disaster monitoring and comprise the steps of dividing and extracting characteristics of multi-source sensor signal data of a coal mine mining working face based on a preset time window, and constructing dynamic extremum event indexes and dynamic covariant vectors; the method comprises the steps of combining and updating dynamic covariate vectors based on a multi-frequency sampling asynchronous fusion mechanism, generating a dynamic covariate matrix by combining dynamic extreme event indexes, constructing a Bayesian dynamic extremum model based on the dynamic covariate matrix, updating the Bayesian dynamic extremum model based on a Markov chain Monte Carlo method, calculating a dynamic risk index of a coal mine mining working face based on the Bayesian dynamic extremum model, and carrying out disaster early warning on the coal mine mining working face based on the dynamic risk index. The invention relieves the technical problem of insufficient capturing capacity for the disaster instantaneous mutation risk in the prior art.
assignees: SHAANXI COAL MINING HANCHENG MINING CO LTD;UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Water-electricity coupling system toughness assessment method considering drought risk evolution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a toughness evaluation method of a water-electricity coupling system considering drought risk evolution, and relates to the technical field of water-electricity coupling systems. The method comprises the steps of S1, modeling a water-electricity coupling system network, S2, modeling drought risk propagation of the water-electricity coupling network based on seepage, and S3, performing system simulation and toughness assessment on the water-electricity coupling system network based on the two models. According to the method, a heterogeneous weighted double-layer network model is built, a trans-scale dynamics modeling method is developed, a seepage theory and physical flow are dynamically combined, a disaster cascade propagation bi-directional seepage equation is built, a toughness assessment framework based on the seepage theory is provided, the laws of different coupling effects of the hydro-electric system are revealed, and scientific basis can be provided for risk assessment, toughness improvement and emergency management strategy formulation of key infrastructure.

title_en: Bridge collapse disaster early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bridge collapse disaster early warning method and system, and relates to the technical field of bridge monitoring. The bridge damage evolution prediction method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source health monitoring data of a bridge in real time, including strain monitoring data, displacement monitoring data, sedimentation monitoring data, vibration monitoring data, crack monitoring data, environment and load data, carrying out data fusion after preprocessing operation on the multi-source health monitoring data to obtain multi-source fusion data, constructing a bridge damage evolution prediction model based on a long-short-time memory neural network by taking the multi-source fusion data as input, predicting a bridge dynamic damage evolution trend, calculating collapse probability of the bridge in different time scales by adopting Monte Carlo simulation and combining static risk reference values and the bridge dynamic damage evolution trend, and setting a critical threshold value, wherein when the collapse probability reaches the critical threshold value, triggering an early warning signal and carrying out graded early warning. The method and the device identify the collapse precursor signal in advance, and early warning is accurate and efficient.
assignees: RESEARCH INST OF HIGHWAY MINISTRY OF TRANSPORT

title_en: Shallow sea geological disaster identification and pipeline stability assessment method based on light-scale intelligent model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ocean engineering safety monitoring and evaluation, in particular to a shallow sea geological disaster identification and pipeline stability evaluation method based on a light-scale intelligent model, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a shallow sea area disaster disturbance nesting map; and S2, executing disaster disturbance path identification and pipeline risk propagation modeling, outputting a pipeline disturbance influence graph containing disturbance transfer paths and node influence intensities, and S3, calculating stability scores of all pipe sections, and outputting disaster sources, propagation paths and disturbance link graphs which cause instability. According to the invention, through constructing the response relation between the disaster disturbance propagation path and the pipeline structure, the integrated expression of disaster influence identification, propagation modeling and stability evaluation is realized, and the accuracy and the interpretability of the shallow sea geological disaster on the analysis of the pipeline influence are improved.
assignees: FIRST INST OF OCEANOGRAPHY MINISTRY OF NATURAL RESOURCES

title_en: Power grid emergency material scheduling method under rain, snow and freezing disasters based on robust optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid emergency material scheduling method under a rain, snow and freezing disaster, which comprises the steps of obtaining meteorological data and traffic facility information under the rain, snow and freezing disaster, constructing a line fault probability prediction model, adopting Monte Carlo simulation to generate a disaster scene, obtaining a typical disaster scene set through a scene reduction technology, constructing a joint scheduling optimization mathematical model which considers emergency material allocation and emergency equipment allocation and comprises a pre-disaster pre-deployment stage and an in-disaster dynamic response stage, adopting an improved column and constraint generation algorithm to solve the two-stage robust optimization problem, gradually converging to a robust optimal solution, outputting an optimal emergency material and emergency repair team scheduling scheme, determining a repair target and an optimal driving path of the emergency repair team, generating a post-disaster grid and traffic system cooperative recovery strategy, realizing quick recovery and reasonable configuration of emergency resources, and further improving the emergency response speed and recovery capacity of the power grid under the snow, freezing and the rain disaster.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER ENGINEERING RESEARCH INST CO LTD;UNIV FUZHOU

title_en: Heterogeneous evaporation waveguide channel monitoring system and method based on multilink multiband signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heterogeneous evaporation waveguide channel monitoring system and method based on multilink multiband signals, wherein the heterogeneous evaporation waveguide channel monitoring system is built by combining a channel monitoring module, a data communication module and a data processing module, an objective function is built by combining monitoring data, an evaporation waveguide section model and an electric wave propagation model through multilink multiband actual measurement path loss and simulation path loss, an optimal group of heterogeneous evaporation waveguide channel characteristic distribution is searched and solved through an optimization algorithm, a nonlinear likelihood model between optimal heterogeneous evaporation waveguide channel characteristics and signal propagation path loss is built, probability distribution of the optimal heterogeneous evaporation waveguide channel characteristics is calculated, and confidence interval of the probability distribution is estimated. The invention improves the reliability and robustness of the inversion result of the non-uniform evaporation waveguide channel characteristics in the complex ocean environment, realizes the long-term real-time, efficient and high-precision inversion of the non-uniform evaporation waveguide channel characteristics in the large-area sea area, and provides full-time data support for the detection of the offshore beyond-view radar, the evaluation of the electromagnetic environment and the disaster early warning.

title_en: Landslide hazard source identification and dynamic risk assessment method in mountain canyon region
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control, and discloses a landslide hazard source identification and dynamic risk assessment method in a mountain canyon region, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of S1 regional pregnancy mode analysis and identification target region definition, namely constructing a comprehensive vulnerability evaluation model, and defining investigation target regions with different priorities by combining InSAR deformation monitoring; S2, fine identification of potential sliding sources, namely accurately identifying landslide boundaries and deep structures by adopting a star-machine-ground cooperative technology combining multi-stage LiDAR terrain change detection, unmanned plane multispectral and thermal infrared detection and geophysical exploration, and S3, dynamic risk assessment, namely establishing a dynamic and static load coupling stability model considering heavy rain and earthquake working conditions, adopting Monte Carlo simulation to calculate instability probability, and combining disaster-bearing body vulnerability analysis to realize quantitative risk classification. The method realizes early identification, accurate positioning and dynamic risk quantification of landslide hazard sources, and improves the prevention and control capability of landslide disasters in the high mountain channel Gu Ou.
assignees: The First Geological Brigade of Sichuan Province;SICHUAN INST OF GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING INVESTIGATION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Bridge digital twin risk assessment method under extreme event
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bridge risk assessment method based on digital twinning under extreme events. Firstly, multi-source data in a short time window are collected to form a unified observation vector. The abnormal sensor is then identified and redundancy repair is performed. And then, constructing a triple calibration model, solving damage parameters, identifying a damage dynamic evolution field, constructing a full-link uncertainty propagation system, and calculating the residual bearing capacity and risk index. When the risk index or confidence interval thereof covers 1.0, a conservative traffic policy is output. And finally, generating a traffic control scheme by combining the risk indexes, and carrying out collaborative updating on multiple bridges in the area. The invention has the advantages of fault tolerance, robustness, causality interpretability, dynamic prediction, full link transparency, assessment-management closed loop and the like, can rapidly and reliably output the residual bearing capacity and traffic strategy of the bridge after an extreme event, and improves the emergency efficiency and operation safety after disaster.
assignees: GUANGXI XINFAZHAN COMMUNICATION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Extreme rainfall flood risk propagation path identification method based on hydrologic connectivity
abstract_en: The invention discloses an extreme rainfall flood risk propagation path identification method based on hydrologic connectivity, which comprises the steps of constructing a hydrologic topological network, calculating the yield and hydrologic potential energy of each grid unit, constructing a connectivity weight matrix according to potential energy difference and Manning roughness coefficient, generating a dynamic connectivity adjacency matrix through a ponding depth trigger threshold, constructing a risk propagation probability transfer matrix, and identifying a risk propagation main path and key conduction nodes. The method can dynamically characterize hydrologic connectivity change under extreme rainfall conditions, effectively identify flood risk propagation paths and key nodes, and provide technical support for urban flood disaster risk early warning and emergency management.

title_en: Power grid damage consequence evaluation method considering cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid damage result evaluation method considering cascading failures, and belongs to the technical field of power system dispatching. The method comprises the steps of establishing a HEMP E1 environment model, obtaining peak field intensity of a key equipment installation position of a power grid, establishing a key equipment fault probability model based on the peak field intensity, generating an initial fault through Monte Carlo simulation, establishing a cascading fault evolution model integrating direct current flow calculation, power grid regulation measures and communication equipment influence, iteratively simulating a fault process until the power grid is stable, calculating indexes such as load loss ratio, average utilization rate of line capacity and the like, and quantitatively evaluating the damage result of the power grid. The invention breaks through the limit of the existing equipment layer evaluation, realizes the accurate simulation of the cascading failure evolution of the system layer, gives consideration to the evaluation accuracy and the calculation efficiency, and provides important support for formulating the power grid defense strategy in the HEMP E1 environment.
assignees: HUANENG YIMIN COAL & ELECTRICITY CO LTD;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Anchor slope landslide instability risk evaluation method under rainfall condition
abstract_en: The invention provides an anchor slope landslide instability risk evaluation method under rainfall conditions, which belongs to the technical field of geotechnical engineering and geological disaster prevention and control, and comprises the steps of constructing a theoretical calculation formula of a multilayer geotechnical body anchor slope stability coefficient under rainfall infiltration based on a segmented sliding surface method, introducing reliability indexes based on a Monte Carlo probability analysis framework, establishing a slope reliability integrated evaluation model, acquiring soil body, rainfall, support and geometric parameter data of a slope, defining various parameters as random variables, carrying out large-scale sampling calculation based on the theoretical formula, calculating probability distribution of the statistical stability coefficient, solving reliability indexes and failure probability, establishing a risk monitoring criterion, judging whether each index exceeds an allowable value, and carrying out risk dynamic early warning based on a judging result. The invention constructs an integrated evaluation technical system for the reliability of the anchored side slope under the rainfall of a multi-layer rock-soil body, and realizes the high-efficiency quantification of the reliability of the side slope under the multi-parameter coupling effect.

title_en: Transient electromagnetic and seismic wave multi-mode joint inversion imaging method based on physical information transducer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a transient electromagnetic and seismic wave multi-modal joint inversion imaging method based on physical information transducer, belonging to the field of geophysical exploration and artificial intelligence intersection. The method comprises the steps of performing anomaly detection, interpolation, filtering and normalization preprocessing on transient electromagnetic and seismic wave original data, extracting characteristics representing electrical property, elasticity and cross physical significance, serializing space data through a meshing and alternating fusion strategy, constructing enhanced codes fusing absolute, relative positions and physical properties, designing a physically constrained encoder-decoder architecture to perform multi-scale forward modeling-inversion, and quantifying uncertainty of inversion results by adopting a Bayesian Monte Carlo method to generate a confidence map. According to the invention, through the physical rule driving and multi-mode depth complementation fusion, the fine recognition capability and interpretation reliability of hidden disaster-causing geologic bodies such as underground goafs and collapse columns are effectively improved while the physical consistency of data is maintained.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING;UNIV KUNMING SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY;CHONGQING HUIKAN INDUSTRIAL TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Power system vulnerability assessment method and system considering extreme weather influence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system evaluation, and discloses a method and a system for evaluating vulnerability of a power system in consideration of extreme weather influence, wherein a line time-varying fault probability under the dynamic weather influence is determined by constructing a line fault probability model of the power system under the extreme weather, and an countermeasure network model and a Monte Carlo simulation generation typical scene are generated through time sequence relativity matching with gradient penalty; the method comprises the steps of taking a generated typical scene as input, simulating cascade fault evolution through an alternating current cascade fault model, and outputting a cascade fault evolution path, and further realizing multi-level vulnerability quantification of the power system by combining severity analysis, structural vulnerability assessment and causal-probability prejudgment through a spectrogram theory and a Bayesian network based on a fault evolution result, solving the problems of insufficient single-level assessment and neglecting causal association in the prior art, and improving the risk assessment precision and disaster prevention capability of the power system under extreme weather.
assignees: STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECHNOLOGICAL RESEARCH INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;EAST CHINA BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA;STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LIMITED;STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Sampling method for rainfall forecast samples under complex terrain condition of mountain area
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and reduction, and relates to a sampling method for forecasting rainfall samples under the condition of complex terrains in mountain areas. On the basis of a rainfall probability distribution model, judging a sampling mode adopted by an early warning unit according to a forecast rainfall grade and the position of the early warning unit, wherein the sampling mode comprises tail enhanced sampling and Monte Carlo sampling, the tail enhanced sampling specifically comprises that the layering standard adopted by the early warning unit is judged by combining the forecast rainfall grade of the early warning unit and live rainfall data of the previous day and the position relation between the early warning unit and a major attention area, and corresponding layers are divided according to the layering standard, and the corresponding layers comprise a normal layer and a tail layer. The combination mode of tail reinforcement sampling and common Monte Carlo sampling is adopted, uncertainty and high disaster causing performance of rare events (high-intensity rainfall) at the tail of the rainfall are fully considered, and the problems of common sampling sample concentration and poor coverage are avoided.
assignees: CHINA GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT MONITORING INST GEOLOGICAL DISASTER TECHNOLOGY GUIDANCE CENTER OF MINIS

title_en: Alternating current/direct current power grid cascading failure evolution and fragile path identification system and method containing new energy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for identifying cascading failure evolution and a vulnerable path of an alternating current/direct current power grid containing new energy, and relates to the field of safety analysis of power systems. The system comprises a power system modeling module, an element fault modeling module, a vulnerability assessment index module, a cascading failure simulation module and a vulnerable path identification module. By constructing a power system and element fault model containing new energy and alternating current-direct current series-parallel connection, based on entropy weight method fusion structure, tide and voltage multidimensional vulnerability indexes, random scenes are generated through Monte Carlo sampling, fault chains are generated through simulation cascade fault evolution, key vulnerable paths and alternating current-direct current strong coupling risk lines are accurately identified, and the influence of uncertainty factors such as new energy output fluctuation is quantized. The method overcomes the limitation of traditional analysis, can truly simulate fault evolution, improves the identification accuracy of the fragile path, and provides a quantization basis for power grid planning and operation control.
assignees: NORTH CHINA BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA;HARBIN INST OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Basin risk assessment method and system based on geographic space and Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of natural disaster risk assessment and discloses a river basin risk assessment method and system based on a geographic space and a Bayesian network, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a digital elevation model diagram of a target river basin, multi-disaster investigation record and simulation research results, and extracting key points; establishing a disaster chain path according to the key points to complete Bayesian network modeling, carrying out node probability modeling and initializing parameters, establishing a disaster chain probability propagation mechanism to describe the sequential transmission process of disasters among nodes, establishing a high-dimensional joint distribution model to carry out forward reasoning propagation of a plurality of Bayesian networks, carrying out uncertainty compression of a disaster reasoning chain, carrying out probability propagation and reasoning, and calculating disaster probability of population loss and economic loss. By utilizing the scheme of the invention, the overall synergy of disaster chain reasoning and the delicacy of risk expression under a complex system can be improved, and the risk assessment capability of the model under the complex chain disaster system is improved.
assignees: CHINA RENEWABLE ENERGY ENGINEERING INST;CHINA RENEWABLE ENERGY ENGINEERING INST CO LTD;CHINA WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER ENG CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Electric power transaction risk identification method, system, equipment and medium based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power transaction risk identification. The method comprises the steps of performing feature extraction processing on acquired power transaction multisource heterogeneous data to generate a node set, performing hypergraph construction processing on the basis of the node set to generate a power transaction risk hypergraph, performing risk propagation modeling processing on the power transaction risk hypergraph to output risk event triggering probability, performing fusing strategy deduction processing on the basis of the risk event triggering probability and the power transaction risk hypergraph to generate a cascading interruption effect report, and performing deviation detection processing on the basis of the power transaction risk hypergraph, the cascading interruption effect report and real-time power purchasing behavior data to generate a power purchasing strategy deviation early warning signal so as to achieve the technical effects of improving the recognition precision of a multi-factor combined risk conduction path, reducing early warning false report rate and enhancing fusing strategy intervention effect and actual scene fitting degree.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating risk of strong wind disaster of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution networks, in particular to a method and a system for evaluating the risk of a strong wind disaster of a power distribution network. The method comprises the steps of constructing a data vector of each node at t time by means of meteorological observation of wind resistance parameters, environmental parameters and t time of each node in a power distribution network topology model, constructing a node vulnerability model based on a wind pressure response-failure probability mapping function, acquiring failure probability of each node at t time, acquiring risk propagation weight between each node at t time and adjacent nodes based on electric adjacent strength, inverse proportion function of the geographic coordinates and meteorological consistency of each node and adjacent nodes, and dividing all nodes into a plurality of risk areas by considering consistency, connectivity, boundary complexity and time stability in the areas, and acquiring node level risk assessment results, area level risk assessment results and whole network level risk assessment results at t time. The method and the system effectively improve the evaluation precision of the risk of the wind disaster of the power distribution network.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle emergency disaster rescue cluster system and method based on large visual language model
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle emergency disaster rescue cluster system and method based on a large visual language model, comprising the steps of carrying out space-time alignment on acquired multi-modal environment observation data through a cross-modal space-time fusion mechanism; the method comprises the steps of combining a multi-mode encoder with an online contrast learning mechanism, utilizing a large visual language model to generate a structured situation description comprising disaster objects, positions and states, dynamically planning an optimal path through a Monte Carlo tree search algorithm, and monitoring the flight state of the unmanned aerial vehicle in real time through a time sequence anomaly detection network on the basis, wherein anomaly events occur in the unmanned aerial vehicle to trigger task migration and topology recombination. The disaster situation recognition method and the system can improve disaster situation recognition accuracy, shorten task planning response time, remarkably improve rescue efficiency, are suitable for high-dynamic disaster scenes, provide a reliable technical framework for multi-source heterogeneous data fusion and group intelligent decision, and further solve the problems of poor flexibility and low adaptability of a traditional unmanned aerial vehicle cluster rescue system.

title_en: Risk assessment method for large-scale cascade utilization of retired power battery
abstract_en: The application provides a large-scale cascade utilization risk assessment method of retired power batteries, which comprises the steps of S1, classifying the retired power batteries into at least one battery unit, screening out the battery units with obvious physical defects, S2, establishing a three-layer Bayesian network risk assessment model, S3, constructing a directed acyclic graph to characterize the dependency relationship among all nodes, S4, collecting relevant data, sequentially calculating the risk probability of each level of nodes based on the relevant data and the Bayesian network, S5, judging whether cascade utilization is suitable or not based on the risk probability of a top-layer target node and a middle-layer risk node, S6, if the retired power batteries are not suitable for cascade utilization, identifying key risk factors, deciding to disassemble the battery units for reevaluation or material recovery according to the risk sources of the key risk factors, S7, outputting a risk assessment result, and using the risk assessment result for new utilization risk assessment of the retired power batteries. The risk assessment method and the risk assessment system can improve the scientificity and the reliability of risk assessment.

title_en: Urban water supply system earthquake resistance evaluation method considering function decline of water treatment plant
abstract_en: An urban water supply system earthquake resistance evaluation method considering the function decline of a water treatment plant belongs to the technical field of urban water supply network earthquake resistance analysis. The method comprises the following steps of utilizing Monte Carlo to simulate sampling, generating earthquake damage scenes of various pipelines in the water supply network under the action of an earthquake, quantitatively determining the residual functional state of the water treatment plant after the earthquake through the vulnerability curve of the water treatment plant, establishing a coupling analysis model of the water treatment plant and the water supply network, realizing the coupling of the functional change between the water treatment plant and the network, integrating the damage of the network and the functional attenuation of the water treatment plant, and calculating the earthquake resistance index of the urban water supply system. The method quantitatively reflects the function attenuation of the water plant after earthquake by introducing the vulnerability curve of the water plant, and combines the water plant-pipe network coupling model, so that the whole earthquake resistance of the urban water supply system under earthquake disasters can be more scientifically and comprehensively estimated, and the method has important theoretical and practical significance for guiding earthquake resistance design, toughness improvement and emergency decision of the urban water supply system.

title_en: Multi-dimensional matrix construction method for disaster monitoring of power transmission corridor
abstract_en: The application provides a method for constructing a multidimensional matrix for monitoring disasters in a power transmission corridor, which relates to the field of disaster monitoring, and comprises the steps of establishing a three-dimensional main coordinate system of a chain pile-cross section-time by taking a central line of a power transmission line as a reference, and constructing a corridor multidimensional coordinate system; mapping a geographic observation point to corridor space coordinates through a space projection mapping relation, performing time resampling and covariance constraint spatial interpolation on multi-source monitoring data to achieve space-time alignment, constructing a fused disaster monitoring matrix, embedding uncertainty dimensions in the matrix, dividing each corridor local unit in the disaster monitoring matrix into a four-quadrant structure, modeling a coupling relation among disaster seeds through a Copula function, embedding map regularization constraint to obtain a multidimensional matrix, slicing the multidimensional matrix embedded with the disaster coupling relation, extracting local risk views, and outputting a risk cube with a confidence interval. The application breaks through the limitation of traditional two-dimensional geography or single disaster monitoring.

title_ko: 지진재해 지역위험도 평가를 통한 현업 지원 방법 및 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 지진재해 지역위험도 평가를 통한 현업 지원 시스템은, 각 지역 별로 지질학적 데이터 및 지역 단층 구조를 포함하는 지진 정보를 수집하거나, 지진 관련 관측 장치로부터 실시간으로 지진재해 관련 관측 정보를 수집하는 정보 수집장치; 수집된 지질학적 데이터와 더불어 건축물의 구조 유형, 내진 설계 기준, 그리고 지진 취약도 데이터를 조합하여 각 건축물의 피해 위험도를 산출하고, 지진 발생 가능성이 기준보다 높은 지역을 대상으로 지질학적 데이터 및 지역 단층 구조를 수집 및 분석하여 해당 지역의 지진 위험성을 평가하는 지진재해 평가장치; 상기 지역별로 산출된 건축물 피해 위험도를 격자 기반의 공간 분석 기법을 통해 지진재해 위험도 지도로 시각화하고, 시각화된 지진재해 위험도 지도를 기반으로, 특정 지역의 우선 대응 필요성을 판단하고, 내진 보강 및 방재 계획 수립을 지원하며, 평가된 데이터와 시각화를 종합적으로 분석하여 지역, 정부 및 관련 기관에 실시간으로 제공하기 위한 플랫폼을 구축하는 현업 지원 장치; 및 상기 지진재해 평가장치로부터 해당 지역의 지진 위험성 평가 결과를 제공받거나, 상기 현업 지원 장치로부터 지진재해 위험도 지도를 제공받거나, 평가된 데이터와 시각화를 종합적으로 분석한 결과를 제공받는 사용자 단말장치를 포함할 수 있다.
